On to the important part, not my vegan insanity. The buns. And I mean these are THE buns I have dreamed about for months. The daily special was a cinnamon bun covered in gooey sweet icing, covered in a sweet red strawberry-ish syrup, and topped with cinnamon sugar and oats. It tasted like a fancy danish pastry, all warmed up and fresh, and vegan. OOOOOOHHHH it was good. 

Folks, eat here. Forget the stale donuts that were made at 3 am and have been sitting in a cold glass case, just do yourself a favor and eat here. Seriously. I don't even thing I can look at any other pastry now without getting mad because they just aren't as good as Cinnaholic. 

That is all.

Wow....this roll I am eating right now is AMAZING ! I went in because I'm trying to go vegan and living in the Sacramento area doesn't give me many choices for dessert type food. Happened to be in Berkeley for work and I remembered reading about Cinnaholic in a magazine.  The shop is very cute, the people were super nice and the selection was huge. I actually got a little overwhelmed with my choices of frostings and toppings. I had to ask the girl at the counter for help and she did just that. Very, very yummy treat that NO ONE would believe is vegan. HAPPY EARTH DAY!

shocked I never wrote a review for them.  Hands down it's a favorite among the students.  Come in just for the smell.

I love that nice soft gooyness.

The owners and workers are super nice..  Patient too

Just tried them this morning - they are like Stone Cold creamery but for Cinnamon buns- truly awesome!!

They cost about $4-5 / each but worth it! 

My advice is review their menu online so you can figure out what you want before you get there... it was agonizing for me to decide on one so I got 4!   Did I mention they were VEGAN!!?  Being a vegetarian with no eggs in my diet I am in Dessert Heaven!  
When I wen to pay with my credit card  and asked for a receipt I was handed an ipad and filled in my email and they sent it to my Yahoo account- how cool is that?
Mike/ Oakland

i have been thinking about getting my hands on these buns all day! i guess i have to wait until monday...

i am saving the 5th star for the brownie i saw listed on the menu yesterday, don't let me down!

-7/28 - the brownie was great...

I try to head over to Berkeley on Saturdays to enjoy my fav East bay foods since moving to SF from Berkeley in '09. It's pretty awesome/sucks that all these great veg restaurants opened up right after I moved but thanks to BART they will be mine! We stopped by Saturn to use a Groupon (also omfg delicious) and I specifically skipped out on a shake to have room for a glorious cinnholic roll. This was my first time but hopefully not the last. The menu is vast and incredibly mouth watering; I don't know how people can decide in under 60 seconds. I ended up with peach icing and coconut topping. IT WAS DIVINE. The cinnamon roll itself is so delicious it doesn't need any toppings but they were equally fantastic. The BF ordered the chocolate chip cookie dough roll and nearly died eating it. It's insanely decadent, like breakfast and dessert in one. I was pretty stoked they have vegan marshmallow, that will be on my next roll. Love that their POS is on an iPad, super convenient.
I love cinnamon rolls, and am usually disappointed.  Not here, these are the best I've ever had (and I'm not a vegan)!

5 stars for these 5 reasons:

1. Best Cinnamon Rolls ever. I opted for maple with fresh raspberries, I highly recommend this. Also the PB&J was fantastic. 

2. Nicest employees ever.  We were coming from out of town and called because we weren't going to make it before they closed.  They  stayed open a few minutes late for us and seemed almost as excited for us to try the rolls as we were. 

3. Baby buns.  Miniature cinnamon rolls. I have a weak spot for things tiny and adorable. 

4. Humorous / clever tip jar. 

5. They travel well too.  Brought a bunch back to Los Angeles and they tasted just as great the next morning. 

It would be a dream come true if they opened in Los Angeles. wink wink ;)  We have nothing like this here and many hungry vegans.

Small little cinnamon rolls with dough consistent with that of say pillsbury style white rolls and ample frosting. They have a lot of toppings, but for 4$ + it's simply not worth it. It tries to be chic I guess, which some would say justifies the price? I guess it would satisfy those who think cinnamon rolls are exemplified by mall and airport Cinnabons; these people would find Cinnaholic to be just divine, but for anyone else you'll be left wanting something more for this much money.

Yum! I always get the old skool roll. No one can believe it's vegan.
Not overly sweet either. Maybe if you get all those toppings and different rolls it would be much sweeter. 

This is a special treat when I've done an especially good job at being vegan, which rarely happens. Like I said, special treat. 

Sometimes the wait is a bit long but nothing horrendous. Not a lot of seating but it's right across the street from a nice stretch of UC- grass so it's good picnic fare as well!

delicious gourmet cinnamon rolls. wouldn't have even guessed they were vegan. it's really awesome that the toppings are put on right when you order. very well sized portions and just great tasting rolls overall. definitely try their specialty rolls- they're their specialties for a reason! whenever anyone visits me in berkeley, i'm sure to bring them here. definitely worth a try!!

my favorites:
raspberry lemonade (lemon frosting with raspberries and lemons on top)
apple pie (cream cheese frosting with apples and apple pie crumblies on top)

I received a very nice message from one of the owners and had to change my four star review to five. When a business owner takes the time to thank their customer, this is surely a business that I want to keep going to.

Outstanding.  The extras are good but the bun itself is really remarkable.  Soft but substantial and perfectly spiced.  

Thanks for existing and being vegan.  Former over latter, they're mutually exclusive to me.

I hoped I'd like this place and ended up loving it. 

I stopped by the tidy and cute little shop about 15 minutes before closing. I usually avoid going to food places so near the end of the day. It makes me super uncomfortable when you can tell the staff is annoyed. 

None of that at Cinnaholic! The two people working  gave off a really friendly vibe. 

I chose the original with chocolate chips to go. And by the time I got around to eating my roll it was 45 minutes later and no longer warm. That said, even cold it was absolutely delicious...not too sugary and very light and fluffy. I can't wait to try another flavor. 

Bonus - The adorably hip girl called me "miss" as she was hanging me my bun box. I cringe every time I'm called "ma'am" (which seems to happen a lot lately) so I loved this.

I'm very much not vegan, but I LOVED IT! I got a roll with caramel frosting, raspberries, and graham crackers. Soooooo delicious. I cannot wait to go back and get the maple frosting. Sadly they were out when I went. The girl behind the counter was super friendly. Yum yum :)

Best cinnamon rolls ever.

You would never know they're vegan.

My favorite is the Peanut Butter and Jelly roll.

In response to other reviews: I love that they're sweet, I love that they're gooey, I love that they're soft on the inside and a little crunchy on the outside, and the price has never been an issue.  And I love the tattoos and the piercings.  Everyone's always really excited that we're there, and apologizes if we have to wait.  Some have complained about freshness, but every time I'm there, I see buns coming out of the oven and going directly to customers.

Mmmm....Piping hot icing, sugary goodness, crunchy yet also somehow soft roll...Cinnaholic is my new guilty pleasure.  For toppings, you can't go wrong with the original flavor icing, cookie dough, and bananas. Yes, cookie dough and bananas (a combination that originated one day when my sister and I split a roll and wouldn't compromise on topping choice)!!  The rolls are huge so I recommend sharing.  

Sweet sugary deliciousness aside, what I like most about this place is that you can indulge and leave with a clear conscience.  Vegan ingredients means there's one less product supporting (bad) commercial dairy & egg farms.  And everything you use to enjoy your treat is compostable (utensils) or recyclable (plate).  (Containers are by the refrigerated section/order counter)

So head on in to Cinnaholic and satisfy that sweet tooth!

After a delicious brunch across the street at Gather, my omnivorous sweetheart and I decided it was high time we tried Cinnaholic - we'd tried to go a few times but had been in a car and unable to find parking: the eternal curse of downtown Berkeley. But now the stars had aligned! Or, you know, the sun.

The gentleman behind the counter (who turned out to be Florian himself)  was super nice. We got two to split, the Old Skool and the Mocha Almond. They're a little spendy, but really? They're a completely vegan business using non-hydrogenated oils and evaporated cane juice - cheap isn't always better, and they're not that much more expensive than airport Cinnabons!

The rolls were warm, sweet and tasty! And even with all the frosting we didn't feel gross afterwards, which can be a problem with baked goods. We'll probably split one next time, or perhaps get two Baby Buns so we can experiment more with all the toppings. Pomegranate and walnuts? Don't mind if I do!

Thanks to Groupon, I found this place.

A++++ Cinnamon rolls! 
Rolls are very delicious and sweet enough!
very friendly serivce!

Incredible cinnamon rolls. It's hard to believe that they're vegan-friendly. I defy anyone to be able to truly tell the diffence between a cinnaholic vegan cinnamon roll and any "regular" roll out there.

Pretty darn good. I would never be able to tell it was vegan!

You can't go wrong with the old school rolls. They're delicious with vanilla frosting and some fresh fruit toppings. Just writing this review is making me drool.

Be sure to stop here on your birthday and claim your free roll! I went and expected them to give me something small, but that's not the case at all. I asked the guy working (who was super friendly and nice) what I was able to get, and he said ANYTHING I wanted! D: Heaven. Too bad they ran out of all berries except blackberries... but that's okay. The guy was funny and apologized for "lying" to me about giving me anything I wanted.

Cinnaholic is a great place to satisfy your sweet tooth without overindulging. Oh yeah! Show your Cal ID and get a discount. :O)

This place is amazing. I live in LA and they shipped out a dozen of their Cinnamon Rolls with a plethora of icing options ranging from Carmel all the way to Blackberry. I can't tell how how awesome these things are.... But lets just say, productivity in the office went way up when I passed them around. 

I wish I lived closer do I can get them on a regular basis for I am now a fully fledged Cinnaholic.

SOOOO GOOOOD!!!!!!

If your not into vegan, don't let that throw you off. You would never know they don't have butter or eggs. These are the best cinnamon rolls I've ever had. Besides, haven't you always wanted to apply the personalization of choosing frozen yogurt toppings to cinnamon rolls? 

The staff is always nice, they utilize yelp check in offers, they use an iPad/square combo to check you out, have rotating local art on the walls, and they have a customer loyalty program. Everything seems very put together.

The only deterrent is that if you are out of the area parking can be a bit difficult. I recommend going to one of the many wonderful nearby restaurants (Jupiter?) for a meal and then frequenting Cinnaholic for desert afterwards. Be careful with timing, though, they close early most nights.

Try the buttercream frosting with chopped walnuts as a topping.

So my friends bought me two cinnamon rolls from this place. One was with maple and pomegranates I believe and the other was a chocolate brownie thing.

Both. Were. Amazing. Cinnaholic has officially redeemed themselves by tenfold!
Love it.

I visit Berkeley once a year and I always have to come here for cinnamon buns.  They are just awsome!!! Such a huge list of icing and toppings to choose from.  I was there twice this weekend and had butterscotch icing with cookie dough topping and one with butter pecan icing.  WOW always delicious.  I so wish they had a location in Los Angeles.
Love these cinnamon rolls. All vegan, but I think they can be enjoyed by "meaties" as well. It's very cool that you can customize the rolls with frosting and toppings. I recommend you partake.
Yup.  They did it.  Look no further.  They have created the best cinnamon rolls.  I will be counting cinnamon rolls to fall asleep tonight.  Apple pie rolls, especially.
i love this place! so fantastic! if you dont know what you want ask the staff because they got all sortsa crazy delicious ideas! thanks justin and lily for being there for me!

had the mini cinnabon. very good flavor. a little dry, but i'm going to give them the benefit of the doubt and chalk it up to me getting there right before close and them not being as fresh as they could be.

Very good cinnamon rolls, but really really really REALLY sweet.

I got the cinnamon bun with plain frosting, strawberries and cookie dough chunks to share with the boy. It was really delicious but even with my gigantic sweet tooth, I was only able to eat less than half of it before the rest was surrendered to the boy for devouring.

Other things to look forward to is the nicely decorated store. It's a very small shop with not much space for big groups, but the atmosphere is nice and the staff is friendly.  There are a couple chairs and tables for sitting and eating, but I think it's too awkward to sit there and eat, especially when you're the only ones in the store.
Fantastic!  I love this place.  I really like just a plain cinnamon roll with some almond frosting, but anything is good here.  It's like Cinnabon, but twice as good, and vegan as well!

If I could take anyone to any place on earth to change their mind about what it means to be vegan this place would be it, HANDS DOWN. Where do I start? I've been vegetarian/vegan for over five and a half years and been to most of the veg restaurants in the Bay Area. Cinnaholic is clean and cute (avoiding the stereotypical "hippy vibe" that so many people I've heard seem to take issue with) with a pleasant atmosphere, friendly service and of course unbelievable food.

I've brought just about every omni friend I've been in Berkeley with over the last 1.5 years here, and have heard nothing but good things from them. My boyfriend, whose favorite spice does happen to be cinnamon, and whose favorite place to go as a kid was in fact Cinnabon, admits that Cinnaholic is "way better." I even took an "Oreo Explosion" roll to my biggest self proclaimed "carnivore" friend and he said it was "damn good stuff!" For the record, we're talking about a friend who brags about eating nothing but "plain and dry" burgers with nothing but meat (not even mayo) on them when he goes out and who wouldn't have gone anywhere near it had I told him it was vegan before I gave him. If he can get past the fact that the food here is "vegan" I know just about anyone could.

Seriously, do yourself a favor and just forget that there's anything "vegan" about this place and take it for what it is: THE spot to get the most delicious and unique cinnamon roll that you've ever had. In addition to totally satisfying any warm-sticky-gooey-yummy-pastry-craving that you're having, you get to select your own creation from a list of frosting and topping varieties that would make anyone who likes ordering complex coffee drinks at their local Starbucks envious. I once went for cherry frosting with chocolate sauce, marshmallows, walnuts, cherries, cookie dough, and chocolate chips. Yum! It's the kind of thing that brings back the feeling I got when I was a little kid at my local ice cream shop trying to cram as many toppings as my mom would let me onto my cone :)

But even if that's not your thing don't worry because they have several "special rolls" to make decisions easier. That and I honestly haven't come across any combos that haven't worked and at this point I've probably sampled at least 1/3 of their menu. Also, if you're not sure what frosting to pick their "frosting shots" are a nice way of getting a good sample--or for just managing a smaller sugar craving. 

I love this place so much that I made my guy drive me all the way up from Santa Cruz as my main birthday wish and I've had people kid me about how they suspect that I have a financial share in the ownership--I don't--but I do tell people about it because I want it to succeed. Places where a vegan like myself can take their friends, order whatever they want on the menu, and know that their friends won't feel like they're being "dragged" to some average place that happens to be vegetarian but where their friends can actually look forward to a treat that's special by any standard are too few and far between. So I'll do what I can to keep Cinnaholic around. But the truth is that if these guys just keep doing what they're doing they'll have no trouble staying around because their food speaks for itself.

I would have never found out this place it it wasn't for Groupon. I love the all of the varieties!! The cinnamon rolls are heavenly delicious!! 
They have some special rolls that are already created. And then you can also create your own with flavored frosting and many different toppings. Can't wait to keep coming back to try other flavors!
SUPER convenient to Bart!  :)
P.S. Their tip jars are hella funny. They have two jars where you can pick between where your tip goes (i.e. Romatic movies vs. Horror movies) Creative way to get people to tip more often!  :)

Can you improve a cinnamon roll by topping it with a mound of gooey frosting, multiple brownie chunks, and a generous sprinkling of chocolate chips?

Why yes. Yes, you can.

All the icing and topping flavor choices are a bit overwhelming (or at least they were to this vegan, who is not used to having choices on menus).  But you can pick one of their pre-designed specialty rolls, or just have the daily special for $4.

Been there twice; both times the rolls were fabulous. If everyone ate these, I'm pretty sure there would be world peace. Servers very nice, too.

Only downside: I am going to have to start finding detours around Berkeley or I'm going to weigh as much as a Mack truck.

I'm completely impressed with all the awesome vegan options at Cinnaholic. If you have a sweet tooth like mine, you'll love this place. I can't wait to go back and try more of the different cinnamon roll flavors and toppings! It's too bad it's in Berkeley. Maybe Cinnaholic will open a Santa Cruz location in the near future???

Guilty secret: I look on Cinnaholic's twitter page everyday and ogle at their drool-inducing photos of the $4 specials of the day. Having scheduled a cinnamon roll date with a girlfriend earlier in the week, I hoped that today's special would be amazing, and I walked in to happily discover maple pecan pie as the featured roll! We ordered that as well as the blueberry pie roll. I tasted both, but the maple frosting on the pecan one really made that roll outstanding to me. The rolls are most easily eaten with a knife and fork--messy food is the best. I found myself scraping the box for every ounce of sugar toppings that rolled off the top, as they are generous with toppings.

I admit that the icing has the potential to overpower the actual taste of the cinnamon roll bread, but I don't think one can rightfully complain of the treat being too sweet after knowingly ordering a baked good clearly doused with sugar inside and out. I mean, what does one expect with names like Oreo Explosion, Rocky Road, and the like? 

Four stars for hitting that unstoppable craving for sweet, sweet pastries. The staff are all hardcore hipsters, heavily tatted and pierced, and are always extremely nice with recommendations and cheerful small talk. I got a punch card with a free roll as an end award, which I'm afraid will encourage me to come again and again. I want a Cinnacake for my birthday.

Was sucked in by the free samples this morning. The texture is delicious, it's incredibly sweet and quite cinnamony; I don't know what the one-star reviewers complaining about texture are smoking. Do you guys work at a Cinnabon in the mall or something? I had a chocolate chip cookie dough specialty roll and it very nearly killed me. I'd give it five stars if it weren't for the price--I'd rather the rolls were half the size and only $2.50 to $3, because I could only eat half the roll anyway. Other things to be aware of: You might wait about ten minutes if you catch them at the wrong time, and just because it's vegan doesn't mean it won't send you into a diabetic coma.

I came back today and tried the peach frosting, which was superb.  Today, the cinnamon roll itself was warm and fresh, making it much more delicious than what I had on opening day.  This place definitely deserves 4-5 stars.

I tried a cinnamon bun with blueberries on top, and it was pretty good for a vegan cinnamon rolls. I liked that it wasn't too sweet or buttery. 

My husband got one with butterscotch frosting I think. It was quite good. 

The only thing I would like more is a vegan cream cheese like icing because this icing was WAY too sweet and gave me a headache afterwards. Also the menu board is very confusing and there are so many options and when there's a line you feel you have to make it quick. 

I was visiting friends who live in Berkley and it was neat to have a vegan cinnamon bun shop in town. 

There seems to be a long line up and the staff are not really friendly or engaging, they're just working like machines.  I would have wanted to talk to the owner and say hi or something as I'm a vegan chef myself. The San Francisco area has so many more exclusively vegan restaurants and cafes. 

This place seems to be popular so I think it will be around for a while.

Excellent pairing of sweetness from the roll and De La Paz coffee.  I recommend getting the Old Skool and a coffee for the first time visitor.  It was perfectly soft but not gooey and warm out of the oven.  They have many selections of flavorings of frosting as well as toppings but it seems like it would get pricey fast.  I think I'll return but just stick with the Old Skool, it's so good just the way it is!  We did wait about 10 minutes for the next batch of rolls to come out of the oven but the customer service was really great and it was definitely tasty enough to wait.

Yes the cinnamon rolls are amazing as you can tell from the hundreds of other reviews.  However, try the chocolate chip cookie or take it home for $1.50.  It is the best chocolate chip cookie I ever had.

I had the cinnamon roll with vanilla frosting and pecans.  They forgot to add apples I requested, but I will be back because it was moist and just the right mix of flavors.  I'm a big cinnamon fan, though.  It was not busy on a Friday afternoon.  I would recommend it as a detour, not a destination.

A picture of an inappropriat hand gesture on the wall - so leave the kids in the car.  I did.

Oh hi, Cinnaholic. Finally I've tried you. Thanks to the Groupon deal, I got my moneys worth. Not that their prices are ridiculously high... but the Groupon deal (50% off) made my first trip aweeeesome.

Well on to the cinnamon rolls. I got their old skool roll ($4.25) with vanilla frosting and two toppings: strawberries and pecans (.50 cent each topping) -- oh and I must say... it was sooooooo good.

My friend got a chocolate chip cookie dough specialty roll ($5) and she said it was okay. The roll itself is good, in my opinion. There's tons of frosting flavors to choose from that you can put on your roll (extra .25 cent) and also lots of toppings! Mix and match, yum.

The vibe inside the shop was nice, customer service was great. There are only two bar tables though, so it's really not a sit-down place where you can enjoy your cinnamon rolls... but there's always that Starbucks beside it, where you can pair your rolls with coffee. :)

Check out their website -- I know a lot of people purchase their 6 or 12-roll packages.

Try this place if you're craving for some freshly baked cinnamon rolls!

Oh, and the 1 star down? Well.. the price is a little bit too steep for rolls...

I'm going to keep this simple and sweet--just like Cinnaholic's cinnamon rolls.

This place is fantastic! They truly have the best cinnamon buns I have ever tasted. Considering they are vegan, that's really saying something.

I just love everything about my experience with this place.  First, I was able to get a hold of their menu online to understand how they make "cakes" to order, the frosting flavors, the toppings, the themes.  Second, when I called to place my order and explained my situation - vegan wife's birthday the next day, but needed the cake that very day - they were friendly, professional, helpful on the phone, recommending a frosting to go with the chosen toppings.  Third, it was there waiting for me when I arrived and what beautiful cake!  Fourth, the gorgeous lady behind the register, with her kick-ass rockability hair cut, cool tattoos and piericings, was so cool, so obviously into the product and service she was delivering, it made me want to go out of my way every day just to partake of the good vibes.  

Fifth, and most important, UNBELIEVABLY DELICIOUS CAKE!!!  Hard to describe the awesome taste of perfect cinnamon roll, maple frosting, blackberries, vegan brownie bits, and vegan cookie dough, all delicately arranged and beautifully presented.  Big hit with my wife and kids, it just topped off a perfect birthday.

Thank you, Cinnaholic, I plan to be back (to indulge myself) and I hope my wife thinks of you for my own birthday :) !!
Amazing, vegan, and soooo fresh! Worth the price and friendly staff.
YES. Cinnaholic is great! Fun decor, yummy treats, cute staff, AND all vegan! What more do you want? XOXOXOXO
So friggin good.  I got the cookie dough cinnamon roll.  I don't think I have had a cinnamon roll this tasty in my life.  Can't wait to go back!

I got the mocha almond cinnamon roll the other day and it was quite good! It was pretty big (it costed me $5), and I don't think my student discount did me any good. I love how they have a huge variety of toppings though! And as a vegan...I love the entire concept! On the other hand, (being the health conscious person I am) if they had a variety of "healthier" cinnamon rolls (whole grains anyone?), or a smaller option, that would be nice too! I can't wait to come back and try out another interesting flavor...it'll be half the day in calories, but I'm sure it'll be worth it!

Ooooohhhhhh mmmmmyyyyyyy GGGGGooooooddddddd  I am in love with this place.  I have been twice, once back in March and then yesterday.  By far the best choice is the Old Skool I think.  I tried a fancy one my first time, and while it was good, it seemed a little overdone.  My fault!!  I should have kept it simple.  Got the Old Skool yesterday and I thought I would s**t my pants when I ate it on the way home in the car.  These are (thankfully) must smaller than anything from Cinnabon but still my husband was blown away when I finished it in like less than 5 minutes!  I could have eaten like 50 more, so it's good that I don't live in Berkeley.  
I have had vegan cinnamon rolls before, but none have ever been like this.  Sweet, of course, but not too sweet, and soft and chewy.  It was even cold when I ate it and I didn't even care.
I will be going back to this place again and again and again every time I'm in Berkeley!!
Thank you Cinnaholic for making my Sunday!

Finally got around the trying the vegan cinnamon buns.  I've bookmarked this place for a long time now.  I've never had a vegan cinnamon bun before and I'm not Vegan but I must say that the cinnamon bun didn't blow me away.  Maybe because I haven't tried a whole lot of vegan pastries so I don't know if this is actually good considering that it's vegan or not.  But usually I would think that a cinnamon roll/bun would be kinda chewy - theirs was soft.  I order the special which had berries and granola on top.  It cost $4.  I agree that it's kind of pricey for a cinnamon bun.  The cinnamon bun tasted good, but the texture wasn't so great.  The staff was really nice.

I first went to Cinnaholic after all the craze and went for their classic normal roll with regular frosting.  I also got hazelnut frosting on the side.  The roll itself was a bit dry, but the hazelnut frosting was delicious.  Overall though, the frosting coudn't make up for sub-par cinnamon roll itself.  

The second time I went there, I got there maple special roll, which had walnuts on top.  Again, the roll (which is freshly baked but just not flavorful, rich, or moist enough) was unsatisfying.  If the walnuts were candied or something, then it might have been special, but they were just regular walnuts thrown on top.


My major gripes: 
-unflavorful roll that is not moist or rich; hardly cinnamon flavor
-really small roll for $4 - $5; I would much rather get something much fancier and delicious for Crixa Cakes or something for much less



Staff is nice.  Limited seating.  But sub-par product.

Wowzers!
These are hands down the best cinnamon rolls that I have ever tasted! The entire thing taste like the inner most circle of typical cinnamon rolls- need I say more? They have so many options for flavors, topping and frosting! Wow and to think they are vegan is perplexing to say the least- sweetened with beets or something. I am still in shock of how good these things are.

I consider these a major dessert. Thats why I wish they were opened later and their store had more seating. It is best to take these to go and eat them some where picnicy with a coffee ( hint* starbucks is right around the corner!) ..

SO TASTY! I got a roll with orange frosting and it was so good. I also got a shot of root beer frosting to go, but was a little afraid to try it. The idea of root beer frosting didn't sound too good. But let me tell you, it was freaking delicious. MMMMM.

I live in North Oakland but never really get over to campus area to often so I decided to check out Center St.  I'm walking around and run into this place and just get pulled in by the smell!  Customizable "vegan" cinnamon rolls?!  Really?  They are so tasty and I really like the daily special idea because it helps when you are overwhelmed by the toppings.  I take mine home and pop em in the micro for 15 secs and you are good to go!

This is my GO- TO SPOT for a quick sugar fix.  The cinnamon rolls come out soft and warm, and you can ask to have an array of toppings to put on your roll. Whenever my parents come to visit me from out of town, we make it a point to stop off here.  Luckily, I discovered this gem on a living social voucher I paid $5 for $10 worth of baked goods.  Awesome!

Cinnaholic! You are so swwwweeeeeeeeeett! My faves are the Old Skool, butter pecan, and the smores one. The people who work there are extremely nice and friendly. And it's right next to Saturn Cafe! Get a vegan burger and fries, and then go get a cinnamon roll for dessert! Whoohoo!

Vegan Cinnamon rolls??? My first thought was gross...but after I tried it...OMG It's sooooo good!!! I prefer this over Cinnabon any day! We got it right when it came out of the oven so it was still hot. Pure bliss! =)

The only thing I didn't like was how you have to pay 50 cents for each topping...and they aren't that generous with it =/ When i chose strawberries...I expected many slices on top; however, there were only 3 small slices...NOT EVEN A WHOLE STRAWBERRY FOR 50 CENTS..?! It's okay though, I still enjoyed every bite!

TIP: Make sure you show them your student ID to get the regular roll for only $3!

I don't know what to say other than this is pretty much the best place for any baked goods anywhere in the bay area.  I will plan my whole weekend around these delicious cinnamon rolls - and I've taken friends who didn't like cinnamon who confirm that ALL of their goodies are delicious!

These rolls are the real deal and I usually eat through a whole Cinnabon on my own - but this place has actual choices for frostings and toppings. I have been here on two occasions and both times the rolls were so delicious. I even ordered a cinna-cake once for a friend's b-day. You walk in there and its very simplistic in its decor - you would think you entered one of those upscale cupcake bakeries - the iPad payment process is neat. The staff is friendly and the establishment is very laid back. It's a bummer there's no south bay location. However, now they are able to ship!!!! I recently ordered a half dozen for my special someone and they were easy to work with in terms of shipping over a weekend. Not only are the rolls worth the drive - but, this is some of the most top notch customer service I've ever received.

This is the best place ever! It's such a funky Berkeley eatery. They have kick-ass VEGAN cinnamon buns. The staff is always really nice and energetic. It can get a bit busy since it's right near Cal, but it's well worth the wait for a roll, especially if it means you'll get a fresh one. There are tons of options for toppings and frostings (all vegan friendly), and you can make your own yummy combinations, or choose from pre-made combos. I definitely recommend Cinnaholic.

Just stopped by this cute shop yesterday with a friend. There are endless choices here and the girl at the counter was extremely helpful in helping us make a choice.

We ended up getting one of the special pie cinnamon buns, blackberry. It was big enough for the two of us to split and be satisfied. Can't believe that it was vegan! The dough was delectable. 

Totally would recommend people to go try it out. And they do offer discounts to Cal students, which is definitely a plus, since their prices are a bit steep.

I went here a few weeks ago and had a remarkable taste-bud experience. I discovered Cinnaholic via Instagram App for iPhone when an acquaintance posted a delicious looking photo of a pecan cinnamon roll. 

So I checked it out on yelp to find that it was only a 15 minute bus ride from my house AND there was a check in deal. Delicious. I ate that cinnamon roll and immediately wanted another four! hah... Delicious. Totally going back on my next day off.

I can imagine dying ungracefully while consuming one of these sugary treats, and I'll always think of Jim Gaffigan's bit on Cinnabon, but at least I'd die happy.  And I better have eaten the whole thing prior to croaking.

Okay I had the gone bananas which was soooo good, it had kind of a bananas foster feel,  and the strawberry pie is to die for.  These are very good and I would like to try more and I will very soon.  Please give it a try you have many choices to choose from be creative.

First visit here. The overwhelmingly number of 5 stars makes me think I might have missed something. Regardless, I wanted to give it a shot after passing by the small store so many times. 

Menu has a variety of toppings/frostings/specialties. And the moment you walk in, there is a display of some of the rolls that you can customize and whatnot. I ended up with the special which was apple pomegranate because...it was the daily special...Anyways, it was okay. A little bit on the sweeter side for 11 am in the morning, but I definitely appreciated the fact that it was warm and fresh. Lady behind the counter was nice too, so that was cool. 

Price starts at a basic for $4, and keeps adding. Likely paying a little more than what you're getting, but I'm not regretting that I tried it. If you're wondering whether to try it for the first time, then that's a yes. I don't know if I could come back on some timely basis, however.

Cute place, custom cinnamon rolls, and reasonable prices!

I came here to get breakfast for my boyfriend and I. I got a cinnamon roll with peaches and pina colada frosting MMMM so good! And I got him a cinnamon roll with vanilla frosting and strawberries + blueberries. Admittedly, his looked much prettier...

The variety and possible combinations of cinnamon rolls here are amazing, giving people plenty of reasons to come back. I also really liked the service here - I was the only one there that morning, so the guy behind the counter would make friendly conversation with me while he made my cinnamon rolls (about classes, life, my day, etc), so I didn't feel impatient at all while waiting as he carefully crafted the desserts.

I can't wait to come back and try some bananas on my cinnamon rolls!
Great concept and great food!

Very nice staff! My bff and I wanted something peanut butter and chocolate and voila! She suggests the daily special which is a chocolate chip peanut butter banana cinnamon roll and mmmm~ It was delicious! Although I wish I had heated it up because it's not as enjoyable when it's at room temp.  I also wish that the insides were a bit more gooey-er and cinnamony. 

I do love how you can customize your own cinnamon roll and all the different flavors that they offer!

Super delicious vegan cinnamon roles!  I've come on numerous occasions.  Even my (omnivorous) family loved this place.  The bakers are very friendly and accommodative.  Once I placed an order the night before an event for two dozen cinnamon role cupcakes and they were able to prepare them by 9am the next morning.  I would highly recommend Cinnaholic to anyone and everyone.

DELICIOUS CUSTOMIZED CINNAMON ROLLS!! Seriously, it's so hard to choose what flavor I want because the options are nearly endless...and can't believe these are VEGAN (you can't tell AT ALL). Finally found a dessert that I don't feel guilty indulging in.. =p

Hmmmmm, I never thought I'd be hooked on a vegan treat....guess what??? I am!!!! I visited here with a classmate for the first time on a Friday afternoon, and I must say, I'm hooked! I wasn't sure what to order, so I had a simple cinnamon roll (Old School Roll) as they call it, topped with shredded coconut flakes. Yummmm! The roll was so warm and just sweet enough (not too much, not too little).

I would have rated 5hot stars, but I took off a star for the price and the demeanor of the employees. They weren't mean or anything, but they kinda had an attitude..

..I think this is gonna my fave spot whenever I'm on campus and craving something sweet. Plus, show your CAL student ID card and get a discount!

Yummy! 

Made a special trip to Berkley to use our Groupon and it was completely worth it, I didn't know vegan could taste so good. The frosting is definitely the best part of the roll and is chocked full of sugar.  My only negative is their was not a lot of cinnamon in the cinnamon roll.

My husband decided to get the Oreo Overload which was vanilla icing, Oreo pieces and chocolate chips. He said it was definitely a sugar overload (pun intended) but that is what he was looking for. I got the Blackberry Pie roll which was vanilla icing, graham cracker crumble and blackberries of course. 

Although Berkley is a 35 minute BART ride from our home; we will be back.

Don't be afraid of the "Vegan" label, if your into baked goods (especially cinnamon rolls) this place will not disappoint.  I'm more of a traditionalist and ordered their no frills cinnamon roll.  Anyone can topple on loads of sweet things with an attempt to "shock and awe" the sweet seeker but when you can do it with your "base" , nuff said!  This cinnamon roll was topped with just enough vanilla frosting to allow for equal parts dough to sugar input.  But it wasn't like you needed to use the frosting to help choke down the tough outer ring of the roll like soo many other places.  This roll was supple from the first bite of the outer ring till the nirvana center.  It was an act of god that I didn't march right back in and get another one.  If your looking for sweets look no further

Cinnaholic is amazing. The cinnamon rolls are freshly baked all day, and it makes all the difference in the world. My favorite rolls are the pie rolls, especially peach. The light fruit balances the richness of the rolls. I had a bite of both the smore and cookie dough rolls. While they're delicious, they're a bit too rich for my liking.
There's no reason not to come here if you're in the Bay Area. I just hope they start making a coconut frosting soon!

Yes, nice, sweet buns but I wonder why all so much fuss. Plus (or rather minus), the staff - totally uninterested in service. I was the only person trying to buy while the man behind the counter kept on chatting with his two friends. I felt like he is doing me a favor selling a bun for $5 (no receipt, no thank you).  Maybe it's the vegan attitude...

I came here for the first time during finals week of Summer 2010 (while vegan).
I came here again during freshman year (while vegan).
And I made a third return recently after bio 1A lab (after Guate. aka I will eat almost anything).

What do all these events have in common? I was stressed as HECK.
Something about a warm, gooey, cinnamon bun customized to your liking is so satisfying.

Service is friendly. Food is good. (I actually wanted to apply to work here)

I'm sad they don't have their $4 daily specials anymore :(

I didn't even notice/know that these sweet yummy buns were vegan. I didn't care! They were good! my boyfriend and i shared the daily special for the day. i forgot what it was called but it had caramel frosting and fresh apples, i wanted to order another one but i had to practice some self control! i recommend this place, everyone should go now!

My husband and I are addicted to this place. The food is awesome and decadent (by decadent I mean like eating a big slice of rich cheese cake decadent: rich, heavy, gooey, thick). The prices are reasonable; ost of the (very creative) specialty rolls are around 5bucks.  I highly suggest the cookie dough! The staff are genuinely nice, laid back, and professional all at the same time. The atmosphere is clean, sanitary, simple, and hip. 
And the food is vegan, down to the marshmallows and cookie dough. This place kicks ass.

this place is the cutest!  and i'm not just talking about their limited edition snail hearts cinnamon roll t-shirt.  we stood there staring at the endless combinations of frostings and toppings before using our groupon to purchase a s'mores specialty roll and a lemon frosting/strawberry topped creation we invented.  so delicious.   chocolate soy milk was the perfect beverage to enjoy these rolls at one of the tables outside on the sidewalk.  then we somehow walked 3 doors down and stuffed ourselves again at saturn cafe.  college kids these days are so lucky!
O.M.G. Speechless. Nothing to say, except GO HERE. Now. Seriously. Just go here.

I've had better cinnamon rolls for cheaper. 

The student discount was a pleasant surprise, though.

This is definitely my go-to dessert spot when I feel like I need a break from studying at the Starbucks nextdoor. 

The staff here is super super nice! 

The specialty rolls are normally $5, but everyday they have a "special-of-the-day" where a particular specialty cinnamon roll is only $4! You can also make your own roll! 

They make everything to order, so it's always super fresh and warm when you get it (who doesn't love warm fluffy dough dripping with frosting?) 

They have a bunch of toppings and different flavored frosting, so the possibilities are endless!! 

For all the Instagrammers - Cinnaholic also has an Instagram (@cinnaholic) and everyday they post a picture and description of their special-of-the-day! 

They also have a frequent buyer card - after buying 10 rolls, you get one for freeeeeeeee!

The best damn cinnamon roll you've ever had. Yes it's vegan, but you would never know it. There are campy punk-rock decorations, tons of delicious frosting flavors and toppings, mini-cinnabuns, brownies, a creative special every time, and a student discount. I cannot overstate how good these taste- especially straight out of the oven. Drool.

Best cinnamon rolls ever, vegan or not. Excellent texture, not too sweet. Millions of choices in terms of toppings and frosting, but if you just want a good old-fashioned cinnamon roll, you can't go wrong with the Old School Roll. Parking is definitely a pain, so go in the morning on a weekday if you're driving. I'll be returning to try their more adventurous rolls, but I have a feeling that the Old School Roll is already my favorite.

4 stars for DELICIOUS cinnamon buns! frosting was as good as Cinn-a-bon, only vegan! the variety of toppings is overwhelming... 

minus 1 star for atmosphere.... there wasn't any. at all. also... the display case was super sparse.  there are so many topping choices and no way of really telling what seems like a good idea... perhaps a book of photos of different buns that people have put together.... just to help people visualize what is possible. 

anyhow... it was a damn good bun

Wonderful tasty treats with wonderful choices for add ins.  My little one was excited to see it made.  The food is so tasty and the service so kind that one can overlook the vegan factor and how long it takes to order.

Yelp tip: Check in before you walk in, I checked in after I inhaled my food then got a check-in offer for free frosting or topping.

When visiting the Bay Area, Cinnaholic is a MUST! I've been here three times, but have had six cinnamon rolls, service is always great, limited seating, but they put it in a to-go box and you can enjoy it across the street on campus. Please open one in Los Angeles!

Hi, I'm Aaron. And I'm a Cinnaholic.

Whenever I think of that warm gooey cinnamon center, I just can't resist. Soo good. Soo addictive. No wonder they can get away with charging crack prices.

If you've never been, here's how it works. This place is vegan, but you'd never know it. You get a cinnamon bun as a base, and you can customize it with any flavor of icing (such as regular, strawberry, caramel, butterscotch, maple, etc) and any topping (such as brownie bits, cookie dough, bananas, strawberries, etc). You pay upwards of $5 and your cinnamon bun is ready to go within 3 minutes. Make sure to ask for the customer loyalty card - you'll be back.

Also, for best results: ask for one fresh out of the oven and extra frosting.

A big fan of pastries and a sweet tooth aching, I was excited to try Cinnaholic.  I remember the first time I tried Cinnabon and how amazing it was so I had the same state of mind coming in to this small store.  At the front of the counter are the day's specials.  Cinnaholic's main deal is a cinnamon roll with toppings.  But how clever they are.  Topping combinations that you've never even heard of for cinnamon rolls!  I rolled the dice and tried the cookie dough special.  The staff member gave me a hot one right out the oven!  She hooked it up with the toppings and handed me the warm gooey goodness.  It was soft, warm, soo delicious!  Best of all it wasn't so big and sweet to make your tummy ache.   It was just enough to walk away satisfied.
Thanks Cinnaholic!  I'll be back!
Street parking is tough in this area.
only THE WORLD'S BEST CINNAMON ROLLS!!!  perfect in every way.

Ok, so I tried this place out because I bought a groupon and it is AMAZING!  Not only is it vegan, but it's SO GOOD!  I had the "Go Banana" - banana frosting, fresh bananas, chocolate syrup, walnuts!  What more could you ask for??  I will be back!!!

OH. MY..... so delicious!! I started by taking one bite from my bun....that one bite turned into two, then three. After eating half of the darn thing, I decided to save it for later as an after-workout treat. Unfortunately, right when I closed the to-go box, my mouth started to water and I started to have some withdrawal symptoms. Not a good sign, so I had to remedy it by eating the rest of my bun. I normally have fantastic self-control seeing as I'm a vegan and all, but SHEESH. I really could not get enough of this bun. Absolutely glorious! I will have to come back ASAP!

A friend of mine was giving her dissertation proposal to a group of professors, and it's apparently departmental policy to provide snacks to your committee. A professor on her committee eats vegan, so she asked me to run to Cinnaholic and pick up 4 cinnamon rolls.

Despite having walked by the storefront about a thousand times, I had no clue this place was a vegan cinnamon roll store. And, after tasting the cinnamon rolls, I am convinced that if no one had told me beforehand that these rolls were vegan, that I still would have no clue. I'm not averse to vegan food, but I really was surprised at how rich the frosting and roll were without butter or cream. I'm not about to go vegan or anything, but if it were somehow healthy to eat only cinnamon rolls on a vegan diet, I would so do it.

While I was waiting for the rolls to be prepared (they're all made fresh! I got to watch them come out of the oven!), I couldn't help but admire how adorable the interior of the store is. Neat displays of mouth-watering rolls, checkered tile floor, hand-written signs. I was also inappropriately excited at how they check out using an iPad app, where you can get your receipt emailed to you. So much efficiency! 

As long as you've got ~$4 and 10 minutes to wait, you can look forward to the best vegan dessert ever. TREAT YO SELF.

Maple frosting with strawberries! The end. No, really, this is an incredible place. They pretty much just do cinnamon rolls, and they do them well. Do yourself a favor next time you're feeling a little less than super and go get one of these rolls.

I waited 3 months after I found out about this place till my birthday to indulge in the deliciousness that is cinnaholic.  My creation was root beer icing with hazelnuts and chocolate chips.  It was everything I dreamed it to be, I can't wait for the next special occasion.
I think it kind of goes without saying that Cinnaholic is incredible. Try one, you'll be hooked.

Found out about this place through groupon. I was really excited to try it after reading all the positive reviews. I didn't even know cinnamon rolls were part of a vegan's vocabulary! 

I was immediately memorized by the delicious, lonely, single cinnamon rolls in the front case, which I found out were the specialty rolls ($5). Picked out the blackberry pie, mocha almond fudge, and the fudge brownie. All were delicious. They all had the same standard cinnamon roll base - the only difference was the frosting and toppings. 

you can create your own by choosing different frosting and topping combos, but I was too excited to notice the actual menu in the back 'til after I ordered. 

Service was great. The guy was friendly and personable and answered all my questions. 

Do regular cinnamon rolls taste better? Yeah. But, since they're not, I was blown away. I still can't believe they're vegan. My tummy sure couldn't tell :)

Wow, super delicious!!! We did a vegan roadtrip from LA, and this was, by far, my favorite stop on the whole trip. It was so awesome, we went back the next day and took some to go.

I got my roll with coffee frosting and chocolate chips...WOW!! So good!

Lovely place for an occasional vegan treat (occasional is the operative word; the different flavors and combos all run pretty close together so I wouldn't be able to have it more than once every few months).

i absolutely love this place. Pure ~DECADENCE~ and its always very tasty. My favorite has this really yummy maple  cream and chopped apples. 

SO YUMMY. Great place to go for dessert. And they're so big; I usually end up sharing just one.  

Highly recommend for any vegan or non.

I've tried this place a few times and it is not very consistent. On my first visit I got the Old Skool roll, which was served piping hot and was delicious. The next time I went I got the banana roll and asked them to scale back on some of the sweet topppings - even for my sweet tooth, chocolate chips, chocolate sauce, icing, bananas and nuts was just too much. Even with removing the chocolate sauce, it was just way too sweet and there were seriously like only 4 small banana slices on it.  The last time I went I had to wait for 15 minutes while they made more rolls and the clerk didn't tell me this until after I ordered, which was frustrating. Overall, it is a fun concept and can be a sweet alternative to traditional dessert or a morning pastry, but be prepared to be surprised at how expensive it can be - and bring cash - they charge you for using a debit or credit card.
Drink a lot of water when you eat one of these buns. They are rich and sweet, but soooooooooooooooooooooo good. I got a sugar high just looking at it LOL

Yup, totally great! 

Amazing food and lovely people!

Yum!!! I made a point to go here right after it opened. I am not a vegan, but I try to support and eat as much vegan as possible. This place is great. The store is tiny with two small benches outside for instant enjoyment. Or you can always walk across Oxford St. and sit in the park. Their coffee is good and strong. I recommend lemon frosting with pomegranate seeds. : )

Cinnaholic is not only a vegan delight but blows Cinnabon out of the water.  I have NEVER tasted anything as amazing as their cinnamon rolls.  I used to frequent here when they first opened and then unfortunately moved far, far away to a land with hardly any vegan food and have been utterly sad ever since 2 weeks ago when I tasted the amazing goodness again.  In the past two weeks I have eaten more rolls then should be allowed and I promise you I would rather eat one of their rolls then have sex.  Yes, I promise you they are that good!

The employees are super friendly and are always willing to help with any questions you may have.  There are way too many options so I like for them to surprise me and I have never been disappointed.  Plus they all seem super happy to work there, where do you see that anymore?

The only problem I have, besides there isn't one by me any longer, is that the rolls aren't always hot when you get them.  I love them nice and warm so they are ooey gooey on the inside.  yum, yum, yum.

Please bring Cinnaholic to Salt Lake City, I will quit my job and run your shop.

Who: Husband and me before a day of shopping in Berkeley.
What: My own Cinnabun! 
When: Saturday morning. No line! Warm bun!
Why: Excellent, tasty, vegan! And customized to what you want...What else can you ask for in a Cinnabun place?! Friendly service as well, and very well priced. (Easy parking, seating outside, and near a Starbucks if you want coffee).

This place makes *the* most amazing cinnamon rolls. The staff is always smiling and helpful, the place is clean and fun, and they have a huge selection of toppings. Cinnaholic makes the the trip to downtown Berkeley worth it.

I heard about Cinnaholic on twitter and I was oh so excited! I live in Los Angeles so I had place an order on line. They don't ship the toppings, so I did not get the full Cinnaholic experience BUT my cinnamon roll was DELISH! 

I was not happy with how the rolls arrived. I understand they have to wrap them in plastic wrap to keep the "freshness" but I thought they would at least come in a cute box (I am all about packaging!)

see pic's on my blog www.sickofeatingsidedishes.com

The best decision you will make!. Customize your gluten free Cinnamon Roll to your liking. Don't want it sitting in the frosting all day? Put the frosting on the side. Don't want all the extra calories from the butter and gunk? No problem. This is a 
   
    Dairy/lactose-free
    Egg-free
    Cholesterol-free
    Lower in saturated fat
    Made with heart-healthy soy
    Sweetened with beet sugar


 Cinnamon Roll. Placed in an environmentally friendly to-go box. 
 AMAZING! DELICIOUS! and Guilt-Free!

I wasn't in the mood for a huge roll, but I was curious to try out this legendary vegan cinnamon roll shop, so I stopped in and got a "baby bun," a two-bite pastry which was the perfect size for impulse sampling. I paid an extra quarter to doll it up with maple frosting and walnuts, and it was the best $1.50 I spent today. 

My fancied-up baby bun was tasty and satisfying. I was surprised by how rich the flavor was, especially since my favorite home recipe is little more than a thinly veiled vector for butter. The bun itself was a good balance of sweet and spice, though the dominant flavors were from the nuts and frosting. This bun is definitely meant to be a palette for the many intriguing topping options, which is where Cinnaholic displays their creativity and where the fun is to be had.

The only factor that makes me unlikely to become a regular is the concept. Truth be told, when I want to customize, I bake my own pastries, and I go to bakeries when I want choices made for me. If I baked less, I might come here more. But I may return for another taste test anyway, to steal ideas!

I don't care much for the Old Skool rolls (your classic cinnamon roll), so I always go for the more unique frosting flavors. Maple with any combination of nuts is usually pretty fantastic.

If decision-making isn't really your strong suit, go for a specialty roll or ask one of the always-friendly and helpful staff for suggestions. I recently tried Oreo Explosion, which was pretty good (I'm not even that much of an Oreo fan, so hey). The specialty pie rolls are delicious, too; the brown sugar-oatmeal crumble takes a perfectly good buns up a notch and actually makes sense as a cinnamon roll topping.

Whenever I come here, the rolls are always warm, fresh, and dressed to order--nice as an occasional indulgence for vegans and non-vegans alike.

a place completely dedicated to cinnamon rolls - what a great idea. 

i treated myself to a warm cinnamon roll with vanilla frosting and whole hazelnuts. they have such a huge selection of frosting flavors and toppings, so there's a combination for every palate. next time, i'll ask them to go lighter on the frosting though.

they are also a paper-less establishment - all orders taken on an ipad and receipts can be emailed to you if needed (but really who needs the receipt anyway.)

i'm just glad that this place wasn't around when i was at school there. my freshman 15 would have been more like freshman 50!

Yum yum yum yum.
They were playing Joy Division when we went in. 

This place is super alty with cute tattooed girls working and fun art on the chalkboard menu.

I got the pumpkin spice frosting with pecans and my fiance has the daily special which was lime frosting with cookie dough. 

We will be back!

cinnaholic is the place you take non-vegans and dare i say anti-vegans and make 'em EAT IT!

they will love it and so will you.... 

the end.

These cinnamon rolls are the best dessert iv eaten in my life. There are so many options on what you can put on them. Even people who aren't vegan that have tried them would never either know there vegan. Far far better then a cinnabon.

I hate to exactly repeat what other Yelpers are saying but gosh darn it this place is amazing. It's a vegan bakery but believe me you'll never tell the difference. There's a lot of options for signature flavor cinnamon rolls, or you can customize your own from the variety of toppings and frostings they have. I went with the oreo explosion signature roll with added caramel frosting (free frosting or topping choice with your Yelp check-in!) 

Sweet jesus this is the most delicious cinnamon roll I've ever had. The roll itself was just so fluffy, and the toppings made for a new flavor experience that made me wonder why more places don't allow you to customize your cinnamon rolls. 

Cinnaholic gets five stars for the cinnamon roll alone, but I'd give it another five stars for the tip jars (superman vs batman - who gets your money?), the friendly service, and pleasant ambience. A great find.

OMG! This place is amazingly finger licking good. If you have a student I.D. They give you a discount. I'm kind of Old School, so I ordered the original without any topping. Though next time, I'm up for the challenge! It's On! I also love their Pin Boards on Pinterest @ http://pinterest.com/cinnaholic/pins/

Split a roll with a couple of friends the other day and it was as good as I remembered it.

We got a roll with hazelnut frosting and chopped pecans.  The only complains I have were that the pecans were chopped too small & had a little bit of a stale texture.

Even though I didn't order a plain Old School roll, I still got the student discount.

Still didn't get the chance to get a freshly baked roll but I guess I just have to keep coming back until (& after) I do.
Can we say "yummaaay" haha this place is awesome!! The only problem is deciding to be good and not wanting take home more than one cinnamon roll.
Extremely delicious and I couldn't even tell it was Vegan...I would definitely visit again.

I absolutely LOVE cinnamon buns and this place did not disappoint!!! I was critical at first, because come on, how good can a VEGAN cinnamon bun really be??? But with my first bite into that soft, delicious, amazing cinnamon bun, all of my uncertainties melted away. It's reaaalllly good, like really really good. I had the classic with hazelnuts as my topping and my boyfriend had cream soda frosting and cookie dough topping - both were just so good. 

A must try if you like sweets, and especially if you like soft, gooey, yummy cinnamon buns :)

Also, don't forget to bring your CAL student ID because you get a discount if you buy one w/ the classic frosting.

Delicious amazing cinnamon buns. Irrelevant to me that they're Vegan, in other words they're not delicious & amazing vegan cinnamon buns. They're delicious & amazing & they also happen to not have animal products in them. I'm not sure what in a cinnamon bun would usually have animal products since these buns aren't missing anything (is it like advertising a fat free raisin?). I dunno, maybe traditional cinnamon buns are made with butter.  I've never made them. Their coffee is just ok and their hours are short (they should open earlier).  They are a great establishment and are still growing into their success. In a year they'll have gourmet espresso drinks and be open at 7am. I think as a small business they could definitely afford to make these investments b/c their core product truly is the best out there. They are creative business people too (using iPad for transactions, yelp deals, groupons & punch cards). I see greatness in their future & perhaps some more chains or sale of their goods in local outlets.

This place would be five stars if it weren't so expensive! The cinnamon roll I had, blackberry pie was really yummy, but way over priced. I could get a whole meal for 5-6 dollars! If they lowered their prices I would come here all the time! I am not vegan, but I try to eat less meat and dairy products so its nice to have a dessert option that isn't laden with cream and eggs. You also totally wouldn't know it was vegan if no one told you. The roll is soft and fluffy and the icing is rich and creamy! I don't know how they do it! If I come here again, I think I would want to try the s'mores or oreo one. They looked really good! The service was great, my cinnamon roll was prepared with care and the employees were super nice. I want to come to this place more but the price is too damn high!

These are definitely worth trying (if that's what you were wondering).

I am a super-sweet-tooth kinda person, and this satisfied my need for the sweet stuff. As a tip, look for their daily special as it is a discounted option to trying to make your own crazy concoction. I loved the chocolate syrup, and the cookie dough, and the wonderful gooey-ness of something sticky and chewy over a coulda-sworn-it-was-buttered cinnamon roll.

Do not be afraid to talk to the staff, they have lots of creative combinations you can try, and are more than willing to share their favorite ideas.

It's gonna sound corny, but I love this place with all my heart  :P

The best cinnamon rolls and brownies I've ever had in my life! *_* My personal favorites are the strawberry pie roll and an ol skool roll with macadamia nut frosting. My boyfriend loves the smores roll. They also have a million delicious toppings to choose from, cookies(awesome!), coffee, tea and juice. 

The shop itself is always well kept, nicely decorated (simple/elegant/unique) and really nice staff. Their prices are reasonable too. Whole foods and Rainbow grocery tend to charge twice as much for vegan sweets that are good, but aren't made fresh or can even stand a chance to Cinnaholic.

Didn't tell my nephews it was vegan and they had no clue as to vegan or not :) I only wish it was open 7 days and had some better seating but other than that, I totally love this place!

I moved here for Cinnaholic! Well not just Cinnaholic, but the whole vegan scene of the bay area. I've had a few rolls here and even had them shipped across the country when I lived in NY. Every single one was amazing and so warm and cozy.

I read some reviews that people didn't care for the texture, but I love it. I personally don't like regular cinnamon buns because they're dry and cakey. The doughy, pull apart texture of Cinnaholic's buns is perfect for me. The Old Skool Roll is my fav because it's not too sweet. I've also had the cookie dough roll and coffee and caramel frostings - they were super sweet (and delicious), but what do you expect when you're eating raw cookie dough?! 

Two tips: 
(1)The baby buns are an awesome on-the-go snack as you're passing by. 
(2) Stick the regular frosting in the freezer and eat it with a spoon. It is amazing!

Now that I'm in the bay area I plan to be a regular! Thanks for feeding my sweet-tooth, Cinnaholic!!
quality ingredients and the cutest ladies you will see for miles. the coffee is also locally roasted and super high quality. check this place out!

Wow! 

I got the cinnamon bun with plain frosting, strawberries, and graham crackers, and it was soooo good. Warm, gooey, amazing.

I loved that it did not make me feel as if I would wake up with diabetes the next morning.

However, I wish that they had graham cracker pie crust instead of the graham cracker animals; just does not taste as good.

The girl working there was super nice and I swear, food tastes so much better when the person serving you is not a jerk.

Cinnaholic does cinnamon rolls right. These rolls are large, sweet, moist and the icing in gooey. They have a whole list of toppings and frosting to choose from fruit to chocolate. You can really get creative if you feel like it. Wonderfully delicious and all vegan. I had the raspberry frosting and fresh raspberries. The next time I tried one of their specialty rolls the chocolate chip cookie dough roll. This roll was topped with cookie dough, chocolate chips, icing and chocolate syrup. My daughter declared both of the rolls equally good. Great place to visit for a decadent dessert.

My friend Jenn got me some cinnamon buns from here recently and I fell in love!  I had the "old school" which is just your basic cinnamon bun except this one was decadent, absolutely delicious (especially the frosting) and oh, did I mention, VEGAN?  Yeah, that's right.  I'm not a vegan but I always appreciate healthier alternatives that happen to be delicious.  Some friends got some of the fancier buns like Rocky Road or Fudge but I say stick with the basic cinnamon bun, you can't go wrong!  I love the cinnaholic website & aesthetic, Ashley who works there is a sweetheart and I will definitely be telling all my friends about this place!

One of the very best dessert places I've found just yesterday, and I now know why: their cinnamon is baked perfectly, and I ordered their Old School cinnamon roll (with a student discounted price of $3.50 with ID!) which really capped my brunch at next-door Sunny Side Cafe... It was really dessert heaven for me! Also has quite comfy outdoor (tall bar-style) seating looking out to Oxford Street, and it's a place that not many people know about unless you know where to look... Their cinnamon for me: 11 out of 10 (extremely outstanding)!

Props for offering vegan cinnamon rolls to the Berkeley community!

I find their cinnamon roll's okay, can sometimes be a little dry. The fun part is being able to customize the frosting and toppings to your own tastes. Students also get a discount for personalized cinnamon rolls. I like mine with pomegranate frosting and topped with strawberries and brownie pieces. 

Overall, I think this place is a unique concept.
But I think I may still prefer cinnabon's rolls.

I came here two days after my first visit, and it's still just as good. Except, I must say that the cinnamon roll I got on my 2nd visit was MUCH sweeter than the first one. I had a peach pie roll and it was very sweet. Maybe it's due to the fact that I had a cafe au lait the first time and I barely sweetened it to balance the sweetness I would be getting from my blueberry pie roll. I think so...?

Also, I bought my roll first thing when they opened and brought it home. Kind of a mistake. The edges of the roll did get slightly hard after only a 30 minute drive home, so I suggest eating your roll(s) as soon as you get it! It was still good, though. After the initial layer, it got soft again.

I'm still gonna come back! And I'll be sure to get a cafe au lait or something to balance the sweetness...so far, blueberry pie roll is still my fave!

Yum. Yum yum yum. Cinnamon rolls fresh and hot out the oven, you can pick your own frosting flavor and topping. I came here for a lazy sunday (albeit unhealthy) breakfast and wow. Oh, and did I mention they're vegan?! vegan. I'm no vegan but hey, if you can make cinnamon rolls like these vegan, I'm all for it! I'd have to recommend coming here more for dessert though than for breakfast. It was all a bit too sweet for my breakfast taste....I tend to be more of a savory breakfast person. All in all - unbelievable and a total must-try.

Since becoming vegan I've missed cinnamon rolls something awful - and all I can say is thank whichever higher power strikes your fancy for Cinnaholic.

I mean, seriously, so absolutely delicious! I got the plain-jane frosting, which wasn't too adventurous, but I was in vegan heaven. I really don't thing a non-vegan would be able to tell that the roll was sans eggs/milk. It was unbelievable.

if I lived closer I would be about 50 lbs heavier from roll consumption. They are so good - and with all the frosting and topping varieties, I don't think anyone could tire of this place!

I am in love with a cinnamon roll.... don't tell my husband!

Honestly, I first found Cinnaholic last summer and it was love at first bite. And every time I have been in Berkeley, I have wanted to stop by for a warm gooey treat.

With a variety of topping options, specialty rolls, and daily creations... you can't get tired of cinnamon rolls. My favorite is the Old Skool roll with fresh peaches. Many of my friends opt for the cookie dough roll.

It's vegan, but you wouldn't know it on face and I love bringing friends who think vegan food tastes bad... surprise!!! Cinnaholic has gotten rave reviews from a number of vegan news outlets and they now ship their goodness to people who aren't nearby.

The only thing that is disappointing about Cinnaholic is how far away it is! I want a San Jose location!!!

Overall it's pretty good.  For a vegan cinnamon bun, its really good.  Small quaint place with a total hipster feel but the stuff is good. The service is nice and pretty quick!  At first look, the buns don't look very appetizing because they're kinda dry looking and almost crusty on the outside (kinda like artisan bread). However, once you have a bite these things are legit.  The frosting looks kinda like snot but tastes great with the buns.

If you're a college student you'll get a discount too.

Ever since I became vegan several years ago, I've always kind of missed Cinnabon. As a child of the suburbs, Cinnabon had an unhealthily large presence in my life growing up, and those kinds of attachments are hard to shake. I've been looking for something to fill the void ever since then, and finally Cinnaholic has saved me from despair! These cinnamon buns don't just hit the spot, they beat it to a bloody pulp. And they won't give you a heart attack.

Also, the people who work there are really nice.

We finally tried Cinnaholic and wow that is some decadent shit!  We originally wanted to order the smores and rocky road rolls but they didn't have marshmallows in yet, sad.  We were offered a yummy sample of the pina colada roll and the frosting as sooooo good!  In the end I ordered the oreo explosion or something and they served it to me all warm and gooey with delicious vanilla frosting, crushed oreos, fudge sauce, and chocolate chips, damn!  It was almost to much for me and will definitely be a rare indulgence!  My significant other ordered the brownie avalanche and again it was decadent beyond measure!  The brownies which they make in house were divine and I can see myself stopping in to order one of those on my lunch break!  His also had vanilla frosting, chocolate chips, and fudge drizzle.  Cinnamon roll lovers will be in heaven no doubt about that!  I am excited for the pumpkin rolls that I'm sure they will have come October, yum!  

Also we liked the fact that they served their buns in a nice eco-friendly potato ware to go container!  Nice job Cinnaholic!

I'm definitely a Cinnaholic. It's a problem.

If I lived any closer I would get an Old Skool Roll every morning.

I love everything about this place! Everything from the decor to the compostable take-out containers and utensils to the friendly, tatted up people that run the counter. 

They always get me with the tip jar battles. Today was Robots vs. Humans. Obviously I gave robots a quarter. 

Anyway if you haven't come here yet DO IT. This is like my favorite quickie breakfast/snack in Berkeley. 

Remember to flash your Cal ID for a discount! And pick up a punch card: if  you get 9 punches in the card you get a free roll! I'm 3 away.

This place is just dreamy.  First off, I live in So Cal.  But I caught wind of these guys from VegWeb, added them on Facebook and have been drooling ever since.  
The daily special posted in the morning? GET IT! I spent three mornings in the Bay recently, and got the daily special every day. $4? No complaints!  First morning: banana frosting (foodgasmic) with gingersnap cookies and sliced almonds.  Best.food.ever!  The next day when I showed up, the guy at the counter says "I was just thinking about the conversation we had yesterday", to which I awkwardly responded "I was thinking about you in bed this morning!".  Um, I meant the daily special.  He didn't flinch; everyone there is super nice, welcoming, and just generally people you wanna chat with.  
This is not typical vegan food and about 1,000 times better than anything I've found since I moved to So Cal 6 months ago.  Pretty sure these are the best cinnamon rolls I've ever had, vegan or not.  Cinnaholic, I love you.

WTF, they're vegan??

Cinnaholic serves up some sinfully scrumptious cinnamon rolls and each bite was like one mouth orgasm after another XD  I had the daily special with cream soda frosting and cherries and it was a solid deal too at $4.00.

Be a man, do the right thing and get over here to satisfy your sweet tooth.

OMG love this place with all my heart.  Having a huge sweet tooth, but not a lover of chocolate, cinnamon rolls happen to be my dessert of choice.  Lucky for me I found this place randomly one afternoon and have revisited every week since.  I don't have a favorite yet because I'm determined to try every combination I can think of before choosing.  
Thanks be to GOD that this was opened.

This is exactly what I want in a cinnamon roll: Really gooey, hot from the oven.

There's complications, though: If you eat this more than once a month you'll weigh 300 pounds. Also, I've had to fight my way through an army of Berkeley stoners who are absolutely sure that ordering these cinnamon rolls is THE BEST THING THAT HAS EVER OR WILL EVER HAPPEN TO THEM, and so they should probably hug each other repeatedly and take 15 minutes to actually order. The poor guy at the counter handled them pretty well, but I hope that's not a common occurrence.

Cinnamon Rolls are the food of gods. 

For some reason, even though they are sopped with sugary goodness... the fact that they are vegan makes it a touch- just a touch- guilt free. You know how some vegan food is so pretty and glistening, but the moment you take a bite your taste buds make that sad trombone sounds? Nope. Not here, folks. Cinnabun can go take a crap, 'cause these tasty buns of love are the shiz. The staff is friendly and nice, and helped explain how to order a special bun. They even politely ignored the drool escaping from my mouth as i watched them slather the maple frosting onto the freshly heated seasoned swirl of bread.

Haven't been daring enough to try one of the deluxe rolls of crazy, but in the sense of cinnamon rolls , I guess I'm a purest.

Eat here. Be Happy.

Oh, Cinnaholic. It's just unbelievably amazing that this magical place exists. It's like you're getting a crazy ice cream sundae but with a fluffy, warm, perfect vegan cinnamon roll instead of ice cream. At first I tended to go with the more "traditional" toppings like nuts, but lately I've been branching out into the various cookies, chocolate things, fresh fruit, and crazy frosting flavors they offer. Who knew that raspberries on a cinnamon roll would be mind-blowingly delicious? Cinnaholic, that's who.

I can't say enough good things. YOU WANT TO GO TO THERE.

Dear Cinnaholic,

I think I may be in love with you.  So much for giving up sweets in the new year.  I'm a recent convert, but I think I've gone in to the shop about 4-5 times within the past couple of weeks.  I could stare at the menu board for hours.  There are endless combinations of frostings and toppings that could suit even the most picky of eaters.  Typical frostings like coffee, maple and butterscotch and fun ones like root beer or pina colada.  Each time I've been in, I try a different combination and I fall in love again.  The rolls are soft and doughy.  They literally melt in your mouth.  The one I had today was still soft and delicious 6 hours after ordering it.  The service is super fast and the staff is great.  Some may consider the buns to be pricey, but they are huge and I am happy to pay that price for a quality product.  $4 daily specials also rule.  Vegan baked goods get a bad rap, but I think Cinnaholic has the power to change that.  Skeptics beware, Cinnaholic may just make you a vegan yet.  Keep up the great work, I can't wait to try more flavor combinations!

Still waiting for the 1-star reviewers who are complaining about texture to open their own vegan treat shop and be as kind as the Cinnaholic guy was to my friends and I today. The rolls we tried were delicious.

Plus a star for the "optional 35 cent credit card fee." Take THAT, credit card companies!

I've already reviewed (5 stars), but had to respond to the offensive review by Anon A.  

Hey, Anon A:  If you're going to resort to nonsensical insults and childish name-calling, at least learn how to spell conniving (and several other words).
All I want is you.
