I just figured it would be hot dogs.  Wrong!!! It's a sausage fest.  There's nothing better than sausage on a toasted baguette with Beaver sweet & spicy mustard.  My only gripe about the food was the lack of grilled onions and peppers.  The caprese and linguica were definitely top dogs in my book.  It's also nice that Top Dog also serves their sausages at the stadium.

They're open late - its cheap - and their hot dogs are delicious!  What more can you ask for?

This is an awesome place to get a late night bite after either studying late or partying late.  Occasionally, you'll encounter a line, but no line the Top Dog staff can't handle quickly.  There's a hot dog place in LA where the line goes around the building.  (Top Dog beata them by far by taste and you won't stand in line for hours.)  

There is a lack of seating, but its a hot dog, so you can stand and eat without a problem.

They tried opening a Top Dog in Southern California, but its not quite the same.  I love how they toast the buns just right.

I miss it!

TOP DOG is good, but I have something better in SF. 
Well, the quality is almost the same. The price too.
But, the worker is.. errrr. That's why I took a star off. Sorry.

After visiting campus over 20 years later, this place still rocks. Hot kraut in the condiments area is a small bonus given the straight up yummy dog and luscious bun. I could eat 'em plain-they're that good!

Simple & good.

Why so good? because you get down and dirty, without all that nonsense-crap-pinks-overpriced-hotdogswithdumtoppings kinda thing...

$3 including tax, you get the dog and bread.  You do the magical thing and add some condiments and kraut and whatever else they have on the counter.

I love their hot links, bratwurst, lemon chicken, & italian.

there is 10+ years of a love-relationship between I and top dog on durant.
Best hot dogs in norcal! Socal has to go to Pinks!

Open till 2 a.m., this place hits the spot when you're up late and hungry for something unhealthy.

The inside embodies the Berkeley character. Political cartoons and clipped news columns pepper the small interior's walls and counter tops. My favorite is the full-page, single-panel cartoon about the path of life, illustrated as if it were a twisted amusement park.

The cooks are nice, and the atmosphere is very easy and casual. They aren't afraid to speak their mind, and they strike me as nothing but down-to-earth.

There are a huge variety of dogs you can choose to put on a grilled bun. Self-serve toppings include relish, onions, and sauerkraut. Ketchup, yellow mustard, and deli mustard also included. The result is at least as good as any dog you'll get at a ballpark.

I recommend the chicken-apple sausage or the regular "top dog." I'm salivating right now.

Yeah 3bucks for a hot dog might be a little steep but I love Top Dog.  Too many good times because of this place.  Coming back late from a study session, finals, etc and Top Dog was there.  Nothing beats a chicken apple or lemon chicken on a drunken night.

This place is on the top of my list. (my totally awesome list).  If you love hot dogs like I do, well this place is for you.  The menu is very simple, you pick the dog you want from their huge selection, all of which are the same price ($3), and the dog grill-er will throw one down for you along with a nice sesame seed bun.  Once the dog is grilled you can select your toppings.  There are many mustards to choose from as well as chopped onion, relish, and warmed saur kraut.  When I go in, I usually get a Bockwurst or two with a line of brown mustard and the saur kraut piled up high.  Hot Dog Heaven right there man.  For those that love this place like I do, you can even take home cold dogs and buns for parties or just for whatever.  Words for the wise, make sure that you don't mistake the hot Russian mustard for brown mustard, and when biting into the dog, watch out those suckers are hot!  Go on, eat your heart out, and try to top 7 at one time.

Top Dog is one of the first places I've tried in Berkeley. 

I always get the lemon chicken because it's soo good, especially on the toasted roll. They have condiments on the side that you help yourself to. For $3, it's slightly expensive for a hot dog when you think about it, but it's still really good! You can also buy the hotdogs and buns in bulk for a cheaper price.

This place is a little too overpriced and a little too overrated. I like the different varieties of dog they offered, and it is $3 with no tax, but I wasn't satisfied with one. It was good, but I wouldn't really have this as a meal but have it more as a snack. A very expensive snack.
I probbly could've gone to McD's and gotten full with the same amount of money, but I decided to take a chance and see what all the hype was about with the 4.5 star rating. 
But hey, at least it tasted good. =]
These dogs are awesome!
This is the standard when it comes to a quality SAUSAGE-FEST!  Get the bird dog!!!!

It's true that the dudes at this particular Top Dog are consistently the jerkiest of any Top Dog jockeys, but they're also on top of their shit. They are efficient and they will never fuck up your order. 

And it always kind of makes me giggle the way they skip over people in line who hesitate when ordering. You gotta be assertive and decisive at this Top Dog, and those are two qualities I value highly in other humans.
Still great. I love how it hasn't changed (except maybe the prices that reflect inflation. Did I just say that? Oh gawd, I'm old).
Rude. Not accomodating with allergies. Poor service. If I have a question, the least they can do is answer it with some bit of respect. But, no.

Easily a 5! I love their chicken apple sausage and after a late night out, this is the go to destination in Berkeley. Mmm mmm. I love that there's no line cuz I'm one of those people that would cut every single line if I could. This is gonna be a short review..simple, Top Dog is helllla good! Just go! Cash only btw!

I visited this place yesterday with a gigantic appetite and it was quite satisfying. They have a good variety of flavors, the boyfriend had the smoked apple chicken and I had the lemon chicken. 

I came with zero expectations and all I have to say is ..despite it being a bit expensive, it was some pretty darn good hot dogs! The only thing that bothered me was the size of the place. It was quite cramped and had about 5 bar stool seats. 

If you're in town, you've got to try!

spicy hot link, hot russian mustard.  

the cooks don't insult the customers anymore.  so sad.  

but i'll snarf a couple links here any time.

Can you say hot dog heaven?  I tried the Chicken Apple & Hot Louisiana.  If your into the HOT stuff like me, definitely try the Hot Louisiana it will not disappoint!  I like how they use this sub-style kind of bread, its all nice and toasty!  I would say that it's pricey compare to Costco, but you can't beat the variety of the dogs they have.  This place is great for a quick grub inbetween breaks or to fulfill a late night hunger.

Don't know how long Top Dog has been around. When we lived in Berkeley some 35 odd years ago, there was only one Top Dog, the one on Durant. Now there is one on the North side, and one on Center near the Bart station.
One of the best hot dog ever!! Hot links and Polish sausages are our favorites. Always tried to eat there, the counter guy browned them to perfection, the they have all the condiments available for you to top the dogs yourself. When we don't have time, we always buy the uncooked hot dogs to take home. Great for BBQ parties!!!
No hotdog gets five stars.  But this place does serve good dogs on the go with brisk, terse, and often firm service.

Drove all the way from LA to Berkeley !!! First time there with my boy friend and i gotta say its the best hot dog joint Iv'e been to!!! I recommend the Lemon chicken hot dog or the Bratwurst!!! Can't wait to come back! The drive is worth it !!! LOL

2 big, juicy dogs for $6? WORD.

Next time I am ordering everything on the menu and taking a bite of everything to see what I like best! =)

NOM, NOM, NOM

It is what it is.  

They have good sausages, they grill them well, no frills, none asked for.  

The place is a dump, but who cares when it's 12:30 at night?

one of the best hot dog places on Earth! I've tried 75% of the menu and been here a few hundred times. I can't say that about many other restaurants.

Lemon Chicken dog - delish w/ kraut and mustard

Cost - dirty cheap

I'm also keeping this one short, can't wait to go back.
MHMMM TOPDOG! Always open late for us night life people and night owls. They have a great variety of dogs and I enjoy them all, even the really unique ones.
I think this is biggest hot dog menu I have seen at a hot dog place. The hot dogs are pretty good and the customer service is not bad.

what can i say:  12am in berkely and hungry.  the kielbasa wasn't enough, so i had to take down a hot link as well.

ambience:  if you count the homeless guy looking at me and the strange looking students as a positive thing, i give it one star.

food/value ration:  this is the best utility for dollar spent play out there.  the sesame bun and the "hot" dog is great.  better when drunk.

can't wait to go again.

Top Dog is awesome food.  It's cramped, it reeks of grease, and the chefs are smart asses and I still love this place.  What is it about these dogs that are so good?  They're thick, they're hearty, they've got a little bit of char and a whole lot of flavor.   My favorites are the Lemon Chicken and the Kielbasa.  Together.

I like this place. I love the three dollars for any hot dog price too. I hate change ! 
It is good, I love the polish dogs and the kielbasa.
Is it great? Nah. You're talking to a girl who grew up on filthy L.A. bacon wrapped dogs grilled in dirty grills with even dirtier people. MY GOD THEY ARE DELICIOUS. 
Top dog...does the trick when it is two am and I am hungry. 

Do not appreciate that the guy at the counter was rude when I was clearly being harassed by someone in the middle of the night. I know you probably get that a lot, but come on.

Back in the days when I was a student I come here every week to satisfy my lemon chicken and hot link craving. Whenever I'm in Berkeley I would specifically stop by here and get myself 2 lemon chickens and 2 hot links because I miss it so much. 

I wish they have a store in San Jose.

Love a slightly crispy bun with tasty links in a hot dog! My brother brought me here to try it out for the first time and I ordered the hot link and lemon chicken.  Both were delicious and the hot link was sure hot!! I love to eat spicy food and was skeptical as to how spicy it would be but this made my nose run so it's definately h-h-hottt! 

$3 for a hot dog is rather reasonable here for the special sausage they have unless you're comparing it to a Costco hot dog with a drink for $2.50 =P.  If you come here, expect to wait since this place seems to be always busy.
I'm kind of a hot dog snob.  Excellent dog.  Rivals some of the better dogs I've had at baseball games all over the country.  I love this place.
They have catered a few hot dog days with my work. Always awesome and its hard to stop eating.

One of my favorite eateries in Berkeley - I have many fond memories coming here with friends during college, for a quick lunch or late night snack.  Although the prices have risen a bit, it is still one of the best hot dog places I've enjoyed.

For those that like it hot, I recommend: 2 hot links, dressed with onions, and Russian mustard - simply delightful.

if only it was $1.10 for a dog and a cola still...
but it would be five stars up there if swain was still alive and working the grill at night. all these grilled sausages and sesame buns, miso soup, unfiltered apple juice(the dark brown stuff) poured from the jug, bag of chips, the 12" or 13" tv that has "stolen from top dog" in permanent marker written on it, german mustard, sauerkraut, russian hot mustard, pickle relish, onions(eeew), ketchup, and cold dogs to go! they're open all the time except for one day a year, and i think it's new years day.

i've read some of the other reviews, and i love top dog too! i've never been there drunk, and i usually go late at night. david p. swain was the original 'soup nazi' and the other guys who work the grill are great, but the customers who go there now don't even know what it's like to have swain point his tongs at you and say "order!" i was passed by many times over the years---it wasn't just a rookie thing.

i think i can't go to any other dog except this one(dog south) and *dog north*(northside) as my friends and i like to call it.

dog center(st.) is usually slow, and sometimes they don't even warm up the dog to hot! location is great but if you want it done right, go to dog south or dog north...

Hit this place after the Arcade Fire show at the Greek. Had the kielbasa -amazing. Can't wait to go back and try more (there are about 12 different types of dogs). The guy behind the counter was very friendly and the woman cooking was very fast and clean.

Got a hot link here whilst visiting the bf, I was not particularly impressed or disgusted. It was an average experience at an above-average price for a not-too-filling meal. Yeah. Meh. I think this place gets a bit too much hype.

I don't know why Top Dog inspires so much discussion. The dogs are pretty good, but they're overpriced. Its main attraction lies in the fact that it's open later than almost any other place in Berkeley.

Having said that, I recommend trying the potato salad, which for some reason nobody ever seems to order.

this is it ! it doesn't get any better than a top dog . i been going to top dogs for over 30 years now . i still have not found a better place to get a dog . Sauerkraut and the hot russian muster is off the chain . if you like great sausage you'll love this place

When living in Berkeley we went here all the time, and my hubby got me hooked on their delicious grilled hot lemon chicken sausages. We'd get it with  a little thing of potato salad and deli mustard and a drink. It was the best and by far what I compare all hot dogs to since then. 

I'm giving them a 5 star because I don't like hotdogs usually, and since moving to California (and specifically to Berkeley) I have become a huge fan of TOP DOG and miss it terribly since moving to SoCal. 

The brats, the chicken apple, the lemon chicken.. anything and everything you get at TOP DOG is a winner, and perfectly grilled right in front of you. Can't go wrong with that! 

Next time we're back home in Berkeley (a couple times of year of course!) It's TOP DOG!

it's funny how you don't realize how much a place means to you until after the fact.

i can't believe that i use to pass up going to Top Dog thinking that it was too far at one point when i lived at the dorms. and now, years after graduation, i will drive taking a detour on my way home just get a taste. this place is great anytime of day from late breakfast to late night snack any day of the week.

this tiny berkeley venue has grown and i'm not too surprised anymore when i see it popped up at a new location. however there is something to be said about the nostalgia and going back to where you had your first bite. i think usher shares this sentiment because when his tour visits the bay he makes his pilgrimage to this same location.

to each their own of course and my favorites have changed over the years.
originally a fan of their (chicken) apple: a great mix of sweet and savory
then moved on to lemon (chicken):  for the garlic and lemon knock out combination
and finally to bock(wurst): the milk and eggs give it a breakfast taste and breakfast just happens to be my favorite meal of the day. oh if they only had a bacon add on option... 

until next time

cheers

YUMMY!!!!! my first time at top dog and it was soo good...
shared the smoked apple sausage dog and it was deeeeeeeeelish.
loved the roll that they put it in! (not your normal hot dog bun) 
i'm a fan

Great selection of hot dogs, but comes at a steep price. Each dog is 3 or 3.50, which is about the price of 2 at a regular street vendor. The service was alright, but very rushed. I personally got the garlic frankfurter, which was decent but not amazing.

The greatest hot dog place on earth. Fortunately, in southern california, we have Berkeley Dog which features pretty much the same line up of hot dogs. However, if you find yourself in the bay area, you must stop here.
Best hot dog ever.

too amazing! Cheap, tasty, delightful, out of the ordinary. 

When my friends wanted to get hot dogs from here I originally didn't want one because I don't really like hot dogs...but after I saw how they were prepared, they looked so darn good that I couldn't resist! I got the Smoked Chicken Apple Dog! YUM YUM YUM! Super juicy, tender, and fresh! I like that they do NOT serve their hot dogs on regular buns. They use much more quality bread almost reminding me of a baguette type of bread. 

The cool thing about this place is that it is open super late. Perfect for late night munchies. This place definitely serves top of the line hot dogs!

PRO:
* simply THE greatest hot dog place on the planet (but you must go to the one on Durant, southside of campus)
* been coming here for 30 years and amazing consistency
* sometimes hilarious (in a sardonic way) guys behind the counter
* it's the way they toast their hot dog buns that keeps them king
* offers a six-pack (dogs/buns) to go (however; home cooking them is not as good, unfortunately)
* as reflection of the economic times, I guess, they've started a Top Dog card program (one punch per dog)

CON:
* it's no longer a few blocks to walk to, ever since I moved away from Berkeley
* once saw Kurt Vonnegutt, Jr. walking by and regretted not offering to buy him a Top

alternatives:
* better than Carney's (LA), Casper's (Oak), Gray's Papaya or Nathan or Sabrette's (NYC) or Ted's (Buffalo)

Man, I've been wanting to yelp this place for awhile... 

Good:: 
The food here is WONDERFUL. I LOVE their Hot Link&Braut. I Love how they sort of toast your bun and stuff. I usually come here late after a night of partying and it always hits the spot for me. 

Bad:: 
Sadly, this place has the worst service. The people that work here are total assholes!! The fucking guy with the ponytail is a total jackass!! I asked him for a bad and he said I would have to buy one. Who the fuck pays for a brown paper bag? No one ever charged me before!! Also, the bitch with the glasses!! I sure scared the shit out of her!! Haha!! So the story is... Me and a friend had come there at night and order a whole bunch of stuff and when everything was finish and she gave us the total, and we had remembered and added 3 more things (a drink,chips and potato salad) and then asked her for the complete total again. Guess what she said?? She said... "Add it up" I was heated!! I went off on that bitch!! I told her to take the fucking stick out her ass and don't be mad at us for having a social life and actual jobs, instead of working at a hotdog place at 2am. I was a little mean for that, but I was so mad!! I haven't seen her since!! Haha!! 

Other than the bad service, the place is great. I still come back at least once every 2 weeks.

Normally, I would never make the trek out to Berkeley, since I live in San Francisco and BART is quite expensive. When when I found Top Dog on Yelp, I just had to make a visit. The trip cost 6.80 on BART just for a $3 hot dog, but it was all worth it to support my people: Libertarians. Liberty never tasted so good!

i still can't find a place anywhere that can serve hot dogs this good!!!! dammmmit .. living in Sac depresses me once i realize there ain't no Top Dog here!!!! =( sometimes i wish i went to UCBerkeley just to be near it!!

Erytime me n my homies are on our way home from the clubs, if Lucky Chances n Denny's ain't crackin, we always end up here ... haven't tried a hot dog i don't like either!! the hot links are my favvvorriiiitteee ... my bro likes the Kiel, the Calabrese and the Smoked Chicken Apple ... all my guy friends agree that the hots are the best and chicken apples and kiels come in 2nd .. load 'em up wit onions, slap on some ketchup or some deli mustard and mMmm .. have an RC Cola or a lemonade to wash it down too!!!

i hate that there are 3 in berkeley and 2 in oakland!! please make one in sac .. tons of us bay area folk would LOVE YOU MORE! =)

man, now i want one ...
Best.  Dogs.  Ever!

Well, this place's hot dogs and links are pretty good but not as CRAZY GOOD as I've heard about. I'd probably stop by if I was in the area (like really really close to it), but it's probably not something I'd go too much out of the way for. The guy working there is nice and all the dogs are cooked to order. 

The topping bar has relish and sauerkraut where you can just keep piling it on. Wait now I'm craving hot dogs even though I just ate... dammit!

Top Dog is just like every other hot dogs... NOT even kidding... the bread is better though! I think the bread is what makes Top Dog good. LOL

It is 3 bucks for one hot dog... & I can eat like 4 hot dogs -.- hmm... So I think it is pretty pricey for just ONE hot dog... I mean, the hotdogs aren't bigger than a "typical" hotdog. WTH is so special about it? the different meat?? chyeah right!

I think it is pretty overhyped. It's unsanitary (they touch money & use those hands to make the hotdogs. barf!) & the hot dogs are just aite.

p.s. I don't have a picture of a Top Dog. I just never thought it was that special...

My dad used to bring me here as a kid and now... well now I drag all my friends here on a regular basis.


$3.  C'mon.  What's to lose?  


My friend and I made it our New Year's Resolution to try everything on the menu.  So far, my favorites go to the Calabrese and the Bratwurst -- hands down.  Less delicious are the Linguica and the Bird Dog.  


GO if you're lucky enough to be in the area.  


Oh, and bring one down if you're on your way to San Diego ;)

Top Dog is the place to go!! 

I actually had the privilege of working here a long time ago at their location in Rockridge out of what was call Long Drugs back then.  My friend worked there and hooked me up as a part time job after school.  I was HOOKED after working there. EVERYDAY, literally, I would have a hot link, butterflied of course, with a bag of BBQ Lays chips and a small Root beer, MMMMMMM...just talking about it now makes my mouth water.  

The quality of the dogs are just GOOD.  The kielbasa is yum, the bird dog is juicy, lemon chicken is addicting and the good Ole old fashion top dog frankfurter is just simple and satisfying!! Have it with ketchup and mustard, or hot mustard with warm sauerkraut, or everything on it or just PLAIN! Either way, its good.  

So come anytime because they're open late and try any of them! They'll hit the spot!

i can't go to berkeley and not get a lemon chicken.  if i'm feeling industrious, i'll go for a hot link too.

the service doesn't need to be friendly, just quick, so be ready to order when called on and have your cash ready.  the dogs are delicious but i believe half the magic comes from the crispier-than-average buns with sesame seeds on top.

make sure you accessorize well and choose the right mustard, add ketchup, relish, and onions at your own discretion.  the dogs are the stars here.

the only thing i wish is that the prices were the same as they were when i was in college.  they're up to $3.00 each.

I would give this place a five star on service and how delicious my hot dog was but I'm giving it a three star. The reasoning is food handling. I was grossed out as the guy took our money then grabbed the buns with his bare hands without sanitizing. Besides that I ordered the garlic dog which was delicious and cheap:)

This place is a late night Berkeley institution. There's really nothing all that spectacular about Top Dog but there's a soft spot for this place in the heart of everyone that hangs in Berkeley.

They have all kinds of sausages from your basic hot dog to chicken apple to keilbasa. Nothing you can't buy at the grocery store and cook yourself. They also have a bunch of different kinds of mustard, which is really all a good hot dog needs. 

It's the most crowded between 1am and 2am when everyone is stumbling around for something to satisfy their drunk munchies. When you order, make sure you know what you want because the cooks usually act like you're wasting their time. It's pretty fun to watch.

If you're ever in Berkeley, you've got to try Top Dog.

I absolutely love their Lemon Chicken and Chicken Apple. I haven't tried anything else off the menu but I'm loving what I chose so far. You're able to add your own condiments. I don't because I simply love the taste of a plain hot dog. The buns they use are quite unique. It's good because It's actually crunchy, but I don't really like the sesame taste it provides. I think an original, grilled hot dog bun would do the honor of complimenting the sausage.

Service: 2/5
Food: 3.5/5
Wait: 2.5/5
Price: $
Presentation of food: 3/5
Presentation of restaurant: 3/5
Overall: 3/5

this place is pretty good considering the pricing as well as the lack of places open late in Berkeley even on weekends! im not from Berkeley, so i am def. not use to places closed so early on WEEKENDS. i would've gave them a 4-star but i was there around 1 something almost 2, and there were few more people behind me about to order but they were drunk; and debating what to get for like an extra 7 minutes long. And the dude that worked there was really impatient and got fed up so they just closed on them on the spot; (cuz they close at 2am), they just took all the dogs off the griller and told them they can't order n e more cause they took too long. i think thats kind of messed up, its still business and they WERE RIGHT THERE; talk about being in a bad mood.

I always get "The Wienie" (veggie dog). It's actually pretty good (hence the 5 stars), and great if you're looking for a small meal. I love that THIS top dog is open late. There is one on Northside on Hearst but it's not open nearly as late. Another difference between this one and the one on Northside: the wait. This top dog is pretty crowded (esp with those late night snackers!!), and there is one guy that works here who is extremely aggressive and intimidating. My tip: if it's crowded, KNOW what you want, and if you hear someone describing what you're wearing, he's not admiring your sense of fashion...he's the cook and he's trying to get your order on the grill! 

Take advantage of the condiment bar (sauerkraut, ketchup, mustard, onions, dijon mustard...etc).

Finally, if you're planning a barbaque and don't want to serve taste-less hotdogs that come in packs of 300 from where ever you like to shop, you can buy dogs (in packs of 6 or so) from top dog and impress all your friends, frenemies, and co-workers...or satisfy your inner hot dog junkie.
Pretty good and unique hot dogs. I like how they are open super late as well. It is nice when you are craving a delicious hot dog.

Does Top Dog really need another outstanding review??
C'mon, Top Dog is tops in Berkeley and top 3 in the bay area.  A unique dog cooked on a flat griddle with griddle-toasted, fresh sesame seed bread.  A variety of the dogs and sausages for all your moods.  No tables though.  Street parking can be tough. 
Just come try it, OK!

I can see it now, years ago a man woke up claiming he had been visited by the gods and was ordered to build a TOPDOG and they will come!!!..and so he did. Top dog is the best place to stuff your face after a good night of heavy or moderately heavy drinking at kips or the Downlow. The Dogs are fairly priced, down side, place closes at 2. SHOULD BE OPEN ROUND THE CLOCK

This is my favorite branch. The sausages are good quality, but nothing you can't buy elsewhere and cook yourself. There's nothing too weird on the menu (like some of the foo-foo places in SF... not that I mind a foo-foo sausage). But these guys are efficient and funny and open late. The dogs fly off the grill even when the place is packed tighter than a mosh pit.

The thing that's great about Top Dog is that they don't need to give you a ton of weird toppings that don't belong anywhere near a hot dog. The dogs themselves are good enough so that a little mustard and relish is all you need. They have some unique dogs like chicken apple, lemon chicken, linguica and others, which are all really good. The only one I haven't tried is the vegetarian.

   I usually order the Calabrese, which has a great blend of spices. A hot dog will set you back $3, drinks and chips are 75 cents each.
fav hot dog !  love its hot links specially cold winter nites.  every time i visit nor-cal, I have to get some!   love it !!

Had the Top Dog Frankfurter which was the best hot dog I've had in awhile.  Parked at the garage around the block and the best seat in this place is outside on the curb with a drink.

Menu: http://www.topdoghotdogs.com/themenu.html

Everytime I visit Cal to reminisce the good 'ole days, I always make it a point to come back to top dog for my favorite - Lemon Chicken!!!  You cannot go wrong with the lemon chicken and even after all these years, it's still the best!  I love it so much that I even bought a whole pack of 20 franks to take back home with me.  But cooking it at home doesn't beat eating it from the top dog grill.  Even their hoagie sandwiches bun for the franks are the best I've had.  The combination fits perfectly.  If you could imagine a frank marrying a bun...it's hands down the lemon chicken and the top dog hoagie bun!  If only they'd open up a top dog in NYC.

Been going to Top Dog since I've been a little kid. My Dad went to Berkeley and he passed on the love of Top Dog down to my brother and I. He would also take us to the location on the North side of campus because it was sometimes easier to get to, but this location is the better of the two!

I rarely deviate from getting a hot link, unless I get two dogs and then it's one of the varieties they offer like lemon chicken. I love piling on pretty much everything and then saurkraut. Makes for a perfect dog. The prices have slowly been creeping up, but hey - one would expect it to. They had been like $1.50 - $1.75 for so long, at least when I was a kid.

To boot, right across the street is King Pin Donuts! Yeah...heart attack waiting to happen. Yeah, Top Dog definitely my favorite place for hot dogs!

Top Dog is excellent for two reasons:

1.  They have a good variety of quality sausages grilled to perfection and served in a nicely textured bun.  They also have a variety of mustards at your disposal.

2.  It's one of very few places actually open past midnight in Berkeley.  

The original is actually really tasty but if you want something more original, the smoked chicken apple is a favorite.  If you like things spicy, the hot link will light a fire in your mouth.

The politically themed wall decorations are an entertaining read too while you wait or eat.

I'm sorry but Casper's hotdogs prices are getting out of control, poor college student can get a damn hot dog for cheap! 

This place has a huge selection of hot dogs, links, and sausages for 3 dollars only. Totally sold. There was a young guy running the tiny place by himself who was really nice and helpful with me deciding on what I should get. 

I got a hot link. It came on a really nice bread roll and then a guy sitting next to me suggested that I put the krout and the hot russian mustard on. The guy had obviously been there plenty of times because that's exactly what I was looking for! 

The link was really good and all the stuff with it but I think the bread did the trick for me. It was toasted and soft, just what I was looking for. Thank you Top Dog, next time I'm hungry and don't feel like spending a lot of money, you'll be seeing me.

I really can't add being that this review is the 597th one. All I can say is that when I go to Cal for a football game or whatever, I have to have something from here. This place is a true institution for Cal students and visitors.
The hotdogs are alright. If you're in the area, want to try something this area's known for, give it a try.

The best dogs and brauts ever! They have dogs for any person from vegie to chicken apple. Standing room only and the lines can be long but that is because it is so good! 

I you visit Berkeley then you have to eat here.

The Magical World of Berkeley begins at Top Dog.  It's one of the smallest restaurants you will ever find.  So small it feels like you walked inside a hotdog cart.  They rarely have more than a five minute wait, but if they do, it's because they won't serve it unless it's steamed to perfection. 

It's a great place to start your walk through Berkeley. You'll finish your dog before you get to the first traffic light and make that big decision: Left or right? Note to visitors: Go Right! It's the Berkeley way.

Top and a Hot. You can't beat that, son.

Half the fun is just watching the grill guy keep track of 30 different orders at once. The other half is watching your dogs pick up the flavors of the surrounding dogs on the grill. And the remaining half is enjoying an RC Cola and fondly recalling that dreary scene in Taxi Driver where the lady at the porno theater tells Travis "We don't have Coca-Cola. Royal Crown Cola is all we got."

Best hot dogs in town (or just about anywhere else)!  They have a good selection of sausages & it only takes a few minutes to heat them up & have them ready for you.

Don't come here expecting a sit-down meal (although some locations actually have stools and/or tables and chairs).  This is a no-frills, very down to earth, cash only sort of operation.

They always have lots of interesting political stuff to read (with a strong libertarian tinge).

If you want to save some money and have good hot dogs at home, ask for a 6-pack (not sure how much it costs, but it's much cheaper than the normal price of $3/dog).

Last time I checked (which admittedly was several years ago) you could buy the same brand of hot dogs (Saags I believe) at Berkeley Bowl.

The best place to get a midnight snack around the Berkeley campus.  My favorite is the hot link.  It's has a nice kick if you like it spicy.  Also, at roughly $3 a pop, it fills the stomach without breaking the bank.

One warning! Make sure you know what you want before standing in line.  The cashier will likely yell at you taking up space of another customers wanting to get in the door.  Seriously, the place is 10x10 so it can only hold may 10-15 people.

after spending all my money at the mega-longs drugstore,  on 51st and broadway. i am famished. i hit the top dog and have my hot link with kraut and relish. life is good even tho i must brush my teeth when i get home to get rid of the stinky breath.

I love hot dogs and Top Dog is the place to get them in Berkeley. It's a tiny place with the friendliest people. One of my favorites is the chicken apple sausage. I think the last time I was here, I ordered two ;). I need to come back here more often!

THIS PLACE IS BOMB.  I am not a fan of hot dogs because you never really know what they are made of, but that slipped my mind when it was nearly 3 am and my friends and I drunkenly stumbled upon this "famous" joint in Berkeley. I felt compelled to try one, actually two.  They were delicious.  I had no idea they had different kinds, I would love to go back and try the Chicken Apple.  

YUM YUM YUM

if you want a hot dog, come here.  the end.

ok i'll say more.  the selection is huge.  the sausages and hot dogs are good.  and i love the selection of mustards.

it's hot dogs plain and simple.

Alright.. I love hot dogs.... I don't think I've ever met a hot dog that didn't ust totally make my day.  That said...this place is hands down the BEST place to get a hot dog that I have ever come across.  

You basically cannot go wrong here (unless you accidentally use the russian mustard and use way too much... (me...last night...ow, it was still GOOD though)).  

Sometimes you have to wait through all the CAL kids, but even so, they're great too if you're in good spirits.  

Open SUPER late so you can go post-bar if you'd like.  And, it's berkeley so there's no "proper" way to kick it there.  I sat on the curb with my girl last night, chowing down.  Pure bliss.

(cons: the wait, it's small so you have to cram in, no seating area....  but, basically, nothing can make this less than 5 stars (except for bugs...and I've seen none))

Like Rosamunde's in SF, but cheaper!  The weiner/vegan dog has changed over the years, is currently a tofurky brand I believe, but @ $3 this place is a great cheap meal if you can't grab a four pack from Trader Joe's for the same price and cook 'em up at home.  Plus if you've got friends, or kids who are omnivorous you can both eat and be happy.  I'd say I still prefer Rosamunde's in SF because they've got more of European topping choices and are adjacent to the amazing Toronado, but I'm grateful that the East Bay has Top Dog - hell even my parents when here when they were students.  It's an establishment and even open late!
For a hot dog joint, this is best.  Their lemon chicken is one of my favorites.
I drove 370 miles for you, smoked chicken apple hot dog. I also visited some fam/friends, but enough about them, you were the main reason ;) Til we meet again.
and who doesnt like TOP DOG ????

Top dog serves mainly to satisfy the hunger pangs of uc Berkeley students throughout the week. It's late business hours mean that sometimes students are left with it as their only choice of obtaining a low cost meal.  And that precisely is what top dog is good at doing. 
I give it 2 stars -
-1 star for quality - the hot dogs are prefrozen and cooked hastily, sometimes even undercooked. I would recommend the chicken Apple and garlic selections from the menu .
-1 star for the fact that they DON'T accept cash which is very inconvenient especially at 2 am 
-1 star for its overall ghetto feel. At late nights especially on the weekends the crowd here can get really sketchy and armed robberies do take place around here. It is also a favorite meeting place for berkeley's hippie community who probably haven't taken a shower since the 1960s.

I want to give it 5 stars but I resist simply because I don't know exactly how clean the place is. And cleanliness is so important for food venues! Anyway, this place is a Berkeley landmark. It's 2am and you're hungry. You can go to the local 24 hour Jack in the Box but why would you when you've got Top Dog which is open til 3am?! 

I recommend the lemon chicken (my fave) or the chicken apple. But I've also heard good things about the Calbrese (for you pork lovers which I'm not). 

For $2.75, it's the best hot dog you can get just about anywhere.
No place to sit, sometimes really long lines but still drive out here sometimes just cause i'm craving a hot dog. It's that good!

Yum! The lemon chicken is so far the best!  The guys working there are hilarious. The place is very cozy but with a friendly atmosphere. There is a parking area right next to the place and street parking is also available. Check them out!

Top Dog is one of the greatest little hole in the wall restaurants. Nearly every wiener on their menu is great! My personal favorite is the hot link and the chicken apple. 

Beware of the super spicy russian mustard. I don't know if that's been there this entire time or if i just saw it when i went on thursday. But gdamn, that is the spiciest thing ever--it caught me off guard because it had more of a wasabi heat that gets caught in your nasal cavity. My boyfriend made the mistake to put the russian mustard on his hot link and proceeded to cough up a storm after his first bite lol.

As a former food service employee, I would say that top dog is pretty grimey. The cook who handled my food also handled my money without proper sanitation. When i called it a "hole in the wall" it is literally a hole in the way. Also, with no seating inside, the only other place to enjoy top dog is outside, which is nice most of the time but not when its freezing bay are weather. but despite the unsightliness, its still one of the best hot dog (and perhaps the only) places in the area

If you are looking up on Yelp for Top Dog, you don't deserve eating here. Haha, just kidding!

But the place have awesome hot dog! But the guy definitely have an attitude, which I respect. I had been lectured by him on a few occasions, but completely my fault. Love the place nonetheless!

And I love the comics on the wall. 

One warning though, be careful about choosing the spicy mustard and mustard. The owner of the chain believes that people ought to read and decide by themselves, which lead to a lot of people tearing afterward. The guy was nice enough to make the lady another one though (of course, after a nice lecture)!
Open late which is great if you need a late dinner or snack.the french rolls & hot dogs are always cooked just right. parking kind of sucks though

Had the hot link which was really good and enjoyed the russian mustard.  I really the like texture and taste of the buns.  It is sturdier so the whole thing doesn't fall apart if you have loaded it up with toppings.  

The ordering, paying and the place itself can be a mob scene and there is probably a better way to get people in and out but no complaints since the order came pretty quickly.

I can see myself coming here a lot simply because it's nearby and it's open late. The dogs are average-sized and everything is three dollars no matter what kind of link or sausage you get. It's just an ordinary hot dog joint but it's definitely a Berkeley landmark. 

The one thing I dislike is that the guy taking your order is really impatient and sometimes rude. We asked for a recommendation and he simply told us to look at the menu -- thanks a lot. He also seemed to be a little offstandish simply because we were waiting in line and did not know what we wanted immediately upon entering the small restaurant. Apparently we cannot make our minds before ordering. 

It's an average place but I still love it.

Came here last nite for a late nite drunken snack before heading over to blake's on telegraph. I don't live anywhere near berkeley, just visiting for the nite and a bunch of friends wanted to go.

So I go there and I order the chicken apple hot dog, put all the condiments on it and walked around downtown chowing down. The hot dog itself was alrite, good seasoning and decent size (that's what she said). The bread was probably the best, it's like a sub roll that gets slowly toasted on the flat top grill while your dogs cook. The best part of the experience was the cook, dang that guy has some memory. Basically just chillin and grillin the whole time. 

Tips: when he asks what you want to order, order, don't stand around with your fist up your ass acting like an douchebag ed hardy reject. Once you order, just chill and drunk blabber with your friends and soon enough your hot dogs will be done. Always bring cash, and exact change is crucial. Dogs are 3 bucks, you can't argue with that.

One word, linguica.  I can proudly say I have tried every dog on the menu, except the weenie (vegetarian) and enjoyed every last one.  I always seem to go back to my favorite, the linguica, but the hot link, bratwurst and even the occasional frankfurter work into my ordering.  A key to any good dog is sauerkraut and mustard.

The service, while rude at times, is great.  They are rude in an almost nice way, just trying to get people taken care of as quickly as possible.

I frequent this place with out of town visitors in the mood for a quick bite to eat.

If you love the hot dog or sausage, this is the destination when you are around the campus at Cal. Tasty, tasty, tasty - no frills but a rock solid line-up of choices from the world of one-handed eating. Stand in line - it's worth the wait - go with the Linguica or the New York!

I always make a stop at Top Dog whenever I am in the Bay Area. This place is simple, but delicious. I usually just get the Frankfurter and add my condiments, but if I have room, I'll try something else. I like the Hot Link, but I'm warning you, it is freakin' HOT!!! 

There are so many reviews for this place, I am not sure if someone has already mention this, but you could buy a pack of frozen hot dogs and take it home. I was thinking of doing this but I had no place to store them for the rest of the trip. 

Random side notes: 

-There is no Coke or Pepsi. They have RC Cola. Sweet...
-BRING CASH!!!
-Plus it's fun to shop on Telegraph Avenue after you eat.

Late night eats after partying in Berkeley? Heck yeah! Cheap & yummy, just how I like it! No chairs to sit on. And if you don't know what you want yet, get out of the way or else the hungry people behind you will get angry.

service sucked. but the hot dogs are soooooooo gooood! i definitely plan on coming here again and they are open late! till 3am! but be aware that there are so many people you are going to have to fight for a dog!

I would gladly drive 45 minutes for two Hot Links from Top Dog. I normally subsist on a healthier choice of food but I'll make an exception for these dogs.

They are delicious, no-nonsense and are accompanied by very little fuss

For starters they don't taste like assorted animal entrails and have distinct and unique flavors. My favorite are the hot link and the kielbasa/polish dog. The chicken apple and linguica are pretty amazing too.

The bun is nice and toasted with a nice crunch to match the juicy dog. A winner's meal indeed.


It's a cash only place so make sure you hit up an ATM first. Street parking is kind of a pain in the ass but well worth it.
Top Dog is part of Berkeley history, which is one of the main reasons why I give it 4 stars. I find $3 to be too much for a hot dog... But it's great for late night munchies.

Lemon chicken for life! Dont get the garlic dog...

More Beaver mustard please!

I'm a Vegetarian that is alarmingly obsessed with fake meat and I love Top Dog! When I first found out I could get The Weiner here I sorta went nuts on the late night excusions. Excellent buns, appropriate stock of toppings, entertaining staff, and meatless hot dogs! The Oakland location  has seats and also offers the more traditional flavored soy dog along with the Italian Sausage standard. I prefer the Telegraph location though because it's fun to be yelled at by short order cooks while battling for space with Berkeley's finest in a storefront the size of a bathroom. No really, it is. Plus there is nothing better than exiting drunk from a local Hip Hop show and getting a hot dog here at one in the morning. Not too many other options in that time frame for vegetarians. They do lose a star however for regularly making me say "I want The Weiner!"
NomNomNOmNoMNOM!  I love this place!  My favorite dog is the lemon chicken and I always put some kaurt on it!  Can you say crack dogs!

Went there today with my boyfriend. Was told the hot dogs were great. I have gotten great German hot dogs back east and know a good dog. These were not. They were not juicy, they were lukewarm, the bun seemed old and the kraut was really watery.  I was really disappointed by the place. Plus the girl working behind the counter was not helpful at all. Maybe I need to go back on a different day and try them again.

If their bread were a little better, I'd give it a 5. You can almost never go wrong with their menu. Everything is good in it's own way. And you don't have to be a hammered college student to eat here. I often went here before Cal Football games. My usual order is the chicken apple. Expected bill: $4.

This place is a Berkeley institution!

If you love sausages, this is the place to go. I've had most of everything on the menu (minus the veggie dog) and I would have to say my favorites are the Kielbasa, Hotlink, and Calabrese. This place has stood the test of time and all their sausages taste good.

Be warned, this place has a no-nonsense kind of service, so make it easy for yourself and listen to the cooks. 

Get the Hot Russian Mustard for that extra kick. 

This is some of the best food $3 can buy!

My favorite place to go at 1 in the morning.

Best hot dogs ever. Kielbasa and the Hot Link are my top dogs. Mmm.
This place makes the best hot dogs hands down. I have been going to this place for many years.

whoah can't believe I haven't reviewed this place yet! This was probably the first place I ever ate in Berkeley and I've been coming back for the past ... 6 years? The decorative articles/wall papering were certainly an eyeopener the first time i walked in, but it's part of its charm. The lemon chicken is still my favorite. I lovveee the hot kraut and the buns and the russian mustard- the only things that go on my dog.

This place was really close to the hotel i stayed in. nearly a 1 minute walk hah. Love Love Love their different sausages.specially their Brotswurst, and the apple one i forgot!!! I only give it 4 stars becuzz they were small and a bit pricey!!!
If you love hot dogs you will love this place! When I'm out of state (which is most of the year) I crave this place, and any time I'm in or even near Berkeley I have to stop by!

Everything a hot dog should be. not all dressed up with other crap like at Pinks in La, service may not be the friendliest at times, but its 1 guy most of the time, doing an insane volume of orders, prices are very good the bun is great all the dogs are awesome, and condiments are varied. this is what all hot dog places should be, does not need pastrami or bacon or other crap to make up for a flavorless generic dog. Top dog forever... Pinks can bite me

Though I'd never want to venture to the back of house in this place to see what dungeon this food is stored in,  but the dogs are freakin' great. Out of sight out of mind.

Will be back!

Just now, I made the horrible choice of going to La Burrita instead of Top Dog. No, I'm not drunk. Yes, I wish I were.

I liked Top Dog even when I was a "vegetarian" - although the name "Weiner Dog" gives you a clue - they like to fuck with people, especially whiny ones. But I kinda like their take-no-shit attitude. Now their "Bird Dog" is my favorite, although the Chicken Apple is also pretty tasty. 

The only thing I'd ask them to upgrade is their condiments: besides the mustard, I think they all have high fructose corn syrup. But oh well. It's cheaper so I don't think they will ever upgrade. Still, really great for when I want some meat and bread!!!

Any true hot dog loving fan NOT giving them 5 stars is out of their mind!  Wide selection of dogs are ALWAYS grilled to perfection, served on great buns.  They have a superb selection of mustards, self serve kraut, and OMG RC cola!!.  All this in the tiny cramped Durant institution that's been there for as long as I can recall, from the same grilling dude.  NY couldn't do it any better than this.

Always go to this joint back when I was still in berkeley. They open late night, interesting crowd, and have a good hot dogs. I like their hot links and bockwurst.

I remember after spending countless of hours starring in front of the computer in the underground soda hall lab, the only place that is still open that hours is Top Dog. Cheers to 'Dog' for making a memorable experience at Berkeley.

Awesome hot dogs. I recommend the bird dog -- it had red and green peppers in a turkey dog. So good. The buns were large, dogs were delicious. Tasted the chili on a chili dog and it was very bland -- mostly beans, so I would skip the chili and just stick to the dogs. One was plenty for me and the kids, but hubby had two. He was bummed because apparently we just missed seeing Petros who was his whole inspiration for wanting to eat there in the first place. Lots of political stuff posted on the walls, but nice balance of political views represented. Guy at the grill was honest -- forgot to give me one of my dogs (which I discovered after I was stuffed from eating one), so he gave me back $3 for the dog. Nice! Felt like I made money eating there, ha ha. Not much seating, but had a counter for standing up and eating at. Offered chips and sodas too.

Top dog at it's best! Had another great meal at one of Berkeley's great institutions! Top Dog really is excellent. Two dogs and a drink for 7 bucks. not bad at all! Especially considering how good these dogs are! Had a top and a kielbasa, both

Price is moderate and service is personable enough to influence me to come back. Wait time for a hot dog to get hot felt a little long averaging about 6 minutes. This place allows you to add toppings/will give you the plain product which is great so you can customize for yourself. Have had better hotdogs elsewhere however I like that this place has variety on the menu and yet remains very simple. I dont think a hot dog should take 6 minutes to be served though.

4.5 stars. 

Great kielbasa. Good beef dog. Served on freshly baked bread with sesame seeds. And cheap. Will definitely frequent this place & its Oakland counterpart.

As a fellow Golden Bear who will always bleed blue & gold - this place has so many memories and history for me. Although the price has definitely gone up over the years (I remember when they were just $2) - the taste and tradition that comes with this place still stands strong.

Whether it's 2 in the morning, stumbling after Blakes/Henry's/Raleighs or tailgating before a Cal game - a hot dog from top dog definitely hits the spot. My faves: hot link & chicken apple. I definitely recommend you try this place out. Deli mustard for me.

Also, did you know that you can buy their hot dogs frozen w/buns? i think it comes out to $1 each - good idea if you're every gonna bbq with the buddies.

Simply put, these are the best hot dogs you will ever eat. In my opinion the best varieties are the following

1. The linguica.  This is the authentic thing; forget any greasy flavorless imitations you might have encountered in the past. The Top Dog ling comes from Portugal and  has a uniquely coarse texture that stands out from the other dogs. It's taste is equally unique, featuring red wine and fennel seed in its flavor profile. I recommend topping it with sauerkraut, a few dabs of ketchup and sweet mustard, and a lot of fresh onion. 

2. The Bockwurst. One of the two albino sausages on the menu, the bock is even lighter skinned than its bratwurst cousin . It has a mellow flavor the lightest, fluffiest texture of any sausage you will encounter, which contrasts wonderfully with the coarse ans spicy linguicia. The secret behind its amazing fluffiness is that it contains egg, so throw it on a bun and you've got an all-in-one substitute for eggs, toast and sausage. As with all sausages I recommend starting the garnish with lots of onion as (because it's the only hot dog condiment that's not  vinegar based). Then a little sauerkraut and dabs of brown mustard (and ketchup if you're one of those people who likes the taste of eggs and ketchup).

I won't say much about the atmosphere, other than that it is a beloved Berkeley landmark and it hasn't changed one bit in the many decades they've been in business.

Happy dogging!

Top Dog, been here many times and the place is way over rated. It is just a normal hot dog spot. Nothing speical to talk about just a spot to go get your hot dog fix. Everything their taste about the same, nothing stands out. To tell you the flat out truth i rather go to costco and get a costco dog and soda for $1.50

Food: Average Dogs
Price: Way over priced for hot dogs.
Selection: Alot to select from
Service: Could use some smiles once in awhile.

3 Stars for the tOP dog

Oh, Top Dog, the fond memories I have of you. You made me actually enjoy being stuck in the editing studio until the wee hours of the night just because I knew someone would eventually offer to go on a Top Dog run. Now, just before you start thinking I'm lazy (that would be accurate) I did offer my services from time to time and I'd always come back with an extra lemon chicken to make up for the calories I lost walking to meet with you.

Prettty tasty hotdog!

Hot
Juicy
Soft 
Scrumptious hot dogs.

Pretty good price too!

Honestly, what's not to love about top dog!

Lemon Chicken is good. 
Top dog is better. 
Hot Link is the best!! 

This is an absolute stop for me each time I pass by Berkeley. 

You can order some cold ones if you want to bring them to a bbq. If you're into tapioca there is a place across the street.

the service there is horrible not to mention it's a dirty location and three dollars
for a hot dog way over priced
for fast food
Best after the club eating spot!

YUMMY & cheap!

top dog's legendary.

mmm hot dogs! yummy. I got to take a few bites out of my bf's chicken apple dog with horseradish mustard and sauerkraut. The chicken apple dog was juicy and delicious and went nicely well with the pungent horseradish mustard and the sour tasting sauerkraut. I was not hungry enough to get my own but from those few bites made me wanting more! If I ever come back to the area again I'll be sure to get one to myself hehe.

Anytime the great saxophonist Philip Greenlief ( http://evandermusic.com/artist_detail.asp?artist_id=117 ) and I play gig, share a bill or even just attend one or the other's concert all the evening's events just become part of the journey to this Top Dog. 
He goes for the tops, I like the Brats and a lemonade.
The coda is a donut from King Pin across the street. 
Awesome.

I shared a Chicken Lemon with Rose and it was excellent ... excellent sausage - and that's coming from someone who doesn't normally like hot dogs! I especially loved the hot dog bun ... less of a boring old white-bread bun than a toasted sesame-baguette :) Good stuff!

I usually order to hot link, which is very spicy and delicious, but is very small and not satisfying at all. It may only be three bucks, but it only fulfills you as much as an ice cream, so expect to buy something else to fulfill you while you enjoy this snack.

Their apple sausage tastes like the one from costco. Their hot link is usually more spicy than other places, which is why I go here. Their original isnt that great, just taste like an ordinary frankfurter. Their vegetarian is pretty good for a veggie dog. They only thing I like about this place is their bread, which makes it distinctive from other places because they toast it so it comes out warm and good, but thats just about it. Nothing overly spectacular about this place. You also have to just go there and shout out what you want, because they don't look at you to take your order, which is utterly confusing. I dont know if they want me to order or not because they are busy frying but I guess you just shout it out.

Love the sausages, and the buns
price is reasonable, and the hours cater to students' needs
It is not exactly healthy food, but it is hot dog - you can't be healthy
It is disappointing that they don't really have seating, but where even 1 sq ft of store space = $$$, I guess I'd rather have the cheap hot dogs than have seating
All proper condiments are available for hot dog lovers to pick and choose from and smother their hot dog
Definitely recommend for someone who's in the area
Bay area fav, always take out of town guests here for a great dog. Reasonable pricing, hilarious libertarian propaganda, and a great deal.

There's something wrong with you if you go to Berkeley/ been in Berkeley and you haven't tried Top Dog. End of the discussion..

Let me tell you how hard it is to find a good hot dog if you're a vegetarian. Pretty darn hard. Let me also say that Top Dog has the BEST VEGGIE HOT DOG, EVER. There's really not much to say about that. It's just .....really really good. 

For $3, I guess it is pretty pricey for a hot dog but the quality is sure worth your money. I went to this place about 5 times a week when I first came to Berkeley, sometimes even twice a day. Another good thing about this place is that it opens late. I swear Top Dog tastes even better for college students after a night of partying.
After a drunken night in San Francisco, I love me some Top Dog! Parking is horrible (as usual) in Berkeley and the place is always crowded. However, it is worth the wait!

This place has been around for over 40 years.  it was decent.  I had the bratwurst and brockwurst.  The only complaint I had was that the one and only guy who works there touches your money and other's money and then continues to prepare the food.  I'm kinda anal so I don't really like that.  Also, you're on your own for the condiments that sit out on the back counter against the wall. The relish is left out in the open so who knows what goes on there.  Anyways, 2 stars because of my OCD.

More than a hot dog, one of Berkeley's greatest institutions. 
Start with the Bock or Brat. Then study the mural for a dose of local history.

I give them two stars because although their food smells tasty, I won't eat there. When I tried to eat there, the employee took my money and shuffled around more in the cash register for change then proceeded to make my hot dog without washing his hands. I politely asked for my money back and left. Understand that most of their clientele does not care about the sanitation of a restaurant. I do. I really would eat there if I trusted the cleanliness of the establishment. I mean, the food smells great after all.

I made a trip to Berkeley last night and my friend took me to Top Dog because I felt like eating something that tasted like meat ... and I'm a vegetarian so yeah.

Anyway, I got the Weiner (Veggie Dog) for $3 exact, and the taste was okay; I liked it because it had a bit of spice in it, and spice is definitely a plus.  It satisfied my appetite, if anything.  The service was quick, and I hear it's opened late, so yay.

Man, I get so irked at some of the stuff people say about Top Dog.  Yes, it is "just a hot dog shop" and therefore cannot be fairly compared to, say, Chez Panisse.  But it is an incredible hot dog shop.  Disclaimer: I've worked there for 5 years and am incredibly biased.  But maybe I can shed some light on some common complaints people have.
1) "The guy was mean to me and yelled at me when I didn't have my order in time!"
-When you go to McDonald's and get to the front of the line, do you then say "Wait, I'm not ready yet, let me discuss my options with my friend for a few minutes before I order"?  No, you move your ass out of the way so someone else can order.  Same deal here.  We figure that Berkeley students can use their common sense to figure this out, but maybe not.
2) "They should say please and thank you and be nice to the customers."
-First, we are ALWAYS nice to the customers that are actively nice to us.  We are ambivalent to the customers who ignore us, and probably rude to the customers that are rude to us.  Sorry, it's kinda human nature.  Second, it's probably 2 am and there's probably dozens of drunken kids around you.  Our priority is to get everyone fed, and it goes so much faster (and you get your food faster) if we keep the conversation pretty basic.
3) "The hygiene was questionable."  
-And I've been to Starbucks when the barista sneezed in my mocha.  Bottom line is, the Top Dog policy is to be clean.  It's a few dumb workers that make the rest of us look bad.  Oh, and when you complain that you were up all night on the toilet because of Top Dog, it's not because you have food poisoning.  It's because you ate a bunch of sausages, which are not known for being terribly healthy in general.  Order a Veggie Dog next time.
4) "The guy wouldn't take my order!"
-OK, I admit that the 2 am ordering procedure is a bit confusing at first.  My first drunken excursion there I was confused too.  When it's busy, here's how it works.  Walk in and try to get yourself seen.  If you can catch the dogger's eye, say something like "Can I get one hot link?" (Leave the drinks and chips for later.)  If it's super super busy and you can't make eye contact, keep an ear out for the dogger to ask for new orders.  That means you.  Tell him your order.  If he heard you, you'll be acknowledged with a verbal confirmation or, at the very least, a nod of the head.  Get your money out now, but don't try to give it to him yet.  In a minute he will ask you if you want anything else.  (Here's where the drink and chips are introduced.)  He'll tell you the total.  Give him your money.  (But don't make us fish change out of your sweaty hand.  Put it on the counter.)  A couple minutes later, he'll either let you know personally that your dog is ready or will yell "HOT LINK!"  You must remember what you ordered or you won't eat.  It may seem like a lot of work, but imagine how much work it is for us to remember all your orders.  It's really hard.  
OK, so I hope I've shed some light on the Top Dog way.  See you all Thursday night at midnight.  Peace.

This has got to be the best hot dog joint so far for me. It finally beat Costco by a pretty large margin only because theres variety. Ive always wanted to try this place out. The place was really tiny which is why I gave I left a star out. The service was ran by this guy who looked like he owned the place. Anyways, I ordered the Topdog special, Bockwurst sausage and my gf ordered the italian dog. All dogs were off the chain!! OMG, the buns are toasted and pretty big for the dogs to fit in. The condiments were pretty cool. I really liked how they had sauerkraut in a large bucket type thingy. The dogs were all flavorful and juicy. 

TIP--- Try the regular topdog. This has all beef natural flavor all inside. Also, when you do order a hot dog, I recommend making it New York style by just putting deli mustard and sauerkraut on top. NOTHING ELSE.

I will try to come back and eat the rest of the different hot dogs. MMMM great place! well done!

Nothing is better than a Top Dog on the way home from a late night of studying at the library or at midnight when you are going stir crazy in your dorm from all the studying.  

I stuck to the traditionals - Kielbasa and the frankfurters, and they were delicious.  The toasted buns really adds to the dog.  I never at the Chicken Apple but I had friends who lived off of them.  They offered a broad variety of dogs - the most random dogs you've never heard of.  

This place is very "Berkeley" - bumper stickers everywhere, standing room only, cramped while waiting for your dog to finish.  Awesome.  

I gave it a 4 stars because of the cash-only dealy and because I always got a little sketched out that the cooks never wore gloves.  They limited their touching of the dog but still, it was a bit gross.  The standing-room only business when it was cramped (say, after a concert or something) tended to be annoying, but it also added to the Berkeley experience.  

Definite recommend!
Their Hot Link is my favorite.

It shouldn't take 20 minutes to make a bird dog. Not sure they can handle large crowds. The African American ladies that were waiting just as long were not as patient. As a result they wanted their money back. Their hot dogs are good though. That's why I at least gave 2 stars.
Great quick stop for a dog.

This is my favorite place for a hot dog.  No frills you just walk in and kind of shout out your order.  They have a condiment bar with all the good stuff.  A great variet of hot dogs.  I usually get a top dog, with spicy mustard, onions and relish, a bag of chips and a lemonade.  Price is right also.

I can't believe I haven't reviewed Top Dog yet.  Yuuuuuum.

They've got all sorts of dogs, and you can even buy huge packs of them frozen.  I always go for the Top Dog Beef Frank for $3.  Can't beat it, topped with spicy russian mustard.  A few days ago I bought two dogs just for myself and wolfed them both down.  

Their other options always look really good to me too, but the beef frank is old reliable.  

This location is super small and can get crowded, but service is always fast.

One of the many places I miss about norcal... TOP DOG!  so cheap so simple so delicious!  Choices that i get (depending on mood of course) is chicken apple, lemon apple, brat, or hot link... but all of them are very delicious!  except for the veggiedog.. but then again ...i love meat!  so thats probably why...

the guy in the front can be a bit intimidating but it's all worth it... just order, pay, go and enjoy!!  :D

Best hot dogs and sausages in the area, and that I have ever had; period! This place is awesome, really quick service and every type of hot dog that I have tried so far has been awesome. If you haven't been it is definitely worth trying out. Last quarter we used to go once a week because it is just so damn good!
legendary.  i drive across the bridge for top dogs

Best hotdogs ever.

A hotdog is two things: sausage and bread. Get either of these wrong and you have a crappy hotdog. Top Dog gets both of these so perfectly right.

I'm a fan of the Bockwurst and Bratwurst. They're plump, juicy, and change of pace from your typical hotdog. The bread that they use is slightly crisp and warm on the outside from sitting on the grill, and soft on the inside.

For a moderately big eater like me (I'm 5'10" 165lbs), two of these hotdogs fill me up and make a meal. One makes a great snack to hold me over until dinner.

Another Cal tradition!!!! Truely amazing dogs any time of the day, especially late at night when nothing else is open! Nice grilled dog and buns made unlike any other. Not really focused on the toppings but rather the unique individual flavor of each special dogs. My top favorites are the hot links (nice amount of spice if you like it hot), Linguica (tends to be a little dry but a very unique taste) and Calabrese (nice amount of hot and sweet). If you are in town, you gotta TRY IT!!!!

I don't think I've ever eaten top dog sober so I don't know if I should even be writing this review. I just remember I like the spicy one a lot.  I think i've tried the girly one (either chicken apple or the other girly one?? i forgot) and that was yummy :) hahaha. I practically live next door to this place.

It's okay. Very overrated by Berkeley people.

And it didnt help that the guy who made our hotdogs, touched our money, did not clean hands, touched his hair, did not clean hands, then made our dogs, with no gloves, just bare-handed.

Grossed me out.

so i'm probably going to get some dirty looks from my husband for only giving Top Dog 3 stars, but it just didn't impress me to the magnitude that i expected.  my husband is a cal alum and like so many others from cal, he LOVES Top Dog and proclaims it to be the best hot dogs in the world.  when i finally had the opportunity to try my first very own top dog, it unfortunately did not live up to the mountain of expectation that had built up.  

thus this is probably an unfair review given the fact that i was imagining a life changing hot dog to appear before me.  it was good, don't get me wrong, the various flavors and snap of the dogs from the grill, toasted sesame buns, and sauerkrat, mustart condiments on the side for you to add as much as you want....all amount to a great hot dog joint.  

i just wouldn't crave one or need to go to berkeley for one any time soon

i'll have to try it again with less preconceived notions of grandure

There are numerous other top dogs in Berkeley but somehow i always find myself at this one. Maybe im just addicting to the "awesome" service that these guys behind the counter provide. BTW, the owners of this place is notorious for being rude. 

The service is terrible but i think their thrive off of being mean to other so whatever. On to the hotdogs-everything i've tried here has been extremely tasty. Some worthy of mentioning is the apple sausage, the hot link and the garlic. The bread is warm and toasty and there are an array of toppings that you can pick from. They also sell raw hot dogs with buns so you can take it home with you and cook it yourself. 

Do yourself a favor and do your research and know what you want to order before you get there. These guys hate customers that asks 20 questions before they order so do your homework! 

Great food though and very very cheap :)

Used to be my late night stop after midnight in the late 90's when I used to live in the East Bay.  I always thought i would getaround to trying all the different hotdogs they carried, but I moved away before I had the chance too.  Definetely the best dogs I ever had.  No frills place, kinda run down and dirty with bums outside in the later part of the evenings, but, As longas the dogs were good, it was worth it.  I always had 2-3 dogs each visit.  They are kinda on the smaller side if you are a big eater like me!

Top Dog is not for the faint-hearted. 

You have to be aggressive, tough, and adamant if you want to get your order in here. 

This is where I learned how to fake confidence as I approach the grill and demand, "one chicken apple," adding "please" only in a condescending manner, as if I'm suddenly  better than the griller just because I've overcome his intimidating manner. 

He already touches money and hot dog without gloves, what do I care if he spits on my dog cos I give him attitude?

But secretly, I like coming here after a long night of party-hopping on frat row just because I feel like the griller will protect me if any hobos or drunkards come to make a scene :]. He looks like the type that takes no BS.

I ordered the Top Dog topped with picked cabbage and mustard. I think it's too overpriced for a hot dog. I got a burned dog, since the worker is fairly new. I asked to fire up another one but they can't do it since they're busy. Huh!.

We use to hit this location many late nights when I was a student.  I like it when they serve Top Dog on campus during catered events.  My favorite used to be the hot link with Russian mustard.

Now I tend to buy Calabrese and others types by the large package then grill or barbecue at home or parties.  I also have a huge container of the mustard.  And I buy the sesame seed buns as well.

I have been going to the Top Dog at the Oakland Longs Drugs since they used to have discounts.   Now it is a CVS.

I like the RC because that i the soda we drank as kids.  The carbonation, acidity, and sweetness is very different from Coke and Pepsi.

The first dog we got was a decent Bratwurst.  But the second one was a vegetarian one and it tasted funky.  My friend said it tasted like a Round Table pizza, which isn't necessarily a bad thing because he likes RT.  Also, the wait was rather long for a mere dog.

Best hot dog joint, hands down!!!  Maybe I haven't been to many hot dog places, maybe I don't travel around enough.  When I think of good hot dogs, tasty hot dogs, hot dogs that I will crave for.  The only place that comes in mind is TOP DOG.  They have all these different flavors to choose from.  My personal favorite is the hot link.  My gf loves the lemon chicken.  The only thing I would complain about when I go and satisfy my cravings, is the parking situation on durant.  However, since top dog is so good, I don't mind circling a couple of times...(ONLY A COUPLE OF TIMES).

There isn't much left to say about Top Dog that hasn't already been said.

The hot dogs are delicious. I've tried the Calabrese, Garlic dog, Kielbasa, Lemon Chicken, and the Hot Link. All are good and worth trying. Every time I've had top dog the hot dogs are all super juicy and flavorful. My personal favorite is the hot link with its perfect amount of heat. The buns are staple as well, hearty and easily stands up to a heaping helping of toppings.

What I love about this place is the laid back, no-bullshit attitude. It's about getting in and out quickly and efficiently. Awesome that it's open late especially for those late night post-drinking munchies. 

All I can say is this place is worth trying multiple times. I plan on giving each hot dog a try and can't wait for my next visit.

Been wanting to visit a good hot dog place for a long time now, and this place definitely hit the spot. I've been hearing about Top Dog for a long time now and finally got a chance to stop by. You really can't get much simpler than this: Get up to the grill, give your order, pay the man, then wait for him to hand you a paper wrapped bundle of deliciousness. 

There's not really any where to sit except for a couple of bar stools, and if you stand around inside you'll likely be blocking somebody from getting to the condiment bar. There are about 3 kinds of mustards, ketchup, relish, and sauerkraut. My favorite was definitely the hot russian mustard; yes, it does pack a kick. The soft drink selection is definitely old school, you won't even find Coke or Pepsi, but RC cola! 

I tried the Bratwurst, Chicken & Apple, and Hot Link. I can't really tell you which one was the best, because they were all good! Nicely grilled sausage, well toasted bun, what more could you ask for? I've definitely got to go back to try the other sausages. MMmm.....

Back in my earlier college days my friends and I would always try to take a side trip to Berkeley not only to visit friends but to come out and have an amazing hot dog on the way. Every time we hung out with those crazy UC students they would take us here for a light "snack" or food depending on what you order. Now in order to imagine what kind of place this is, just know that tons of college students come here for some good deals. It's exactly like a hole in the wall you would find in any big city but I like how the workers are always willing to give you a run for your money when it comes to sensitive topics or anything revolving around politics (go figure huh?) but at the same time they will serve you up great brats or anything else you crave and desire all at a very reasonable price. This place is pretty much standing room only so order quick and move on for others to get their grub. It's not as greasy as some other places I have been to in the past but good nonetheless. It is a little far to get to as there are only 2 locations around the area but if you ever find yourself visiting, then this place is a must.

yes their ice machine is very big.  that might be because they need to serve a lot of drinks with their hot mustard.  anyways, this place is rad.  varied and delicious hot dogs, and good potato salads to boot.  I can't vouch for anything but the calabrese dog...but hot diggity dog (yep, I just said it) that was amazing.
You can't go wrong at Top Dog!!!  The best Hot Dogs in California!!!!

THAT RUSSIAN MUSTARD is not fucking around!!!  Seriously.  I won't waste your time reviewing the dogs themselves, because with 1,000+ reviews and 4.5 stars, you're already coming here, right?

Don't miss the condiments though.  Mmm sauerkraut, onions, and relish if you're into that kinda thing. :-P BUT KNOW what you're getting yourself into if you get the Russian Mustard (there are others).  I love spicy, sinus-clearing experiences, but after I howled at fellow yelper Deanne C. in pain, I described it as "I kind of wanted to roll on the ground crying, but it was also amazing and I loved it."

Take a taste first ;)

So I kept hearing about top dog and finally I decided to go to the one that had opened up in Downtown San Jose because it was greatly raved ... however I was pretty disappointed after having had PINK'S in Southern California so many times and Costco every other time ... 

However, I kept telling myself that maybe the San Jose one doesn't do justice because it's just NOT original ... maybe...
