So I trekked all the way out to Berkeley to visit the ORIGINAL top dog, the one that everyone raves about. Honestly it's not a bad hot dog but it's just not a good one, and for this kind of price I would expect PINK'S quality but you just don't get it. The selection is ok and there are never any seats at any of these places ... sigh ...

It's not as good as Underdog in SF but it's pretty darn good, sober or drunk.  Open late and friendly on the wallet, if I'm around the area, I will definately stop by and get a fresh, juicy, delicious lemon chicken hotdog with extra-extra onions.  If you're lucky like me, your friend will be nice enough to piggyback your drunken ass to get some!  :)

3.5 Star

Top Dogs Anyone? I feel like this place is a bit overrated but still is the best spot for some dogs... maybe I'm not too much of an hot dog fan? Don't get me wrong... the dog here is juicy and perfectly cooked but I wasn't wow-ed by it.... maybe my expectations are too high... I've been here a few times because my bf and his friends craves for this every now and then. They also open late, so that's a plus.

My favorite?
- Chicken Apple Sausage and the yummy toasted bun are used instead of the regular hot dog buns.

What's so special about Top Dog?
- Dogs and buns are placed on a flat top grill to be grilled when ordered.

Condiments: Ketchup, Mustard, Russian Mustard, sauerkraut, relish and onions.

This spot is small but I'm always amazed by the fast service and memory of all the orders from this guy. Great for people who has late night cravings.

You know... I have to admit that this is the best spot for Top Dogs though! Also, only $3 a dog!!! You've got to try it out if you haven't yet!

Almost forgot... CASH ONLY!!!
No hot dog is worth the rude attitude I experienced here. I'd rather spend my money at an establishment that values it's customers and treats them with respect.

Been coming here since I was a high school pup in the early 70's. Best dogs anywhere with a great attitude. I live 3 hours away from here now, but whenever I'm in town and I get a hankerin' for a dog, Top Dog is the only place I go. Long Live Top Dog!! Too bad they closed the Montclair location, but the north side shop rocks too!
Lemon Chicken & Apple Sausage, UGH yum.
Yum.  A great place for late night munchies or any time of the day really. Service is friendly.  Had a chicken apple hot dog for $3 and it was delicious!

Top Dog catered our 200+ person event this summer on the Cal campus.  They are fantastic!  They brought out a bbq grill and grilled everything before our students arrived.  Unlike the many other caterers we've dealt with, they knew how to handle a large crowd of kids.  I definitely appreciate the swift replies, efficiency, and flexibility of the staff.  :)

Hotlink Hotdog will be a regular for me there. 

If I only had a bigger stomach to try everything else on the menu.

Only downside to this place would be lack of space. But nothing wrong with eating a hotdog on the street with seven other people.

Oh yes, and "Politicians Unwelcomed"
Really good! I love coming here after a long night out with my friends. IT always does the job! Shoutout to all the frat guys that delivered multiple orders of Top Dog back to my friend's place!

Worth your time. I know its just a hot dog but they are legit. From the chix apple to a standard bratwurst, they are cooked to perfection on a great toasted bun. Great late night food or an on the go snack. Very reasonable priced as well.

I've been wanting to try this place for a while as I am a HUGE hot dog fan, but I'm not sure top dog lived up to my expectation. They were definitely tasty, I enjoyed the chicken apple and garlic dogs. The bread was also nice and toasted. But I feel like I could make some similar with a grill and some sausages from costco. Still tasty though!

Not impressed, but I have to admit, I've never been a hot dog lover :( 
They used a baguette for the buns. That was pretty good! :) 

ordered: 
1. chicken 
2. beef
3. vegie

yes.....I eat alot...you have a problem with that??

i love this hole in the wall.  top dog is an indoor hotdog stand, it's just what it is.  their louisiana hot link is the BOMB!  the hot link is spicy, spicy, spicy.  the snap of the skin is awesome and the toasted buns just make everything taste better!  must try if in berkeley, or san francisco, or visiting anywhere in the bay area, particularly after 9pm.  that's right, it just tastes better at night.

If you guys watch seinfeld, maybe this might help the review out.

remember the soup nazi in seinfeld?

ORDER, MOVE, GET FOOD, PAY!

When I went to Top Dog, that is what the feeling I got. The cook was like, PLEASE ORDER, AND MOVE ASIDE, PAY LATER WHEN YOU GET THE DOG! 

I was like wow, sorta hectic and how the hell are they gonna know what hot dog I ordered because there is like literally 30 people in front of me and I got no slip or anything?

I heard CHICKEN APPLE! I was like is that mine? He goes, YES THIS ONE IS YOURS. I was like impressed. They know how to run the business there.

Okay now for the food, 2 words

FAWKIN GOOD!

The END.
Chicken Apple Sausage , that's all I have to say. The hot dogs are okay, I'm not a fanatic over them, but I could understand why people love this place.
Didn't meet much of my expectations. I guess it's convenient that it's opened so late but I think I'd prefer a sausage link from Costco.
it's good..it's fast..and it hits the spot...but...5 star worthy for a hotdog?..i can understand if they ground their own meat to make gourmet hotdogs....but...anyways..it's good stuff...go grab one

I was really excited to eat top dog since I haven't. Had it in a while but this experience made me not want it again. It was super crowded, there was barely no space to move but what topped my experience was the fact that the worker was handling the food and the money! Using no gloves or washing his hands in between... at first I thought no way but as he was receiving money from customers he would use the same hand to cook the buns.... It was too unsanitary, money should just not be mixed with food.

Whilst visiting Berkley, we had a quick bite here.  We really enjoyed their Calabrese and Hot Links, and the price was still $3.  Good for them!!!  They didn't mind cutting the sausages in half (to remove the extra fat) at all.  My old review still stands.
The shrine of hot dogs.  Don't bring an empty stomach because it can get pricey in a hurry after 3 dogs, but the selection of sausages is just amazing.

Cheap and yummy and delicious. What more could you ask for? I loved the kielbasa, one of my all time favorites done perfectly. I missed the line, but the line grew quickly since these hot dogs are tasty and cheap! The guy working behind the counter had a sarcastic sense of humor, a huge plus in my book.
lemon chicken sausage, mmmmm!

When I was a kid, I threw up after eating top dog once, and proceeded to boycott it for the next 10 or so years of my life. It might have been good going in, but it (apparently) wasn't so great coming out. I recently got over this fear/bias though, and haven't looked back since. I love this place!
I went there to taste the hype.. i was a little disappointed in their garlic frankfurter-- nothing special.. I should have tried my friend's recommendation for their chicken apple!

5 stars for the memories. Late night Berkeley roaming always ends at Top Dog. The hot dogs are just slightly above average (unless you have been drinking) and are normally priced, but the whole experience is part of Berkeley.

the only times that i've eaten at top dog in my years at berkeley were when nothing else was open and/or i needed something to absorb the alcohol in my stomach.  it's best at 2am when it's cold outside and you get your tasty dog piping hot.  my only pet peeve is that one time the guy who was handling all the money started touching all the buns when he was putting them on the grill.  gross!  people need to wash their hands after touching money, you never know where it's been.

Meat?  Goooood!  Ketchup?  Goooood!  Mustard?  Goooood!  Onions?  Goooood!  Greasy hot dog while you're piss drunk in the streets of Berkeley?  GOOOOOOOOOD!  What more can you ask for besides one of those greasy two tacos for a dollar from Jack in the Crack?  Top Dog reminds me of that Seinfeld episode with the Soup Nazi.  If you haven't seen it, you should get smacked in the face!  You need to know what you're going to order and don't make the cooks wait.  Be drunk, order quickly and eat.  Yum!

The pre-cooked dogs they sell before football games en masse are not as great as the ones hot off the grill inside, but top dog deserves its place as the best hot dog in the bay area.

The one on Durant is the home base of the enigmatic but professional grill-man. Start there.

Walking up Durant you are suddenly hit square in the face with the most delicious wave of smells. I am one of those who reconsiders if I have to get where I'm going on time and I always make a detour. 

Top Dog is excellent drunk. It may even be better sober because you can enjoy it more and not have to split your attention between your chicken apple and trying to make it up the hill. 

I've had almost everything on the menu but the all time favorite is the Chicken apple. You can't beat it. It truly is the best sausage / hot dog I've ever had.

My dad would swear by Pinks in LA and since I was a kid we stood in those lines to get the dogs and enjoy the snap of the casing. 

I am proud to say that since he tried Top Dog, the poor man is reduced to hungry glazed mush every time he boards a plane up to SF. He even admits that Pinks doesn't stand a chance. 

If that's not a testimony, I don't know what is.

THE late night Southside eatery.

The attitude you'll get from behind the counter is all part of the experience.

Enjoy

I'm grateful for all of the reviewers who give Top Dog only one or two stars because this just means fewer people to wait behind in line for our dogs.  We're all thrilled that you're going to eat at your neighborhood T.G.I. Friday's tonight.  Seriously, have a good time.

Top Dog is the place to get the BESTEST Hot links!!
MMMMMMMMMM...........YUM.
But One little COMPLAINT The price is kinda iffy cause it is $3
That's all, but EVERYTHING else is good

Top Dog is my standard for all hotdog places on the planet earth. Grilled, not boiled. No frills, no fancy pants anything. Big dog selection. Quick service. Blaring music. A big dose of 'tude. Perfect.

There are only 3 things I truly crave when I come through Berk. A Cal game followed by the Bears Lair, the asian ghetto, and Top Dog.

Also, any time a hot dog shack wants to tell you about the government, I think we should all be required to listen. I know what politicians have to say, I know where the rich and famous stand... but what about hot dog shacks? Do you have ANY idea where they stand on the social issues of our times?

I didnt think so. I didnt think so.

Service is fast but they never refill their ketchup dispenser.  There is generally only one counterperson there he probably can't leave the grill but I splattered ketchup all over my shirt in an attempt to get some.

The top dog was a bit too tough and not as good as Nathan's hot dogs.

I really enjoyed this place. My girlfriend doesn't like hot dogs so I ordered the top dog to try it out. Just as everyone says, its a good dog on a baguette bun,which was nice instead of a regular hot dog bun. I tried some hot mustard that cleared my sinuses right up. The guy working the counter was "rude"in a funny,quirky way. Someone tried to pay with some nickels and dimes (not only with them) and apparently they don't take them here. (Just a heads up) The lady had some banter back and forth with him and the gave each other witty come backs. It was entertaining to watch while o waited for my dog. 

I'll stop by again the next time I visit my girlfriend to try another dog.
1.Lemon chicken, 1.Bird Dog and 1.braut, and an RC cola (yeah, RC). You can't go wrong (damn I miss Berkeley).

I am a fan of the Hot Dog. Some people think hot dogs are gross... I am not one of those people. 

Top Dog has been there for me for so many years. When I first went to Top Dog I was a big hot dog fan. They even supported me during my vegetarian faze with "The Wienie" which is STILL the best veggie hot dog I've ever had (most veggie hot dogs are kinda gross and have a weird texture). 

Top Dog has everything a hot dog lover could want. Variety, flavor, toppings. A+

yummy snack. 

love the bockwurst ( i became a huge fan of these in my travels through germany and was so pleased that top dog has them)

love the super spicy, sinus opening leading to snot dripping awesome mustard. 

plus they have rc cola. 

plus its one of the best late-night-post-drinking foods to sop up a belly full of alcohol. thanks top dog.
$3 Brats rule.

Top Dog is a place most people go to after the bars close in Berkeley and with good reason. So many choices you really can't go wrong with any of them. The line is usually out the door but, moves quickly.

On my last visit there a homeless person "traded" with the cashier for the German Frankfurter. What he traded for to get a dog you might ask? Well, let's just say you would have an urge for some munchies afterward.

I always order myself 2 dogs when I go Kielbasa followed by a Bratwurst loaded with the works (relish,ketchup,mustard and sauerkraut). All their dogs have their own distinct taste and flavor from their traditional Top Dog to their Lemon Chicken dog each will earn a special place in your stomach. $2.75 for such a delicious dog you can't go wrong. Open til 2am during the week for those unfortunate enough to be stuck working in studio or 3am for those who venture out to the bars and clubs on the weekends. You spend your time outside on the sidewalk standing around eating your dog along with a bunch of other people eating the same thing. They do have seats inside all 4 of them and during the late night  hours those seats are removed to make room for the crowds that soon follow.

They also sell your choice of dogs uncooked for bbq's or other event's. I brought a pack to a recent bbq and they were a hit.

If your ever in Berkeley you owe it to yourself to experience some of the most enjoyable flavors to be had at Top Dog.
The dog is amazing, but the service...not so much. Bad service, great food. Oh well, in the end the tastes what matters so I'm definitely going to frequent there again.
aside from the price (i know it's cheap, but i'm kinda cheap)-- mmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm

How good can a hot dog be? Once you have tried top dog, you will find out.

I have tasted most of their dogs, and my favorites are the top, hot link, lemon chicken and calabrese. The hot dog has this distinct snap when you bite into it that is just amazing. The hot link really packs a punch, but well worth it. The lemon chicken was real interesting; but I like sour foods and a big fan of chicken. The calabrese is probably my favorite; great pork taste with a hint of spiciness.

The only challenge is that the lines get real long and it's pretty hectic and intimidating to get your order in. The condiments are thrown out there and usually are empty, and you're always bumping into someone inside cause it's so tiny. And by the time you walk out of the place, you smell like a hot dog.

Nonetheless, my great friend who lives up north comes down with a "6 pack" in hand and life couldn't get any better.

lookie here,

I'm not one of these people who throws out 5 star reviews left and right..... well, ... this is only my second review so I haven't really had the chance... but I promise not to be one of those people. The reason this place gets a 5 star is because it makes no bones about what it is, and what it does.... well, what it does is heaven on bread with condiments. this place is dirty, cheap and absolutely phenomenal. I honestly wake up craving this sometimes in the morning, just thinking about it now has convinced me to go out of my way on my way home from work tonight to get one. Keep up the good work top dog.. and I'll keep comin back.
For anyone pasing through Bezerkeley, this is a must do.  Nothing beats a top dog on a french roll.....

Not that there's a great deal of difference, but this original branch is the one to go to if you have the choice. They sometimes have specials, like a Molinari chorizo the other week, and the high turnover eliminates the risk of semi-stale buns or condiments. Usually, though, I'll go to the closest branch.

I always heard about this spot and when I got the chance to go here one late night in Berkeley, I was excited!!  It took us awhile to find this place after we found that the other Top Dog in Berkeley was closed but at last, we were here.  We parked in the small lot next door that was awkwardly painful to get in and out of and scraped our low ridin' rice rocket, so my advice is to find some street parking.  At first I was overwhelmed when I got there because there was so much happening in such a little store!!  Everything was quick moving that I was afraid of slowing anything down.  After staring at the menu, I ended up getting the Lemon Chicken which was pretty good.  First, make sure you bring cash!! I didn't have any but thank god my friend did, because if not there would be no Top Dog for the night!  Second, don't look like an amateur and expect some ketchup. I put mustard and onions on mine and was ready to go!  Overall, the combo was good but I can't say anything too special about the dog itself.  However, I did like the bread-- A LOT.  And I usually don't like bread so it's kinda weird... But overall, it's cheap, open late night and good to have randomly.  I don't love LOVE it yet, but I'm ready to go back and try another flavor.

One of my first stops to pig out in the bay area was here....

For the price I think it's not enough to fill you up, but the quality you can expect much better than any ordinary sausage/ hotdog/ bun. Place is friendly and there's lots of campus students/ visitors such as myself. Inside it's very compact so when it gets busy it's not a nice place to be standing around in.

It's good, but I can find a better hotdog stand around LA or NY.

CHICKEN APPLE SAUSAGE dog on a SESAME BUN!! 
So delicious... especially on a late cold night.  I've tried many dogs here but the chicken app beats them all :)

Top Dog another hole in the wall was first introduced to me by my loving boyfriend. We came to eat at Top Dog right before a Cal Bears vs. Oregon game (not to mention Cal Bears won that day...WooHoo!!) Other than the hard to find parking, the hot dogs and links here were absolutely DELISH!! My boyfriend had the bratwurst and I had the calabrese due to the fact that I almost always eat my hot dogs with jalapènos and since they didn't have any, which I didn't mind, I ordered something spicy. At $3 per dog it was well worth it and it came with a hot toasty bun. I was surprised that they were very nice to let us bring in our own vitamin water from the liquor store across the street.

Definitely a late night spot if you're in Berkeley.   The guy who works here purposely tries to be mean to you so make sure you don't take it personally.  The bread is probably what makes the hot dog so good because its different from any other hot dog bun you've ever had. It's not really like the usual soft bun that hot dogs come with but more of a harder crust (soft inside) type of bread.  Try the following dogs when you go there:

chicken apple
top dog
bratwurst

There will be a lot less people during the day and you will be able to sit down and eat inside but once you hit dinner time and beyond, you'll have to stand outside and eat your hot dog. Enjoy!

This review is not about the grilled sausages served at Top Dog, although they are the best, and I'm not just saying it because I'm a Cal alum and have been eating them for over 40 years (my dad started bringing me when I was a kid).

Instead, I'm going to talk about the "cold dogs" that Top Dog sells.  They will sell you six cold sausages and six unheated buns for $8.50 (both in plastic bags), so you can take them home and cook them anytime (or put them in the freezer for later).  The sausages are fully-cooked, so you just have to grill them (long and slow is best) and toast the buns.  They're the same dogs and buns (exactly) that you get in the shop.

My favorites, for those of you who are scoring at home, are the Hot Link (Louisiana Style) and the Kielbasa (Polish).

top dog is a berkeley institution. 
It's open until at least two in the morning daily (three on weekends), capitalizing on the late-night hunger-struck stoners and drunks. 
that said, top dog is one of the few foods that tastes just as good (or maybe even better) when sober.

the veggie dog is absolutely incredible, though I find it demoralizing to have to utter it's title "the wienie" when I order - I guess that's what a non-carnivore gets for trying to eat at a damn hot dog joint. 

also - if you're ever having a barbeque (or, of course, if you are moving to a place where top dog is inaccessible [first, reconsider this choice] and you urgently need to stock your freezer) they sell their hot dogs and buns in bulk for dirt cheap.

yum, yum, yum. a must-have in berkeley. a little hole-in-the-wall with awesome dogs. perfect for a late-night snack, or for those times when you are a bit tipsy. quick and delish. especially the chicken apple. that is some good stuff. yes, the guy that works there may be a bit of an ass, but hey. i consider that part of its charm.

Pretty self explanatory.  It's a hot-dog stand that sells some really high-end sausages (mostly SAAG I believe) on a great sesame seed bun. Almost all of them are great given what you feel like at the time.

If you want to steer clear from grease, then choose the chicken apple or similar non-pig dogs (the menu is clear about whats what). the hot links are pretty hot and great on a cold day. condiments are provided self-serve. 
this place is still fairly cheap after all this time. gotta love it.
Delicious hot dogs!  A little bit more expensive than your normal $1.50 Costco hot dogs!  But the quality is so much better.  Whenever you walk by Top Dog, you can smell the deliciousness

Five stars only because they're open late and the quality of their hot dogs has not gone down since the first time I came here ~11 years ago.

I've never ordered anything else here but the Lemon Chicken. For $3, I am a happy camper. The sausage is always bursting with flavor inside a warm, grilled bun. They have a variety of different mustards on the counter along with ketchup, relish, onions, and sauerkraut (which is in a heated container).

I recently went to their other location on Center Street, which is bigger and nicer. The Durant location does not have indoor seating whereas the Center one does. Both are conveniently located because one is close to campus and the other is close to where I live.

Yay for cheap, efficient food! :O)

When I first arrived in Berkeley, it was 2.75 for a good dog. It's probably up to a full dollar more now, though I haven't been back in some time.

Regardless of the price, this is a no-brainer 5-star review for me. There is nothing bad that I can say about Top Dog. It's such a staple in the Berkeley college lifestyle. The shop has been there for decades and you can always count on a satisfying experience. Honestly, I've never had a hot dog better than the ones at Top Dog, and I currently live in New York City.

My favorites are the Chicken Apple Sausage and the Kielbasa. If you fancy a lighter sausage, I'd go for the Lemon Chicken or the Bird Dog (turkey + cilantro). You've got to get all the condiments; this includes onions, relish, sauerkraut, ketchup and mustard.

IMPORTANT NOTE: If you want to eat here, don't be a jackass. It's important that you don't hinder the full operating efficiency of this place, or you WILL be yelled at. Keep your cool and don't hold up the line. I'm of course referring to the drunken freshmen at 1:30AM. 

Man, I miss this place.

haven't been here in a while but i've gotta say this place is awesome!  2 hotdogs and a drink and you're set. we're here at least once everytime i visit the bay

small place and there is no line. you just wait for him to look at you or just holler you're order. he got it.

I think the only thing I don't like about Top Dog is that fact that it attracts unsavory characters. Otherwise, what's not to love about a hot dog place that stays open for drunk people and has numerous kinds of delicious sausages on a grilled bun? Most are $3, and they have veggie options. They also have $1 fountain drinks and chili (vegan) too. I mean, this place is a Berkeley classic.

There's nothing better than grabbing "two kiels and a chicken apple" after a night of drinking in Berkeley. 

The service is good, as long as you know what you want. You want a Top Dog? You say you want a "Top Dog", not a hot dog. Order your dogs, then shut up. When they ask you what else you want, THEN you can ask for chips or a drink. Staring up at the menu blankly or asking dumb questions will get you skipped for other hungry customers. That's part of why I like Top Dog; they don't put up with annoying drunk customers or people that don't know what they want. 

They have an excellent hot dog condiments bar with plenty of mustard, relish, and ketchup to customize your favorite type of dog. There's always a fun crowd at top dog; college kids, bums and people who just got out of a bar/show. Check it out sometime if you're in the area or you're fiending for a good hot dog.
Turkey dog was pretty good.  Got a discount cause it was smaller.
Love top dog. Make the special trip every once in awhile and I am always pleased. The chicken apple is great..and so is the wienie!

I came here with some drunk friends. most of them were hyping up TopDog...I've never been here before. i ordered the German Frankfurter. The frankfurter was good and the bun was nice and toasted.  I came away unamazed, it tasted just like something I could make myself, but it was still good. The guy taking orders was pretty good at his job, but the place was small, crowded, and some of the condiments were out or looked unsanitary.. I would come here again and try a different dog, but wouldn't go outta my way to get one.
Top Dog... how can you top that!

As delicious as I remembered it ... back when I attended Cal and walked (instead of drove) and lugged around a 30 lb backpack.  Ahhh, those were the days.  Everytime I walk around Berkeley, I miss it and wish I came back more often.  It's good to go here when it's crowded, you get your hots dogs faster because the grill is turned up and cranking.  $3.00 for a dog ... cash only.  

I know that I said I'd name my penis Fat Slice ... but if I had a second penis to name, it would be named Top Dog.

5 stars for the best dog!!!

From the bay and living in LA, I constantly crave my Chicken Apple at Top Dog.  Every time I've gone up for the past 6 years, I've gotten fix.  For the people who like Pink's, stay away because we don't want you here.  This is all about the MEAT aka dog and not about mixing weird concoction of condiments together. What do I get? 2 chicken apple's, a little bit of ketchup, hot russian mustard, and maybe some sauerkraut with an RC cola.  Yeah baby!!
Back in college, I had friends who would drive up north to Top Dog to get their fix and hang out with friends before driving back down the SAME day.  I swear by this. It's that good.

BTW, cash only

I love this specific location! 

This student area near the UC campus is a culinary eyesore filled with beggars and loud, leftists activists in your face every step of the way. Top Dog is like Calgon for me.

They have several chicken and turkey sausage options which were tasty and cheap. The place is a hole in the wall yet the one guy running the whole thing makes it seem like Cheers. I watched as he giggled to "Family Guy", chatted with everyone and somehow pumped out yummy sausages on a pretty busy night. 

Not all the Top Dogs are like this one and I am so glad that I stumbled upon it.

Out late? High? Drunk? Hungry? If so...treat yourself to some fucking Top Dogs.

Everytime I come here at night its busy. But that doesn't mean you could just chill there looking at the menu shit, make a decision and get your money out.  After ordering my shit, I just chill there by the door amazed on how the cashier/cook could remember all the orders of 10 different people and add up the total within a minute.  Yeah, i'm sure anyone could do it if they worked there for a couple of weeks but dude...when you're high, that shit looks like a circus act.

I sometimes play a game in my head while i'm waiting and see if i could beat the cashier dude on adding it up.  I always lose.

Suggestions:  Get a hotlink and the chicken apple.  They're like night and day.  Don't stand directly outside the exit to eat your food.  Instead, go ahead and sit on the steps of the house next to the parking lot.  You had a long night, you deserve it. When you're done, leave the litter in front of the steps.  Think of it as leaving a present.  If you had the hotlink, get ready to have a burning anus after your morning dump.  Cheers!

What can I say about the legendary Top Dog??  $3 each for some of the best dogs out there.  Regular toppings (ketchup, several different kinds of mustards, onions, relish) are self-serve.  What really sets Top Dog apart from other dogs is the SNAP you get when biting through the skin.  

Faves: Bockwurst, chicken apple, louisiana hot link

the ORIGINAL!! that's all i can say.  there will always be a special place in my heart for the Lemon Chicken-- so good anytime but especially after a night of heavy drinking.  Back in my college days I was a regular...  in fact one time I witnessed a pretty bad fight out front and even got subpeonaed to show up at court since i was a witness!  i guess that's what happens when you get a bunch of drunk pissy hungry guys at the same place at the same time.  awww how i miss the good ol days.  Thankfully, now I live by the one in the giant Long's on Pleasant Valley though its not open quite as late, and usually there's not as much action.  oh well....
dank assed stuff

I think Top Dog has lost it's buzz compared to 7 years ago.  From my older Cal friends and sister, hot dogs used to be only ~$1.50 and it made a fantasticly cheap late-night meal after a drunken night of debauchery.  Nowadays, hot dogs are $3 =(.  For a college kid, you can easily lose $1.50 and not care, but $3?  that's pretty significant haha

I still pay my visits here because I heart my spicy food.  I now always get the hot link with the spicy russian mustard. (I used to get the deli mustard, but thanks to my bro colby, I discovered russian spicy mustard!  The russian mustard had a good portion of horseradish in it. Oh the nasally burn =)  Unlike normal ketchup and mustard, the russian mustard is only located on ONE end of the condiments table.)

Overall, good variety of dogs to choose from, but only a select few have easily recognizable distinct flavors.  Smoked Chicken Apple, Lemon Chicken, Hot Link to name a few

Lemon Chicken Hotdog is so good I didn't try anything else on the menu.

I use to come here pretty frequently when I was living in the East Bay Area 12 years ago. I make a point to come here whenever I'm visiting the Bay area.

Good to come here a little bit after lunch or in the afternoons. Not a good place to be at Midnight as every college student in the area is here because its that good.

I'm currently out of the country, and near the top of the list of my food cravings is a Bockwurst.  

Damn, I wish Top Dog went international.  While their political idealogy might not be welcome everywhere, their sausages surely will.

Hard to go wrong with tasty sausages and toasted buns. They always have a great variety. I now live in the city and I gotta say, I would honestly prefer having Top Dog over Rosamunde as the Toronado food option. Half as expensive, but much better than half as good. While I was at Berkeley, I also got discounted hotdogs since I often knew the guy behind the counter, as many of them lived in the co-op system. Pretty great if you ask me. :)

Best Hot Dogs in the bay area.  Hands down.  I think there are over a dozen types of dog to get.  I always say that this time 'I'll just have one and be done.'  Hasn't happened yet.  Then again, I didn't start going here until I was out of college.
 
Dogs to go is a smashing idea Deven.
The place to be while at UC. And with the cool cat behind the grill--que mas. Make sure to get the ' hotlink' dog with Russian mustard. Too much goodness...

What better way to end a night of drinking with your friends than eating a lemon chicken with kraut, onions,spicy spicy mustard (I bet you want to make out with me right now don't you?!?) and a diet coke (the only thing that makes up for the ridiculous amount of calories consumed during the evening's debauchery--HA.....who am I trying to kid).

Without fail, Top Dog is one of those "Berzerkely" institutions that when my alumni pals and I get together to hit up the bars during football season, we all stampede towards. Knocking those poor unsuspecting freshmen over as we race for cheap and filling sausages or hotdogs.

The grill master is just that--a master at getting your dog done and to you in a couple of minutes. He without fail is able to keep most orders straight and in order of receiving them so all is fair in love and top dog.

The only bad thing? Sometimes it is a toss up between Top Dog and its neighbor La Burrita.
the hot dogs are good but not really worth the price though. after eating it, i was still hungry...

stand in line...shout out what you want when he asks...sit for 2 minutes...eat a great dog.

top dog is great...when i need my hotdog fix minus the chili this is the only place that can provide that for me.  although they have chili now, i've yet to try a dog with chili on it here.

this place is literally the only place i like to solve any hot dog cravings i might have.  good dogs, great selection, cool people.

Best hot dog I have ever eaten in my life!
You'r in Berkeley then there is no excuses for not grabbing a dog from Top dog!!!

we have made trips to Berkeley just because we want top dog. the survice is funny, guy treats you like shit but its amusing. verry small and often crouded, but still delicious. its amazing how terrably awesome this place it

Awesome hot dogs! It's all about a frank, chicken apple, lemon chicken, and hot link. And you gotta add the hot russian mustard too. Hopefully they don't keep raising their prices.

Sometimes wait can be long on weekend nights, but worth the wait!

I've been eating hot links for years, and now I've gotten my girlfriend hooked on them too.

We've been coming here and buying hot links and other dogs by the half-dozen, then cooking them at home. We add grilled peppers, grilled onions, and cheese (mozzarella and cheddar) to ours, and they're even better than the ones you can buy for $3 in the restaurant (though we still haven't quite figured out how to cook our buns to be as crispy as the "dogtenders" do, without access to a grill)

Moral of the story: this place should grill peppers and onions and put them on their dogs. Mozzarella and cheddar cheese also helps.
Heaven in a bun.  This is a Berkeley staple.  Go now...

Great hot dogs.  The only thing I haven't like recently is the wiene (they used to have a veggie dog that way WAY better) but honestly, when I'm drunk at 1 am in the morning, it tastes like a little piece of heaven.  And you can just get them cold and grill them yourself too.

Top Dog
Berkeley, California
10pm Sunday 12th August 2012
Four Stars

You cannot come to Berkeley and not get a piece of meat at Top Dog.  I went with the namesake and ordered a Top Dog Frankfurter at Top Dog and topped with Mustard and Sour Kraut for $3.  The Grungy cook/cashier made my Berkeley experience of Top Dog at absolutely perfect.

I have dreams about top dog and get so excited when I come to Berkeley thinking I'll finally have one - or two. Last weekend I went to the Cal/UCLA game and didn't want to brave the long long line for top dog. I opted to have a burrito next door instead. I proceeded to eat the entire burrito  - yes - but I still wanted a top dog. I had to go immediately next door and brave the line to get one. Nevermind my pant buttons were popping off at that point. The moral of the story is there is no substitute for top dog. In fact, my friend had to have 3. If only I hadn't had that burrito I would have had another one.

I'm not a huge fan of hot dogs. Actually, I hate hot dogs, but I ate here anyway. Pretty cheap but honestly.. A hot dog is a hot dog. It's somewhat of an establishment in berkeley though and everyone HAS to eat here once right?

I like the bread the best and the chili! Only 2 bucks for a nice big cup full of chili. Warm and fills mah belly = happy kelly.

Service sucks. Everyone at top dog is just angry faced 24/7. Look out during big days (eg: game days, cal day, etc) because the lines are REEdiculous.

I have been wanting to try out Top Dog for a while since hearing about it from many friends. 

They sell hot dogs at a price for $3 each. They also have a combo with chips and a drink.

I decided to try out the smoked chicken apple because it was popular on yelp and I wanted to try something different from a regular hot dog. It wasn't as great as I expected it to be, but it was exceptional for hot dog standards.  The buns are better than hot dog buns you usually get with your hot dog. So +1 for the buns!

I want to come back to try some other flavor that might suit my taste buds

Maybe it was a bad day for the guy, but this location (Durant) sure is bitchy. I wanted to make sure they had enough chili for a larger-than-they're-probably-used-to order by phone, and also just place the order so my husband picking up takeout for sick family wouldn't have to stand around forever in case it got busy. I got a bitchy phone call when my husband didn't arrive at the minute I didn't-know-I'd-promised. I'm aware our food might not be hot as if he ordered it there, but I'm taking that chance. Mostly I just don't want the employee to be a jerk to me when I'm trying to get cheap fast takeout.

The Center Street location has always been lovely, however.
Hot Dog nirvana.  There really isn't much more you can say about this Berkeley institution.  It's just a superb experience.

Nice place. About 3 dollars for a hot dog. Bread is crispy. Kind people and good hot dog but I cannot give 5 stars...

Would be a good place if I studied in Berkeley and need to grab some food quickly.

I am a fan of thier KIELBASA...My boyfriend got  the chicken apple sausage, and our friend got the lemon pepper. To me those weren't as flavorful as th polska kielbasa I ordered. Its delicious plain with no toppings, or with ketchup and mustard.

There are few institutions in Berkeley --- one of them is Top Dog.   If you haven't eaten here, you really haven't "been" to Berkeley.   Wait your turn and shout your order, and read the wall of social commentary.   Leave physically and mentally satisfied.

Definitely one of my favorite places to go if I'm looking for a quick and inexpensive lunch. My favorite would probably be the Hot Link, or even the Lemon Chicken. Both are ridiculously tasty, and they're always bursting with flavor. For $3, it's not too expensive (hot dogs for football concessions anyone?) and it's definitely affordable for any broke college student.

It's a must-have for everyone.
lemon chicken and hot links. period.
Top Dog is really truly honestly the best hot dogs around.  They're open late and make a good drunken late night snack.

I never understood the appeal of Top Dog. It's drunk munchies food, which is great since it's open late. In fact, I've only been here after 2am, which says a lot.

I've had a good number of their hot dogs late at night, and they really just taste like hot dogs. It's delicious and satisfies a craving when intoxicated, but I wouldn't come here during the day or for a meal. $3 is really steep for grilled hot dogs.

It's fun to people watch late at night though around Top Dog. You get all kinds of crazy around this establishment.
Come by, don't hesitate! Dogs are exceptional! They offer 3 types of mustard, relish, chopped onions, kruat, and even ketchup. About $3 bones a dog.

DELICIOUS!
Like many of the reviewers wrote, the staff isn't the nicest but it's definitely worth sucking it up for a good meal for $3! They use french bread for the bun and it's absolutely amazing. Don't expect like a restaurant eat-in style (especially when they're busy) because they have like, 4 high stools. It's not the cleanest place to eat but usually the best places to eat are the dirty hole-in-the-walls.

Don't forget to bring cash because it's CASH ONLY!! 

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!! MMmMmmmm YUMMY

Ah Top Dog.  My first meal during Calso.  *tear*  This is a must-have for people in Berkeley.  Not only are the hot dogs delicious, and the service excellent (except when the cook is in a bad mood, which only happened to me ONCE in 4.5 YEARS), Top Dog is essentially a microcosm of the Berkeley community.  You have the walls plastered with propaganda, the students studying at the counter, the families coming by with kids and are like Ooh! Hot Dogs, the absent-minded professors.  Yes, Top Dog is a Berkeley classic.  While I can only speak for this location, the Top Dog experience is not to be missed.  Especially if you manage to sneak a hotdog at closing on a Thursday night as you stumble back up the hill.

OMNOMNOMNOMNOM

No matter how many times I come here, I can't get enough of it! From my last review, I've tried the smoked chicken apple, lemon chicken and kielbasa. I've been meaning to try the rest of their menu but after tasting the chicken apple, I just couldn't stop myself from ordering anything else! I feel like it was meant to be. If I could be married to chicken apple dog.........
The bread is GOOD. The meat is delicious. Opens late.

i'm really just gonna have to give this place 5 stars.  The food is cheap and relatively fast to order and it tastes really good.  I had the "linguica" which had a very acidic taste (probably due to the vinegar) that I really enjoyed.  If you're a fan of acidic/salty foods this is probably dog you'd want to get.  Although, all of the dogs are pretty cheap so you could probably get more than one if you wanted to.

Open pretty late.
$3 for a hot dog. (My favorite is the lemon chicken)
The guys that cook them are really nice.
Too bad they couldn't be more filling. :(

SOOOO GREAT !

I've made it my personal goal to try every dog on the menu, and I have about 3 more to go - the bird, the wienie, and linguica - it of course has taken me forever to try all of them since I usually fall in love with a dog after I try it, and I keep ordering it over and over again ! I love the options that are available, it is definitely one of those places that you want to take people when they come to visit. It is delicious and cheap.

I'm not huge on hot dogs, but one of my friends love this place.

Its a hole in the wall hot dog joint. There is no parking lot, and sometimes you have to drive around the streets to find a parking spot. 

Inside is very small with no seating, you place your order, and directly behind you is the commodities, ketchup, onions, relish, the regular. 

The owner is very anti-government, and has a bunch of clippings posted on a wall which I read every time I come by, there are a lot.


As for the hot dog, like I said I'm not huge on hot dogs. I like mine tender, but their hot dogs are very tough on the outside, and slightly tender on the inside. The bread is off the hook. I only eat the top dog, so I don't know about the other hot dogs. For $2.50 its not bad either.

A bit pricey for a hot-dog but if you're in the area you HAVE to try it at least once.
I always find myself craving it randomly...like now. The lemon chicken dog is by far my favorite and I'm sure the others are just as good!
This isn't a place to sit and dine. You come here if you want some good food fast. 
Just a heads up it gets really crowded during football games (which I guess you don't have to worry about for 2011)

The original regular top dog is just excellent! Something about the casing -it's like crispy. And the buns always has this crisp to it! The best dog ever, really!

you should try it when you're not sober. trust me. it's heaven!
The veggie dogs are really affordable here. You can load up on the onions and ketchup. I love it. So many convenient locations too.

From what I've overheard waiting in line, Top Dog is one of the places you have to go to.  I first went here a few weeks ago after a game and again last night.  Their staff are really on top of things.  I'm not much of a hot dog connoisseur, but with dog casings my friend says have "just the right crunch" and their perfectly toasted buns, so far I haven't been disappointed.

This is like a Costco polish dog....except with more variety and all the fixings including sauerkraut! Small location, but that did not stop the many customers who come to order one of the delicious hot dogs on the menu. So far I've had the top dog and the chicken and apple and I fell in love. No wonder most people who come through order more than 1, heck I would too since it's only 3 bucks each!

Reasons I love top dog,
       1. Open late
       2. Toasted bun
       3. Tasty 
       4. Affordable 
       5. The hot links 

I recomend asking for whatever u get butterfly style. I love my hot links well done and that seems to do the trick.
hotlink.

Drunk food or not, Top Dog is the shitz.  

$3 for a freshly grilled link and as much of the condiments (chopped onions, radish, sauerkraut,  ketchup, dijon mustard, and yellow mustard) as your heart desires.  They do have a veggie dog which is also vegan called the weenie.  It's tasty and packed with spices.

There is a bit of a wait (15-20 mins) on busy weekend nights but well worth it!  Nom.

Good shit.

Great service and great food every time. Too bad it's overcrowded on most days.

My friend's live in an apartment next to this so whenever I'm over I am blessed to be assailed by the pleasurable smell of grilling hot links and lemon chicken.  Sometimes I ask them if they would ever grow tired of smelling like a pleasurably burning slaughterhouse, to which they vehemently respond: "NEVER!!! OM NOM NOM NOM!!!"  Oh thank god for constantly hungry Asian women.

Honestly, Top Dog and La Burrita are pretty much places I come to when I'm plastered and blitzed out of my mind, so rating this based upon criteria such as taste and atmosphere would be specious at best.   From my brief flashbacks in a ocean of inebriation, I remember Top Dog being incredibly delicious and the staff being more than tolerant of me and my Dionysian coterie.  Just remember to pile on the condiments because that sh*t is free.  Also, don't be a wuss, slather on generous portions of that spicy hot mustard.

Beware of the surrounding homeless, they have been known to attack small Asian girls and blacked out college students for half-eaten bratwursts.

TL;DR:  The food is awesome...if my poor memory serves correctly.

If you dare to speak of not loving Top Dog, beware of being punched in the face.  I kid...I kid. It's TOP DOG though...it's a Berkeley Institution for goodness sake.  

My order of heaven on a toasted bun: 
Chicken Apple, Polish Kielbasa...and/or a Calabrese...PLAIN with nothing on it. 

TOP DOG, how I miss thee.  Now that I don't work at CAL, I'm am without lunchtime stops at your shop. Sad panda. I'm left with football season, which is only but a few months and concerts at The Greek.

PS: GO BEARS!!!

a place to take my dog to eat a scrumptious dog. hey great for a student's budget and fast too. more than a Polish on the board. not  an O. Meyer in sight! But wish they had a Dog Mobile or maybe a Top Dog cart on Bancroft before a film at PFA.
Just tried their Calabrese dog today and it was DELICIOUS! omg...

I have a great affection for Top Dog. It gots heart and soul!

The location is right smack dab in the hustle and bustle of the campus food scene. Right Across the street is asian ghetto. Walk down to telegraph and you'll meet your share of interesting characters as well as encounter tons of down to earth food and shopping establishments. A couple years back there were no chain restaurants, but now that is slowly changing =/. 

On to the hot dogs. What I love about top dog is the purity of the sausages. These guys don't dress up the hot dog with tons of frivolous fixings like Pink's hot dog which is famous in it's own right down is Los Angeles. Top Dog destroys Pink's imo. I never fail to order the HOT LINK and CALABRESE. Both are wonderfully flavorful and come in a sesame seasoned bun. The condiment station is very traditional with your choice of onion, sauerkraut, relish, ketchup, and mustard. Load it up how you like it and viola! Perfect sausage. Only downside I can point out is the price and size of the dogs. Some people balk at the thought of paying 3 dollars for a hot dog. Long before it was a lot cheaper, but times are tough and inflation is inevitable. 

I can't speak highly enough of Top Dog. It has fed hungry college kids till the late hours of the night for years and will continue to do so. When it comes to staple eats in Berkeley 3 places really come to mind: Top Dog, Cheeseboard, and Chez Panisse Restaurant. Two of those are extremely affordable.

If I had attended UC Berkeley I firmly believe that I would have concluded every late night adventure with a veggie dog from Top Dog.  

The one man behind the counter managed to take orders, cook, deal with money transactions, and watch T.V. all without missing a beat.  It was one of the most impressive performances that I've ever witnessed.  

Delicious, filling, and cheap.

Top Dog's bockwurst with Quickly's jasmine green tea (no milk).  There was one month when I ate mostly this combo.  You don't get a lot of nutrients but it is tasty and cheap.

I may need to eat more hot dogs elsewhere, but this is still my favorite hot dog.  Perfectly toasted bun and delicious dogs.  Keepin' it simple.  

I like to buy their dogs for BBQs (people love that shiz) and the last time I was there, I bought a pack of dogs and buns to recreate the magic for lunch at work.  I just pop it in a toaster oven in the kitchen.  Not the same but I don't have to leave the office :D

Top Dog is always a must when I'm around the Berkeley area.  I've never had a bad experience here.  I usually get the hot link but went out of my norm and got the lemon chicken.  I'd have to say I wasn't disappointed.  One isn't enough.

What can I say about Top Dog.  It's perfect in every way.  It's been almost 10 years since I first tried this place, and it still makes me grin as I take my first bite, and grease drips down my chin.  Yessss.

I love the buns...oh yeah.  Perfectly toasted and sprinkles with sesame seeds.  I love you Top Dog.
What Time Is It?  It's TOP DOG Time!!! (3am, a typical thursday nite)

I love this place so much it's embarrassing.  Whenever I'm in Berkeley, I try to find an excuse to pick up a dog.  Love that they are open till 3 on the weekend, perfect for grabbing something to soak up some beer after the bars.
Another reason I go to Berkeley besides Comic Relief is to enjoy the delights of Top Dog. It's SO good, what else is there to say?
Chicken apple!! $3 for a hot dog is kind of pricey, but they're so tasty! Also, they're open till very late.. so good drunk food.

Last weekend I visited UC Berkeley for the first time to participate in a tournament. In between rounds my team and I  ventured off into Telegraph, in search of food and excitement--that later being found without having to search for it all. Telegraph itself is brimming with options for a hungry gadabout. On Saturday I was faced with the seemingly ridiculous and insurmountable task of finding a place to eat lunch. A 'place?' Just one? Take a look around and then try choosing between pizza, curry, falafel, and burritos. Eventually at the suggestion of our coach, our hungry party descended on Top Dog. Top Dog is run by ruthless staff who will tear viciously into the souls of those who don't order promptly. The tiny shack is cluttered with Anarchist, Free Thought, and hyper-Liberal articles and stickers (Don't like Abortions? Get a Vasectomy! was my personal favorite) that provide some real spirit to a shop already full of character. My favorite part of my visit was of course the food. I ordered lemon chicken and garlic dogs, which were perhaps the tastiest franks I've ever had. Condiments are great, sure, but when I took my first bite I realized they were completely unnecessary at this place. To make my story all the more better--last Saturday was the owner's 53rd anniversary to his wife. Guess how much lunch costed? Two dogs and a soda, $.53. Top Dog, you've won my heart, I shall return again one day.

yummmmmmmmmmm top dog. Never fails to satisfy. 

When I lived in Unit 2, as a 2nd year sick of crossroads, I went to Top Dog almost every day for a few days...weeks? I'd be done with it before I got home because it's ONLY good when it's piping hot off the grill. I love my Hot with saurkraut, onions, and normal mustard. that is happiness. 

Perfect drunk snack. 

Ugh, except the workers are moody. I'm sorry you have to work at top dog at 2am on a weekend but you don't have to take it out on your customers.
Wish they had a Top Dog near me.  Fast, cheap, delicious.  The bratwurst is awesome.

Top dog is the perfect late night drunk food place ever, and it is one of those places that isn't that bad sober as well. I use to stand in the line with all of the drunk people waiting for what felt like years for my lemon chicken and if I was really drunk or hungry then a kielbasa as well. The place isn't very nice and the people who work there are not that friendly however if you want a killer dog this is your place. 

I took my parents there years ago and they loved it as well, my dad liked it so much I sent him a box of the brats to him for a Christmas present. Writing about Top Dog makes me want to drive over there right now and get one...

doing my part to help push the number of reviews to over 1k. as always, scroll down to the bottomline if you don't have time to read this bullshit.

Don't know how to explain it, but nothing seems to really scream at me when I'm hungry. As a Cal student, I know of many cheap eateries, but that's just it..you get what you pay for. As I lose more and more of my baby fat (I like to think that that remnant of youth lasts well into adulthood), I become more and more concerned with what I'm putting into my body.

Top Dog is not the healthiest meal. But wait! the SAUERKRAUT ALWAYS HITS THE SPOT! and S.kraut is said to be very very healthy with billions of live culture bacterium--probably augmented by exposure to all the late-nighters adding to the pot of immunity--that improves your digestive system and general body health. No condiments for me, just SKRAUT IT!

Anyway, I did used to just get hot links. but then I ventured out next to the Top Dog F.furter--which when following a spicy hot link provides a tasty, tangy cool-down of deliciousness. then I got the calabrese and the linguica, needless to say, both of these are also delicious! THERE IS A REASON THAT THEIR MENU HAS LASTED ALL THESE YEARS! Just went through apple chicken, chicken lemon, and garlic frank..wow apple is a great finishing dog!

NOW WHAT DO I DISCOVER!!!! OH WHAT! COLD DOGS FOR HALF THE PRICE??? $8.50 for six dogs and six buns, and $0.50 for a small deli cup full of sauerkraut. Sure waiting in that grimy line is part of the dining experience, but when you're eating it as often as I have began to...well sometimes you just want to flip the switch, turn up the volume on the stove and enjoy a handful of dogs in the comfort of your own home. Albeit, it takes some concentration to cook the dogs evenly and toast the buns on a separate medium..but well worth it fsho! TIME TO STOCK THE FREEZER !!

Anyway, what warranted me to make this review is their hours of operation. Yes, we all know that they are open until two am most nights. But during this holiday season, when I'd get off work near midnight on both Eve's and Day of's, what was open for me to grub on? TOP DOG!

Bottomline: The BEST STAFF, Great taste, Great Value, Great menu. Not for the heartless (meaning non-heart eating) vegans.

Best damn dog you are gonna find anywhere in...well anywhere!  You have over 10 options to choose from, the hot link being my favorite!  The buns are large and coated with sesame seeds.  The guys at the counter are weird, they might be trying a bit too hard to be witty and clever, but it's always entertaining. 

My only gripe with this place and the reason for the missing 5th star is their terrible selection of drinks.  They only offer a crappy fountain machine with RC Cola, and 7-Up.  It looks like it's the same machine they have had for a few decades.

They're open late. $3 for a hot dog/sausage. They have a wide variety from chicken apple to keilbasa.

Also this has the best location. Nothing like getting drunk and walking down to Top Dog for a 2am sausage to stuff your face with and settle the beer in your stomach.
Cheapest lunch around. Meat lovers: you should try the veggie dog! It will change your mind about how you can definatelly live without eating animals :) SeRIOUSLy!

Never have I liked hot dogs... like ever. It's an amalgamation of mystery meat and the buns usually suck and, well, it's a hot dog. 

And then there's Top Dog. Forget the fact that the big guy with dreads doing the midnight shift is a boss who holds more street cred than any other man could possibly deserve for working a hot dog place, but the hot dogs are AMAZING!

Hot link is a must, it hits the spot every time, and the 2 am closing time makes it every drunk kid's best friend.

No offense, La Burrita, but Top Dog wins.

Also, it's only $3... mediocre coffee at starbucks or an amazing hot dog that redeems hot dogs round the world.

Top Dog:1 World:0
(win)

Location: Easy to find, popular spot

Ambience: Hole-in-the-wall, with a serving counter on one end, and a condiments counter on the other

Service: FANTASTIC! Precise, and you receive exactly what you ask for.

Variety: For someone who loves meat, you'll find something for everyone - chicken, beef, pork. From a vegetarian stand point however, there is only one option, the "The Weanie," and it's not the greatest thing.

The place is sort of an in-and-out type of deal, not a dine-in. As long as you understand you're stopping by for the food and not the experience, you'll love it.

P.s. Their anti-political decor is to die for :)

Mann i used to live close to this area bfore i moved to the city. I member my mom would take me and my sister here after we went for a cruise round the neighborhood. Mann i miss the hippies and druggies hangin around there, but most of all i miss top dog. I used to get the bratworst here and damn it was good. The last time i went was about 3 years back with a buncha friends and i decided to try somtin new. THE LEMON CHICKEN! HOT DAMN that was a good wieney! havnet gone back yet but definitely need to to catch up wit old times

Best hot dogs ever! I used to go here at least once a week when I lived in Berkeley. My favorites are Lemon Chicken and Hot Link. And the prices are cheap so I always order two or more.  Of course, not the cleanest place on earth, but I go for the food and not the atmosphere.

The Lemon Chicken hot dog (low salt and low fat) was scrumptious! The bread is not hot dog bread - it is so much better than that!! You can all of your own toppings. Just be prepared to order quick and have those 3 exact dollars ready to pay.

This place gets 5/5 stars for me because I haven't ever been to a hot dog place that's as good as top dog.  Pink in LA doesn't even compare, and the only reason why that place is "kind of" good is because they beef up a crappy hot dog with hella other shit. 

If you're looking for some GOOD hot dogs or sausages for the sake of the actual HOT DOG,  come to top dog.  This joint has been MY SPOT after a night's drinking or just random hunger pangs.  Make sure you know what you want before waiting in line because the cook and the guy that gets your order doesn't take any kind of bullshit.  Order fast, give your CASH, and move your ass to the side to let the next customer order.

What's DERISHOUSH? 
1. hot links
2. kielbasa
3. chicken apple

Lots of cool- and different groups come out here and I've had many-a-conversation with random people about... anything!  

Just make sure you have cash and don't bullshit around with your ordering.  Bon appetit!

My First time here, it was a small lil shop, kind of hole in the wall. There was a semi-friendly girl behind the counter.  There are about 10 different kinds of hot dogs/ sausages that were from different countries (Germany, Poland, Portugal to name a few). 1 star for ambience (it was small, homey, and had a wonderful breeze from the wide open windows)  The flavor of the Linquica, was Wonderful.  You could really taste the marination from the oak-smoke and the wine vinegar.  It wasn't too salty or anything.  Toppings that were put on it were ketchup, spicy russian mustard (like Wasabi in the mouth!!), and sweet diced onions.  This flavor explosion makes such a big impact.  I also tried the Hot Link, and it was really spicy as was, but with extra spicy russian mustard on it, it was like "Fire in the Hole!!" But Oh soooo worth it :)  Total I would give both links 4 stars- It really was like a party in the mouth.  So.. I guess this place gets a Perfect 5 from me.  I will be visiting again shortly.  At around $3 a dog, it is kind of pricey given that it is not gigantic, but hey, quality over quantity!!

I mean I like the food here its hella good, real talk.  However, I'd recommend you go to Desi Dog on Bancroft from 5pm-8pm for their happy hour because its pretty much the same shit but its only 1.50 each plus you can add grilled onions and all that other jazz at Desi Dog too.

If its late or not between the hours of 5-8 on a weekday, then yeah come here for your sausage fix.  It gets crowded as fuck on certain weeknights after people are leaving the bars. It was hella crowded when I was here last week during the summer because all of the Euro trash that is studying abroad.  

If you think about it, its pretty pricey...3 bucks for a sausage?  You can get a polish and a churro at Costco for 2.50 and it comes with a drink.

This small hole-in-the wall joint has THE BEST WURST and is one of the few remaining historical Telegraph Avenue restaurant relics (at least that I would recommend) that serviced the influx or gentrification by crappy corporate-turned-hipster restaurants. Bratwurst, Bockwurst and a plethora of other tube-shaped options is made by Saag's sausage company, a San Francisco based wurst magician that I prey to god every day will show up in a grocery store within 100 miles of Minneapolis.  YES I WOULD DRIVE THAT FAR. Being a California native that spent many-a-days on what we called the "Ave" or "Tele", I have a very soft place in my heart for TOP DOG. The same guy has been the cook there for years and is the heart and soul of the experience. Whether your a new CAL student or just new to the Berkeley area...drop by. As it says on the Saag's sign: You deserve [their] wurst!

Back in my college days I ended up here while visiting a friend that was going to Berkeley. She took me to this hot dog place called top dog. It was different types of what most would consider as gourmet  sausages on a sesame roll. This place was strict though if you didn't  know your exact order they would pass you off and you would have to go back to the end of the line. It kind of reminded me of the soup nazi from that sitcom seinfeld. We got one of each and split then. They all were pretty good they all had nice flavor but the one that I liked the most was the Italian so I ended up getting some shipped back to my apt back in NYC.

Lemon Chicken, Kielbasa, Hot Link, Bockwurst, what more can I say?
I will miss being yelled at by the order taker. I will miss being surrounded by drunk/high Berkeley students. I will miss double fisting two dogs with onions, spicy mustard and ketchup. I will miss walking down to Fat Slice after two Top Dogs.

For those that are complaining that $3 for a hot dog is too much... are you kidding me!!!  Any street vendor in NYC, SF, LA, or Seattle will charge you at least $4.  And those are just basic Oscar Meyer hot dogs.  Top Dog serves somewhat sophisticated hot dogs on bread (not a cheap bun).  

They have about 8 different regular types of dogs and sausages  (including vegetarian) and at least one special.  They have a meal deal for one dog, chips, and a drink for $4.95.  I choose two dogs which was filling enough for me.

Two complaints... way too much bread.  And I wish they had more seating.  A bench on the sidewalk would be a nice touch for more seating.

As a tourist in this city, friends of mine highly recommended and took me to this place.......

The result was I wanted another as soon as I was finished.  This place is comparable to a bratwurst stand in Austin, TX that I frequent when I visit Austin (The Best Wurst).  I loved the familiarity of a good bratwurst and didn't think there was another place in this country that could top that..... I ordered the Hot Link (spicy of course) and I love how it doesn't come on those weak hot dog buns.  I topped it with ketchup, spicy mustard, and of course sauerkraut.....Absolutely amazing and delicious!

I tried the Chicken Apple Dog as well and definately tasted unique.  If only, I lived in the city... I would like more than seconds!
yay! I'm a fan.

Top Dog is a small shop near UC Berkeley that sells various hot dogs. I tried the Calabrese, which is an italian styled sausage. It was decent; however most of the sides were burned. Top Dog did not exactly have the best sanitation, but it can be considered an ideal place to get food if you're in a rush.

Super cheap, good food, fast service, and great location!  Also, this is the only place I've been to that serves RC Cola in the soda fountain, so that's a big plus for me!  There are great vegetarian and even vegan options.  And I don't know why it's listed as not accepting credit cards, because they do accept cards. (I think there's a minimum, though)  Love it!

Affordable, delicious dogs with a good variety of flavor. I use to come here a lot when I was still a student, but I have to say, even after I graduate, this is the first place I always go back to for food. Personal favorites are the chicken apple and hot links (which is HOT, so be warned...). Love it and highly recommend it! $3 for a juicy hot dog on a toasted bun? C'mon... totally worth it.
A Berkeley institution, I've been going for years.  Best selection of dogs in the East Bay.  Cheap, consistent, and delicious street food.  Go now!

I thought Pink's Hot Dogs were good, but this place was cheaper and better.

Also... there is no line! You just shove your way to the counter and order! And there is no tax! And hot dogs are $3! I know I love my $1.50 hot dogs from Costco, but sometimes you want different flavors and toasted bread with your dog, you know what I mean?

Dogs are juicy and delicious. My boyfriend got and enjoyed his hot link and I loved my garlic dog. 

Yea, the guy running the place is kind of rude, but hey, as long as my hot dog is yummy I'll put up with it. And then skedaddle. 

The only thing missing in the joint? Mayonnaise. But it's all good. I can bring my own packet. And sometimes I do.

Top Dog is a Cal staple. If you visit Berkeley for whatever reason it is, make it a trip to grab a Lemon Chicken and a Hot Link. Probably my favorite hot dogs outside of Chicago, Top Dogs are about 3 bucks each, .50$ less than they were last year. My girlfriend demands two foods every time she visits from USC, and a Lemon Chicken is one of them. Just make sure you prepare for game days: you'll be waiting a while.

Disclaimer - I haven't been here since I graduated undergrad at Berkeley. The smoked chicken apple and the hot link are really, really good. This rating would be higher if the dogs weren't like $2.75 a pop - although at this point they're probably more. It really is one of the quintessential places to go though if you're in the Bay Area and you're doing yourself a disservice if you don't try it out at least a couple of times.

Four stars for the food, but less than one star (unfortunately, there is no option for that), for how food is handled there.  

Came in to order a linguica and hot link to go.  There were already stacks of dogs on the grill sitting out to let bacteria harvest.  The guy working there took my money and threw the dogs I wanted on the grill using tongs.  He started counting cash and after he was done, did he bother washing his hands?  nope.  he touched and handled the buns with his dirty ass hands.  OMG.  it was gross.  Ok, I know, it's a restie and most people who work there probably aren't super germ-o-phobes like myself, but still.  don't do it in front of the customer.  

Unfortunately, I didn't have the guts to tell the guy he didn't wash his hands and that I wanted new buns.  Took the dogs, and delivered them to my friend who I was getting the order for.  Did I tell my friend.  No.  Sorry dude.  

Anyway, I was just a little surprised to see how food was handled and kept there.  The guy was probably waiting for an early dinner rush or something with those dogs just sitting off to the side of the grill.  But still... yuck.  I won't be ordering from there for a while.  What a disappointment.  I really liked the place.

Hot links, chicken apple, and hot links!  Great flavored hotdogs, in fact, some of the best I've had.  Very small shop with room for about 5 people to order.  Last time I've went, dogs were about $2.50-2.75 or so a pop.  Quick service (there's usually only one guy who takes care of your order), affordable food, open late and most importantly, GREAT tasting dogs.

The hot dogs are very good-- don't get me wrong. Still, I can do the exact same thing at home by buying a high quality dog and a roll and heating it up at home. This place really doesn't offer anything special to me.

Plus, $3.50 for a hot dog? I'll get a delicious Hebrew National hot dog that is huge on a sesame bun with a soda for $1.50. They'll give me the same saurkraut, mustard, onions to boot. Don't get it with this place. Maybe more history and location than anything?

I usually really hate chains and Top Dog is bloody everywhere, but Top Dog is not bad.

Service/Decor: There are always hobos outside of the restaurant asking for change. It's sort of a shack where you order and get your sausage and go since there are no seats. Staff are pretty nice and are willing to give you recommendations on hot dogs. It's also open till around 3am, which is cool.

Food: I really like the hot dogs here. There is a very large variety, such as chicken apple, hot links, chorizo, etc. I've had the chicken apple a few times, and it has the right amount of seasoning and maintains its sweetness. The sausage and bun go well together, especially since the bread is toasted. I'd say if you're looking for an actual meal that'll make you full, this isn't the best place to get lunch, but if you're looking for a snack, this place will definitely satisfy you.
What more can you say?  Top Dog!
Best hots dogs around and cheap!
I love this place. Quick trip to berkeley and i'll stop by here. Especially late at night when you don't wanna go to a denny's.

As a poor college student, this was an exciting place to go to when I realized just how cheap the food was. The menu provided the prices with tax included so in return, I was able to take an amazing hot dog without a plethora of change. The best dog has to be their original, the Top Dog. I think that one really satisfies and hits the spot whether I'm there for brunch, dinner, or even a late night snack. However, their hot dog isn't the best I've tried and definitely, not like those back in LA but the food is worth the price. The drinks aren't overly priced and since it is such a small restaurant, the customer can really connect with the cook and learn stories about the surrounding area. Another thing is that the restaurant has a variety of posters that are really mind-blowing such as the one on the left side of the restaurant about how to succeed in business and the many pitfalls or mistakes that people often take. So, in other words, it's a great place that not only satisfies the stomach, but also, the mind and the eyes. Definitely would want to come here again!

Such a long overdue review, but better late than never!  I've had a handful of dogs over the years including Linguica, Calabrese and Smoked Chicken Apple.  My favorite's probably the linguica with its spice and grittier texture.  Quick, cheap and tasty.  Win.

Hot dogs are only good at Costco, the ball park, and TOP DOG!  Chicken apple and lemon chicken...oh, I crave you!  This is also one of the late night eateries available when all the parties on frat row closes down.

I first ate at Top Dog as a freshman in 1972.   The dogs ranged from 40-45 cents.   There's been a bit of inflation since then.  It doesn't get any respect, yet anyplace else you get a hot dog, such as Atlanta's famed Varsity Drive-In (and my mom was a 1940's Atlanta bobby-soxer) , you get a boiled dog in a mushy bun.  Top Dog has more sausage varieties than just the usual Oscar Meyer weiner and it grills them and serves them on a French roll.

The good ol college days. When I used to visit Berkeley for drunken house parties a group of us would always walk to top dog. wait int he ridiculous crowd of people shouting their order. CHICKEN APPLE, CHICKEN APPLE! holy cow that is an awesome hot dog. the fact that they can get every ones order is pretty crazy too. Now have I ever tried this place sober, NO. So maybe im being very nice about the rating, but seriously it's probably still one of the best hot dog places I've tried around the bay area.

Top priority when living in college 
Its past 12 and most places are closed 
but 2am is approaching 
you need to rush down Durant 
until you yell out the type of dog you want
then apply the condiments and enjoy
Also I love getting RC cola where else are going get 
Hot Link and RC at 2am in Berkeley

Note 5 Stars applys  for late night and limited options based on time frame

I really like their hot dogs, but I find their price a bit pricey so I have only been there a handful of times. I really like their chicken apple sausage and the veggie dog is not bad either.

i don't know. I feel like if the place wasn't a Berkeley icon, I wouldn't have bother to go.
Not too impressed by the flies roaming around the grill area. The hot dog itself appear to be Colombo bread + Amy's chicken apple frank (chicken apple hot dog), 3 stars for the taste and portion.

WE NEED TOP DOG IN L.A.! I went to Berkeley for the weekend and I was on a mission to try Top Dog and it exceeded my expectations, which rarely happens. Had the lemon chicken sausage with spicy Russian mustard and the regular hot dogs and I was blown away. SOOO much better than the overrated tourist trap L.A. Pinks hot dog stand. Yes, the Top Dog staff does not try to be lovable, but there are very long lines and I can understand why they demand the order be placed immediately to keep things moving.
The best hot dog place I've ever been to hands down!

Good dog... nuf said.

Go to south side... stop by top dog, ib's, blondies.

I usually drive up to this burrito place next to top dog.  I am sure that if you know one, you know the other.  One night I decided to try it and was is good.  The service is terrible.  The other customers, loud and rowdy and sometimes a little drunk.  They toast the sesame bun and the dogs are on the other side of the grille, just waiting to be called upon.  I tried the chicken apple and was not disappointed at all....so for 3.00 where can you beat this.

Hands down for the best hot dog late at night after a party. 

The chicken apple sausage and hot link is definitely the way to go. The hot dog bun really makes the dog that much better.

If you are in Berkeley you have to stop by Top Dog.

This place is cool. Not too many choices to confuse and slow you down; good product, great prices. I had the special which was the mango habanero chicken dog and I added some of that russian mustard. It was delicious!

Allrite!! I agree that 1100+ reviews on yelp forced me to check this place out but I still don't understand what the hype is all about. May be it's near to berkeley university and it is open till 3 am ? or $3 hot dogs served on french bread roll ?

It's very tiny and not that clean. We went around 11 pm and I ordered Chicken apple sausage. It wasn't outstanding or I should say i have had better before. 

Relish was overpowering. But you cannot beat the price for sure :)

if ever your in the east bay partying and you decide to grab a quick eats...this IS the place to go. seriously, i hardly even like hot dogs but this is a must try. everyone and their mommas in the east bay knows about this spot.  late at night it will get crowded but its so worth it. its even amusing at the same time...drunkards everywhere. not the type that  causes drama but the fun sometimes stupid ones. real talk...this is another hidden spot in the bay area.

Love it!!!  Cant get any faster than the guys that work inside the Berkeley Top Dog.  Great stop when you're in a hurry or cant decide where you wanna eat.  The dogs here are great, and the selection is wie.  Polish dogs, applesmoked dogs, bratwurst, etc.  They offer sauerkraut on the side, which my husband loves.  Wish this hotdog stand was as good as the ones closer to me.  It's wortht he 20 minute drive!

Summary based on many visits over years:
--Classic Berkeley scene, especially at night
--Great food 
--Parking challenging (for free, that is, in keeping with TD ethos)
--Service amusing. Don't take anything personally. 
--Cost in line with college student expectations

It's helpful if you have some clue why you're there and what you want to eat before you order.

On our way up the hill for my bro's graduation, I and a trail of cousins made a pit stop here for top dogs. Three hot links, a Kielbasa, and Garlic Frankfurter later, we were ready to go.

Still a fan. Thanks, T-Dog. You're the bomb.

everything is soooo good here. i've never truly craved hot dogs until i came here. ignorance was bliss ... i wish there were a top dog in SF!!!

the guy who works the grill has an amazing memory and can serve at least up to 20 hot dogs all by himself for all of the inebriated anxiously waiting in the doorway at 1 in the morning.

my favorites are the hot link and apple chicken. oh and it's good when you're sober, too.
