ohh the best place for hot dogs and late night snacks in berkeley. i love the lemon chicken and the polish dogs. they even have something for you vegetarians. they only take cash. its really cheap too. and they are open as late as 3 am i think. well on the weekends at least. it's true that it will be surrounded by drunken college students, but it's soo good. parking is easy late night, not so good during the day.

I use to come here a lot after a night at Henry's which is right across the st. Nothing better than getting some fresh juicy hot dog with some sauerkraut after drinking at the bar. You cant beat $3 hot dogs or less then $5 with a drink. you can actually watch them make your hot dog thats how you now its fresh right off the grill... They also have a funny looking Logo!
I grew up with Top Dog! Nobody beats their dogs.

the dogs were great, i love that they are served on french rolls instead of crappy lifeless hot dog buns.... 

the lovely man at the counter with dreads was absolutely more wonderful than you would ever expect a hot dog cook to be in his greasy and super small environment.. he was so damn polite and accomodating... even to my boyfriend who got a burrito ffrom next door. i would give him ten stars if i could 

they only lose one star for the lack of seating room. we began our meal sitting at the front counter, enjoying our lovely meals , until 5 min later it got packed in there and i had customers barking orders literlally on top of me and over my shoulder. but i would still come back, just next time eat outside
Yum. I like to get the chicken apple sausage. And LOTS of sauerkraut.

Favorite late night spot...my favorite is the calabrese w/sauerkraut and that's all I need.  When I'm super hungry - I eat 2!  Sometimes I add the apple cider too.

This is truly a hole-in-the-wall location.  Only downside is the wait, takes a few minutes for the dog to cook, but that's what makes it fresh!

This place is all about the nostalgic value of eating a hot dog meeting the variety and gourmet nature of any kind of sausage you can imagine. Top Dog has one of the most extensive "dog" menus around, featuring anything from the hippie dippie vegan sausage to the once-so-trendy chicken apple to a good old fashioned braut or hot dog.

I'll always remember it as a place to get a snackable item late into the night, willing to serve eager high school students, college frat kids and the ven the stray professor alike. Before hot dog stands were a "thing" this was the "thing!"

Now, it's the brick and mortar of the countless dog vendors in San Francisco, but the satisfied dog munchers after bar closing show timelessness of an appropriately placed snack food shop in a college town.

Grab a dog (chicken apple is my go-to-order) and sit down in the outside area next door to enjoy the Berkeley show.
it's a great snack when you don't want a slice a pizza kickin' it around campus or shopping on telegraph.

This is the perfect place for a quick hot dog. It's open til 2am, and is a famous spot for the Berkeley party crowd. On a weekend, expect a line and a hoard of people loitering in front of the place til close. 

The food itself is tasty, but nothing phenomenal. People visit Top Dog, because it's convenient, quick, and filling, not for unique flavors or amazing hot dogs. 

The first time I walked into the place, the guy asked what I want, and I responded, "one hot dog." He replies, "we don't serve hot dogs, we serve TOP DOGS!" haha I think this story is a good reflection of the overall experience. Decide on what you want ahead of time! There is no seating once-so-ever, so don't make this place your dinner spot. Save it for the late night FEAST! Enjoy!

Good buns.  Nice meat.  I nearly choked on a hot pepper flake and still left happy.


Yum!

After a nite at the club a few friends of mine were starvin and needed to refuel. So we made a stop at the local Top Dog. It was dippin into the early wee morning hours ona saturday nite, the place was packed but surprisingly the line shrunk within a few mins and it was time to order. I eNded up getting the lemon chicken, it surely hit the spot and then some! I tried my friend's and it was equally good but forgot wut it was! The buns are perfect, just the right amount of crispyness outside and moist on the inside (you could put some butta on that thang!) Top Dogs a great alternative if your getting sick of those other fast food joints. So make top dog your next choice when you want something cheap and good.

If you want a tasty hotdog and a mouthful of eff'n abuse, come to Top Dog!
I always get the Wienie (veggie dog) with onions and mustard.  Somehow, they make it tastier than the veggie links I buy at the store.  Perhaps it is because of the meatjuices coming off of its neighbor dogs on the grill (-1star).  

The guys at the counter are sassy.  Once, there was a customer that came in and was staring at the menu until the guy at the counter was like, "Are you going to order anything, or just take up space."  For some reason, I enjoy the abusive counter people (+1 star).  This place is also a landmark of sorts.  Some people just come in, look around, take  pictures, and leave.  

My boyfriend begrudgingly comes here because he is convinced it is run by Libertarians.  Libertarians or not, they make a good dog...and potato salad...and I like their mustard.

went back the other day to get a hot link.......still yummy and still cheap:)  $3 tax included, $1 more for soda and a line of ppl eager to get their dogs:)

Love it!  It's a must visit in Berkeley still, after all these years.......

You order and wait for your dog to be cooked to order. Easy, right? Just make sure you wait close by otherwise someone might walk away with your order. Not that it happened to me but I can see that it might. 

Prices are on the high side considering they are only hot dogs.  You would figure the amount of dogs they sell before a game would let them price them a bit lower. Just my two cents.

overrated.
i had the chicken apple but couldn't taste the apple.
not bad food, just expensive and less-than-filling.

I only ever get Top Dog when I'm really hungry, because otherwise I can't justify paying $3 for a hot dog, but it IS yummy. The top dog is always good, and lately I've been addicted to the Bird Dog (yay cilantro!)

They make food a little on the slower side, but then again, that's probably because I just stare at the hot dog on the grill the whole time waiting for it to be done. In comparison to other restaurants they are speedy.

Restaurant people are nice, though definitely leaning on the political/not-conservative side, which is kind of scary for me because I know almost nothing about politics so I never have any conversation to make with them. But the posters and newspaper articles on the wall are cool.

I went today and saw the guy handle my food using just his hands (putting hot dog in bun, taking it off grill and wrapping in paper), which kind of grossed me out, but I'm hoping that's just a one-time deal since I've never had that happen to me before.

another late night staple....please don't compare it to a regular hot dog because it's just not. if you like dirty water frankfurters, don't come here. the dogs are all freshly grilled to order and bursting with flavor. i haven't gone wrong with any dog on the menu (well i haven't had the wienie cuz i don't do veggie tofu crap)

I saw buns on the grill, and I started imagining dry hard bread engulfing my hot dog. I was so sad.

And then I took a bite after it came straight off the stove.

OMG.

$3 per hot dog? So worth it. 2 of us savored our 3 hot dogs outside by the car (yay street parking!), with my running back in every once in a while to pile on more mustard and sauerkraut. Chicken apple is by far my favorite. Bread wasn't overpowering, and it was nice having soft ACTUAL bread without the stale hot dog bun taste.

Man. I want another hot dog.
Lemon Chicken and an order of Potato Salad 4 LIFE: best late night snack of my college days, can't wait to go back when I have CAL football tickets as an alumni!

Went to college there, can't end a night of drinking without going to Top Dog. Been a fan for years, whenever I am back, its usually the first place I stop at. It really doesn't get much better. I even bring a cooler and buy their frozen dogs/buns so I can take them back to LA. Try the Hot Link, Bird Dog and Keilbasa.

i had the chicken and apple dog, which was decent. never noticed anything special about the buns--in fact, i thought they were kind of on the dry side.

the bun was too big for the dog and every bite i had was mostly bread...sigh. 

i dunno man, $3 for a hotdog is pretty steep when you can get one twice the size for 1/2 the price. costco wins, hands down.

the thing that really irked me was that when the guy was finished making the hotdog, he'd semi wrap it up and slide it across the counter...with part of the bread touching the countertop. sanitary?! i think not!

Eaten here every now and then back in my Cal days. The hot dogs are delicious and cheap. I usually order a chicken apple one that tastes deliciously fatty and good. With that in mind tho, I feel like top dog's hype is overblown which hurt it in this case. It's good...but I don't get the WOW! Factor that most people seem to rave about.

Top Dog is quality hot dogs. My faves are chicken apple, lemon chicken, and kielbasa. I love that they use a baguette for the buns. Pricey though at $3.50 per small hot dog (you'll need at least 2 to fill up).

Insanely good dogs + open insanely late = gain insane amounts of weight freshman year at Berkeley.  :-)

Everything on the menu is great - i know - I've had it all. Regulars know the dogs by their short names (Bock, kiel, 'brot', bird, etc) and the staff is amazing at taking 50 orders at once and getting them all right. It's not uncommon to have a line outside the door at 1AM... and once you get into the doorway you find that the entire place is completely physically packed with people waiting for their delicious, delicious meats.

It is always packed after shows at the Greek - or during finals - or just whenever.

I've seen a few conservatives get pretty annoyed at the awesome commie/hippy/liberal propoganda/news/comics covering every inch of the wall - that just made me love this place even more. This is the true Berkeley experience, this is the Berkeley Rosamunde.

Been here twice and it's good to be here instead of Irvine's "Berkeley Dog."  No bullshit, 3 bucks with no tax for a hot dog with your choice of about 10 different dogs.  

Your choice of I think 3 different mustards, ketchup, sauerkraut, relish, and onions (all self-served).  What makes these hot dogs special is their bun, it's not that wimpy soft bun you can buy from any grocery store but a solid french roll (I think that's what it's called) that is grilled alongside your dog.  It's not the best thing I ever had, nor is it as big as Costco's polish dogs, but for it's value, I think it's worth it.  

It may be helpful to note that I did not see any seats inside nor outside so you'll be standing or walking if you wanna eat it while it's hot.  Still doesn't make it any less enjoyable though.

the best hot dogs on the West Copast.Grilled to perfection-perfect buns, great selection and outstanding atmoshere.I travel 10 miles to get a top dog...the Berkeley Durant st. option offers the best atmosphere.

I always envy my Berkeley friends for having had what I consider to be a true collegetown... and this little hot dog grill is part of what gives a place like Southside its charm.  They keep it simple (i.e. grab your hot dog, pour on the condiments, and be on your way), but they also give you some freedom where it matters most: the choice of meat.  There are 7-ish meats to choose from, and I know I'll be going back at some point to try them all.  Great for a quick bite.

As other Yelpers have noted, the smoked chicken apple is a safe bet.

I'm not a big hot dog fan, at all, so I'm probably biased. But I liked their chicken apple, and their buns taste better than usual. Overall, compared to a regular hot dog, this is definitely better. Sorry yelpers, but I really just think it's okay. 

p.s. but Usher likes it, so I guess that's cool haha.
Delicious! The only bad thing is your they don't have ample seating to enjoy your dog.

it's ok.  chicken apple dog was nothing special.  Entire wall dedicated to Libertarian propaganda -- that's not interpretation of art... there were pamphlets and brochures.

$3 is not cheap for a hot dog.

this place is perfect for a late night bite.  The chicken with lemon was amazing.  The hot link is good too, just don't make the mistake of putting spicy mustard on it, as I did one late night.  What puts top dog over the top is the toasted bun, slightly crunchy on the outside and chewy on the inside, YUM!

Hot dogs have long been under-appreciated in the food world. I dare anyone who questions the validity of the hot dog to try Top Dog. I ordered the bird dog (turkey, bell peppers, and cilantro) and added russian mustard, onions, and sauerkraut. The sausage had a great snap to it and was full of flavor and the russian mustard was the perfect condiment. You could really taste the quality of the turkey meat and other ingredients in the link. Be warned, the russian mustard has a kick to it. Place is open till 2 am (3am some nights). 

All hail the hot dog!

Before Top Dog I hated hot dogs.  But these aren't hot dogs, they are gourmet sausage.  Hot links are the best.  Haven't been here in a while since graduating, but hopefully nothing has changed.  It's small, cramped, crowded.  There's just two guys working, sometime just one.  One guy will take your order, "one hot link please..."  The griller would then yell out "ONE  HOT" to confirm the order.  Then when your order is ready he'll yell "ONE HOT" again to get you to pick it up.  Then you go eat outside on the curb.  That's how eating should be, for dogs and burgers.  None of this I'll have a glass of cab with my brie burger like at Taylor's and some other upscale joints.

This is another place I try to eat at when I visit Berkeley.  It's great night food.  I love the chicken lemon and the other chicken dog.  I hate going there when there is a line though.  But it's usually worth the wait!
$3 for the most substantive veggie hot dog you will ever witness. its a bargain and its delicious.

A true Berkeley institution. The best place to get a wiener after a long night of drinking. I've never had a bad dog here & they have a good variety. Just yell out your order to the cook & have cash in hand & enjoy. Plenty of hot kraut and condiments to garnish your dog. I really enjoy the chicken apple & the kielbasa & hot links. 

Bonus: after you find your favorites, they actually sell dogs & buns to go to cook at home or at a bbq if you want

The guys that work there are kinda jerks BUT if you had to deal with drunken college kids for a living you'd be a jerk too.  

I've got nothing but love for Top Dog.  I ate here last night and couldn't have been happier about it.  Prior to eating here I had been to the Ivy Room and the Hotsy Totsy.  Most visits to Top Dog are proceeded by similar activities.  

Best thing to do...get a top dog and eat it while heading across the street towards King Pin Donuts.  By the time you get there you'll def want a donut.

Never had a bad dog here!

Quick, delicious, cheap. You can stuff your face for under $10 (dogs are $3 each). They are also open late, so you can get your eat on after the bars close. 

Cash only and there is usually a line.

IF YOU'RE IN BERKELEY GO GET A HOT DOG AT TOP DOG'S.
I live in the Central Valley, but me and my boyfriend find any excuse to stop at Berkeley for these hot dogs when we're near the bay. 

I definitely recommend the garlic one. It's so hot and juicy! (that's what she said) And it's so cheap (just like the other hotdogs) Just get it! You won't regret it!!!!

The guys working there are so nice and chill. 

Note: it's not a place to hang out. The place is SO SO SO tiny, which can be tough since a lot of ppl go.

As anyone who knows me will tell you...I'm a hot dog fanatic!! This is my favorite hot dog joint. The bockwurst is grilled to perfection and served on a toasted sesame bun. The bun is awesome! I've been going here for years to "get my fix". 
By the way, the Russian mustard is pretty hot!

Is this the best place to get a sausage at normal prices in Berkeley?  Probably, but that doesn't mean much to me.

Let me just say something:  COSTCO MAKES THE BEST POLISH DOGS EVER, they only charge $1.50 soda included, and the dog is huge.

Back to Top Dog, yes it is the best of its kind in Berkeley.  But is there anything great about it besides that?  No.  I don't know if they're paying their workers better than minimum wage or what, but $2.75 for one hot dog is ridiculous if you ask me.  Maybe if their hot dogs were twice the size, but there's no way you can tell me that the current puny sausage is worth the same amount as a FAT SLICE.  And what excuse is there?  Fat Slice has to buy fresh ingredients, all Top Dog needs are sausages and buns.

I only go here if I'm really craving a hot dog, otherwise, there are way better deals everywhere else.

Oh and I agree with another reviewer, the Top Dog guys are usually pretty arrogant.  I find that they're sort of like the guys in high school that hate everyone that doesn't listen to death metal.

Man, I would do (almost) anything for a lemon chicken hotdog from Top Dog right now. I've been here a few times and it hasn't disappointed me yet; and he makes it for you right on the spot. Last time I was here, they were even open on Christmas day! I only wish the hot dogs were a bit bigger and not as expensive as it is.

My friends and I herd to this place right after bar hopping all the time. group of 10+ drunk out of their minds peeps doing the yellow brick walk dancing thingie that quickly turns into a race of death to get to Top Dogs before their 2AM closing time just to get our hands on a... SMOKED APPLE CHICKEN HOT DOG!  best.ever. 

We also flock to this place right before a big road trip to Tahoe, or LA, or wherever, just to get our fix. 

Everyone should definitely give it a try, cheeeaaappp and delicious.

Top Dog gets straight to the point, giving the customer a delicious hot dog as quickly as possible.

This place is one of the go to spots late at night and its always popular due to the close proximity to the UC Berkeley campus.

I don't find the people working rude at all, to be honest some of the customers are plain idiots with blank looks taking forever to order.  Its a tiny place, get in & get out.

Polish dog, onions, deli mustard and ketchup at 1:30am: Amazing

the best.  i haven't been to a hot dog stand that rivals top dog.  the many varieties of grilled sausages rock.  my fave being the cal and the bock.  and a complete condiment bar to boot with sauerkraut no less.  the guys behind the counter are quick and aren't fazed by anything.  i went in there once trippin balls with a hungry friend.  dude says, 'next' after my friend orders and takes one look at me.  without saying another word to me and almost immediately, he looks at the guy next to me and says, 'next'.  man, those guys have seen it all.....

Top Dog still ranks # 1 on my Hot Dog-Ometer...Frankfurters, lemon Chickens, Calabreses, Brockwurst, Brats, parmessan chicken, pork dogs, many others, and of course my favorite, the Hot Link....

Top Dog is a landmark small hot dog joint in Berkeley and is solely responsible for making me a hot dog/sausage conniseur. 

All of the sausages they make are high quality, natural casing sausages....which xmeans that they have a pop when you bite em, and are made fresh right in front of you, and are made with only the best dogs you can buy. The sesame bun perfectly compliments anyheir dogs, and also the condiments station with multiple ketchups, nmustards, sour kraut, onions and relish.

Everything you need to have a really good dog for cheap!
OMG...for $2.75 get the Top Dog frankfurter and load it up with mustard, onions, sweet relish and kraut. The best dog around, and has been for years.
Best $3 hotdog ever!

Top Dog, as you may all know or have heard, is a Berkeley establishment.

You should also know that it's KINDA overrated.

I mean, $3 for a hot dog? Let alone a hot dog with nothing to jazz it up a la Pink's.

I've had the hot link, lemon chicken and chicken apple. They were all really good. Bonus points for toasting the bread. But the minor chink in my wallet from paying $3 for a hot dog left me feeling unsatisfied. 

Don't get me wrong, Top Dog is a great place late at night if you're hungry for a bite on the drunken walk back home. I also understand that Top Dog has earned its rep for its witty cooks behind the counter, giving you the "Top Dog" experience.

But I feel like the experience is a rather overrated one, with a slightly overpriced cost of admission.
Exactly how a hotdog should taste like.  Love that it has that intial crunch to the dog.

one of my absolute favorite places anywhere. so many hot dogs of every kind. so simple. so good. the sauerkraut at the condiments bar aren't particularly good but for some reason i love it. hot links are my favorites here, tho they're all pretty awesome

It's like mandatory that you have to be grumpy in order to work here, but what top dog lacks in service it more than makes up for with its dogs. I remember complaining about how expensive Top Dog was, relative to the Costco $1.50 (and you get a soda!), but the quality really is worth it. I'd recommend you try all of them, but my favorites are the calabresi and the linguica.

I love spicy food, but holy crap, hot links here were soooo spicy, my stomach was burning for a few hours after eating it.  College students and drunk kids love coming here because its cheap and fast.  I was neither but still enjoyed it.  About $3 for a hot dog, but you might need to eat two because it's pretty small.  I heard that their chicken apple sausage here is good.  Next time i will try that.

Top Dog is Cool but the worker that night i went there was getting high as we wear there not cool and they dint wash there hands like when i pay in cash he went right back to pick up somebody els hot dogs i will not come back sorry Top Dog

Top Dog is so Berkeley!

I don't eat hot dogs! EVER.. except on cold icky nights when I am working in studio... Then these things warm my soul! :)

I'm the "friend" in the review below me. But she's lying because she never actually ate the hot dog! And it was chicken apple Erin.

WHAT I GOT: Chicken Apple Hot Dog

PROS: The food is pretty cheap, the sesame bun enhances the taste a lot, chicken apple is my favorite, and the staff is always entertaining/friendly. 

CONS: Most of the flavors to choose from are ones that most people have not tried yet. And so, it's hard to find that go-to flavor without having a few strikeouts.

ADVICE: If you're a person who doesn't like to risk getting new things in case they end up tasting horrible (I've only gotten strawberry tsunami from Jamba Juice for the last few years), this place might be not be as ideal. But with hot dogs you really can't go wrong, and with Top Dog the risk is even less.
had the apple chicken. it's good, but could've used some more spice.

Long time favorite is only OK. It wasn't great, but it's certainly not bad either. There is a nice variety of choices and the people working there were helpful and very nice. 

If you're in the area and are hankering for a hot dog, Top Dog will fit the bill. I would make it a pilgrimage however.

The diet coke was actually R&C, which is flat and nasty. Maybe actual Diet Coke is too "corporate" for Berkely? There were many sketchy people wandering the streets, so you might want to guard your wallet while taking in the sights of Telegraph & Durant Ave's.
Good spicy links.

Top Dog does truly serve top dog! sometimes there's a line but I can't really blame them that a lot of other people like it to. The Sausages are Juicy and full of Good Meaty Taste, and the Buns are Soft and warm so that it's also easy to chew on one big bite!

My bf dragged me here after we went to Supper Club and man I didn't know what to order. Everything was so fast and confusing. So I made my Bf order for me. I had the... shoot it's been so long that I forgot what I had. But some kind of pine apple or was it apple? I don't know. But I'm not a big fan of hot dogs or burgers, but this hot dog was good. I haven't had a hot dog since then, but if I do again, I'm down for some Top dog.

Must be the buns that keep me comin' here for more.  I don't know exactly what it is, but I crave for Top Dog once a month.  Definitely a place to go after some drinking...

The process of getting your food is simple.  Be aggressive and yell out what you want.. the line is usually out the door.  Those UC Berkeley students like their dogs.. a lot! The first time I came here, I was overwhelmed, it was crowded and I wasn't really sure what to order.  

I always get the veggie dog, a.k.a. The Wienie.  It's made of wheat gluten, eggplant, tofu, bell pepper, onions, garlic, fennel and red wine.  This perfectly seasoned dog with a toasted bun is what it's about.  With chips and drinks, it's a perfect meal.  I love it!  

Cold dogs to-go is available.  Order some for your next BBQ party and it'll sure be a hit :-)!

interesting buns if you dont like them toasted just say so


really good hotdogs

Nineteen years and seven hundred and eighty eight hot dogs later, I still go back to Top Dog at least twice a month. It's safe to say at this point that pretty much every cell in my body is infused with hot links. 

Although they've long promised to open a San Francisco location, the East Bay is still the only place to go if you want a Top Dog. I make the pilgrimmage by driving over from San Francisco. In my opinion, the two best Top Dogs are this one on Durant and the one on the north side of campus. The worst is the one embedded in the Long's Drugs on Broadway in Oakland. The indifferent staff and overcooked dogs make this the Bottom Dog.

All the dogs are good but I've settled on hot links as my personal fave.   And there's enough fat and protein in there so you only have to eat one and you're good for the whole day. NOTE: While one Top Dog never seems like enough, two is too many. Go easy and save your gut for next time.

Nice touches about Top Dog:
1) the libertarian rants on the wall--Top Dog is a monument to the glories of free enterprise
2) The old school patter of the grillmen--the ponytailed Mayan warrior at this location can keep track of 47 orders at the same time.
3) The anti-establishment soda selection--where else can you get RC Cola these days?
4) The stellar condiments--six kinds of mustard, fresh onions and relish and steaming sauerkraut.

I come here every time I am in the area.  Their hot dogs are delicious!  It is no Pink's but the best in the Bay I would say.  Every time I went there wasn't any line except for once (maybe I went during school / class-in-session hours).  I've had their frankfurter and brautwurst but would love to try their other items.

Open late everyday. Juicy, meaty dogs. it's a perfect way to recover from a night of hard partying.

Try the hot link. OMG, yum.

searched yelp for a good place off bart as i was going to the greek & didn't wanna spend moola on the crap food there. 878 reviews? 4.5 stars? serious?

we ordered 2 dogs...the garlic dog had no garlic kick or even garlic flavor. I asked for a recommendation of their most popular dog...the top dog. it was TINY (maybe the girth of 3 pens). nothing special to the taste at all. 

really disappointing. i would give 0 stars if that were an option. i'll let them have one star because the spicy mustards were bangin. save yourself the disappointment & go to costco for their polish dogs & a soda, can't beat that at $1.50.

O my freaking goodness.  I just realized that I never wrote a review for Top Dog.  

I ab-so-freaking-lute-ly love this place!  A must for me is the Lemon Chicken with the self-serve toppings & a HEAPING load of sauerkraut.

Hot sausage......mmmm.

Word to all those uninformed: there is no line at Top Dog!  Just walk up to the freakin' counter already!  Or I will just walk around you and order my food and eat and you will still be waiting in line like an idiot.

Always good for a drunk 3AM snack.  I don't eat pork or beef, so I always get the chicken apple; so good!  I've been eating that for at least four years and I'm not sick of it yet.  

Chris is my fave.  For serious.  Not my fave: annoyingly drunken very loud UCB students who are almost always here when I'm trying to score some hot sausage.  Don't get between me and my hot sausage.

As hot dog places go, pretty awesome.  They have a very wide selection, and almost all of them are great.  I used to eat here seriously four times a week, since it was right next to Soda Hall.

However remember- it just serves hot dogs.  Which is great if you are young and getting lots of exercise, but all that fat and meat does catch up with you.  Just a warning there.

Top Dog is also a "only in Berkeley" type of thing, because it's run by Libertarians.  This means there are ranty diatribes all over the walls about how the government is trying to oppress you by making you pay for roads and the fire department.  And how global warming is a myth being used to silence Freedom Lovers.  So that is a bit obnoxious.

I'm not sure but I think the dude working the counter is "leasing" the entire business while he's there, in keeping with the Libertarian principles of the place.  Whatever the reason, he has a bit of flexibility; you can cut deals with him for buying dogs in quantity."
Every time we go it's always a garlic dog, never disappoints. Love the open feel of the location, nice street view with their open windows.  Great place for a snack while walking in town.

Berkeley takes a lot of pride in sustainability and Top Dog will outlast the cockroaches. Never having eaten a top dog before 11:30PM with a bac below .15,  top dog has never failed to deliver. 

Simple and reliable with local flair. Honestly, what else can you ask for

Its cool how berkeley students 25 years ago, and 25 years in the future, enjoy that same midnight kielbasa

I don't know why it's that good, it's just a hotdog!!

But almost everything I've tried here was good. Maybe its the bread? I dont know... Ive had the top dog all the way to the chicken apple, all delicious. I like how all the condiments are on the side and you choose how much of whatever you want to slap on the dog...

Service is pretty dope. All the times I've gone it's been pretty busy and somehow the ones that work there remember everyones order how? Maybe magic? 

One think I was that disappointed me was the veggie dog. I know, why was I ordering a veggie dog in tv first place at top dog right?!? Well I had to, but trust me that will never happen again. Stuff was nastyyy...and goodluck with parking...
Love all the hot dogs here!  I've pretty much tried them all too!  Chicken apple is one of my favs... Mmmm

top dog is small and crowed place. you can choose many different kinds of chorisoes, but i liked the garlic frankfurter.
the taste was awsome, but i didn't like the attitude of black guy man. that guy was keep yelling at me like he was something.
fuck you hot dog guy!! at least i took SAT.

hahaha

6/9 Great service! The people were super nice! Got the hot links (extra spicy!) and top dog...yummy! And then had an extra bratwurst without the bread!...they were so nice they even gave us a brownie for free! I wished I had asked for her name..she was sooo nice! 

It was pretty funny...the BF asked if he could wash his hands...and they were so surprised they figured we weren't from the Berkeley area because we were too polite...unlike other customers!!  

It was a great experience and we were so glad we stopped by and shared a meal here!

I WANNA HOT DOG! I wish I didn't live hundreds of miles away. Top Dog is a must stop destination when visiting UC Berkeley. TD sever a variety of different hot dogs. The closest thing in socal was the Dog Out in Riverside, which was a copy that didn't last. 

I once ate here shortly after eating dinner at another restaurant. I guess you could say it was my dessert. Highly Recommended!
I love top dog, all their dogs are good and well priced and they are open pretty late too. smoked apple dog is delicious. Gave an extra star because I grew up eating here

Hands down, the best hot dogs i've had in my life -- and I know nothing will ever beat it.  (And I don't even like hot dogs.)

It is a bit pricey for a hot dog and they are a bit small, but none-the-less still great.  I recommend the hot link or the chicken apple.

Yummm!!!  :)

FYI, cash only.

I miss you Top Dog! Their hot dogs are hands down, THE BEST. 

I rank Top Dog above Pinks down in LA because it is simple but amazing. You cannot go wrong with what you order here, but my personal favorite are the chicken apple and the kielbasa!

I've eaten at top dog since as long as I can remember and those dogs...are awesome.  Something about the kielbasas with spicy hot musturd just does the trick.  The downside is that the cost keeps going up for a hot dog.  I remember back in the days when the a top dog's hot dog only cost me $1.50.  It's okay once in awhile blowing $3 for a hot dog won't kill anybody.

Smoked Chicken Apple is the biz!
This shiz is legit.
Plain n simple...

OK so there's already a lot of reviews, so i'll add more fuel to the fire of this awesome hot-dog eatery. here's some plus points...
+ open late
+ cheap $$$ food
+ great variety of dogs
+ fast service
- wish it accepted credit card at the late night location.

About 3 decades ago I finished many evenings by stopping here on my way back from Moffitt or whichever library I'd been studying at. And, back then for about $2 I got a Hot and some Apple Juice. Fast-forward to now .. and you'll find you can get a great 'dog at a good price, and maybe catch part of a game or whatever program is on the overhead TV while you wait. Top Dog is still food for the people at a good price. 

Don't be fooled by people who review Top Dog as if Alice Waters or Thomas Keller could make this place better - please, it's fine the way it is and always has been.

Top Dog is one of those places you just associate Berkeley with because it seems like it's always been there and always will be. Sure there are other places open at 2 am but the crowd is always around Top Dog.  You get plenty of choices and hot dogs in a sandwich roll filled with condiments is always great.
Great place to go when you're broke but want delicious apple juice and quality veggie hot dogs.
A ultimate favorite..its quick and easy to get too.. My favorites are bratwurst and linguica. This the one spot that you must go in berkeley.

top dog.  

I used to come here all the time when I lived in Berkeley.  Now I only come when I come before the Cal game.  My first stop is top dog.  There is a little line, but its worth its wait.  I get a top dog, frankfurter.  Its on a seasame roll, nicely toasted.  I top it with mustard, relish, and onions.  The best 3 bucks you will ever spend at Berkeley.  I take a bite, and its goodness.  The frank has a snap with a bite.   Nice flavor.  My other favorite is the calabrese italian pork sausage.  

The shack is just a shack, with a line out the door.   You order and its on the flat grill, a little wait, but worth it.   No seating.   Just grab and go.

Only drawback, RC cola.

Some of the best post beer drinking food ever.  They stay open until 3 a.m. on the weekends.  They sell cigarettes and you get to yell your order at the workers.  THREE TOPS, A HOT & A LEMON CHICKEN!

But all the condiments are lookin' pretty hurt by 2 a.m. after sitting out all day.  However if you are buying hotdogs @ 2 in the morning you are probably intoxicated so it doesnt even matter.

Fast, cheap, and delicious.  After close to a decade of hearing about how good this place is, I finally decided to give it a try.  My fault, I've always been a wine and dine kinda chick so I could never see myself standing on the sidewalk with a hot dog in hand, but that's definitely changed now!  I was expecting the "rude" service that I've heard a few people talk about, but the guy behind the counter seemed like he was just trying to be efficient seeing as how the operation is pretty much a one man show.  But that's all a part of the charm and experience, right? :)

I've only had the chicken apple, which was super-yummy.  It was plump, juicy, and had that great *snap* that I look for in a sausage.  And at only $3 each,  I can't wait to try the rest!  I'd take one of these suckers over a McDonald's meal any day!  Just remember to bring cash!

I love this place. It is just as funky now as it was 25 years ago. The dogs are delicious, the clientele is eccentric and the order process is quick and to the point. Better be ready when its your turn, or you mess up the whole flow and feel like an outsider. The Calbrese are delicious and the toasted bun brings the whole thing together. Good selection of self serve mustards and condiments. Excellent way to finish a night of drinking. If you like a good sausage, this place is a must!!
bangin brats!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I would give you 4 stars on taste, but I had to take away a star based on cleanliness.  It wouldn't be such a big deal if I didn't see it myself, but it's kind of gross when the cook is handling with money and then touches my hot dog and buns without gloves or washing his hands!  He has tongs, but he still uses his bare hands and fingers.

I got The Wienie, which is the vegetarian dog.  It was a pretty good dog, not rubbery at all, like most veggie dogs.  The veggie dog is made up of wheat protein, bell peppers, fennel, eggplant and garlic (says their website).  Sounds like a good veggie dog to me!  But I kind of wished Top Dog had more toppings available on the side, so maybe I can make myself a Chicago style dog, but oh well.  

Friends got the lemon chicken and the smoked chicken apple.  My friends were pretty happy with their dogs as well, but I know one friend also felt a little sick in his stomach... he saw the cook handle money and touch his hot dog too.

Sooooooo worth the wait and lack of space. This place has the best hot dogs in the world. 

It was tradition to come here after a long night at Blake's (RIP Blake's). This is the perfect place to come after a couple of drinks.

Top Dog has absolutely some of the best hot dogs I have ever had the opportunity to eat... and I have had many dogs in my day.  Every time I am in the Berkeley area during the day, I attempt to stop here and pick me up a dog or two.  Being that I have been coming here for years, I have tried every single one of the hot dogs they have to offer on their menu.  I would have to say that my favorite hot dog here is between the bratwurst and the calabrese.  Add a little spicy mustard, white onion, relish, and sauerkraut (NO ketchup!) and your have pure bliss in the palm of your hand.

Do I even have to review this place?  Top Dog is a huge part of my Berkeley experience.  No Berkeley trip is complete without a visit to the top dog nazi.  This ia great treat for lunch, dinner, 2am drinking nights, before a football game, after a football game, on a rainy day, etc.  I've had the veggie dog which is good, but my all time favorite is the smoked chicken apple.
Oh why oh why can't there be a top dog in los angeles???

Came here twice now. Had their chicken apple and lemon chicken. Both are mouth-watering-great! I like the bun, it's not the average hot dog buns u find in the grocery. Sauerkraut is a must. To really taste every bite of the sausage, I'd skip the mustard and ketchup.

It's cheap, would definitely come back to try their other ones.

Ah...good ol top dog. However, why do they keep raising the price? It makes me a little sad.

I'm always super amazed by how the guys are so good at remembering names/orders. Sometimes they can come off a little rude, but I mean they're on their feet making hot dogs for hours, so I guess they get a break. Love how they are open late, but dislike how drunk the customers are.

Yes, yes, yes: Smoked chicken apple. Not really yes: Lemon Chicken tends to be a little bland for me. Also a good tip, alcohol and spicy hot links don't mix. I've heard various throwing-up-hot-dog stories with drunk people who thought it was a good idea to eat a hot link. lol.

The original is still the best.  Lemon chicken is my favorite and the apply sausage is good too.  I love how the cook never writes anything down and calls out orders.  The toasted bread puts it over the top.  Still the best hot dog around.

Tasty hot dogs! I had the Hot Link one for the first time last night & enjoyed every bite! 

The place is SUPER CONVENIENT b/c they close late, we got there after 2 AM & its seems to be the place to go in Berkeley after the bars. It's relatively cheap, 3 dollars for a hotdog, which i personally thing its nothing cause i know street vendors charge 5 dollars for regular hot dogs. WORTH IT!

Def making another trip (possibly a couple) to this place!

This is one of my favorite hot dog places because it offers atypical hot dogs and a eclectic variety to choose from. 

Food: This place offers items such as smoked chicken apple (yummmy!!!!) , lemon chicken, and vegetarian hot dogs. They are very delicious, fresh, and one of the best hot dogs I've tasted in any hot dog place I've been to.

I love this place because it offers non traditional hot dog eaters (non red meat eaters and vegetarians) the chance to eat hot dogs.

If you love this place as much as I do, you can also buy the hot dogs to take back (as packs) and grill them at your own picnics. I've done this before and they worked with me on a good "value".

Price: Very great deal. All the hot dogs are under $3.00 dollars. I normally get 2 - and save 1 for later. The place is awesome enough that I would drive to Berkeley, risk the parking meter maids just to savour the experience!

Service: Although it's self service, the top dog hot dog preparers have a great personality. I've chatted with some of the guys who've worked there and they are friendly and have a good sense of humor. No frills type workers.

Parking: Beware. Parking is street only and NOT easy to find. If you are a Berkeley student with a parking permit, there is a "hidden" lot that is adjacent and across the street near Unit 2. You can park here if you have a permit and it's after 6pm evening hours. Otherwise, parking is difficult, but there's also several parking lots (UC Berkeley ones as well) that offers public parking at night. A popular place to park that isn't too much is the lot on Channing (ample parking spots). Credit cards accepted for the spaces along Bancroft Avenue though not necessarily at many of the spots near Top Dog on Durant. (coins only on Durant).

Ambiance: Fast. Take out style. Standing room (very little) only. Not a place for sit down though there are some benches across the street at the Asian food lot aka "Asian Ghetto".
if you happen to find yourself in berkeley and you want something quick....head over to top dog. the workers are entertaining..and the food is good.

Who would think that a hot dog experience would be this good.  They have a great menu and fresh ingredients, the service is quick and the hot dogs are amazing.  I still remember this place and it's been years since I've been there.  Unforgettable.

Top dog has cheap hot dogs and a good variety of them. My personal favorite is the Linguica. YUM!  My sister is a fan of the chicken apple, but I feel like you can just go to Costco and buy them in bulk there for even cheaper. There isn't much space at this location so you pretty much go in and order, then wait outside for your dog. Go back in to pick up the dog and put toppings on it.. and then you're on your own to find a place to savor your cheap deliciousness that is a top dog in my book.

Don't expect anything fancy on your dogs like Pink's in LA. It's just a small stand with a variety of wieners.

Crispy grilled bread that doesnt fall apart and quality hot dogs!

original - best standard hot dog i have had

chicken apple - juicy and not salty

russian mustard was just like a kick of wasabi, except manlier

A friend of mine who used to attend UCBerkeley recommended this place.  So I went and gave it a try.  I ordered the top dog.  I like how they grill the hot dog and the buns and when you bite into it, there's a snap to it.  It was yummy.  I'd definitely go there again if I'm in Berkeley.

Oh Top Dog, why are you SO GOOD? When I was living there, my night was not complete without going to Top Dog at 1am. Mmm... The crazy people outside provide entertainment as long as they don't try to get you to buy something for them. My money is MY money, bum!

Now if only I can find out how to review Krusty's... I know, it's not called that anymore. I can't handle change.
This place is a total sausage fest.  Thank you!  I'll be here all week!  Please remember to tip your wait staff!
What can I say about this place? JUST DELICIOUS!

I hate hot dogs.  

I'll eat a polish dog at Costco only because it's dirt cheap.  But I rarely order a hot dog anywhere else (like at a sports event).  The one exception is Top Dog.  I make special trips just to eat a sausage on a roll (or two or three) from Top Dog.

I've tried different sausages at Top Dog and I haven't had a bad one yet.  And the rolls they use are heavenly.  Tasty and substantial without overwhelming the taste of the sausage or making the sandwich seem too bready.

My favorite sausage is the Calabrese which they describe as pork, paprika, chili, fennel -- semi-hot.  I've also had the Top Dog Frankfurter (which is probably the closest sausage to a regular "hot dog"), Lemon Chicken, Bratwurst, and Hot Link and they were all great.  Although I've never had it, they even have a veggie dog.

I've been to this location and the one on Center St and both serve the same great sausages.

On the side of the restaurant is the self-serve wall of condiments you are able to put on your sausage.  

When in Berkeley, you have to try Top Dog.

This place has great hotdogs! The facility to buy their delicious hotdogs tends to be very small. I think from a bay area standpoint, it's not your usual feel. You get in, get your food, and be on your way. 

If it's late at night and you have the munchies I recommend Top Dog for sure! If there is a line, it's worth it.... so bring an MP3 player. For the price, the atmosphere, and great taste, Top Dog is a lock.

If they only opened some more chains...... that would be even better....
simply amazing hotdogs! forget pinks!

$3 for a burnt hot dog on a sturdy bun

Got the chicken apple as it was highly reviewed and seemed the most interesting. Tasted kinda sweet and savory versus the usual salty hot dog. It was good but it was burnt significantly so I tasted the charred flavor more than the actual meat itself. Complimentary onions, sauerkraut, and russian mustard. The russian mustard is like and upgraded wasabi so take caution. You have been warned. Overall, I was a little disappointed but Im always open to second chances.

Top Dog is the shit. 
Anyone who says otherwise is stupid or doesn't have taste buds. 


Need to know about me? I worked at Top Dog (North Side) for two years some time ago, and although I ate there every shift for two years straight, every time I am in Berkeley I still eat at Top Dog. 

Can't go wrong with a Top and a well-done Cal.

and Kimby's the best griller. :)
I love their hotlink, but whatever preservative they use alway give me stomach problem.

Very little beats a $3 hot link, beef hot dog or flavored chicken dog wrapped in a toasted bun after a night of imbibing copious amounts of alcohol.  Throw on your choice of ketchup, mustard, onions, relish & sauerkraut (or all of the above) for a tasty American classic that should hold you over until you get home.

Don't block the doorway while you decide on what to order; this place is like an assembly line.  You walk in, place your order, pay, get your food, then walk out.  There's no seating, so don't expect to enjoy your hot dog while you bang out a term paper on your laptop.  It's been this way for centuries...or whenever they first opened.

A classic. Every dog is awesome, and they've got RC Cola! They've got vegan dogs for the veg-heads out there. 

They used to sell cigarettes at this location, which was real handy for those of us dying slowly, particularly because they were the closest place to buy them after 10. I think they quit selling them awhile ago, sadly. From what I understand, the owner's kinda an old Berkeley libertarian, which explains the wall decorations and why they were sellin' smokes in the first place. Heck, probably explains the RC Cola too. 

After 10pm expect to wait at least 10 minutes. After 2a this place is jammed up with folks. The one on Center and Northside is of equal quality, if less trafficked.

I love Polish dogs so I had to grab a KIELBASA along with a small lemonade. It's not a huge hot dog, but it was enough for lunch today. Today was pretty warm so that lemonade really hit the spot. It wasn't too sweet or bitter either.

Best hot dogs around! And the bread is hot and toasty!!! That's what did it for me. Toasty bread. And not like the crappy bread you normally get in stores. Toasty REAL bread. I usually get a cal or lemon chicken depending on my appetite. If you're new, make up your mind...quickly. My friend took a friend there once and he got yelled at and had to let 3 other people order before him 'cause they guy working got annoyed because he was so indecisive.

straight to the point, very good selection, open late, and super friendly staff! the only complaint, would be that i wish the dogs were a little bigger. 
:o)

i often drive here from vallejo just for the dogs, they're delicious and this is one of my favorite places to eat. Diverse selection of different links. Really old-school grill that gives the links a great taste. My favorites are the hot link and cal. Good prices and when you go there enough you can feel cool and order stuff using one syllable words like "cal", "hot", "top", "Apple", "lemon" etc. If you go when it's not busy you can sit at the bar, but usually you have to either eat outside or in your car. even with that it's a five star place.
The chicken apple and hot link are bomb. Good eats!
2 WORDS: LEMON CHICKEN!!!!!! I wish they had a TOP DOG here in San Diego. Cause I sure miss me some late night Lemon Chicken Hot Dogs from Top Dog, especially after long nite of fun and games. i

Not what I remembered. 

I went to school at Cal from 2001-2005 and loved this place... the other night I found myself lost in Emeryville and decided to revisit my nastalgia - I was neither disappointed or impressed.  I got the Lemon Chicken and a Hot Link, loaded them both up with suarkraut and onions and enjoyed them. 

I ended up only eating the links and left the bread which are now weird looking sub type bread with sesame seeds.  Its a little hard, I like regular hot dog buns but I guess they break too easily and make the meal a little messy.

I no longer think its worth a late night 1/2 mile hike.
I'm not a huge hot dog fan, but top tog is truly the top dog where dogs are concerned.

This place gets one star for really shitty customer service. The guy behind the counter in the glasses is a complete asshole. He is routinely rude to customers and I'm not really sure how they stay in business give their reputations for abrasiveness. 

NOTE TO OWNER: YOUR CUSTOMERS KEEP YOU IN BUSINESS & PAY YOUR BILLS. TREAT THEM WITH RESPECT!!!!

As for the dogs, they're overpriced and not really worth it.

Great place to have a late night meal! All the dogs are fantastic! inexpensive place to have. Apple Chicken is my favorite, but everything else is good too! If they have it close to my house, i am there for the late meal for sure!!!

Hot Dogs at 2 am?  
...
I'm game!  Top dog is for when you have those late night cravings for a big long juicy sausage (umm.... yeah I said that with no regrets).  The buns are toasty (ohh god I gotta get over this) and you can dress your dog with lots of condiments... the usual selection of sauerkraut, onions, ketchup, mustard and onions (raw not grilled unfortunately). 

The service is informal... REALLY informal in that if you're not a regular you just annoy the guy.  Well I understand why he might be grumpy, standing up all day taking 100 of orders an hour... but still!  It's his job! Try to be nice about it!  Please?.... okay that won't happen because no matter the service, people will come to top dog anyway.  Oh yeah... and 2.75 is a little steep for a hot dog.

How could you not like Top Dog? It's cheap, the dogs are GREAT, it's open until the wee hours, and all the propaganda on the walls will keep you amused while you're waiting for your food.

If you ever want to see a food establishment in utter bedlam, visit this place at 1 a.m. on a Saturday. You'll see the angry grillman barking at about 50 drunks who are milling around and yelling and spiling out onto the sidewalk, and this goes on at a steady pace for hours. I'm not trying to put the place down, for this, by the way - it's highly entertaining. 

ALSO - if you want to try to duplicate Top Dog at home, the hot dogs they use are Saag's. At least the hot links are; I know that much. Don't get me wrong, they always taste a little better the way they cook them on the grill at Top Dog, but if you don't have time to come down there often, this will keep you at least reasonably satisfied.

Top Dog gets my vote for the most nostalgic food in Berkeley.  A trip is not complete without a brat.  The hot link is not especially hhhot, as they claim but it makes me feel studly that I can say that.

Let me start by saying TOPDOG as a business is the Shit!!!! This review is based on one employee that was very racist. I'm still in shock that people in 2011 have the audacity to still think they are better than another race. Long story short...A white guy working the register act as if he didn't see my husband in line and just looked past him to take the other persons order. Although my husband did speak up to let him know he was waiting like everyone else the guy still did not want to take his order, tried to ignore him. My husband just left out before he caught a case in there. 

If your not white BEWARE

The best hot dog i've ever had. Me and my friend's wish we could go there more often but there's just not enough time in the day to beat the traffic in Berkeley. Good thing they're open late! Great spot to hit up when you get the late night hungry hungry hippos. I usually go here after a night at Blake's or vice versa...

I could tell Top Dog is definitely a local favorite. It was about 11 at night, and this place was swarming with bunch of college students.

GREAT bockwursts just for a couple of bucks.. really yummy.

I also enjoyed the really funny anti-capitalist stickers all over the wall.

Minus one star because the guy kept on forgetting my order, but it was understandable because the place was FILLED with people, I guess.
The best late night food.

Great hot dogs - why go for anything other than the classic - I always miss them when I try anything fancy schmancy.

1 star off because of the wait, lack of seating, and it is a hot dog...

Kielbasa, kielbasa, kielbasa.

Garlic frank was unremarkable.

Gotta try calabrese next time.
The smell was horrid and grease everywhere, totally freaked this vegetarian out. Altho my carnie friends enjoyed the links, they seem really happy and claimed it was heavenly.

yup, it's that good! any and every time I'm out in the area I have to have me a TOPDOG. My fav is the itialian and the lemon chicken and the apple chicken can't forget the topdog and kielbasa. 

not to mention there open untill 2 or 3 am perfect spot to hit up after a night of drinks

Top Dog, I didn't take advantage of you enough when I was at Cal. Now that I no longer go to Berkeley 5x a week, I crave thee. There really isn't anything like a lemon chicken at 2am after a night of drinking. YUM! I love how they toast the roll with the dog. This is making me hungry already....

I have been eating at Top Dog since the early 70's.  The prices have increased six fold.  There are better hot dog shops in the Bay Area with more consistent cooking.  Last Friday, I had the Garlic Sausage aka German and Linguica.  Well, the Garlic Frankfurter was perfectly prepared.  However the Linguica was overcooked and dry.  The selection of condiments were excellent.  I love reading the old articles taped to the walls.  The articles have changed since the seventies, but they are still worth reading.

On a cold night, there is nothing like a hot link with super hot mustard to make you sweat.

Soooooooooooooooo delish!  Hands-down this is the best hot dog I've ever had -  flavorful, juicy and tender!  I could go for a hot link or a lemon chicken anytime!  The toasty bun is also good.  It'd be even more perfect if they increase the sausage-to-bun ratio (either fatten the sausage, or reduce the bun size)! Nom nom nom
I don't need to write a review, because you already know how awesome top dog is.

Best hot dogs you could ever eat! Always relied on this place for a quick bite and have less than 5 dollars in my wallet . Cant go wrong with any of their hot dogs. Quick service. The guy in the back will spot you right when you walk in and take your order.  Open everyday til the early morning. Try one when your out in the berkeley, telegraph ave area.

As a self proclaimed hot dog connoisseur, I pride myself on the fact that I don't need a parade of umbrellas and none of that fancy shmancy stuff that is often associated with fast food places.  

Prior to eating here, my favorite processed meat enclosed in casing was this little stand in Cayucos off on the corner by the docks.  To sum the taste in one word: bomb.

Although it's indoors, it still has the charm of a hotdog stand which gives it that authentic feel.  You're in and out. That's it.  I think I offended a couple of people though because, yes, I eat my dogs with ketchup. Don't judge.

top dog is soooo good. try the lemon chicken and hot link. they are delicious!! 

the only thing that annoys me are the people working there. they try to be smart asses because they think thats how a hot dog cook is supposed to be. they fail miserably at it. its okay though. i will put up with anything if i can just have a lemon chicken.

Tastes fine, condiments are neat, but not really worth the price.
Rating might go up (or down) if I ever try everything on their menu, but honestly, it's just sausage in a bun. Good bun, flaky crispy, but the meat wasn't amazing in really any way. It wasn't bad, just not all that great.

The one time I tried the chili wasn't all that amazing either.

I used to come here all the time when I went to UC Berkeley.

How I miss these hot dogs.  Easily one of the best hot dog places around.

Best Hot Dog I've Ever Had.

I went to Austin and tried The Best Wurst.  I went to Chicago and tried Hot Dougs.  I went to OC and tried Jerry's.  I went to SF and tried Costco's.  Nope.  Top Dog wins it easy.

It's awkward when you go roll into Top Dog and asked them if they changed their bun.  Apparently, yes they did 3 years ago -- the original bun provider went out of business.  It's even more awkward when you try to buy a pack of smokes and find out they stopped selling cigarettes 5 years ago.  At least the kielbasa hasn't changed :)

Oh, and for some reason I can only theorize about, I like this location better than the others.  I think they leave it on the grill a lot longer so it gets the nice charred taste.
Got to have me some Top Dog when I'm up in Berkeley. Great Louisiana Hot Link.  Open really late. Have RC Cola which is a definite plus too.
Best hot dogs ever. Enough said.

+ Polish Dog
+ Linguica 

Just try it.

When all you need is a good hot dog after a good night at the bars, Top Dog is a must. Great selection, quick service, and good taste.

I'm a huge fan of their hot links and chicken apple.

Their dogs will feel you up, and make that walk home a lot easier.

a) open late
b) tasty food
c) awesome staff and decorations

They also have vegetarian options and a wide variety, each for only $3.  It's rockin.  The variety of mustard alone is worth a re-take.  The Russian beaver mustard burns like fire!  Me likey. :)

Perfect way to end a drunken evening.  Not because the food is crap, but because the food is AWESOME as well as horrible for you.  The scenery is great.  It's awesome to get wasted and head over to Top Dog for drunken university antics.  Get the lemon chicken or hot links, slather them in relish, onions and Russian mustard for a quick and cheap way to prevent a hangover.
What hasn't been said? Nothing. F-I-V-E-S-T-A-R-S.

Best dogs I had...been coming here for years. Try the hot link if you like somethin spicy with little kick, kielbasa and bird dog hits the spot too. It's a Berkeley institution. I had  pinks (la) :(  New york dogs from the streets of nyc, and chicago hot dogs from the windy city..gotta say top dogs is still the top dawg.... come here late at nite after knockin a few down and the dawgs taste extra good.

One dog here is perfect.  Lemon chicken --brings me back to my days at Berkeley...

Additionally, there are other dogs like the polish and chicken apple sausage which aren't bad, but neither are they spectacular.

Service is also quick, but there is no real sitting space.  Order inside, wait outside, pick up dog, and add condiments --pretty much a pick up and go place.  

For $3 a hot dog, don't think this is the best deal around, especially since it warrants a drive over to East Bay and than, also having to find (and pay for!) parking by the UC campus to have a hot dog.
Top dog is the only friend I have in North Cal and I hope to visit very soon.

i'm now a Top Dog fan. 

chicken apple FTW.
This place definitely hits the spot after you're nice and drunk from hitting up the local bars.  And it's open pretty late, too!  My personal fav: chicken apple dogs!

This is another place I've been going to for as long as I can remember. My Dad introduced me to this place as a kid, and he's been a regular customer since the late 1960's. There is no better hot dog in California, in my opinion (Pink's is over-hyped and underwhelming to say the least). The only place that I could compare the hot dogs to would be Nathan's in NY, and even they've gone downhill (or maybe it's only the ones outside of NY that aren't as good and over-priced?).

The hot dogs are great, the sausages are great, and being as that's their focus, I can't say anyone does it better. I go out of my way to get here every time I'm in NorCal, without fail.

I honestly think that top dog is over-hyped and over-priced. I got the frankfurt dog(if I'm remembering it correctly) and it was decent but a bit disappointing after all the reviews I've read. I'd rather get desi dog or the big fat juicy ones at 7 eleven for half the price.

NorCal's version of Pink's.  Just not as many variations and toppings...and parking is a bit tougher than at Pink's.

$3 per dog.  

You can eat at the bar (with 5 stools)...just be aware people will be reaching over you to pay, and get their food.  

Tip 'o the day:  Just take it outside and stand and eat like the locals do.

A late night Berkeley favorite! 

This place always has a huge line full of drunken students, but it's mos def worth it. As many different hot-dogs as there are different asian restaurants in the asian food ghetto, and 3 kinds of mustard. The buns are grilled crispy and sesame-seed laden.

The black guy that keeps track of the myriad orders in his head is a friggin' genius and it's amazing to watch him work. Their free-market propaganda is always fun to read, which I have to imagine is put there by the dude with the glasses.

There is no line, yes the guys aren't the friendliest people. Just don't waste their time or take forever to order.

There's about 10 different hot dogs on the menu, and I've heard good things about all of them. My personal favorite is the chicken apple, yum! Toppings are great. Most definitely some, cheap good eats on the go.
must have. I can't say anything else

I've heard a lot of things about this place, how it's supposed to be the best dog in the area so I was going in expecting something awesome. 

My girlfriend and I get there, look over the menu, but since we didn't know what we wanted right away after first walking into the door, we were ignored. We called our order to cook but he ignored us. Another group walked in and he asked what they wanted, when he didn't acknowledge us the second time I spoke up with my order again. Still nothing. After someone else came in and he acknowledged them, we were finally able to get him to pay attention to us, but he definitely did not seem happy about it. He was horribly rude to everyone if they weren't ready with an order or with payment right when he wanted them to be. 

On the plus side, the dogs were ok, the buns were actually quite good, and they had IBC root beer in their soda machines. 

If you don't mind terrible customer service, then it's a decent place. But if you prefer a stress-free eating experience, I wouldn't recommend it. Maybe I'll check out one of the other Top Dog locations, but I won't be coming back to this one.

Greatest late night bite, I visited Berkeley a few months ago and my friends took me to top dog late at night and it was delicious. They even have vegetarian options, which is great. I love this place!!

Best dog spot ever. Sportcasters have mentioned this place on espn while doing highlights from cal games. You really can't go wrong with whatever you order, but my favorite hands down is the lemon chicken with the spicy mustard and onions. I grab two pretty much everytime I go there.

I mean the hot dogs are good but it's more a thing to do when you go to Berkeley. I mean Top Dog has been around longer then i've been around. But the food is just good because i'm usually drunk when i come here. 

But with long lines and fantastic choices of hot dogs this is the place when i'm in the east bay. Overrated? Possibly, but sure some darn good hot dogs, probably not worth the price sometimes. Sometimes i'd rather have the mexican hot dogs. mhmmm

Ive been continually craving this place ever since I was introduced to it. all of their sausages are amazing and service is always entertaining, fast, and friendly. Remember to bring cash! the sausages are never overcooked or burnt and always taste amazing. My personal favorite is probably the mango habanero when its on the menu. In my opinion, what really makes these dogs stand out is the bread. It tastes fresh and toasting it on the flat top adds another level of flavor and texture. its simply amazing.

In case you were wondering, its okay to get two. :)

I love this place.

You can get pre-cooked dogs and buns to go.  Throw them on the grill on a Sunday if you don't feel like going all the way out to Berkeley.

FOOD:  Perfectly toasted buns and juicy wieners make my mouth water.

SERVICE:  Fast.

AMBIANCE:  It's a small place that's always packed, but hey, who doesn't want a portable yummy treat?

OVERALL:  Best dogs in the Bay area.

Top Dog...Come on! This is the spot 2 hit up on the early mornin hours when U jus headin back 4rm a nite out...Or U could jus B cravin 4 this sh!t...I like the Hot Link, Top, & the Lemon Chicken...Haven't really steered 4rm these selections...Its always packed, but its worth the wait...

Sausages, sauerkraut and mustard: the requirements for an awesome hot dog.

--------
Food: Out of four possible stars: three stars.

Tog Dog's appeal is not so much in the preparation of the food as it is in the ingredients used. The rolls are not tasteless Wonderbread rolls, and the sausages are not your usual beef franks.

Just a sampling of the selection: Calabrese, Kielbasa, Bratwurst and Chicken & Apple.

The kicker is the vat of sauerkraut. It is not a hot dog without it.

--------
Miscellaneous: Out of one possible star: zero stars.

During peak hours, this Top Dog location can get absolutely packed. Yes, it is the product of being located next to dorms and frats, but it still gives me pause whenever I happen to get a Top Dog craving in South Side.

had a huge craving for a hot dog today and knew only top dog could satisfy my processed meat longings. a hot link, a brat, kraut and mustard, cup of rc cola, served by a dude with attitude and i'm good to go!

5 stars for the food. I have pretty much tried every single dog they have and I must say that their Top Dog is the best one. Don't be fooled and think that this is just a "regular" hot dog. Oh no sir.

The high MSG and sodium content in this dog makes it one mother effin top of the line TOP DOG. I was skeptical at first because I had never thought that it would be something other than just a regular hot dog until one day my friend bought me one on accident.

I hear somebody from Santa Barbara started their own hot dog joint after coming here to berkeley's Top Dog. Yes, that's how delicious it is.

Then why 4 stars, you ask? Minus one stars for cleaniness. With a self serve condiments station, things are bound to be messy. But no, that is not why they get subtracted the one star. They get minus one star because the chef who also handles the money touches the food without washing his hands. I understand that this would be an inconvenience for the chef especially when it gets busy, but I'm sure that dude handles A LOT of money a day so some of those germs are bound to get into your food.

My fiancee is in love with Top Dog.
We headed over there with some friends after a night of drinking. I got the Chicken&Apple sausage (which was AWESOME!) and he got a hot link.
He swears up and down that it was the best hot dog he's ever had - and he's lived in big cities all over the country.
Two days later he proposed to me on Christmas Day.
To this day I'm not sure what he was more excited about - the fact that I said yes or his precious Top Dog hot dogs.
I'm hoping it's not the latter!
it really is just a hot dog....

dude, i dont know how some people gave anything less than five stars to this place.  obviously, it's not the french laundry.  you know what youre gonna get when you walk up to the place.  

you order
they cook
smoke a cig and chat outside for 5
get your dogs plus large apple juice(hella good)
top em off
and eat

theres never a hitch

simply, its pretty much the best fast food out there

im a hot dog freak, ive been to many joints but this place has to be the BEST.  they have a great selection - faves are bockwurst and lemon chicken.  never, ever had a chewy skin on them.  plus they're grilled, so they have this nice crispiness to them.  
the natural apple juice is off the hook.  
the guys are always efficient - especially the guy with dreads(he's still there right?) they might be brash, but its part of the topdog character.  plus theyve got like three choices in mustard.  what more could you ask for?  maybe mayonnaise...  or do they have that there?  its always a haze when i go

okay, one negative about it:  i hate it when im waiting outside and a bum always has to come and harass us for a quarter or "what about a dollar?"
Stools are back .

i think i was set up for disappointment for this place.  the whole nite, my friends were prepping me by telling me we were coming here after we drank, & how it was featured on a food channel, & blah blah blah.  so naturally, i was expecting something spectacular, but this was not the case.

tried the lemon chicken hot dog, which wasn't too bad, but nothing my taste buds were jumping up & down for demanding "more! we want more!".  i couldve easily gone to a grocery store & bought one of those chicken sausage hot dogs & grilled em myself.  i wouldve gotten 6 hot dogs for $3+ instead of one.  

there was a pretty small line when we got there, but got our orders pretty fast.  there is no place to sit down in this place, & its a really small venue.  but i wasnt really too impressed with the flavor or taste of their hot dogs.

eh.

yeah brother.  lets be real... there are like... 300 other reviews.  what more could i possibly add but this...

this is a good place to go if you'd like to gobble some weiners.  




yes... i totally took it there.

oh snap tho... try that spicy russian mustard... that stuff'll put on some steel toes and kick you square in the face!  it's AWESOME!
Ive nvr tried any other dog but a hot link and its so good that i cant get myself to try any of the other dogs. The toasted sesame bun? Deeeelish
Super cheap great hot dogs.  I was surprise to see just one person working though.  Luckily I got there early so there wasn't a wait.  Would definitely stop by again if I ever around Cal again.

I have no idea what a top dog tastes like when I'm sober.  But when i was in college, top dogs helped to soak up many an evening of debauchery.  I don't know if i would have graduated without their dogs.

I finally wrapped my mouth around a hot, sizzling, succulent wiener.

Top Dog is amazing, cheap and open late, what could get better? Oh, i know, some cheese!! next time i'll have to bring my own graded cheese =]

the place itself is small, but convenient. The worker was on top of his game, people were shy, afraid, petrified to step up to the counter until he yelled like no other to get their orders in. i loved it.

it's a few minutes wait for the dog, but that's because they're getting all hot and juicy, while your bun is being toasted to perfection. once you get your top dog, be aware, it is hot! just turn around and there you go, add your condiments and your good to go.

can't wait to go back and have another, i love top dog!
The only thing better than sausage with man is sausage with sauerkraut.  Actually, I take that back:  the only thing better than sausage with man is SPICY sausage with sauerkraut.
Great hotdogs...but starting to lose their touch...

Best  hot dog joint in town!  Recomended dogs are  Lemon Chicken ,Bird Dog and the Hot Links. To vu n. " The reviewer who wanted the fries" What hot dog place serves fries?? As far as the customer service goes..You gotta understand the dudes that work there have been employed since the early 90's! Their life revolves around hog smoke probably one of the reasons they're so rude and biter. Just have to learn to to deal with it.

good
- most dogs... my faves are the kiel, brat, top, and chicken apple
- like 400 kinds of mustard and other condiments

bad
- politically charged atmosphere and chicks with hairy armpits

Chicken apple is the bomb. I love top dog but the three dollar per dog is pretty steep for a college student. However I do believe it is a must try! One of my friends have made it his mission to try everything on the menu each time he visits me... And let's just he always leaves Berkeley stomach happy wallet empty!

I might change my mind after a do-over, but I had the lemon chicken (which Roy swears is the best) and it was just so-so. Cal likes this place, and DC liked her veggie dog. The guy there was really cool, though. You gotta love good service.

I remember in UCLA we had a little thing called U-Dog. Now sure it wasn't the original, and sure it didn't have two schizophrenic extroverts behind the counter watching either Beverly Hills Cop or Demolition Man on their 14 inch fuzzy TV which might as well be attached to their cornea at the unbearable 8 inch distance that they seem to enjoy watching it. But guess what? Same hot dogs, but 92 cents plus tax. 

You want to know how that works? Well here you go: You walk in. Place your order, say apple sausage. Place a dollar (a bill, quarters, pennies, whatever) on the counter and a minute later you get your hot dog. No talking back from the griddle-master/money handler, no threats of your hot dog being withheld if you proceed to make fun of the bandanna wearing guy's taste in music. 

So Top Dog slinging master of the Zen of grease trap sausages, I ask you please do not scream my order back at me in the timbre your daddy screamed to you that you swing like a girl. I ask you to resume your medication and proceed to use words like "please," "thank you" and "could you please let the next person make their order?" 

Most importantly, I ask you, nay I beg of you to have some sense and lower the price of those outrageous 4 dollar hot dogs. Now I know these poor head-cases have nothing to do with the pricing of their product, but I wish that the owners did. 

Look, I like dirty hot dogs as much as the next guy. Especially when they come in 15 different flavors and are served well into the night - I will even pay a taxi in a drunken stupor to just smell the uplifting aroma and enjoy an turkey dog and a hot link. But to pay something as outrageous as 2.97 for a hot dog? Depression era child or not, thats not Okay in this world!

Now come to think of it, maybe its best that they charge 4 bucks a hot dog. Because as I recall, UCLA's dollar alternative to Top Dog was never left without the proper critical mass of 5 plus dogs which one was assured to taste again in the morning. 

So I say thank you Top Dog, you keep me slim and as agile as a gazelle. Even if my wallet suffers.

sweet savior to my benighted drunk self,
sweet shelter to my inebriated shell,
sweet companion to empty belly.

        -ode to top dog

yea it's good

Miss.  This.  Place.  So.  Much.

So much, that when I hosted a Big Game viewing party in NY, I ordered a bunch of dogs from them (with buns) that were shipped to me in dry ice.  My apartment smelled of Lemon Chicken and Hot Links for a week afterwards, but it was worth it.

I always swing by when I'm in town.
One of the 5 most important restaurants in the East Bay.

What can I say...a Berkeleyan cannot live without having a hot dog from Top Dog at least twice a year.

My favorite: Lemon Chicken
2nd fav: Top
3rd fav: Bird
