We stick to our regular favorites and are extremely satisfied with them :) I would definitely recommend this as a breakfast place.

Overall rating  - 4/5

This place offers some solid breakfast and lunch items. It is not a dinner place. It's good for those who want to get food on the go or just out for a quick lunch break. Their menu doesn't offer anything special other than the normal salads, sandwiches, soups, pancakes, eggs, and whatnot. Even so, none of those stand out to me either. Portions are smaller compared to similar breakfast and lunch places around the campus, but it is still relatively cheap. They have a huge fridge the size of a wall of bottled drinks just like a convenience store. Since they are a cafe, they also have coffee drinks. The iced latte was bad because all the milk was at the bottom when it was given to me and there were also coffee grinds at the bottom. The hot pastrami sandwich I got was alright, but they used aluminum foil to wrap it a second time, which I think is a waste of foil when it is already wrapped in parchment paper.

Gee, I won't humiliate myself by telling you how many years it's been since I was a student on the Berkeley campus, but let's just say a few of the redwood trunks in Muir Woods were significantly skinnier than they are now. Jamie W. and I decided to take a nostalgic trip back to the campus just so I could point out where I used to hang out around campus. I was shocked to see Aki's still around all these years later and still operating in the same spot in that cozy food mall on Hearst. Oh and there's La Val's Pizza, the same place I used to hang after watching "My Dinner with Andre" at the Northside and pretending to appreciate it.

While I wasn't quite in the mood for a chicken teriyaki flashback, we decided to sit a spell in this cafe on the corner of Hearst and Euclid on the edge of the campus. Northside Cafe appears to be a popular spot with students taking advantage of the numerous electrical outlets to plug in their laptops to work on their term papers. There were quite a few with their noses to the grindstone. We decided to split a Corner Salad, a student bargain at $6.50, which was a bed of iceberg lettuce with slices of cold-cut-style ham and turkey, a hard-boiled egg, marinated roasted red peppers, shredded cheddar and black olives.

It's all lightly doused with a Balsamic vinaigrette and accompanied inexplicably by a generic slice of white bread (see photo). They also offer breakfast scrambles and wraps, deli sandwiches, paninis, and even a full selection of baked potatoes - all the healthy food groups that a kitchen-challenged undergrad needs to digest to get through finals. I could imagine being a student and thinking this to be a great, post-study-hall meal, and even at my age, I thought it was pretty decent. You may already know that the north side of the campus is not nearly the chaotic scene the south side is, so this cafe is where to go if you're looking for a much calmer vibe.

FOOD - 3 stars...pretty good salad especially for a student on the go...and the rest of us, too
AMBIANCE - 3 stars...lots of tables and plenty of plugs
SERVICE - 2.5 stars...students on the run
TOTAL - 3 stars...Go Bears!

Foley's Deli, its been too years and I just recently discovered this place, but I am so glad I did.

At first glance the deli doesn't look too appealing, mainly due to the fact that its inside a market, Sam's Market, but also because there isn't a line for food. The reason for the line is not that it isn't busy but rather that the turn around time is pretty quick. 

The food:

They have a very simple menu, but with a huge selection of choices.
For instance, they have:
Fred's Famous Chicken Sandwich
Pastrami (ONE OF THE BEST I HAVE EVER TRIED, with Pepperjack cheese!)
Famous Steak
Cheese Steaks
Roast Beef
Italian Meatball
Chicken Shawarma
Tuna
Super Burritos... tons more

The sandwiched come either cold or hot( warmed bread and dipped in au jus) Hot Sandwiches/ Super Burrito are $5.99 and cold are $4.99. 

The Super Burritos come with your choice of Famous Chicken or Steak( or any other meat, but you have to specifically request it), pinto/black beans, rice, salsa, cheese, Free Guac!  For less then Chipolte, and its bigger!

Personally, I get a hot sandwich or burrito with a Arizona for $7.50 (Which is a Great Deal) Make sure to grabs tons of napkins it gets messy, but its a good thing, dripping with flavor

P.S. They also have a 'Sandwich Club Card'  which is get every10th sandwich free!
Greatest pastrami ever. This place sells the best sandwiches in Berkeley as far as I'm concerned.

One of my favorite CAL moments happened right here at Bear's Lair.

Immediately following our general commencement (yay Class of 08!), two of my bestest friends and I skipped the hoity toity hors d'oeuvres served in the Campanile Esplanade and headed straight for The Bear's Lair.  

We were greeted by a wave of applause from the burly 3pm drinking crew (thanks guys!) and the three of us feasted on BLUE and GOLD nachos with chicken, a dozen white castle burgers, and a big pitcher of Jupiter Hefeweizen!

It was the perfect way to celebrate 4 fantastic years at the greatest university in the world!  

GO BEARS!!!

If you're up by UC Berkeley on a Friday and looking for a great place to hang out with friends, then The Bear's Lair is the place for you! They have an event called Beat the Clock, which offers pitchers on tap at awesome  prices according to the time. For instance, from 4pm to 5pm, a pitcher is $7 and from 5pm to 6pm, a pitcher is $8. The price caps at $10 a pitcher from 7pm to close.

I've only been here on Fridays, but so far it's been a good place with great atmosphere for college students and college graduates.

Great atmosphere, decent pub food and inexpensive good tasting beer, what's not to like?  I went on a Wednesday night so business was light, mostly just a few locals and college students trying to get over the mid week hump.  I could see how this place could packed out before a football game.  

Makes me wish I went to college with a pub on campus.

Believe it or not, you can get a burger at the Bear's lair. They have the frozen White Castle burgers available for purchase. Whereas i give the actual frozen burgers 3 stars, i give the Bear's lair one star for their ability to constantly fuck up 'cooking' them and average it out. I know i've said a lot about sliders and White Castle - maybe i'll review a White Castle and really jizz all over them.
The beer and the fries and the wings were all delicious I couldnt eat it all, So I took it to go. They had some good music. Go bears!!

Some of the best times of my life! Friday Night Beat the Clock.

Price for a pitcher of beer:
4pm-5pm: $7
The price increases by a buck every hour.

Back in college, my friends and I would partake in something called PTF, otherwise known as Pitcher to the Face. Everyone would get a pitcher, and drink it. I'd highly recommend the quasar double ipa since it's double the bang for your buck. Great times!

Upping the ante to 3 stars.  I guess in order to deal w/ the bathroom you just have to be tanked.  I went on the Saturday after Halloween and I didn't mind it too much this time, but it was funny cuz there was a cup filled with piss in the corner next to the toilet.  the bartender guy walked up to me with food and asked me if the food he was carrying was my food, I replied no but took a big ol chicken strip anyways.  And played beer pong with some guys who were at least 30.  Rip roarin evening

Ah the bears lair!  The one stop place to get all your brew needs.

It's the best place to come for a Cal football game if you don't have tickets.  Its always a great place for food, fun, atmosphere, and to meet some very cool people.

Everytime I came here as an undergrad, you'd always run into someone you know and even now as an alum, I still run into old friends here for Cal games.

The food is pretty decent for bar food and the beer is pretty good.  They have a pretty good selection with some of the nearby Jupiter's brews on tap.  I also suggest getting their micro brews since its pretty much the only place you can get it.

Take back the axe I.P.A - It was alright a little more on the bitter side, but not too bad

Ludwig's Lager - A little bit more lighter taste with a crisp finish.
Oski's honey wheat - I dunno what happened to the Oski brew but it was my favorite.

Last time i went, Ludwig and Oski wasn't on tap, i dunno what happened.

I had the vegetarian pizza which was also good and the fries.

I don't eat meat but the sliders and the buffalo wings are what my friends usually suggest on getting for you meat eaters.

anyways if you are looking for a good time for a sports bar during any Cal game, I highly suggest coming to the bears lair.

Awesome staff, awesome beer, awesome games.

That's about all I have to say about it.  The manager is awesome too.

I'll be honest...I'm giving The Bear's Lair three stars since I'm a Cal alum & usually stop by here on game days, but I'm not really that big a fan of the place. 

A good chunk of my four years at Cal were during the time when this place was being renovated, and when it reopened the main reason I would come here was because on Thursdays (or it may have been Tuesdays?) they had some kind of cheap liter beer promotion (don't remember what it was specifically). 

In the present day I normally stop by The Bear's Lair for a beer before a football game. It's okay I guess. It's crowded (but who can complain about that...what do you expect on game days?), but there's a lot of outdoor seating. There's just something about the setup for this place I don't like. I like to sit on the patio (weather permitting), where they usually have a couple people handling the beer and serving whatever food they're serving out there on game day. Like I said, I expect a large crowd on game days, but things seem to move slower than they should (Henry's is crowded to and they seem to be able to move things along much faster/smoother). As far as the food goes, I've had the nachos & the fries, and they're okay. If I were sober (why would I do that?), I think the food would be borderline, not that great though... 

My experiences at Bear's Lair the last couple years are only for home football games, which I know is a lot different than most other days. I think this place is potentially a lot funner during the week or when there isn't events going on (this "beat the clock" deal I see they have sounds intriguing), but unfortunately it's been awhile since I've experienced that here. I'm still willing to be generous and give this place an A-OK though...

Bear's Lair is, at it's best: crowded, has sticky floors, repulsive bathrooms (unisex), and one has to fight to order a beer.  But all that and the noise and the excitement, whether it is a game day or just any old night of the week, is what makes Bear's Lair great.  It's reasonably priced, especially if you go for Beat the Clock, and packed full of Cal people - students, grads, old alumni.  There is a certain excitement at Bear's Lair that makes it a great place to go.

Bears Lair is definitely a Berkeley experience.  It's probably the best place to watch sports.  It has a lot of TV's for a Berkeley bar, and every TV usually is a different game or sport event.  

On busy days, like Cal football games or March Madness, things can get hectic.  Room is spare, and it can be a hassle to get from point a to point b with a pint in hand.  Just use your reflexes, and you can do it.

The people provide the atmosphere though. It can get REALLY fun during a close game or during March Madness.  People cheering, fans screaming, high fives and tipsy people, what else do you want?

I've had the food a few times, and it's pretty decent to.  Sometimes you get so lost in the beer, that you forget how good bar food compliments it perfectly.

I've had so many great college and post college memories here that I can't give it anything lower than a 5 star.  The people are usually friendly, and its a nice break from the busy hub bub and stress that Cal can bring.  Just chill, relax, and drink a beer.  Good times.
Great atmosphere for a night out with friends. Beer selection is cool they have local Jupiter beers. Definitely a place to hang out and watch sports games with a group a friends.

Being of a legal age, and a Cal student, it is my up most duty to support the on campus boozery.  I am so not a cheap beer girl though, so I am thrilled that they have house brews.  My favorite is the Honey Ale.  They are often out of Honey Ale though so my second choice is the Hefenweizen.  Food here isn't bad either.  Garlic fries and pizza are the perfect compliment to the two to three cheap $5 pitcher of beer that you can get in from four to five on Friday night.  I try to plan my class schedule around this.

This bar is actually on Berkeley campus, but has crappy beer selection and blend pizza with too much bready part.  Although its usually a good price to see random events and interesting ppl as bar goes.  There is once where we saw 2 guys argue the pro and con of Christianity and Buddism, when both of them are not even religious.

I guess if you want to see interesting people and doesn't care about the quality of your food and beer.  Welcome to come here, although I would actually just people watch at the corner of telegraph and bancroft and can probably get the same experience.
great place to have a beer

For a college pub, nooooot baaaaadddd!

I've only come here for beat the clock, which is a great way to kick off some steam at the end of your week. It gets realllllyy crowded as you would expect for college bar, so come early and reserve a table.

They have TV's all around, so if you're alone in town, and want the support of local fans for your favorite team, this is the perfect place to score a high five or man back pat. They also have garlic fries, amongst other regular bar foods if you're hungry.

I came here on CalDay to watch a soccer match with my buddy and was surprised at how empty it was, thought I'm sure this is not always the case. The food is bar food, but was their wing packs were a nice size when I wanted to sit down and watch a 2-hour game.

They ran out of ribs (though I think this had something to do with CalDay) so were kind enough to substitute a bunch of boneless wings instead with various sauces. The normal wings were very tasty, but the boneless wings didn't taste much different from McDonald's chicken nuggets.

Being an out-of-stater, this was not a bad experience, and my expectations weren't high as I saw this as a place to chill, drink a few brews, have some unhealthy food, and cheer for Barcelona (they lost, but I swear it didn't affect the rating). Overall, you're gonna be frustrated with the slow-moving staff, but once you get your beer and food, it's not a bad place to be.
I go because all my friends go, not because it's a nice place.  Although I have to say that the bartenders are really great.  They're the reason I bumped this up to 4 stars.

This is a typical Berkeley hangout, and even a place to grab a beer on your way to Ochem.  Not that I would do that, right?  Anyway, it's grungy and busy, the way you'd expect a rowdy bar to be.  There are good beers on tap and they sell the T-shirts: "Go beers!"  Get it?  haha.  Not very many restrooms so be creative.  Afterall, this bar is on campus nearby many buildings which contain restrooms...

Bears Lair consistently is ranked as one of the top campus bars in the country, and to be honest, I just don't know why. Beat the Clock is sweet, being on the campus is sweet, and watching oski take a beer bong  through his eye socket is freaken awesome but besides that it really doesn't drive me wild. 
Beer selections is decent, (mainly local stuff, Jupiter, mmm) No pool table or shuffle board, never live music, always closes before 2am and no hard alcohol, just beer.
I would give it a 5 star no question if oski was there more often taking a beer bonging in the eye. AWESOME

I like Bear's Lair for the beer and people, not the food.  Really, go eat somewhere else since this place has not yet mastered how to get (good) food to people (well, minus the fries, those rock.)  All their beers are microbrews and the post-game scene is always a fun crowd.  Perhaps I like this place so much because I saw it before it's rennovation in 2001.  It was such a shit hole that the current Bear's Lair looks like the Top of Mark compared to old days.

In a word..  The Bears Lair Sucks.  I gave it one star because...   I really don't know why. 
The place is totally understaffed.  The only reasonably attentive employees were the food servers.  Otherwise, you sit there, while the slacked jawed employees behind the bar stare at you for a while and then their attention span goes on a tangent.  They must be thinking of cleaning the (yuck) bathrooms and then lose their train of thought.

The one good thing is I know where I won't be squandering my time today... Or any day!!

I love love love and miss so much the infamous Berkeley Bear's Lair Beat the Clock. It's been exactly one year since I graduated yet I still managed to run into people at probably the most crowded beat the clock ever and represented by lasting from 5:00-8:30!! (Not too shabby!!). 

As most people have figured if you need to go to the bathroom the most hygienic solution would probably be Eshelman next door of which the door facing campus is always locked, BUT the door facing the street is usually open! 

Cajun Fries + Garlic Fries + Hef = God I miss college...

during the world cup or baseball playoffs i am very lucky indeed to work a block from the bear's lair. though i can't have a beer with lunch they have a good pizza and drink deal and tons of tv's to watch the game. the staff is usually super busy on those days but they're cool about it and take care of everyone. the epitome of what a campus pub should be.

They changed their name. But the service wasn't very good as I was sitting at the bar for 10 minutes, before I said something to take my order. I had the party platter of 50 wings and it was good, not bad for the price and more than enough to satisfy 10 people with leftovers.

While the food certainly sucks and sometimes the angles from the table still won't line up with a view of the multitude of TVs, you gotta love the ambiance here for any sort of big game: Football, Futbol, or basketball. If you watch a home game and the bears win, the band will come in and play right after they get out of Haas.

3 stars for being a convenient place to get drunk at 4 pm any day of the week. 

minus 1 star for the clientele: too-old man sitting alone, the frat/sorority crowds, library staff on duty
plus 1 star for a chance graduate student instructor sighting! 

oh yeah and if the bartender offers you pizza that is free from sitting out all day, PASS. you can do better.

Beat the clock is amazing. It's really fun but the lines are so goddamn long. It starts at 4 pm so I suggest getting there early if you don't want to wait outside like a chump! Seriously, you start having reunions at this place or at least I do. Everyone and anyone is here!

The food is pretty typical pub food so you shouldn't expect much. It's not Henry's! Don't order their Hefs. I've always thought they tasted a bit off but just chalked it off to them using a different brand than what I'm used to. A lot of my friends have reported that their pitchers of Hef are half-Hef and half-Coors/Bud Lite (piss). BOOOOOOO BEAR'S LAIR FOR BEING CHEAP! Also, there's no slice of orange, what?!

Ghettoooo but still amazing because it's our campus bar! With the pitchers, stick to an IPA or piss if you'd like! Speaking of ghetto, why are people mentioning the bathrooms here on the reviews? It's a bar! WHAT DO YOU EXPECT?!
One of my first bar experiences at Cal. I like the feel of old, unpretentious bars like Bear's Lair, they also have cheap beer.

I loved going to the Bear's Lair!  Sure I wasn't a student of Cal but what the hell right.  My buddy was part of the engineering grad program and went here as a rule of thumb every Thursday.  It certainly helped that he knew a couple of the bouncers and bartenders.  (Is it redundant to say that most of the female bartenders were good looking?)  We got tanked on more than a few occasions for next to nothing.  The best was when the marching band would come by after a win and play their hearts out for those in the pub.  

And the beers were great!  Luckily they have Jupiter's microbrews on tap.  Red Spot was the beer of choice in our circle.  I love a good Hefe but the line must be a little dirty here cause it never tasted right.  The pizza was serviceable but I was never blown away.  It was probably due to them sitting in the rotating pretzel-case that turned me off.

This is a review for beat the clock:

It's pretttty fun to come hang out with your friends at BTC every Friday! It's packed, yes... but if I were to pick from an empty pub or a packed pub with high energy, I'd pick the latter. 

Don't expect to do anything except eat and pass out after BTC though... trust me.

The Pizza was whack, but the beer I had certainly hit the spot when I was here last month presenting at a conference.

The pizza was very bland and not good at all, I couldn't even finish it, but this place has a good selection of beers for a campus pub. At least based on my experiences with campus pubs.  It was pretty dad when i came in, but I bet on a Friday and during the right hours this place looks like hella good times!

The place should allow people to bring food from outside though, then it would be a better win.

I have many fond memories of the BL.  I'd consider myself a regular at this point since last time the bouncer recognized me and didn't bother to ID.  They've done a lot to class the place up recently, including trivia night on Wednesdays.  It loses 2 stars for a lot of what I used to dislike about it (rude staff, bathrooms that require tetanus shots, slow service).  The bathrooms are still atrocious, but at least the staff has gotten more pleasant.  I'm a little disappointed Beat the Clock is no longer $5 pitchers before 5 (they're $6 now), but I guess Jupiter (they own the BL) got hit by the recession too.  Still, you'd think hard economic times would be a reason for more, better drink specials, not the reverse.

THE GOOD:
-Cheap beer (particularly at Beat the Clock)
-If you go to/went to Cal, you're almost guaranteed to run into someone you know here
-Friendly bartenders
-Good for groups

THE BAD:
-Beer selection isn't that great; they sometime run out of stuff
-Can get unpleasantly crowded (and loud!)

THE UGLY:
-Bathrooms

While the Bear's Lair has its shortcomings, the combination of cheap beer and good memories from undergrad is pretty hard to beat.
Booze on campus with decent service and selection, complete with sticky counters and white castle burgers? You can't really complain.

If there is one thing the East Bay lacks, it's real sports bars. I'm not talking about yuppie, over priced lounges that happen to play sports on the TV. And a cheap bar with one and a half TVs and no sports packages doesn't cut it either. I'm talking about an honest-to-goodness, sports lovin', watch four games at a time, wear your team colors and drink beer all day kinda SPORTS BAR. A "you shouldn't really be here if you're not trying to watch sports" kinda sports bar. The kind you find in abundance in the Midwest but is somehow missing from the general East Bay landscape.

Tha Bear's Lair calls itself a "Brew Pub." Maybe to attract the more artsy, non-sports loving Berkeley set. I don't know. Fact of the matter - this place is a SPORTS BAR proper...and thank God for it. If not for this lone oasis of sports in this otherwise parched landscape, I'd miss every interesting football game being played on Sundays (I just can't watch the Raiders and 49ers week after week - I'm sorry, I need to see REAL pro football being played). And I can see my alma mater on Saturdays, too - GO BLUE! Flat screens lining the walls, full sports packages, good beer and good food at a reasonable price!

So, thanks a million, billion Bear's Lair. You've got Sports Bar down pretty pat. While Berkeley fans are a bit weak in their "fan"aticism (in my humble opinion),  I am more than happy to show up for the games of MY chosen teams and show you how true fans watch sports. I am more than happy to show up as soon as the doors open, park my ass at the bar, and watch sports ALL DAY LONG with a never ending mug of beer in hand! 

Thanks so much for providing a place where I can do it!

I'll see you there, darlings (and my mood will depend on how my teams are doing)!

During my senior year of college, my best friends and I helped launch this joint.  We re-opened the Bear's Lair w/ the most awesome tagline ever: GO BEER!!!  We did our rounds of making stops at every frat house to pass out invitations.  If you're in the mood of drinking beer from a gallon beer mug, then Bears Lair is Your Lair.  My fav beer here was always the Hef or Porter. Food here is plenty awesome too.  Seeing this place totally happening now brings joy to my tears (sniff, sniff).
Come beat the clock.  You'll see what its about, and I'm gonna leave it at that.  Friday, 4PM.

BTC still kickin'!  Good to see great traditions haven't all died out.  Big fan of the outdoor seating.  Usually only go after baseball games... just too hectic on football days.  Still when I was a student, I killed lots of time and brain cells here.  Always will have fond memories past and hopefully future.

I wish they had a bar like this on campus at Udub when I was in school, though if we did I am sure the bathroom situation would be much better and the nachos and hot dog ( DO NOT order food from the outside grill) would be edible.  Their B-mary's were good and it was a great vibe even after the Huskies got crushed, not sure they could even tackle the Charlie Brown x-mas tree at this point , thank goodness the season is over. Looking forward to 2009, a new coach and our QB's shoulder healing. Cheers to that!

I've had good and bad experiences at Bear's Lair.

Bad: About a month ago, they closed one of the sliding glass windows midway through my stay and I smacked my head into it. It was very funny, but very embarrassing!
Good: I asked for the window discount, and I got it!

Bad: The bathrooms are the most awful I have ever been in. Worse than the BART in late night. It's really no place for a lady.

Good: The cook put cheese on my pizza when I asked for no cheese, and I got a free pizza! 

Good: BEAT THE CLOCK!
Bad: BEAT THE CLOCK. Oh gosh. 

All in all, when I'm not running into windows, and when I don't have to pee, I like this place.

I love the Bear's Lair, I believe a lot of that has to do with spending many college days there. The food is actually pretty bad, but I love the beer, staff and how it feels like a dive bar that doesn't exist on a college campus. 

I usually get a Guinness or Denogginizer. Careful with the Denogginizer, it'll get you drunk good and quick.

It's the campus pub! How else would a Cal student intend on starting off a Friday? Skunky beer at Beat the Clock... but seriously you get what you pay for (starting from $5/pitcher). And then everyone clears out and goes somewhere else. My roommate and I came every freaking Friday since the beginning of our last college semester. And then once more the night before our early morning commencement. We woke up sorta late, it rained, but we still made it on time. Awesome.

Great student bar, but make sure you have cash and are ready to order.  It's super annoying though when stanford ppl decide to hang out there....it's not like I hang out at the Stanford student bar when I go to a game down there.
Biggest downside about the bar....the bathrooms are absolutely disgusting.

Way back when, my friends and I used to play Trivial Pursuit in our freshman dorm lounge. Now that we're old enough to play grown-up trivia, we head to Bear's Lair on Wednesday nights for their weekly 2 hour pub quiz. In fact, we've often blown off studying for real tests and quizzes in favor of trivia night. Maybe I'm a nerd, but I think it's THAT fun. It gets pretty crowded so other people must agree. The snarky quizmaster will provide you with an eclectic mix of questions, testing your knowledge from Charlie Sheen to Charles Lindbergh. You're bound to know something. And hey, let's not forget about the prizes. First place gets a $30 credit to Bear's Lair. My primarily-male team and I have been eyeing the "GO BEERS" bootie shorts for weeks.

Came here for beat the clock, the place was already packed by 4. $7 pitcher of Hefe, no lemon or orange. Cheap. It's not the best beer I have had, but I was there just to try BTC. 

It's a college bar, so don't wear your flipflops or open-toed shoes. There was some guy who yacked next to the bar and ran, beer cups falling, pitchers stacked on the side. Yeah, it's a college bar.

BTC/beat the clock:
I dont see what the big deal is. Maybe it's because I dont really like beer or maybe I'm not used to drinking when there is still light outside. But the things I do for my friends on their 21st birthdays. 

Speaking of birthdays, she got a free pitcher AND pint. Holla. Maybe that is what she did [holla-ed] at the bartender because apparently its normally only the pint that is free for your birthday. 

$7 a pitcher....I guess. I heard it used to be $4 back then. Boo for inflation. 

My friend came early to get a table for us outside which was a good idea because it got really packed inside. People are nice, at least the people that ended up sitting next to us. Its a nice place to see familiar faces and get your 4pm buzz on then head over somewhere to get your drunk munchies on. 

We got 3 pitchers of Budlight and 2 pitchers of Heff. Some of my friends thought Heff was better but I thought it had a weirder aftertaste. Again, I am not much of a beer drinker so I dont know what is considered "better" beer. 

Bathrooms are pretty dirty and the lines are long so I suggest running over to Nia Lounge to use their clean bathrooms.

3 stars for the bar
+1 star for the wings and fries

Cons- not enough seating, especially during a game or beat the clock. I've actually never been to a real beat the clock since it's always so crowded. Beers are an ok price. The bathrooms are disgusting. I get that it's a bar, but come on! 

Pros- Great food. I love wings and consider these the best in Berkeley. The cajun style fries are great too. BTC is a great college tradition. It's a BAR on campus. That's just cool.

As a grad student, I didn't think it would be very fun to go to a place that looked like such a college bar but I was pleasantly surprised when we had a law school bar review there on a Thursday night.  

The open space outside made for a refreshing change compared to some of the other bars in Berkeley that can get extremely crowded at night.  The prices were also great!  Glass of wine for $4 and a pitcher of beer for $8!

I was going to give it two stars, but I added an extra star because it's pub on campus. 

A pub. On Campus. 

That's the only thing it has going for itself.

Beat the Clock is every Friday. Nothing beats running into friends and sharing cheap beer = memories :)

Go Bears!

P.S. I would not use the restroom here. Try the bathrooms in the Pauley Ballroom/MLK Room.

Not to shabby for a College bar in campus. My buddy and I came decided to spontaneously journey last minute to UC Berkeley last Friday because Daedelus was playing a free show on campus. We decided to go to this pub to grab a drink and that we could still see and hear Daedelus play from this pub. 

This pub had plenty of space to sit and dance. They have pinic table outside. Stools and tables inside and the dance floor is in the back which they had a dj playing electro music that night but no one was dancing. LOL! They have tv's to watch anything that has to do with sports. The bar area was was decently big enough to try to accommodate  everyone.

One con was that line for the bathroom for long and they have 2 unisex bathrooms which looked raunchy.

We didn't stay here that long but all I can say is this is a cool campus bar but the I would probably go else where because of the weak drinks they serve.

BEAT THE CLOCK (every Friday at 4pm) is where its at, its so fucking crowded though so you better come here early to get a seat.  The pitchers start at 5 bucks and they go up a dollar every hour.

The service gets pretty fucking bad, you get ignored a lot sometimes and sometimes you don't, but for 5 bucks for a fucking pitcher of hef it's pretty worth it.  

What sucks is that you get shit faced by 630 and the sun is still up and you're too tired to do shit the rest of the day.  But if you got the drunk munchies like I do order the food they have here or walk up the street to Desi Dog for some bomb and cheap ass hotdog/sausages.

I'm totally biased because this was my old college hangout and in retrospect, it was kind of dirty and cold, but it had personality and evoked happy feelings.  Or maybe it was the beer.  But those were good days when i took a break from studying @#$% fluid dynamics to come and drink with my irresponsible associates.

i sort of tend to become a fixture at the bear's lair during any major soccer tournament (the world cup, the euro cup, etc...).  i love that show just about every match, and the location used to be really convenient for me.  i love that so many uc berkeley students, faculty, and staff (many of them from whichever country's team happens to be playing) come out to the bear's lair to watch the matches too.  it's always fun.

a lot of the food is ok here (the seasoned fries are really good), but a lot of it is bland or VERY greasy.  the drinks are cheap, though, so i can't complain about that (and believe me, i was needing multiple drinks during the most recent france/italy match!).  the biggest drawback, and the reason the bear's lair is not a four, is the employees.  they are often rude, and even when the lair isn't that busy, it's next to impossible to get them to take your order.  i avoid this place on thursday and friday nights, and all day saturday.  way too busy, and way too slow!

Originally gave it 4 stars, but gave it a 5th just because it's Cal. GO BEARS!

This is an AWESOME place to hang out, especially on Fridays with their beer specials. $5 for a pitcher is a STEAL! Price increases $1 an hour until 8pm to it's normal price of $8 I think...unless they changed.

Food is okay I guess, but it's all about the beer, hanging out with friends and watching sports. Big enough for any crowd. Meet college kids. Good times. Would go every single Friday if I could.

Beat the Clock:

- Cheap beer
- Super packed
- Lines may be long after 4pm
- Loud and impossible to have conversations
- Food takes forever to arrive (like 30mins later AT LEAST)
- I don't even want to know what the bathroom looks like

but as bad as some of these may sound, it's actually pretty darn popular and great for a laid-back Friday with a group of friends.

Great Bar. A real staple of the Berkeley college social scene. I always have fun here. It's got a nice social vibe, very unpretentious and fun. It's a place that every Berkeley student should go to at least once. The bar's on campus and it's been here for a long time. It's really a part of the campus culture and many Cal students have had some of the best times they'll never remember right here.

If only they had hard Alcohol... they'd be a five star.

C'mon, a pub ON CAMPUS? That is practically unheard of. Last semester, I came so much that the bouncers stopped bothering to check my I.D. Not something to be proud of, but this semester, I have only been here about three times max (it's been a hectic semester). But coming here is always fun--especially beat the clock on Fridays! The first weeks and last weeks of school, this place gets so jammed pack and the line so long it is ridiculous. Best thing to do is come here, get a stamp, then go home or do whatever you need to do and come back so you don't need to wait in that long line. The place is just really chill overall, and their fries are good! 

At night, I played beer pong here once. That was fun, except for the fact that when the ball didn't land and rolled onto the ground, yeah ugh you get the point.

First of all, it's pretty rad to have this kind of a bar right on Berkeley's campus. We ventured here right after the CU/Cal game on Saturday (in which CU got STOMPED) so we were all in our Colorado gear. My first instinct was to run.... why did we want to go to a Bear's bar in CU gear after getting stomped?? Surprisingly enough, no one said a word. In fact, everyone was super nice!

The patio is definitely the best part of this bar -- the inside is a bit awkward as the bar is in the middle. Then again, it could have just been awkward because it was totally packed with college kids. 

The patio serves beer and some food as well which is very convenient. The best part? There's an entrance and exit in the front and the back so you don't have to walk all the way through the crowded bar to get in/out.

Fun times!

Cheap beer from Jupiter (the porter's especially good, and at $3/pint or so you can't go wrong) and a quite nice Italian sausage sub make this a good place to hang out after class and watch sports or hang out on the patio and watch all the hot students go by. Not a place to go if you have a tendency to feel old, however -- this is definitely a place for students. Grad students, some of them, but still students.

A loud and trashy crowd of bros and hos in a shitty pub that smells like stale beer and piss. Now don't get me wrong, I like a good old fashioned shady pub from time to time, and I love the idea of getting drunk on the Berkeley campus.

But.

If you go here on a weekend, be prepared to battle obnoxious drunk frat boys and their oh so classily clad female counterparts to get a drink in. Beat the Clock is a fun idea, but in reality turns into a surging crowd of drunk people I really don't want to have to run up against on my way to the hour-long wait for the most disgusting bathrooms in Berkeley (no, but really).

Now maybe you can say I'm bitter because I can't drink beer and they often run out of cider, thus forcing me to drink their shitty and overpriced wine...and admittedly, I had some good times in college with my Wednesday Night Drinking Club playing Drunken Jenga here, but it's purely DESPITE the setting, I assure you. 

Ugh, I hate this place. I would have given it one star, but now that I've graduated I'm all nostalgic and BS, and so I feel generous.

What's not to love? This is the campus bar that plays all the televised Cal games and serves great beers at great prices. I don't know of a student who has been to the Bear's Lair and didn't love it.

Beat the Clock is a tradition at Berkeley that's almost as vital to its roots as free speech - okay maybe not THAT vital but it's pretty damn entertaining. You have to love an hour during which every minute you must down a shot of beer. Good times... Go Bears!

This place is a huge part of my college experience. There was a point where my friends and I went to the Bear's Lair every Thursday! If you're here frequently, we're the big group of Filipinos that always played King's Cup near the fireplace. Beer is cheap and only once did it taste bad. One time, the bartender gave us free pizza! Granted it was because they were closing soon and needed to get rid of it, but you know how starving college students are--any food that is free is delicious. So yeah, basically, I love going here with my friends. It's not getting five stars because of the bathrooms. YUCK. Don't even attempt to go in, especially if you're a girl.

the bathroom is disgusting - absolutely horrible and filthy!

beer's good, though
Cheap pints of beer. Nuff said.

Prime people watching, pitchers of beer, and patio seating earns the Bear's Lair an A-OK rating.  There are better places to go that have all of the things I listed above, but not in Berkeley.  So if you're in the area, this is a good place to chill.

Such a fun place to gather before a game. Bartender was extremely friendly and fast, which impressed me since there were about a thousand other people there. The bouncer/bus boy was awesome at keeping smokers and poachers away from our table. I take off one star because our nachos were just eh. But we scarfed them in a buzzy haze. Seats inside with a tv view are prime territory, generations of Bears with their kids and grandkids will gather here, so mind your manners.
On Fridays can get a little busy but the atmosphere it's pretty cool!! Get there early to get a table or spot at the bar

Never coming back here again, the service is horrible, and it is so packed!! The bar attendant who took my order (I believe her name was Constance or something) didn't tell me what was on their beat the clock menu and then later kept the change when I paid...no one should assume you get tip...don't know what the hype is all about when you can get better deals elsewhere. The crowd and the bad service isn't worth it.

I'm not sure what appeal this bar really has to non-Berkeley students or, at least, non-graduates, but this place is incredible. Good brews, good food, and, best of all, on campus, minutes away from class.

There is no bad time to come here. Before or after a football game, Beat The Clock, watching the NBA finals, celebrating a birthday at midnight on a weekday, beer pong, a chill Friday night, or, my personal favourite, in-between classes senior year.

It's sad that post-graduation, these experiences don't happen anymore.

since Berkeley has very limited drinking options me and some friends ended up here. simply put, its a college bar. it serves beer. its expensive. the bartender was a chiller however, and gave my drunk friend her leftover food when his drunk ass requested it.

O.K. this place is pretty chill I guess. I probably went on a dead night because it wasn't cracking too much. It's a pretty cool concept having a pub on campus, but it really isn't like there's another bar about 5 minutes away. Yeah I looked around about how this place received a lot of recognition and wasn't too impressed with environment. Place wasn't too clean especially the bathroom pretty grotty. Pretty funny and disgusting how someone wrote "taking two shits in the sinks is enough". It didn't seem well kept. They had a few T.V.s around for entertainment and for music they had a jukebox. Didn't really eat here but I saw that they served pizza. Overall this place is pretty chill could be better if it was a full bar though and there is this pretty cute girl that works there so yeah its alright.

Not my favorite, but it doesn't stop me from coming here because I can guarantee that I'll run into a bunch of my friends. The setting is collegiate and laid back.

Pros-wings are good, beers are cheap, convenient location 

Cons-BTC gets CROWDED! No seating, long (upwards of 30 minutes sometimes) wait for pitchers. Bathrooms are nasty; just avoid using them. Understaffed, so the employees (mostly students) are horrendously overworked. 

Last week at BTC I felt like they were in the middle of a gladiator rink because they were surrounded by hordes of students holding their arms out and watching their every move. I left because I couldn't wait that long for a drink, but other times the environment just makes it worth it.

Came here on a Wednesday and while this place seems like a really cool place to hang out and drink at, I still really hate beer...so this place holds no value for me. I tried their beer that starts with an H and which is supposed to be drunk with a lime (ugh, bartending knowledge already escaping), but still not my thing. One thing I CAN say for them though, is that they have crazy good "bouncers". I saw my friends outside and was ready to walk in, when some guy dressed in casual clothes and reading (I didn't even SEE HIM!!) stopped me and asked for ID.

This is the on campus pub at UC Berkeley. Many Cal sports fans love watching games here and it is the place to be after and Golden Bears sporting event. There is nothing like hoisting a liter to the Cal drinking song along with the Cal Band.

As far as beer is concerned, they have a great selection of "House Brews" which are really Jupiter brand libations offered under school themed names. Anything from pilsner's to stouts are avaialable. They also offer PBR and Miller Highlife for the economy minded student.

I recommend Pedro's Porter, named after the former chancellor's lost dog who if ever found would mean the end of finals forever. It is full boied, chocolately and malty with a nice little bite. It is all that fills my glass there.

Their food is better than average, brick oven pizzas and pub fare.

I always go back there, but it is probably because of the memories, not the beer.

I thought I would be over this place once I graduated, but it turns out it's actually full of alumni, even on Friday afternoons (apparently graduating from Berkeley does not guarantee employment).  Always a good time, as long as you don't mind the crowds and getting hit on by freshmen with fake IDs.  A tip for you freshmen without fake IDs- if you get there early enough in the afternoon, they only check ID when you order a drink, not at the door.  So grab your bestest 21+ buddy and share a glass!  If you get kicked out you can always just walk right back in.
Beat the clock should be required attendance for seniors.

Pro's:  Jupiter Hefeweizen, the super hot "mean" bouncer and the freshly made pizza.

Con's:  the DISGUSTING bathrooms.

Roll On You Bears!

Classic college bar and a must stop before a Cal game. I was recently here before the Cal-Tennessee game and it was a blast. Great atmosphere, fun people, and fast service. (As fast as it can be with every college student packed in)

The Lair has screens set up throughout the bar so you can keep track of multiple games and the seating is arranged compactly around the bar. No hard alcohol here, but you can't go wrong with pizza and beer.

Fun place to go to relive those college days. Just an overall great atmosphere.

Beat the Clock!!!  I don't really think there is anything special about Bear's Lair for non-students...in fact, it's probably an annoying place to be.  But for Cal students & alum, Bear's Lair is theeee best.

The lunch specials are super affordable, so coming here during the day for pizza & beer is always a nice break from class.  Bear's Lair is also my favorite bar to watch games at.  But let's get to Fridays...4pm...BTC.  Even on a rainy day, it's packed (even better when the sun comes out...but that's once in a blue moon).  Unless it's midterms season, you really have to get there early to get a table (especially outside).  Sit down, order a $6 pitcher of beer & seasoned fries with ranch...drink more...go pee in MLK or Eshleman...drink more...go eat dinner at Asian ghetto...go home & pass out, hungover at 8pm.  This is the life for seniors at Cal.  GO BEERS :)

beat the clock! 

the beer doesnt exactly taste good, ok it taste like shit, but i doubt you'll know the difference after a couple of pitchers

a UC Berkeley tradition one must experience at least once during their times here

This used to be a fine place to watch football. Now it is hell. An assault on all the senses, plus an affront to the dignity of the customer. How is the bear's lair offensive? Let me count the ways:
One is for the visual dissonance of a thousand tv screens, corporate wing shop logos, the hair-gelled frat boys and open-mouth-chewing senior alums whose skeaziness the eye cannot miss.
Two is for the flimsy feel of a plastic cup, the stickiness of the bar, the slick of the previous customer's grease.
Three is for the taste of a nice beer, tainted by its plastic vessel; the tongue's unmet longing for something worthy of eating.
Four is for the officials' rulings, drowning in techno music from the kitchen and the ostentatious cheers of the hair gel set.
Five is for the aroma of vomit, ranch dressing, and axe body spray with undertones of cigarette smoke and body odor.
Six is for the careless servers, the last resort ambiance, and the frequent visits by campus police.
Too bad they "redevloped" this place. It was a s***hole worth visiting before and now it's just a s***hole.

I don't think I've ever had a college bar experience, until I had to pee so desperately that I pissed shoulder to shoulder with a drunken dude in a dank, one person bathroom--he was doing his business in the sink.

Beat da clock cant beat this deal. This place was featured in Sports Illustrated. Great place to hang out before any CAL game (football or Basketball). It can get a little crowded. 

The 2 gallon club is tuff. 8 quarts

Likes: seeing friends and having a place to hang out on campus

Dislikes: bartender was a jerk when I was trying to order beer, place gets too crowded, hate it when beer gets sloshed on me, bathroom lines, etc...

Bears Lair is the place to go in Berkeley if you want to experience college at its best! It's not the cleanest place, but there's nothing better than smart (or dumb) drunk people having a good time. Those of you who hate on this place, go to beat the clock on Friday's and you will grow to appreciate it!

Come on folks.  Bear's Lair isn't that great.  

Yes, it is a bar on campus, which is super cool.  Yes, the patio is fun.  And yes, beat the clock is sweet.  But, the beer selection sucks (lots of choices does not equal good choices), service can me horribly slow, bathrooms are disgusting and the food is just OK.  

With so many other choices nearby, Bear's Lair is usually not  a good option.  Manny's Tap Room (fka Raleighs), Jupiter, Triple Rock and Beckett's are all much, much better options and are all walking distance from campus.  Blakes, Thallasa, Henry's and Looney's also are all nearby.

This is Berkeley folks...  you are surrounded by hundreds of places with great food and beer.... demand more from this mediocre pub!  Don't just accept what they give you because it is on campus!

I went here once a long time ago.
I guess the only bad thing is that it can get really crowded at busy times.

I remember the prices being fair and service wasn't too bad to get.
You probably already know about Beat The Clock.

Anyway, good times have occurred here.

I'd like to think of this place as your typical college pub.  It's close by (how can you be any closer than ON CAMPUS?).  It has a big screen tv to show the games (although the tv is the old school projection tv that you can see too well with)  And a trophy from the school's glory.  (GOAL POST!!~)  Bear's Lair thrives on their location, their dedication to the school, and their gallon pitchers!  Yes I said it.  Gallon pitchers for $18!!~  Enough to go around the table without breaking bank.  And impressive to look at too!  But in a town where you have places like Triple Rock, Jupiter, and Bison Brew, Bear's Lair is a good hangout place to sit around with your friends, but where you would go for good beer.

Go BEER!
First time went here with co-workers because they are all graduated from Cal. Very nice friendly bartender. I had so much fun.

Ok so here's the insider scoop on the BLP from a bartender that works there....

I always here complaints from people about this place being a shithole (ex. always out of budlight, run out of lemons for the hefe, the bathrooms are despicable, doorguys are assholes, etc.), yet this place has some of the most loyal customers ever! It's the damn Bear's Lair, what do you expect from this place people? You have to give the place credit and not expect it to be something it's not. 

That being said here's why people love this place (and you will too after you appreciate the charm of a marble-top college pub)
-cheap beer: isn't that what you college kids want anyways? and by the way stop slaughtering "hefeweizen" - it's not hef-E, hefenwiser, hefenwisen - it's HEFE, say it right, cause it's bugging the crap outta me!
-delicious pizza: not the stuff that's been rotating for hours, that can be potent (but if you come around midnight we give it out for free, but you have to beat out the bums for it), splurge a little and order a specialty pizza
-decent music after 10pm: once we shut the jukebox off and we don't have to hear "living on a prayer" for the tenth time that night, workers throw on some great mix cds to get people moving (and you know how frisky those easy college girls get when some JT comes on)
-horny people: don't act like you didn't get all dressed up to not get hit on/pick up people! you can always find drunk people here that will pay you compliments and probably even take you home (don't mind me staring, this shit cracks me up)
-games: now i've never been one to need a reason to drink, but for those athletes out there you can always come in and find a game of beer pong, quarters, or foosball to join in
-tvs that are better than yours: you have to come in here and watch at least one great sports game, granted we only have the sound on for football games, it's a fun place to get into a game
-patio: on a great day in berkeley you just can't beat sitting out on the patio bullshitting and drinking with friends 
-hot bartenders/doorguys: now, i don't wanna toot my own horn here (it's so past that, i know) but i have to give credit to my boss for hiring a great looking bunch. it's like baskin-robbins, no one is alike and you're bound to find a flavor you like here! oh, and if you're lucky it might be one of those nights when we get hammered and dance on the bar! and for all you ladies, there's always a hot looking guy standing out at the door. granted, they seem a little hard at first, but that's hot, i'm turned on! how many guys have you dated that can take someone to the ground in 2 seconds? ps the lead door guy is hot!

So stop studying, gather up some friends, and come in! And don't forget to tip me well for this insider scoop!

So where do you go, when you're feigning to drink before a boring, 2 hour UC Berkeley Graduation!? YOU GO THE THE BEAR'S LAIR BREW PUB! This place saved my life! I got so plastered here before my friend's graduation, good thing though... or else that graduation ceremony would've been dreadful! CONGRATS TO ALL THE UCB Graduates! 

The prices are right here as well. $11 a pitcher! You can't find those prices anywhere else. I'll be back for beat the clock!

pros:

+beat the clock is that place you've seen everyone you've ever known in college.
+ fist pumping and stankyleg crunk dancing are occasional sights
+BEST DEAL ON BEST BEER of any place around. (Beat the Clock)
+sometimes they have really good bands (like Passion Pit)

cons:
-its that place you've seen everyone you've ever known in college (refer to the first pro).

-sometimes the bands that play suck (like that crappy asian band that had a pompador hair do and were hipster-rific)..

-the line can be a wait sometimes, (especially after finals week of 2nd semester).


All in all: a GREAT college bar. :)  Would have given it a 5 if their french fries didnt disappoint....

I LOVE BEAR'S LAIR! 

1. BEAT THE CLOCK. friday starting 5pm- BE THERE! no need to explain what it is... you just GOOOOO
2. feel like drinking in the middle of the day when class gets out early or you just feel like drinking in the middle of the day? BEAR'S LAIR
3. CHEESE FRIES are TDF (to die for)!!

It gets pretty packed on Fridays, weekends, and game days but that's the best part! On game days/nights, the Cal band could randomly come in and play us a few tunes. GO BEARS!

Bear's Lair used to be a pretty good place, but now? Not so much.

It was never very clean on my previous visits, but they had good beer, friendly servers and decent food. Then I went one Thursday in November (2011). 

The place was pretty empty, and I grabbed a seat at the bar. While I waited and waited for the bartender, I checked out the menu. Apparently, Bear's Lair no longer offers food, only wings. WINGS. Big wings, little wings, wings, wings, wings. Apparently some chain has moved into the kitchen area. They should really get that looked at, or it will spread.

After a few minutes sitting at the virtually empty bar, the bartender remembered to notice me and came over. I wasn't familiar with everything they offered on tap, so I asked for his recommendation.

Me: "Do you have something brown and malty?"
Him: "How about this IPA?"
Me: "???"
Him: "Or, uh, Bud?"
Me: "???"

I left and went to Raleigh's, enjoyed a Newcastle on tap and a delicious barbeque chicken sandwich, and tried to put this traumatic experience behind me. The very next day, Raleigh's BURNED TO THE GROUND. Coincidence? You be the judge.

After being a Cal student for 3 years and wondering what why the hell Bear's Lair is so packed on Friday evenings, I have finally discovered it. Accompanied with this discovery is the loss of my Beat the Clock virginity, which was taken from me tonight. 

Basic rules for a pitcher of beer:
4:00 - 4:59: $6
5:00 - 5:59: $7
6:00 - 6:59: $8
... 
and so on!

The lines can get pretty long from 5-6, so be aware of that and just come early if you have the chance. I just spent half an hour in line, but that's what I get for coming late. 

Bear's Lair is a perfect way to relieve the stress of a long grueling week. Drink, chill, and surround yourself with awesome people who love beer just as much as you do!

Ok I understand this is really cool for the college kids but I would expect more from anything on the Berkeley campus.  The floor was ridiculously dirty and sticky.  The bathroom was horrendous that two of my girl friends wouldn't even pee in there.  I had to wait 5 minutes to get a beer even though no one else around the bar needed anything and the girl bartender was free - but she was too busy flirting with the only guy bartender and she didn't not care how long she stood there flirting with him while he poured beer into a pitcher, despite the paying customer waiting.  When I finally got my beer and joined my friends, I took a sip of my hefeweizen and almost gagged.  It was the worst beer I had ever tasted. Thankfully I was so annoyed by this point that my friend took the drink back to the bar and got me a better tasting one (even the guy bartender admitted it was horrible)

Thanks but I doubt I'll be coming back.  There are just too many good places in Berkeley to even bother with this place.

Last Friday, we beat that clock. We beat it good! And then that clock beat me...

Believe it or not, last Friday was my first ever Beat the Clock, the Bear's Lair tradition of $6 pitchers from 4-5, $7 pitchers from 5-6, etc. We got there at 3:45  to asure we got a table and then started drinking.

In general, I've never been a fan of Bear's Lair because it is a standard college bar, but that's what we wanted that evening. It's alway crowded, the bathrooms are always disgusting, the food is decent and the beer is plentiful with a selection of all Jupiter beers. And yet, that's exactly what we wanted that evening. We wanted a loud crowded bar full of people who wanted to get drunk like us!

We were there until 6:30, and which point we left for dinner. I alternated between glasses of the Red Ale and the Jupiter Hef with the justification that "Hef is so light that it's like drinking water. If I alternate, I'll be practically sober!"

Yeah, that was actually my justification. It didn't work out so well.

But we still beat that clock.

It's embarrassing to admit but I've been to the Bear's Lair more times this football season than I did my entire four years at Cal. That's possibly because I have more disposable income to waste on things like pints of Apricot ale or Guinness for me and my posse. Or that I'm now a way bigger drunky. Or that I now roll with other alcoholics. Or it might simply be that I'm merely catching up on all the stuff I missed out when I was busy studying at the Moffitt, conducting myriads of surveys for my thesis, or giving head to my TAs...

But yes, the Bear's Lair on football day is great. True, they are always running out of things on tap, their bathrooms are pretty gnarly, and I haven't quite figured out their pricing structure. But that's the price you pay to celebrate with Cal students and alumni on another scintillating victory. For the most part, the bartenders are quick and some even have nice bewbies. Hang out long enough after the game and the band will stop by to perform the California Drinking Song for you. By that time, I am usually too drunk to sing along. But I'm still sober enough to grope you. Seriously.

GO BEARS!

So, whatever, I am way too old to be kicking back pints here but I don't care.  Good deals and some stupid/smart people to sneer at.  Try the Jupiter Quasar beer, it is super tasty and is also the stongest beer they've got.

Let's say that The Bear's Lair circa 1989-1990 was pretty cool.   I actually found ways to use my incredibly cheesy fake ID here and used to come drink beers with the bums hanging about instead of going to my math 50A lecture...   Hmmm... maybe that's why they kicked my sorry ass out of school?

what the? this place is a shithole! i did my damndest to avoid it while at berkeley (granted, i was a little older, and not a fratboy), and the couple of times i did get dragged there by my horny little irish housemate trying to score some (supposedly) easy undergrad poontang, i spent the entire night playing table football (or "fussball") with some kind of latino hobo midget who reeked of weeks-old sweat and rolling tobacco. and then watched the little irish imp crash and burn badly, and had to listen to his post-prowl drunken slurring about how he was "this close to closing the deal" with an eighteen year-old twice his height.

I came in here Friday night before the Daft Punk show (before I realized that sneaking booze into the Greek would have been like slapping a baby when no one is looking. not that i ever would) to enjoy a few pitchers of beer in the early evening sun. Not that I would ever disagree with any of Albie's equations or mathmetical theorems, but when I purchased a pitcher of beer from 5-6pm, said pitcher of beer was actually $6 until 6pm hits wherein it changed to $7. 

I was treated to a little time-warp back into my college days when the boys at the next table started yelling "Chug! Chug! Chug!" I almost downed my pint of beer in a pavlovian reflex.
Best place to relax and have a beer in Berkeley and the staff has always been awesome to me and my friends!

An awesome campus pub. Back when I thought hefeweizen was the best brand of beer, slightly edging out Coors Light, the Bear's Lair served up pitcher after pitcher of unfiltered wheaty goodness.

Prices were cheap, the crowd was chill, and the outdoor area always gave me a good excuse to down a pre-class pitcher (if there is beer, you drink). 

Half the time, I didn't even make it to class. Especially if class was in one of the smaller rooms in Dwinelle. Fellow Bears know what I'm talking about.

Beat the Clock Fridays: Starting at 4 p.m., you can get a pitcher for $7 and the price goes up by a dollar every hour.

Tip: Go with a group of friends and stake out a table as early as 3 or 3:30 so you don't have to stand. Super fun if you're into the whole rowdy college crowd thing once in a while.

I saw Green Day perform here once.  That night my friend slipped LSD into my other friend's drink and he had a horrible trip.  Poor guy, we had to babysit.  

Anyways, The Bear's Lair is a great place to have a drink.  Right on the campus.  Have a drink with the college kids.  Ilove this place!

You know I have a really good story about getting the shit kicked out of me by the bouncer here, but you'll have to ask me in person about it.  Anyway, those days have passed.

Besides my trachea almost collapsing, I usually have a good time at the Hairy Bear.  Recommended.

I am a bit nostalgic for the Bear's Lair due to the occasional buzzes in class and the few presentations I gave after spending an hour or so there.  (Those were some of the best presentations I have ever given, by-the-way.)  It's also a great place to go in the afternoon with some classmates to discuss recent lectures or readings while drinking a few beers.  During rainy days, I recommend sitting by the fire, drinking a few beers, and eating a piece of pizza.  Fantastic.

-However-

During the evening the Lair is an entirely different beast.  The place can get packed and the music from the jukebox can get painfully loud.  I learned about the bathrooms located in the Student Union out of necessity because, while I support unisex bathrooms, these get disgusting.  I mean flies buzzing around you, pee all over the floor and toilet, hasn't been cleaned after last night disgusting.  If you drink another beer quickly after exiting the bathroom you can cut down on the trauma.

If you are a people watcher, you should check out the Bear's Lair at least one time during the night.  The variety is quite fun (sometimes obnoxious) and it's interesting to watch cliques manifest themselves in college.

Renovation! Love bear's lair for happy hour. Friday is full of students and they also have a pretty cool DJ table. Never been here on weekdays, so this review is just for Friday BTC. Only minimal downside is that if you come after 4PM, all the seats are taken

I need just  look up at the Goal Post that thousands of Cal fans (myself included) tore down, carried away and signed when we snapped our loosing streak to finally win the BIG GAME back in 2002.. and then I know I'm home!

Although I prefer hard liquor to beer, it's hard to beat the cheap pitchers, vibrant student (and alumni) presence, and visits from the straw hat band after games of any sort are won. 

Go to Bear's Lair and Go Bears!

First time at Bear's Lair: I was a senior.  Came with a friend to visit visiting friends of hers.  Crowd was mostly rowdy, pitcher-chugging bros who had split beer all over every table and bench before we got there, so there was nowhere to sit unless you were already drunk, soaked in beer, and didn't give a shit.  Shitty people, shitty atmosphere (gets gross and sticky really quick...), never really wanted to come back.

Second time at Bear's Lair: I was a super-senior.  Beat the Clock.  Drank wayyyyy too much.  Hipsteriest band I've ever seen (asymmetrically haircutted, grunged-up Nick Cave rejects dressed in thrift-store plaid blasting garage-y covers of Velvet Underground songs WAY TOO LOUD in the corner) as entertainment.  Still the same pitcher-chugging bros all over the place, but I didn't mind as much because this time I got drunk hecka early so I was the one doing the spilling all over the tables and benches. (I've stickified my table - how do you like me now, seat-robbers!  Chyeah.) Had an okay experience but left thinking I didn't really need to come back again.

Bottom line: I can only imagine myself enjoying this place if I was a freshman (which, I could never get in here that young anyway) or new to the bar scene.  Maybe I just hate the whole bar scene thing (which I DO - IT SUCKS), or I'm too old for a place like this, but this is a college bar through and through - in other words, it has its place, but it's a scene and an establishment that you'll end up outgrowing sooner or later.

"What did you say?"

Yeah, that's right.  If I had a dime for every time I've said that while in there.

It gets super loud esp. during Cal Football games.  Sitting in here gives you that feeling that you're actually inside Memorial Stadium watching an actual game.  Great college vibe, great atmosphere.  I love professional sports but watching the college game can be intoxicating.  The bartenders are quite friendly in that they let me watch a few Champions League games there.  Great beer, good fun.

something about ol' california that conjures up feelings of nostalgia.

actually, that "feeling" was just me wanting to piss after one-too-many beers from bear's lair.

not many colleges can proudly say they have their own bar on campus; this being one of the few. beer selection is decent but keep your expectations low (like your BAC or more appropriately, your GPA) since they only serve a handful (keep in mind they serve only beer & wine).

a great place i'll have to visit once i'm in the area again. and if you are wondering about that nostalgic feeling i had, i think that feeling left its mark somewhere in a bush near haas pavilion.

Always a good time at Bear's Lair when people are there. If you go to bear's lair on an off night, then be prepared for a pretty boring time unless you go there with enough people to entertain yourself. 

BEAT THE CLOCK FRIDAYS are absolutely a must for anyone in the area but be sure to get there early to get a table! At 4 o' clock $5 pitchers, at 5 o' clock $6 pitchers, at 6 o' clock $7 pitchers...you get the picture. You basically drink as much as you can before the hour changes and the pitchers get more expensive ha. It truly brings all Cal students together and you can't go to one of these days without seeing at least a couple people you know.

Otherwise sometimes they have beer pong out and other times people will just gather and drink, and it is also a great place to watch sports. oh and p.s. how awesome is it that Berkeley has a bar on its campus??? yes, bear's lair is in the student union ha

I LOVE BEAR'S LAIR!!!!!
BEAT THE CLOCK!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! 
at 4 pm there are 6 dollar pitchers- and my friends and i try to cRAM as much beer into our systems as we can because we MUST BEAT THE CLOCK!!!! HAHAHA!! 

i always get the jupiter's hef with EXTRA LEMONS!!!! YUM

its great to be at a CAMPUS pub because there will always be students there.  REAL STUDENTS. when you go out somewhere else in the city, you meet all sorts of weirdos and people who say they are student but are not.  SHADY.  either way, this place is safe, awesome, and LOADS OF FUN.  and when they crank up the music, the place is BUMPIN'!! 

the bartenders are what tops off this place- they are so friendly and they REMEMBER you! 

I've never had a bad time at beat the clock. ever.  I WILL MISS IT!!!! 

overall, CHEAP price, great bartenders, great vibe, safe, and very COLLEGE-y! LOVES IT!

I stopped in here with a couple friends before my first ever Cal Football game last Saturday. As far as I can tell, this is the place to be before the game. Everyone was decked out in their blue and gold and the college kids there were appropriately trashed.

The prices seemed reasonable too. I paid $19.50 for three GIGANTIC cups of beer (before tip). The service was quick and we had a nice time sitting on the picnic tables outside. We even ended up ordering a huge basket of fries that only cost $4 and made all three of us full. Good times!

Oh Bear's Lair. What would college have been like without your existence?

The only bar ON campus. This place is jam packed with college students during happy hours and game days.

What kind of happy hour? Beat the Clock! Well, back in my days, every Friday from 4-5pm is $5 pitchers of beer on tap. 5-6pm is $6 and so on. The best deal in town for the poor college students.

The food are not to die for but much better than a lot of other bar foods out there. Pizza and Fries are the recommendations here.

Game days? No deals, but plenty of big screen TVs to watch all your games, especially CAL! Maybe not this season but next season!

Pretty much a guaranteed good time during happy hours and game days. A college experience must.

zOMG!!! BEAT THE CLOCK BEAT THE CLOCK!!  

Beat the Clock (BTC) is THE only central college hangout event in Berkeley where one can reliably meet up with old friends and have a great time boozing it up!   It's implicitly understood that everyone will be present at BTC, even if one drinks or not.  Students rearrange their class schedules to make sure they get there in time.  Newly turned 21-ers await their first rite of passage experience.  A definite must-go!

** DRINKS
Beat the Clock starts at 4pm every Friday.  Select pitchers start at ~$6 and increase $1/hour.  My usual drink of choice is the Hefe because I was indoctrinated with it my first time there.  I've started liking the Porter also.

**AMBIANCE
Great college sports bar vibe.  Jukebox in the back, TVs all around inside playing various sports games.  Half of the property is indoors, half outdoors.  The bar is inside in the center with limited table seating along the perimeter.  Plenty of seating outside.  During BTC, it gets really busy inside so come early to get seats outside.  If it is raining like it usually is in Berkeley, they put up a large tent outside so no worries about getting wet.

As a conservative (personality-wise, not politically) student at Cal, I didn't do much partying. I was too busy being "good". 

I have been working on my crazy skills ever since I've graduated (hey, I'm a little slow on such). Therefore, the 2008 Big Game was the first time I went drinking at the Bear's Lair. It was a fun time, if a little packed. Luckily we got pretty good seats right in front of a TV. It was also ridiculously hot for Big Game time so we were frying in the sun a bit.

The food was edible and the huge cups of beer were great, since it was so busy, it was better to have big cups so you could go longer without ordering. I got well tipsy, maybe even drunk.

The Bear's Lair - a great place for Big Game fun. :)

It was a Harold and Kumar weekend with my son. He asked the significance of White Castle Burgers. First, I described these tender little gems, with savory tiny sweet onions, and the soft gluten buns, perfectly rolled into square. I shared with him that, unfortunately, these delicacies can only be found on the East Coast (though I do know the one in Georgetown on Wisconsin is gone).
I stopped by my office and low and behold, I read a sign at The Lair (to use locals), White Castle Burgers! I went to the bar and found White Castles come in 1/2 doz and the full 12 pack.  I ordered six of them up from a friendly and  cute Asian sister, who was kind enough to pack them to go!
I hurried down the the Cal Sailing Club, with the aroma of White Castles over taking my Whip! I tried to resist breaking open my kid's present, at the corner of University and Shattuck (I didn't make it very far), I stole one.
Yum. Broke the mouth!
I finally get the five remaining burgers to my kid, who promptly knocked them down and a grape Arizona Ice Tea. I was excited for him and pleased I was able to share this legacy with him.  He told me they were OK.
What? OK? Yeah, just OK. He shared with me his confusion with Harold and Kumar and the obsession for the White Castle road trip.
A ah ha moment.
Now, we began a discussion of 420 and the underlying reasons for the manic addiction to White Castles Burgers. He's a Berkeley kid!
He gets it and said he'd rather go to The Smokehouse.
Four Stars for The Lair, allowing my to revisit White Castle and share with legacy with my son.

Food is a good price, bordering cheap. The pitchers could be a little bigger. They give you plastic cups on game day. Whatever you do, if  you plan to stay for a long time, don't sit on the stools. Find a chair, find a comfy chair, find a couch. Whatever you do, no stools. 

Also, if you want the tv to be set on a specific channel. Know which channel you want it put on and guide the staff to your channel. Othewise, you'll get to see what a full bar looks like watching someone else change the channels on the tv screens.

This place is so trashy I usually buy a pitcher for myself and drink right from the pitcher. Recently someone had the bright idea of hiring a band during BTC to create additional noise and decrease seating space on the patio.

A great place to come if you have to go out with friends or coworkers and don't want to hear a word they are saying.

The price of a pitcher hasn't matched the hour for years. The name of their happy hour should be changed from beat the clock to beat the wallet.

The funny thing about BTC is that you run into everyone you have met previously in class or at some party the week before. Forgot to get her number? Find her at BTC.

Whats sup Bro's! This is one of the Bro's favorite places to get a brew! I have had so many Bromanic's here. I find a bro, and we start drinking. Beat the Clock is where is at. All the bro's are here chilling and hang out. I give this place 5 Bro's Up. Best place to bro out and have a brew if you go to cal :)

The best part of broing out at the Bears lair is getting waste and taking a piss with your best bro in the bathroom. We all take turns playing swords with each other it kinda of suck for this bro, my bro sword isn't as big as my other bro's. We play swords as any normal bro would, loser has to buy the next round of beers for the bro's! It's a epic time of swords and brews and all the BROS!. Deal with it bro!


Any hot slams piece at CAL loves bro's if they don' t they need to come at me bro

GO BEARS!

TIP #1: Take advantage of Beat the Clock! It's one of the quintessential things to do as a Cal student, once you've turned 21. A pretty good selection of pitchers of beer are $7 from 4pm-5pm, $8 from 5pm-6pm, $9 from 6pm-7pm, and $10 from 7pm to close. See this photo: http://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/s2Wb3UxXVPU9CV0R2shSuA?select=GRda4Le6B_kgMiV4UF4UxQ

TIP #2: There is no system to ordering pitchers and you will get frustrated trying to get the bartender's attention. Be chill, wave a $20 bill, and demand attention!

TIP #3: Pretty difficult to snag a table--inside or outside--on Fridays. Either send someone to "reserve" a table early on, or make do with squeezing in with other groups. Some of the tables are large enough for beer pong. 

This past Friday was my first Beat the Clock! There was a scare over the summer that BtC wouldn't be happening anymore because Bear's Lair changed management, but alas, it is here. And thank goodness, because all that cheap beer was awesome! You'll see so many familiar faces here, too. 

I haven't tried the food, but during Welcome Week, there was a promotion for $1 beers and free wings and fries. The menu has switched from pizzas and burgers to Wings Fiesta! There are at least 10 different flavors of wings to choose from. From what I sampled during Welcome Week, the wings were pretty standard, but I'd probably drink at the Lair before heading elsewhere for food.

Solid 4 star establishment thrust in the heart of a wonderful campus setting. Don't get too expectant from some of the bar staff, their laid back attitude and general talkativeness leads to longer wait times for drinks and though they do boast a nice array of beer selections, they don't seem to rush to replace them when they go out. Overall, you'll feel like you're back at school the minute you venture to use the restroom and discover yourself in the middle of a food court adjacent to the establishment. Everyone gets carded, every time so don't be insulted if you're well over the drinking age and being asked for id from someone much younger than yourself. A great jump off spot for the rest of the Berkeley bar scene or a safe and comfortable end up after a night of failed adventures. 

Cheers

Hello Manager of Bear's Lair,

I would like you to know that typically I love coming on Fridays to Beat the Clock with good friends. And I ALWAYS have a good time.
