I really liked this place! I tried it for the first time today and was blown away! I asked if they had any garlic chile cheese fries and the lady told me no, then the guy behind the counter said "you can have them any way you want"! That was awesome!! The food was great, the service by the cooks was great! I give this place four stars because five stars is perfect and I don't believe in perfection but this is pretty close!

While a student at Cal, I.B.'s cheeseburgers kept me alive. Hard exam? Cheeseburger. Rough day at work? Cheeseburger. Feeling down? Cheeseburger.  Add a side of fries and I was in heaven.  I used to send prospective students and their parents over to I.B.s for lunch after the 10am tour (I was a campus tour guide) and got nothing but positive reviews from them, too.  

Thank you, I.B.s, for being the only place around campus that had cheeseburgers as good as In n Out.

Mmm. Chili cheese fries and cheesesteaks.

Yes, you know it can't be good for you. And with the portions they give, get ready for a week at the gym. But I.B.'s is my guilty pleasure and I'm proud of it. Their prices are cheap considering how much their food fills you up.

This is anti-south beach diet and when I cheat I head here. My god, it's heaven and then some. If ever you are in the area, you must stop and have a cheese steak and some fries with a big sugar laden drink. Yum. Luckily the UC Berkeley gym is a block and a half down.

I've loved the two things I've tried here - their cheesesteak and their chili cheese fries.  I know, they're probably on the top ten list for the unhealthiest things I could possibly eat, but they're soo good.  :-)  You definitely get a lot for the price you pay, so come hungry.

Had a great experience here. Great sandwiches, and such yummy nachos! The cheese had a tinge of spice and then there was steak on top. The owner was SO nice. Since it was our first time he helped us decide by giving us a smaller portion of nachos (which were huge anyway). The fries too are fried in a good quality oil, so it feels like they are barely fried in the first place. Great!

IB Hoagies is the best sandwich you can get in the Bay Area.  Forget the deli garbage and get yourself a grilled pepperoni or a mushroom steak.

I can power down IB Hoagies for days and never get sick of it.  This is the real deal.
A heart attack waiting to happen, but definitely more than worth it in the end.  :)  The cheesestakes are incredible and the chili cheese fries?  Ohhhhh, SO GOOD.

delicious chili cheese fries and curly fries without having to drive anywhere. 

+cheap
+fast
+YUMMMMMMMM
+HOT
+outdoor seating
Whenever i come to Berkeley, I usually make a stop here for cheese fries. No other places can beat this.

This is the best cheeseburger I've ever had anywhere in my life. No exagerration. I live about 25 minutes away from this place, but would make the trip anyday to get my hands on that burger. The fries, tater tots, or just about anything in the place is to die for! Not good for big crowds as there is about two tables inside, and a few more outside. I highly recommend this spot to anyone in the East Bay area!
Great sandwiches! Great Service! Ordered 35 sandwiches for a group event and Sam was super helpful.

To do it right: $6
To do it big: $9

Oh man--these sandwiches are bricks.  I mean that in a good way, I think.  I happen to be capable of taking down a large cheesesteak in one sitting, but it physically pains me to walk back to work afterward.  Seriously.  The sandwiches aren't bad, but God are they awful for you.  Fairly low quality cheese, OK steak, veggies are variable, age of bread is variable, calories are fantastically exorbitant.  I know that lower quality ingredients are a hallmark of the cheesesteak, but they could do much better.  At least it's not cheese whiz.

Random fact: If you go during the summer, you might see the owner's pre-teen kids.  It's got to be a violation of all kinds of labor laws, but they're cool and know how to work the register (more than can be said about Pancho's next door).

Summary: If you don't have time for the next two meals, stop at I.B.'s.

The things here are kind of expensive, but what do you expect from a location in Berkeley and so close to campus? The Philly Cheesesteak sandwich is BOMB that I probably don't ever need to go PA to try the real thing. They make it fresh so it takes a while, but it's worth the wait. I hear their curly fries are good too, but that will be for my next trip to Berkeley. Also, there's not much seating; it's always a bunch of guys taking up the two tables.

Cheesesteak baby!  

IB Hoagies makes a mean cheesesteak.. Yeah, it's greasy but what cheesesteak isn't?!  This place is a starving student's dream come true!  They are cheap and their sandwiches are huge making it ideal to come to for breakfast, lunch and dinner!  Yum.  And can I just say, the chili cheese fries are so good!!  Chili, cheese, deep fried tators.. How can you not love that combo?  I'm going to be honest because I've never had a hoagie here.  I'm a cheesesteak kind of gal anyways..
I love hot sandwiches from here. Even if they're soggy in sauce and meaty juices, I don't mind. I can take it!

Decent sandwiches and burgers. I come here often for the curly fries.

 I once waited for about 45 minutes for my order only to discover that the cashier forgot to relay it over. But they did apologize and gave me a free drink and cheesesteak, so I guess it all works out. My only major gripe is that they use CHEESE WHIZ on their chili cheese fries. yuck...

Probably some of the unhealthiest food I've ever eaten.  And I love it!

First introduced to them by way of their Chilli Cheese Fries, and eventually I tried their sandwiches as well, which is good too!

It's probably better for my health that I'm nowhere near them now.

Was here with my pop before the Cal game. It's been our pregame tradition for years.

This place has always had a great steak, but this time the quality and presentation was the best ever.

We met IB himself, a true gentleman who genuinely cares about producing a great cheesesteak. Under his watch, the food is better than ever.

Great steak, great pastrami, great fries. Can't miss with this place.

Wanting something different than the usual Asian ghetto fare for my pre Cal b-ball game meal, we stopped by IB's.  I ordered the mushroom steak sandwich with an order of garlic fries to share.  Steak sandwich was decent.  Everything was toasty and warm, but the sandwich didn't have much flavor and I felt like there wasn't as much meat on it as it used to or compared to other cheesesteaks I've eaten.  Garlic fries were good though, and there were plenty of them.  I also love the fact that they've got tater tots here!

One of the best hoagies in the East Bay. The quality is superb, price is affordable ~$5, and quick to cook. If you're limited on time and want a hot sub, then IB is want you want to get. Grill onions are awesome!

You can use it to hold paint, you can use it to hold water, you can carry water balloons in it. You can use it to carry every form of french fries in this universe? What is this magical container?

WHAT THE BUCKET!!!

Yes the BUCKET. The bucket is only one of the things that makes you want to go here. 

One of the best values in Berkeley is Quality fries (curly, regular, criss-cut, and garlic) in the bucket that is deeper than it looks (though I did like the old caldining-esque buckets they used to use better). You can get full just off the fries alone.

BUT Nooooooooo....

Their sandwiches are HUMUNGALOUSHIOUS (rhetoric majors don't need to spell things right as long as they can back their etymology up... so suck it English majors, Though I do love you guys). The Burgers remind me of the traditional burger joint that doesn't fall under the cookie cutter template that most chains use. 

Order the Works with jalapeños and be amazed....

If you aren't down with IB's then I've got two words for ya....

EAT IT!!!


I can go on a further rant but I'll stop right here

Live Strong!!! 

John

Criss-Cut Fries were super crispy and good. The large Cheesesteak was huge and pretty tasty. They offered a selection of peppers (sweet pickled bell peppers -- spicy jalapenos) that went well with the sandwich.

My favorite 3 things here are Cheese Fries, Garlic Fries and the Curly Fries... They give you really good portion too! I just wish they had their own parking lot on their own corner or something.. I hate to have to pay for parking and then come here to order, but its still worth it. Fries are one of the best

Doublecheese burger is the top.
They make a lot of different stuff here, not just cheesesteaks. I like them all. My favorite cheesesteak is a tie between the peppersteak and the bacon-steak. Nice girl at the counter. Remembers me everytime.

OMG!

This place is FABULOUS! 

-Bucket Cheese Fries are to died for! I always sprinkle it with black pepper!

-the HOAGIES! SO SO so GOOD!

-Prices are reasonable!

I like'em cheesesteaks! I.B.'s has cheap and good hoagies. I like to get a large and share with someone.

Their fries are so awesome.

I originally started going to I.B.'s for - what else? - their hoagies. They have a fantastic variety of toasted sandwiches and it didn't take long to become a frequent lunch destination just based on those.

But then I tried their chili cheese burger. And then their chili cheese curly fries.

Absolutely amazing.

Their hoagies are great, but I seriously have not deviated from my tried and true chili cheeseburger/chili cheese curly fries combo in months at this point. 

So good, I've been known to go as many as three times in a week.

BEST CHEESESTEAKS. Period. Other sandwiches are filling, but overall, not even close to being as satisfying as an IB cheesesteak. I like their pastrami, but overall their meats are of pretty good quality. Also, you can tell they make your order fresh because the condiments have not sunk in yet, and hot sandwiches are indeed served hot. Sweet potatoes fries are too dry.

MMMMMmmmmm  comfort food?  Used to go here all the time when living in Berkeley... sure I think it did give me some lingering odd feelings once in a while, but I don't care.

Mushroom steak?  Pepper steak?  mmm  I even have a friend who has an ongoing order for 2 of these to bring back to him whenever I happen to stop by.
Best cheese fries EVER!! The cheese stays hot and plenty throughout the bucket of fries.

Despite all of the culinary diversity in the Berkeley, IB's will always be my favorite place to grub it up.  I'm still not quite sure how I live to tell these tales after all of the bacon cheesesteaks (known as the "baconsteak"--man's greatest invention, and one of my all-time favorite word combinations) I consumed during my sophomore year, but I do.  The people there are really cool, the cheesesteaks are greasy and huge and DELICIOUS, the chili cheese fries cannot be beat, and they even served tater tots (at one time, no longer).

Also, if you ever want to prove your toughness to anyone, challenge them to eat a large of any of the cheesesteaks.  At one point, a large was two regular-sized cheesesteaks, but I think they've gone back to just one gigantic bun.  Oh, and a bucket of fries.  If you can survive one of those bad boys, you're pretty intense.

Yumm!

Boyfriend and I were driving around the area trying to find something to eat, and yelped this place, and decided to give it a try.

He ordered- Cheesesteak w. peppers, mushrooms, and onions
I ordered-Cheesesteak w. onions and mushrooms
Shared-Chili cheese fries

I like how they add lettuce, tomatoe, mayo, mustard, hot sauce to the sandwiches, sounded weird at first, but was pretty tasty....the bread did not get soggy or anything, and the inside was juicy and cheesy.

Chili cheese fries are ultimate muchy food lol served in a bucket, with nacho cheese and tons of meaty chili, def good.

I will most likely come back again!

Love it here!  Dropped by for the first time in YEARSSSSSSS and everything is exactly how I remember from college.  The cheese steaks are ridiculously big - a small can be shared, but to be on the safe side, get a large and share that!  Even the small order of fries is more than enough for 2.  And the prices are ridiculously cheap.  I remember in college, this was fine dining and spending $8 on a meal was out of my budget - it's so weird going back to old college favorite eateries and realizing how reasonably priced everything is in comparison to when you were a student.

Was craving some protein to chew on while last-minute drafting my essay so swung down to I.B.'s and bought a mushroom steak ($5.43 with tax), which my friends highly recommended. First impression after tearing paper wrapping: stuffed to satisfaction. My sandwich was bursting with mushrooms and sauteed meat, drizzled with some sort of white cheesy sauce. I asked for no pickles and no mayo. It was sufficiently savory (not too salty- a complete turn-off in burgers) and the roll was soft and chewy. Less greasy than your Top Dog fix but not healthy all the same. A delicious bite I'd return for though on another sucky work-loaded day.

I.B.'s Hoagies is an indulgent alternative to Smart Alec's just down the street. No wonder I frequented IBH my first two years of college, and Smart Alec's more often as I got older.

--------
Food: Out of four possible stars: one star.

The cheesesteak sandwiches really were not all that impressive. The meat was often overcooked and dry, which was occasionally hidden by the melted cheese. I used to get the mushroom steak, but the mushrooms seemed to taste more like the steak than mushrooms. Plus, it really does not have the taste of a cheesesteak, mostly because of the large amounts of extras. 

The fries were better than the sandwiches, but not that impressive either, in my opinion. They were either overcooked or underdone and soggy, and they constantly missed the happy medium of crunchy on the outside and tender on the inside.

--------
Miscellaneous: Out of one possible star: one star.

The place does look a bit dubious in terms of sanitation, but I think that is just more the general condition of squalor that is Berkeley under the rule of the incompetent city government. I have not had any problems with eating the food, and the service is fast and friendly.

Want a real steak sandwich? Go to the Cheesesteak Shop on University.

Contrary to what their menu says, a hoagie is a cold sandwich, a point which I once passionately tried to argue with the staff to no avail. A hot hoagie is known as a grinder. Also, a steak sandwich does not come with lettuce, tomatoes, mayo, and pickles. That's called a cheese steak hoagie. Seems niggling, but there is a difference.
Either way, I have to admit to buying these things every now and again. I just tell myself, "it's a cheese steak hoagie, it's a cheese steak hoagie," and it all seems okay, especially since they're not bad.
The ingredients seem low quality, sometimes even gross, meat looks like squirl intestines covered in a cheese-product
Basically, all I get is chili cheese fries, extra cheese, with a serious scoop of sweet jalapenos. Great, thick flavor. Awesome!

Cheap and amazingly good. Huge sandwiches--my favorite is the one with bbq sauce.  The chili cheese fries are awesome, but the regular fries with some ranch dipping sauce are great too! When I went to school in Berkeley, my parents ALWAYS requested a trip here. In fact, I think that might be one of the main reasons why they visited me. ;)  The place is pretty small with limited seating. Come hungry.

Strolling down Telegraph, bent the corner and ran into this small spot.  Got the Garlic steak and garlic fries.  Garlic fries were on HIT, the garlic steak was damn good but didn't taste the garlic......my feelings are not hurt.  Best cheese steak I've had in a minute!

The mushroom cheesesteak I got from I.B.'s was SO amazingly tasty! I was visiting from L.A. and it's very hard to find a good Philly cheesesteak in Cali, but I.B.'s is one of the two best I've ever had! The meat was easy to chew and had so much flavor. I can't wait to get back to Berkeley so I can experience I.B.'s again!

So I'm not from hog island or anything like that, but shouldn't a place that is called IB Hoagies serve hoagies? Hahaha... This place mainly sells cheese steaks and other variants (bbq steaks, pepper steaks, etc.) and burgers as well which I am sure are just as good as everyone says they are (or aren't).  

I walked into this place after reading mainly positive reviews on yelp and they didn't really have what I wanted.  However, the staff was very friendly, helpful and accommodating, I ended up customizing what they had on their menu into a hoagie but not much of one at that (Italian combo sandwich plus ham). The sandwich size all though enough to fill me up not big like one would deduce from their logo (I know the sandwich is huge in the pic but still) and actually small in comparison to your standard hoagie They didn't have potato chips either just fries, you know to throw the chips into the sandwich and here them crunch (Philly style! no I'm not from Philly).  I had to walk to Walgreen's and buy them to my heart's content.  

Overall, the ingredients were fresh, the staff was nice, and the service was quick--but the menu was lacking I thought this was pretty strange so I gave this a Meh, I've experienced better (I'm sure hoagie fans would definitely agree).

If you've never had one then go get one. If you've had one before then go get another one. Invest in a cheesesteak with no tomatoes or hot sauce, a large onion ring and cherry coke!! Love the sidewalk seating and friendly staff!! What are you doing still reading this? Stop wasting time and get over there, quick!!

A good place to eat incredibly unhealthy (yet tasty) fast food. The grease-factor is probably the reason this place never seems to attract a crowd as big as the fast food places next door, which is a shame. Oddly enough, I like their burgers better than their cheesesteaks -- both the garlic cheesesteak and the regular cheesesteak I tried tasted pretty bland. For $3 you get a big bucket of curly cheese fries, which I highly recommend.

If you're trying to lose weight, or are concerned about your health, don't come here. Seriously, there ought to be a Surgeon General's warning outside the place.

That being said, it's probably the best fast food you can get around the Berkeley campus. Any cheese steak from here is perfect, and with cheesy criss-cut fries? It'll derail any diet. 

The staff is incredibly friendly, too.

I didn't actually come here, we just ordered take out from here, but this is what I had: 
1) Mushroom steak sandwich: Love the sandwich! Meat was tender and juicy! Very well seasoned! The cheese and mushrooms were delicious! The bread was wonderful!
2) Curly fries/regular fries: You can't go wrong with fries! YUMMY!

The food was great and I'm not even that crazy about sandwiches! Half a sandwich is about a regular footlong at subway so this place has MASSIVE proportions! I can't wait to come again! YUMMY!!

Need a dose of deep fried junk food? Then get the Chili Cheese or just the Cheese Fries.  The wait is at least 3 minutes because they cook everything fresh! You won't get caught with old and soggy fries like you do at McDonald's.  The seasoned curly fries are good too.  

Seating here is limited, so expect to take your food on the go.

I have to admit I frequent this place.  I still don't know why I keep coming back, I think it is related to the buy 10 get one free card.  The cheesesteaks aren't terrible, but they definitely aren't worthy of any praise.  I'll give them some credit, their curly fries are very good, but side dishes shouldn't be the only good thing you offer.  I doubt I will return to this place once my buy 10 get one free card is finished (see Seinfeld's "The Strike" episode to further understand my reason to finish that card).

Get a cheesesteak plain and some curly fries and you are in for a nice meal. Not much seating for groups bu there are lots of tables close by in the Asian Ghetto area. Cheesesteaks rock so go grab one from I.B.'s.
I actually forget how their cheesesteaks tasted, but what I do remember was hot delicious their curly fries were. Hot and delicious.
I was just recently informed the IB's card still exists! I'll be heading back to pick up a new one.

Good every once in a while. Meaning, if you are in the area, and the line at top dog is too long, then why not? Seems that over the years, the amount of meat in the sandwiches has dwindled, which could be either a sign that management is being cheap, or they really don't care how many people complain, because they'll always have business. 

Anyhow, it's good for what it is. A place that makes decent hot sandwiches. Having chili cheese tater tots is a definite plus.

This place is a good stop for a quick bite. But the plague of all quick bite places is the mediocrity of its fare, and this place fell victim to it.

The mushroom hoagie was appetizing on the menu, but after a couple of bites, I couldn't remember much of what comprised its ingredients list.
It's more of just a steak sandwich than a full-on philly cheesesteak sandwich, but it's decent and the fries are really good.

Hands down the best Philly Cheesesteak in the city of Berkley. I'm from L.A. and never ate a Philly Cheesesteak as good as the one at Hoagies.

I went in here and for less then $6 got myself almost a foot long cheesesteak that definitely filled me up. 

The next day I went in and ordered myself a large sandwich this time and boy was I surprised. The thing had to be at least 1.5 feet long of deliciousness cheese and steak aaahhhhhh...


Thank you Hoagies

Their wings are a hit or miss... sometimes it's pretty good and sometimes it's too dry...

Garlic fries are fairly good..


Haven't had their hoagies in a while actually haha
Be prepared to undergo a cardiac cath after eating the chili cheese fries... but freaken awesome. Good sandwiches too.
Awesome hoagies, reasonably priced. Good crispy fries too.

I've been here a few times and I gotta say that this place is pretty damn good. I've tried their chili cheese fries, curly fries, and philly cheesesteak so far and they've all been pretty good. You definitely get your moneys worth. Their large sandwiches are freaking huge. Two thumbs up but only 4 stars from this yelper.
Where cops meet ;-), great burgers, especially the mushrooms burger, I love it

OH MY GOD!!! 

Baconsteak you rock my world. 

Chili cheese curly fries...you too... :-)

I wish you were open late nights!

I was taken here by a few friends and I didn't think I'd be impressed.  

Boy was I wrong!

Not only are their prices cheap, their portions are huge!  I ordered the large BBQ cheese-steak and could barely finish it, especially with all the fillings (lettuce, tomato, pickles, cheese, etc.).  A friend ordered the garlic fries and I was shocked to see that he came out with a full Styrofoam box.

My only complaint is that it was cash only. 

I can't wait to try this place again.  My mouth's watering just thinking about it!

Every place Ive tried in Berkley has been bomb and the streak continues with IB Hoagies. $6 for a cheesesteak is definitely bang for your buck.
Good cheese to steak to bread ratio and you add your own jalapenos and pepperoncinis so always gets kudos in my book. Looking forward to try out their other sandwiches in the future!

I live in San Jose now, and boy do I miss my Hoagie couples with some garlic fries from Smart Alex next door. 

Every sandwich here is good. And get it with everything, including the garlic and the mushrooms. You have to eat it with hot sauce. Don't ask me why - that is just the Berkeley tradition.

Their cheesesteaks are off the hook.  And make sure your cholesterol and heart condition are leveled.  Their chili fries are a must to supplement with your sandwich.  There isn't much room for seating so you may have to stand around the "stand-like" store or bring it to the Cal campus and sit on the steps.  Service is fast and it gets busy during school lunch hours.

Nice little store

Pretty greasy. Chili cheese fries are the shit....
every time i eat here i feel like i have to hit the gym for 3 hours though
Yum.  Greasy, cheesy, meaty goodness.
Everything tasted like warm salt.  The food served as mere texture.  I liked the bread and my dog really appreciated the curly fries I shared.
A girl can't have enough curly fries. By far the best curly fries I had in the bay area! Their mushroom steak sandwich is good too, but be ready to work out for the next few months!
The hoagies are decent. The meat is flavorful and they are generous with their portions. But what you really need to have there is the fries. Garlic or chili cheese they are amazing!

Mmmm...my mouth is watering as I think about a cheesesteak from IB's.  The cheesesteaks are tasty!  The meat is generally more dry than the average cheesesteak, but this also means that it's less greasy than other cheesesteaks. (which is good and bad, depending on what you are looking for)

IB's also offers up all kinds of sides like fries, curly fries, chili cheese fries, and onion rings.  The fries tend to be really hit or miss.  Sometimes they are a bit undercooked - especially when they are very busy.

I recommend that you eat there to get the best quality.  Carrying it around only makes the bread get soggy.  Table spaces are very limited, but walk next door to the Durant food court to find more seats.  Or, take the quick walk to campus and sit on the steps of Sproul to enjoy you meal!

Cheesesteaks are awesome.  Fries are just ok.

$5.99 for regular, $8.99 for large cheesesteaks. I bought the Uloop daily deal back in late January 2011 for $5 with $10 in value. I didn't feel like spending extra out-of-pocket cash at Bears Ramen House nor Thai Basil (which is now cash only) so I decided to finally use the $10 certificate. The Hispanic/Latino (what's the difference? inform me) employees were conversing about the print out as if it was illegitimate or something foreign. One guy/chef pointed at the date of 1/25/2011, which is when I bought the deal. For the longest time I thought they were going to say it was not going to be honored and I was so ready fire back at them for speaking Spanish in front of me. DO NOT attack or offend me please. But good thing there was no tension after it was accepted. 

The menu board is refreshed. I love garlic as you may know so I had to get the garlic steak sandwich (w/o mayo and mustard). I wanted two things so I opted for the regular size. This time I also ordered an avocado burger w/the "works"...BIG mistake (will elaborate below).

The wait was 5-10 minutes, which is actually a lot longer than you might think for 2 sandwiches. I'm sure there are advantages and disadvantages to the wait but it's more of a good thing. I felt the bag and the sandwich and burger were really warm, swell!

I ate the garlic cheesesteak first. Absolutely awesome. 4.5 stars, I highly recommend. Make sure to not get mayo and mustard. Every bite left me craving for more. The garlic isn't overdone like generic garlic fries from a concession stand. The bread/bun is also crunchy to a perfect point. I finished the sandwich in a jiffy since I was so hungry and hadn't eaten anything all day (this late lunch was around 3:45pm). 

Now the avocado "works" burger was a big mistake. I would give it 3 stars at most. The avocado and patty were done right but everything else is just horrible. Avoid! Mustard, mayonnaise, and ketchup on the top bun is just about the worst concoction I've ever tasted lately. The bottom bun is some other sauce but I was fine with that. I only took a few bites/ate 20% of the burger before I had to wrap it up and go. Needless to say, I was smarter previously to get two signature cheesesteaks.

I.B. Hoagies was one of my favorite joints at Cal.  I still go to Berkeley just for the curly cheese fries, cheese fries, anything they have cheese on lol!

It's a college town fast food joint filled with yummy deliciousness!  The cheese is the creamy kind (not the real melted cheese).  It's ooey goey cheese sauce that just makes everything taste so good!

I prefer coming here over the Cheese Steak House when I crave for more veggies.  I love the sliced lettuce, mayo, tomatoes, pickles, the works!  I usually order the chicken philly and it's always juicy.  It lets me feel a little less guilty for gorging on an order of curly cheese fries on my own LOL.

I heart I.B. Hoagies :)

Oh god, the portion for these fries are magnificent. Perhaps TOO magnificent considering the deep fried craziness that IB Hoagies fries are.

The sandwiches are nicely sized, also a plus if you have cal 1 debit card and need to use up some money on there. 

If you're feeling like a beast, try the curly chili cheese fries. I mean, you really have to be a beast to finish these though without hurling it's just SO MUCH. If you're splitting with a big group and you're all hungry (and not calorie-counting junkies) then this is a definite go to!

Garlic fries are a nice relief from Smart Alec's down the street (which just dumps a wad of garlic down without necessarily seasoning) because IB's seasons it and all. MMm nom nom.

I do suggest you grab this to go because there are mainly standing tables in front. Take it to go and eat somewhere nice on campus. Be classy with a fancy book perhaps with your gigantic IB Italian sandwich and fries. 

I approve.

I have an important recent discovery to announce! 

By default these sandwiches are four stars. 

WITHOUT MAYO AND MUSTARD is FIVE STARS! 

The sandwich is 2x tastier without mayonnaise and mustard. Plus I can finally taste the goodness of the cheese for once in my life. I recommend chicken cheesesteak; I usually get garlic but I'm going to try spinach soon; i bet it's awesome.

Mayo/mustard are for food n00bs!

I love mom and pop shops like these. Anyway, I came here today and got the mushroom steak, and it was GOOD. I love mushrooms on my burger, so I assumed mushroom would be good on steak and it was. The regular size is pretty decent, and it filled me up. I'd come back if I'm around Berkeley.

Freakin YUM. had a pepper steak with everything. I am kind of a purist so I may have to lose the veggies next time. This was the bestest cheesysteak I have ever had the pleasure of eating. Try the chili fries! Outstanding.

Just took a trip to Berkeley today to eat their chili cheese fries! My boyfriend and I both went to school at Berkeley (though we didn't know each other then) and we both used to chow down at IB's. He had a craving for IB's today so we drove up and ate together there for the first time! We both got giant buckets of the chili cheese fries with jalapenos. MMMM. Nothing better than greasy comfort food! I love how hot the fries are, how gooey they get with the rich chili and nacho cheese sauce, and how the jalapenos add a little kick to the whole thing. When I was a student I used to eat these fries along with the hoagies (can we say delicious artery clogging goodness wrapped in buns??).

The food here is great for whiling away time between classes, a late afternoon snack/lunch, and just when you have an uber junk food craving. The sad thing, is that the prices have gone up a lot since I was a student. There also isn't very much seating, so it's always a grab and go place.

Okay. So my roomie and I didn't feel like cooking today so he decided to go out and grab some cheese steaks. 

Service:
Not much service really. They take your order and you wait for you order. Can't say much about the service. 

Food:
Mushroom Cheesesteak - It was good. But it came with lettuce, tomatoes, and pickles??! On a cheesesteak? Well it was a first for me. I enjoyed the mushrooms and the cheese steak, but I felt that the bread was all wrong for this kind of sandwich. 
Chili Cheese Fries - This was good, but I felt disgusted afterwards just because of all the oil I was in-taking.

Overall:
Once in a while this is a good place. But if you want your arteries to be clogged and a heavy feeling afterwards, this is the place to go too!

Out of all the places Iv'e tried here in Berkeley this has got to be the best thing. Sounds weird right? I ordered their Cheese steak which was hella packed with veggies and cheese/mayo. For a price of $6 and a regular, this sandwich was a foot long but was stuffed like a mother f**ker. LOL

Then I had their famous garlic fries. I like them because its actually freshly fried and lightly covered with garlic oil. You can still taste the crisp in them. 

Overall, this place was ran by 2 women. They did an excellent job plus they are not stingy with their servings. This place was getting packed yet they still packed everybody's meals which was respectful.

I like this a lot!!! I want more!

People from Philly pan the place and even I've had better, but IB's has the best cheesesteaks you'll find in Berkeley, perfect when you need something hardy.  I usually get a mushroom steak with a bucket of cheese fries... they're definitely not stingy in terms of quantity.  I wash it all down with a sugary Pearl Milk Tea from Sweetheart, just a few stores away.

Wow, I'm surprised I haven't had a heart attack.

I first went there after seeing a friend come back from class with a very large cheesesteak sandwich. I then decided to try one for myself, and I have to say, the sandwiches are every bit as good as they look. They're not too expensive for the amount of food you pay, and I definitely recommend this place.
I highly recommend this place...that's all I have to say about that.

Ahh, another one of my favorite places to eat at when I'm working a gig at Cal. The hoagies here are seriously awesome, and have never let me down each time I've been here. I usually get something different whenever I come to I.B.'s, and maybe I'll get to a certain point where I've tried everything on the menu here. (Hmm, there's an idea) 

But forreals though, I think their hoagies are really good. Every time I bite into one, my inner voice yells out, "DAAAAAAMN!", like Ice Cube and Chris Tucker in that one scene in Friday. Sometimes it can get kinda messy, but that's because they like to pack those hoagies up pretty fat. But hey, it's better than the alternative, where you have a nice and neat hoagie with nothing spilling out, right?

If there is one thing that kinda sucks about I.B.'s, it's that there's not too many tables to eat at there, and the ones that are outside are on sort of an incline on the street. But other than that, I'd recommend this spot if you're down with tasty and greasy food. I know I am.

Mmmmm.... Greasy burgers ready to give you a heart attack. 

Cash only, unfortunately.
Way to bring on a food coma!!
I like the place because of the tradition of meeting there with friends and gorging before a Cal football game. As hot sandwich shops go, it's pretty good, but not something I eat very often.

maybe it's 5 stars b/c it makes me feel like i'm back as a student at cal.  or maybe it's b/c its so damn good.  probably b/c it's so damn good.

nonetheless, saturday football trips to berkeley require a stop here for a hoagie, or chili cheese fries, or both.  it's a 5 star solid hoagie, and i've never had anything bad from here in the 10+  years i've been going.

I am finally dedicating some precious time that I promised to put in a good word for this awesome Hoagie spot!! One afternoon with my Husband, we decided to hit up Berkeley and knew that we wanted to hit up I.B's!! We always enjoy your visit to Telegraph and once we sat down and ordered our Chicken with extra Mushroom hoagies and Sweet Potatoe fries, there was this man that was fixing the fountain soft drink machine. He over heard me enjoying my Sweet Potatoe fries and informed me that he used Rice Oil to fry them in so it's super healthier than any other frying oil. He and I started to engage in more conversation about healthier ways of cooking and organic products. Then he introduced himself as the Owner so we were stoked! Just knowing that we enjoyed his Hoagie spot so much-he handed us free passes for the next visit to BE ON THE HOUSE per the actual OWNER himself!! Can't beat that!! Sorry I.B it took such a long time to write this review but I just got married and it's been crazy! :) Now that we are settling in-we are definitely going to pay a nice visit again!!! Can't wait!! :) This IB Hoagie is better than the one off San Pablo Ave. ;)

Even better than I remember it from college.  I got the cheesesteak with everything (peppers, onions, mushrooms), it was absolutely delicious.  I noticed you can even use your Berkeley account to buy food there now; that would have been dangerous if that option were available when I was there...

Good burgers, average service average price. Overall it was a really good place. I got their double cheeseburgers with fries and had no complaints but nothing that really stood out to make it spectacular. A good place to drop by to get dinner after a long day of classes.

Thank you IB Hoagies for making me gain 15 lbs throughout my college years! Your cheese fries are so freaken delicious and cheesy that it makes me wanting more. The fries are cooked to perfection...

 Not to forget, the almight hot sandwiches.... ahhhh, you cannot go wrong with anything on the menu.

Excellent hoagies! YUM YUM! The cheesesteaks are the best, especially the mushroom cheesesteaks! On top of that, you have to eat their fries....ANY of them...regular, curly, garlic...YUM! I'm not a big chili cheese fries person, but they're pretty good!

This is definitely a great place to eat out when you're in Berkeley! It can get busy during lunch time...
One day, after a midterm, I was sad. I came here and got the mushroom steak, bucket of fries and a soda. I was happy. The end.

i'm just confirming what everyone else is sayin'... the chili cheese fries are freakin awesome.  they used to come in a big cup, but now they're served in a standard lunch container. freshly fried fries, nacho cheese and chili on top... i've never had fries so good.  i used to eat one as a meal by itself... now i get full after eating half.

I ordered a mushroom onion cheese steak, which is the only type of cheese steak I ever get.  It was okay.  It hit the spot, but the flavor was a bit off, especially on the saltiness, and it just wasn't as good as other cheese steaks I've had.  I'll have to keep looking...
Awesome cheesesteak place.

My friend is a lot crazier about this place than I am (she had the eggplant parm, in case you were wondering. I had the chicken sandwich); maybe because I don't like to pay this much for a sandwich, or maybe it's because being around so many southside kids makes me feel out of place. The sandwiches are good, and they are pretty huge. The curly fries are tasty, but I'd rather go elsewhere to sober up.

Ah.  Berkeley.  When I went to school here, I thought the food on telegraph and at the food court was gross.  After spending some time away, though, I have grown to love some of the spots.  IB Hoagies is definitely one of them.  I can't say this is the best cheesesteak in the bay, but it's definitely the best I've ever had.  I recommend calling your order in because there usually is a line (though not too big).
Best sandwich I've had in a while -- maybe since Ikes. The cheesesteak was perfecto in every way -- the steak was oh so tender and yummy, and the toppings and bread were spot on. MMMMM.

Hamburger review! 

I got their normal hamburger no pickles: comes with grilled onions, soft sesame seed bun, thousand island sauce + mustard on the bottom bun, ketchup on the top bun. Pretty delicious, though the sauces were a little overwhelming. Like the bottom bun was pretty much smothered in mustard and thousand island, making it super soft, though it wasn't soggy. Just made the patty slippery and the meal kinda messy. But what  did I expect--it's a burger!

Patty was by default medium to well done. Since I prefer medium-rare, this was too dry for my taste, but the taste was pretty good. It's kinda my fault for not specifying though, so I plan on doing that next time. And probably to go light on the mustard.

Per the usual, I got curly fries (same price as normal fries!). Seriously, their small comes in this sizable tub that would be the equivalent of a large in any other fast food chain joint.  I swear, their large size of fries could probably feed a family of four for a day.

Hamburger and fries came to $6.25. They take AmEx! 

For a burger, I'd say it's better than smart alecks, but not as good as bongo burger.  IB's Hoagies (per their name sake) are in general a better purchase from here.

OMG. This place is seriously bad for my health. The kicker is that the hoagies and chili fries here are more addictive than crack sprinkled with caffeine (wouldn't that be pretty addictive?). Seriously though, this is a must try when your down by Berk.

the cheesesteaks here are alright.. im not a big fan of their sandwiches.. i dont think the meat is top notch.. it can be pretty dry and dull..

BUT.. they get 4 stars because i come here all the time to get their

SUPERDELICIOUS CHEESE CURLY FRIESSSSSSSS!!!!

their curly fries are freaken gooood as helll!

Mainstay Place for Cheese Steak Fill

I ate many cheese steaks at IB Hoagies 
the grease is good from the grill 

don't know exactly do 
but there is some good flavor in the Steak n Cheese 

Nice buns too
Used to go here a lot as a student. It's not healthy, but there hoagies are so good. I love there bucket of fries and bucket of curly fries. You get so many fries for only a few bucks!

FINALLY. 1) I tried I.B.'s. 2) I satisfied my tater tot crave. 

Mushroom steak - I ordered a small and it's a pretty big portion. I'm a small gal so half of this 6 incher was plenty for me. I have to say, it was pretty good. Wish the mushrooms weren't diced to tiny pieces though; if they were a little bigger in size the mushroom flavor would've been more prominent. The bread was perfectly chewy, but not as crusty as I'd like. This could be due to the fact that I ordered it as takeout and ate it about 10 minutes after leaving the joint. Anywho, it was a good cheesesteak! My brother doesn't think this place is that good, but then again that man has eaten a lottttt of cheesesteaks from all over the place so he has different standards. For someone who rarely eats cheesesteaks, it was good enough. 

Tater tots - let me tell you...I have been craving tater tots for the longest time and just haven't had the time to go get them. Tonight was the night, and I am one happy camper. I wish they were a tadddd crispier but it was still good. A small order is huge in my eyes...definitely enough. I don't even want to know how big the large order is. 

It's a little on the greasy side and luckily I workout a lot and don't have a problem with acne. I'm not super super huge on cheesesteaks but if I ever am in the mood for one, I.B.'s is the way to go. And the cheese fries were calling my name. Gawd I sound like an obese fatso.

If you want fries, head over to Smart Alec's. I like a fry with a discernibly crispy-crunchy outside and a fluffy inside, and a good indication of this on a thick fry like those at IB's is to see if the outer layer has a bit of transparency. Nope, these are opaque. Avoid, unless you are craving a bit of potato, which I am all the time and so I inevitably order these, but not happily.

If you want cheesesteaks, go to Rocky's. They are richer, more tender, better. But Ib's is good--nay, great-- for one thing: the veggie combo sandwich. Bell peppers, onions and button mushrooms tossed on the grill with some cheese, and then placed on a toasted bun with a nice amount of avocado and the regular sandwich fixins (the pickles and mustard give this sandwich extra oomp). What you get is a mouth-searing, molten, creamy mess of a good veggie sandwich. A much better (and comparable in terms of dollars and cents) alternative to the subs over at Quizno's and Subway on many days.

Had an awesome cheesesteak sandwich today.
Curly fries and a BUD LIGHT from the mini mart next door.

Small place, limited seating.

GREAT FOOD!!!

The new waffle fries they have are pretty amazing. I also tried the mushroom steak and the pepper steak. They are both great, but the pepper steak is SOOOOO GOOD. The mushroom steak is okay, maybe because i dont like mushrooms particularly.

THEIR FRIES ARE FREAKING DELICIOUS.  I don't know how they make regular old french fries (do people still try to call them freedom fries? haha) taste so damn good.  It must be the oil they fry with...  The fries remind me of meat.  

I haven't had anything else there, so maybe I'll edit this after I do that.  But I dream about eating IB's fries when I'm away from Berkeley.

I haven't eaten here in a while but when I do I usually leave with a full stomach. They have very filling sandwiches and tasty garlic fries. I would always get the Philly cheesesteak with mushrooms. Affordable, greasy, and unhealthy; the perfect combination to gain your freshmen 15! If you want to feel a little bit better after eating one of their sandwiches, wash it down with a Diet Coke.

Pretty bomb hoagie joint near the UCB campus  -definitely friendly to the college kid's wallet. I got a 9" mushroom steak hoagie for $6.

The bread had a perfect crunchy crust with soft, chewy insides, stuffed with mushroom, steak bits, sweet grilled onions, creamy mayo...YUM! 
The steak meat had a lot of stringy, fatty pieces in it that were inedible. 

I recommend the chili cheese fries too. Thick fries drenched in cheese and chunky chili. 

This is a small, no-frills place, there was one table inside and they set up some mismatched bar stools and tables along the sidewalk. Service was good too, the food came out fairly fast, a guy came out and cleaned our table and gave us to-go-bags. 

I.B.'s -  a casual little place for delicious, cheap hoagies!!!

As I have come to this place more and more, I have come to really appreciate this place. The only thing I wish is that it would stay open later to satisfy my drunk munchies, seriously. I will pay your guys' rent if you do this! Just give me the cheese fries and hoagies to boot and we've got a deal!!

My favorites are definitely the mushroom steak and pepper steak. For the sides, you cannot beat the garlic fries or the cheese fries. What I used to grab on the go were the chili cheese fries but the cheese fries are just so addicting even without the chili! What you have to do is grab a free lollipop on your wait and grab some peppers on your hoagie, seriously, it's the most wonderful thing ever. The melted cheese, the slices of steak, the chewy mushrooms, and the sharp taste of peppers is wonderful! 

The only thing that I dislike about this place is that they don't really have too many seats and the lines are often long and their queue for ready orders is just so unorganized sometimes. Also, what's up with your early closing hours, especially weekend nights? My deal for paying your rent is still open you know!!

Mushroom Steak.
Good stuff, quick bite. Very quick.
A little small for the price but it's close to campus.
Not a frequent visitor but if cheesesteak is what I'm craving and I don't want to venture too far, this is the spot.

One of my favorite places to grab a burger or sandwich. Way better than all the other shitty areas to eat. I would also recommend the chilly cheese fies super yummy Poeple to go there asap :)) enjoy some ibs food immediately

What a disappointment. Half of my french fries were undercooked and cold/hard in the middle. My chicken cheese steak was so full of gristle that I found myself spitting out bite after bite until giving up halfway through the sandwich, as my appetite had disappeared.

The flavors were good, which is why I left two stars; clearly the food has potential and could be delicious if cooked properly. But I wasn't so fortunate, and I definitely won't be coming back to risk another 10 bucks on a potentially crappy meal.
the pastrami hoagie or sandwich or whatever is SO gooooood
The chili cheese fries there are so freaking good!  They're made with cheese that's best for fries - nacho cheese!

Their cheeseburger is DEELICIOUS! Worth every penny ---- just under $5.  I just had my first experience at IB's, and I will definitely go back soon.  The burger wasn't greasy like some of those other places, nor did it fall apart in any way.  They even did a good job wrapping it, so I didn't even make a mess.

The hoagie was good and all...but the GARLIC FRIES!! TO DIE FOR!! by far the best garlic fries i've ever tasted!! crispy, not too over bearing, just perfect! and free soda refills! I'd watch out for the bums though...they come outa nowhere..

Finally came here after 3 coming on 4 years at Cal. Came with a friend because I was madly craving some chili chese fries. Despite IB Hoagies being known for their cheesesteaks, my friend and I ordered a turkey avocad hoagie and a chili cheese curly fries. Th small fries ($2.50) came in a good sized cup with fork. Oh man, that lather of cheese, perfect amount of not too beefy or chunky chili, over seasoned curly fries? Heaven heaven heaven. I mixed it around with the fork to get the chessy, chili-y goodness all over those curly bad boys. And after. Long ime, the fries only somewhat wilted, still maintaining some firmness by the time I reached the bottom. For $2.50, this is a delicious steal.

I got a bit of my friend's hoagie. Turkey was just deli lced turkey. I thought it was okay. Nothing will ever top that phenomenal turkey pesto panini from the now-closed Sfoof's Woofles on Bancroft. That place gave thick slices of real roast turkey breast, and delicious bread and generous amounts of cheese and pesto. So I think anything not to that level seems bland to me now. Forgive me if you like the sandwich or it actually tasty, I found it forgettable.

In all, chili cheese curly fries FTW, all the way. Budget friendly, tasty. I have to come back one day and try the cheesesteaks though.

Note: not a great place to sit and eat...
Best hangover food I've ever had.

Was happy to see a cheesesteak shop in Berkeley but I was disappointed by their food . Their mushroom cheesesteak sandwich tasted alright . However , the beef was not tender enough and the sandwich itself lacked flavor . Their curly fries are pretty good ... they're perfectly deep fried . They also sell mini bottles of hot sauce for a dollar which is awesome . Don't underestimate their mini bottles of hot sauce ... they're pretty spicy believe it or not .

you can get deep fried tater tots, they call them tater rounds.
I think they use canola oil, to bad its not lard.
nothing quite like it anywhere close.
Chili cheese fries. Tasty chili, cheese food, on either curly fries or tater tots. Deadly delicious.

Came here for lunch on a friday afternoon. The service is slow but the line was also long, so it is understandable. I had the american hoagie and it was good. I had a side of tater tots because of my nostalgia for grade school cafeteria food, but this was so much better. The cheese fries were good also. Decently priced.

Mushroom steak was delicious: tender, flavorful, and actually good quality meat! As usual, their cheese steak is always piping hot, cooked fresh, and their hoagie rolls are toasted to perfection. Subway is right down the street but it simply doesn't compare to a hoagie from IB's. Unlike Subway which skimps on the meat sometimes, putting in but a few slices which aren't even enough to make a hungry 4 year old child full, IB's is very generous with the amount of meat that they put in.

Might not be the healthiest meal, but IB's ranks among one of my favorite places to eat here in Berkeley.

OHHH BABBYY!!! I LOVE this place. Perfect for one of those really greasy nasty meals when you feel really hungover and want some good junk food. I loved their mushroom cheesesteak!! It definitely will stain the bag with oil if you take the food to go! They have reallly really good chili cheese fries and other types of side items that are all really fatty. I hated eating here though because homeless people will stand right next to you while you're eating in hopes that you will have some leftovers. I used to eat here in college, but now it would have to be a REALLY rare situation to eat here, because i'm not trying to be obese by the age of 25!

Heart-attack Hoagies, at least that's what we call it. I don't think there's anything remotely healthy on this menu?? Nevertheless, when you have a craving, you have a craving, right?

Grilled, hot food toppings for a Hoagie served immediately is delicious. The sourdough rolls they use for their sandwiches/hoagies suck. They either put it in the oven for too long or they're using stale bread. Unfortunately, this has been a consistent deficiency for the items I've ordered here.

Curly fries and cheesy fries are soooo good though. You can taste the grease from the frier, that's how fast it's being brought out. 

Final Call:
For me, there are better alternatives for fried, greasy food elsewhere.

Every one of their hoagies are delicious. I would especially recommend getting any kind with mushrooms. I'm a picky eater, so I generally take out most of the toppings that they offer, but it's still juicy and delicious. Although their tables aren't great to eat on, it's a good meal to buy when you're on the go. Just buy a sandwich and within a few minutes you're walking out with deliciousness in a bag. The service is pretty good too

dude.  YES. 

i remember first coming to this place back when i was, i dunno... 18? i had never had a hoagie before, so needless to say that when i laid my first bite into this deceivingly simple hoagie roll filled with declicious meat and cheese, that it was so good i started crying...

okay, i didn't really start crying, BUT it was reeeeaaaaally good!  they nail philly cheese steaks!  they dont' burdon you with gallons of grease... okay, there's grease, but it's not HELLA.  but man, something' about that grilled steak and onions and peppers with that cheese melted all gooey-ly on it makes a brotha want to start drooling.  

here's to you IB's!

I used to think this place was really good, but maybe because food always tastes better at night. I finally had a cheesesteak in the daytime and realized that it's not really that great. It's on par to sandwiches at Quiznos or Great Steak & Potatoes. The sogginess of the bread bothered me. Sigh. What a disappointment.

The food is great but I'd have to give it 3 stars instead of 4 because the boss is a real prick. My friend and I got the munchonme deal a while back that gave us a regular cheesesteak with pepperoni for $4, and when she asked to have one without pepperoni, he practically blew up at her and said they couldn't do it. Um...why not? -_________-

Anyways, the portions are big and I love the sauces they put inside. The bread is also really good, but sometimes a bit oily. Sometimes if I'm just looking for a snack, I love to buy large orders of their curly fries because they're delicious and cheap ($3?)
I went back to taste it, and I gotta say, it's much better, though not by much.

Cheesesteaks are hard to come by in Berkeley, probably because you can count the number of decent places that offer this type of sandwich on one hand. I.B's has a fairly large menu, but each sandwich differs only by one extra ingredient that you can choose, i.e. mushrooms, peppers, or bbq sauce. They also do burgers, but why get a burger at a place whose title includes "Hoagies and Cheesesteaks"?

Prices are a bit high for what you get, but sometimes there's so much food you can't finish it all. The fries can be oversalted sometimes though. Unfortunately I haven't been able to try their garlic fries and curly fries with cheese because each time I ordered them, they forgot and gave me plain fries or plain curly fries and I found out too late.

YUM! I ordered the cheeseburger and curly fries (for under $7!) and I could barely finish it! (Of course, I did and then could not get up or move around for a good 10 min). The burger was pretty greasy, but then again, have YOU ever eaten a cheeseburger that was not greasy, but delicious? I didn't think so. The portion of curly fries was definitely generous-- it came in a little bucket. The wait seemed to be a bit long for fast food considering there weren't many people there waiting, but I thought it was worth it. I wouldn't recommend eating here EVERY day unless you want to have a heart attack, but I like to pig out here every once in a while. :)
it might have an off-day, right after a Cal football game.  but it was not how i remembered it to be.  the buns were tough and the inside was bland at best.  i still like the curly fries though.

I.B. Hoagie is definitely college food meaning more bang for the buck!  Occasionally when I'm feeling a little broke or I feel like being bad and getting something that might not be so good for me, I go to I.B's.  They have two sizes on their hoagies, a regular and a large.  The large is perfect to split amongst two other people but even a regular could suffice with filling up two people.  I definitely am only able to eat at most 3/4 of a regular.  

Their cheese fries is also a bit of a heart attack!  It's a large order of fries slathered with nacho cheese.  My coworker who is a big eater died when he tried to finish a regular portion of a hoagie and the cheese fries to accompanied it!  Be careful with the amount you order, it'll definitely get you!

I love IB's! I used to eat here daily when I worked on Durant. My personal favorite is the Bacon Steak and curly fries. The ChickenSteaks are pretty damn good too. In fact I have a half a sandwich in the fridge and I think I'll have to eat it now.

this is the CHEAPEST cheese steak shop ive been to especially compared to the ones in the south bay. i got a 15 inch (i think?) mushroom cheese steak with grilled onions for only $10. compare that to the cheese steak shop in san jose, i paid 10 bucks for like 7 inches. ive never tried anything outside of mushroom cheese steak. ill be sure to try something new the next time i visit.

Any place where the "Large" size is actually noticeably large, like, about 50% larger, is pretty awesome in my book.
Also the food's delicious.

Fries- nom nom nom. sweet potato, garlic, chili cheese - I've bought all their tubs.

I was first introduced to this place by a classmate - I had evening classes from 6-9 one summer and every day during break this guy would dash out and come back with a hoagie. He'd eat it during class RIGHT IN FRONT OF ME and IT SMELT SO GOOD. Talk about product marketing - another girl asked where he got it and the rest of the class trooped on over to IB's afterwards.

Their cheesesteaks, the mushroom steaks, garlic steaks (bring lots of mints) are nom nom worthy. Just don't eat it in front of a class of hungry college students, we may have to mug you for it...
this is my go to spot for some real comfort food. the kind of food to get me through finals week. hoagies and chili cheese curly fries for the soul.

I can't believe how stingy some people are with the stars.

This place is seriously like a tiny slice of heaven. For $6 you can get an enormous cheesesteak. The fact that hot sauce is included by default gives them even more credit in my book.

The cheese fries put other establishments to shame. They were freakin delicious. I can't wait to try out their other forms of fried carbs (sweet potato and TOTS). After I ordered my fries, I noticed (to my dismay) that you can ADD BACON TO ANY FRY ORDER for $0.50 - $1.00 (depending on order size).

Next time, you delicious bacony cheese fries, next time....

CHILI CHEESE FRIES!!!! 5 Stars!!!! (Chili with actual MEAT in it and nacho cheese on top of crispy fries. I've never had better!)

(for the rest... 4 Stars!! the hoagies, they are good, but the chili cheese fries are their own meal)

I was spoiled with good fast food.

I realize that "good" is subjective, especially in relation to fast food.  Just as wine critics define and categorize wines with regards to body, the level of tannin, acidity, fruit, and overall balance (among other factors), there should be similar rubric to categorize and rank fast food.

Would it be along the lines of salt, grease, flavor, and trans-fat?

Rankings aside, IB's Hoagies provides a welcome contrast to Smart Alec's Intelligent Fast Food (vegetarian patties, etc.) just across and down the street.  The hoagies are pretty good, as are the burgers.  However, they can't approach the magnificence of a pastrami sandwich from the Hat (Alhambra, CA), nor can they approach the mythic status of heroes from Philly.

The chili cheese fries are interesting.  Instead of using grated cheddar cheese, they use nacho cheese.  The process to create a bucket (yes, bucket) of IB's chili cheese fries is thus:

(1) Scoop in one layer of fries
(2) Pour layer of goopy chili
(3) Pour layer of nacho cheese
(4) Repeat two or three times

I could have graduated with a degree in geology after going through so many layers.
hoagies!! :) used to get the cheesesteak that had mushrooms in it.. perfection!!! :) and fries!
I have to give IB 5 stars. We drive from Vallejo for cheesesteaks. There are a few cheesesteak shops closer but its better here. Also good people watching while you eat. Live Performances!!!

3.5 stars
REVISION due to enlightenment of Amatos 
Sorry but you got bumped down ever since I've had Amatos. Amatos also has bigger portions...and just totally wins hands down. The price ranges from 5-7. Its pretty cheap, a bucket of curly fries are just 2.50 and its huge. My girlfriend and I ordered a large mushroom steak and DANG it was decent! The size was about a 7 inches and extended past the paper bag. It really made us full. It is definitely the bang for the buck. Another thing the mushroom steak was absolutely Delicious it had yummy fresh veggies and the meat wasn't bland but exquisitely soft and seasoned. Our mushroom steak wasn't greasy or made you feel disgustingly bloated.

I wish the bread was better though, its kind off stale tasting

anyways I'd definitely visit this place again....if only gf didn't hate Berkeley so much

------------------------------------------
Sorry IB's but Amatos definitely has the better bang for the buck and larger portions and yummier meat and bread. Yups.
3.5 stars
A quick greasy 6$ sandwich. This place is pretty good as far as taste goes. It isn't the best, but definitely good enough for a quick lunch or dinner.

as we speak, i am chowing down on a mushroomsteak with everything. i don't even like half of the things that they put on it. hot sauce, pickles, and mustard-in what world do these go together? IB's!!!! :D

i had been craving french fries and beef since 10 pm yesterday. as usual, i went onto yelp to search for potential eats and i came across ib's. fast forward to today, i have class from 11-3:30 and i don't eat breakfast b/c i enjoy savoring every bit of sleep i can get. 3:30 comes around and i'm famished. walk to ib's to order a regular mushroomsteak, which turns out to be humungous and is a great deal being the poor college student that i am. i can only imagine how big the large is. the fries came out perfect. fluffy and crispy. enjoyed them my entire walk back to my apt. definitely hit the spot. all for $8.21. damn i am happy.
Good and greasy!  I can never say no to their chilly cheese fries!  Hoagies are also really good. YUM!

Their bucket of fries/curly are usually okay, and CHEAP

but today they gave me a bucket of fucken charcoal....wayyy overfried wtf?

I.B.'s can only be considered good for want of a better alternative.  The place doesn't quite cross the threshold of "bad," but the people who say it's good may have little experience beyond I.B.'s for cheesesteaks.  The Cheesesteak is darn close to flavorless with too much bread and the fries, although indulgent from time to time are little more than matrices of crystallized grease.  Vinnie's is a much better alternative.

Ok, this place is seriously out of control (OoC). Seriously.

I had seen this place before (it IS right next to AG!), but I always assumed it was some crappy burger place. I assumed WRONG.

I HIGHLY recommend getting a large (TWO sandwhiches for less than 10 bucks. WOWWW.). It tastes good. Yommm. 

Getting one sandwhich is an o.k. deal. I haven't tried too many of the other things yet (but my friends love the fries), but they seem pretty solid well.

Damn. I won't eat at this location anymore, although it's the only one I've ever 'dined' at (2 more in Oakland).
I have a habit of ordering mushroom steaks with bacon and sweet potato fries (which are excellent BUT HIT OR MISS); but the last hoagie i ordered was riddled with bits of fat. I can f-o-r-g-i-v-e this occasionally (and I have a number of times in the past) but this was profound! I repeatedly fingered through my hoagie filling filtering out what should have already been trimmed from the meat and after all said and done I couldn't continue eating. This, coupled with yet another botched* batch of the sweet-potato fries, was the pivotal moment of epiphany: I've never returned one of their hoagies but damn, do I want to start now?
They did raise their prices just recently, too.

This definitely was not my first choice but my friends wanted to go here so I gave it a shot.

Surprisingly really good!

I got the avocado veggie burger and it was sooo yummy, which is such a plus because most veggie burgers fall flat.

My friend ordered the mushroom steak and was in love.

College-student-budget-friendly and pretty quick.

Actually, this is prob a 4.5 stars.  You go in and wonder why you're about to drop $9 for a steak, until you get it and realize its as big as ur car.  Biggest steak I've ever had, DELICIOUS and juicy too.  I'd say it held its own against a cheesesteak i had in philly yesterday from a local favorite spot.
Maybe the meat was a bit less perfect tasting than in philly (and thats being harsh) but for how much more you get, i'd go here 9 times outta 10.  Steak is chopped FYI.  Juicy.  Huge.  Dank.

most of the time they throw a good pastrami reuben - a couple of times it sucked - this was mostly on saturday mornings, so I don't get stuff from here on saturdays anymore. I love sauerkraut in reubens and polish dogs - this place does the former, and top dog takes the latter - sort of. They also have pretty good chili cheese fries.

Dodgey meat with cheese mushrooms bacon and tons of hotsauce.  add a bucket of the chilli cheese fries and your mouth will love you while your heart gets pissed.   For two straight years every sunday afternoon I would go to IB's to recover from my hangover, and I was never disappointed.  The pastrami sandwich is also really tasty but it doesn't host a candle to the baconsteak+ mushrooms.  Just remember not to compare it to a philly cheesesteak, it's a different beast, you eat it without wiz, and you dress it differently.  Either way you'll have a hard time coming up with a better way to take the edge of a hungover rainy sunday afternoon

This place is delicious but truly a guilty pleasure. I ordered the mushroom steak sandwich my first time and was so addicted I couldn't try anything new. I love adding copious amounts of their peppers and hot sauce to my already overstuffed sandwich. The meat is perfectly grilled and extremely addicting. I am a huge fan of chili cheese anything, so their fried potato selections can always ruin any attempt I have at eating healthy.

This is food made for the God's. I've never had a sandwhich so good in my life. Everytime I eat this sandwhich I'm thankful that I went to school at Berkeley. I dont' think I've ever eaten one while I was stoned, because I would probably die from the sheer ecstasy I would experience.
I heart IB Hoagies BaconSteak.  With grilled onions, cheese, and some hot sauce!  If I was ever in prison, I might ask for this for my last meal.

I would go here when I had a craving for their fries and at the same time needed parking validation!

While I lived on Durant, just a minute's walk to IB Hoagies, I couldn't always find a parking spot on the mean streets of Berkeley so I would end up parking in the Sather structure.  Then there was IB Hoagies to the rescue... their food gave me my sodium intake I needed for the day, and at the same time the validation I needed.

I've had the garlic fries and they were waaaay too strong for me.  Their packaging also makes them soggy real quickly.  But their regular fries are sooo addicting.  They're salted just right, and have this great crispiness to them.  As I'd walk back to my apartment with my IB Hoagies to-go in hand, I'd munch on my fries...yumms!

I've had the first 3 cheesesteaks on their menu, the regular, the mushroom one, and the bacon one.  Out of the three I'd usually order the mushroom cheesesteak.  

I think their cheesesteaks are delicious, but somewhat pricey for the size and what it is.  I would think they'd be a little cheaper considering they're competing with so many other food places within walking distance.

These cheesesteak sandwiches come with the worst food coma I have ever experienced in my life. Ever.

Every time I go here, I get either the bacon or garlicky cheesesteak, and I can only ever make it through 2/3 of the damn thing before I collapse.

At least the last 1/3 still tastes delicious when I wake up.

This place amazes me. 

The first time I tried this place it was pretty good, I didn't think it was special.. I would like to think that I'm a person who has self-control, however, the second time I had it is where I learned that I didn't have self control... 

I came up with a few friends get dinner with some of my Berkeley friends. But since we had like two hours to kill we all wanted a little bite to eat. So we decided to eat at IB's because my friend was craving it. So my friend and I ended up sharing a 6' cheese steak. And in that small 3 inches of goodness... something good happened... something just snapped. I ended up ordering another 6' cheese steak for myself. And even after that I wanted one more... Oh Lord have mercy on my arteries...

I was in absolute awe of how well everything tasted. The cheese was perfectly melted, the gooeyness of the cheese was perfect, the veggies, meat, and bread were absolutely spot on. 

You know when your a true fatty when you don't care if your mouth burns, and all you care about is filling your gullet with this goodness. 4.5 stars for just being absolutely amazing.

Chickensteak, Cheesteak, Mushroomsteak...all kinds of gooey cheese laden meats grilled then place on toasy bread with lettuce, pickles, hot sauce and tomatoes...

YOU HAVE TO TRY THE CHILI CHEESE CURLY FRIES!!!! It is everything that is bad for you and everything that makes you glow from nasty greasy fatty fat fat.....mmm....fatty fat fat. PMS food of the gods...

(get a soda to drink all the salt down)

IB Hoagies is legitimately one of the best sandwich places in the East Bay.  

Personally, the mushroom steak and the cheese steak are my go to choices.  If you are feeling up for a challenge get the large sandwich, a huge 15 inch sandwich that is at least enough of a sandwich for two meals.  

Also, it recently became halal (although you should specifically mention for halal meat), so that definitely makes it a +1 star.  Quick, fast, and delicious; it is amazing for college students.

I used to live down the street from this place and it would be my go-to spot for indulging when I'm starving.

I used to order the mushroom chicken steak sandwich with a bucket of fries drenched in hot chili and cheese (recently, i went there again and they don't use the buckets anymore).  I swear they put sleeping pills in their food cause after I finish this meal, I would pass out from food coma every single time.

Hint:  Get extra hot sauce for the sandwich and make sure to grab a fork for your chili cheese fries.
another delicious cheap eat... well, except their cheese fries.  those are kind of gross.

Bottom line:
ChickenPepper Sandwich. It will make your mouth water with the succulent taste of an American variation of fajitas in a sandwich.

I've had a couple of different sandwiches at IB Hoagies: Cheesesteak, Mushroomsteak, Bar-B-que, and Meatball, to name a few.

Other than the ChickenPepper, I would recommend the Cheesesteak and Mushroomsteak.

Also, recognize that this is NOT a deli. This is a "bomb ass hole-in-the-wall hoagie joint". It has AMAZING sandwiches and that's why people come here! =]

P.S. It takes a while to get your sandwich because they put so much love and culinary talent into making it. haha.

They're okay, not great. Everything tastes better if you get it with bacon; the chili cheese fries used nacho cheese instead of real cheese which made me sad. Have yet to try most of the sandwiches/burgers and i'm not sure if i'll ever get around to it, but i guess it's a pretty decent grease hole.

Can't stop coming back!!

I live not too far away from this spot and I am glad i stumbled upon it... well i am glad my body probably isn't.  The food here while i am sure is terrible for you, tastes so damn good!  And the best part is, it is cheap! Can't go wrong with a 9 inch great tasting sandwich for like $6.

I have been to a few other cheese steak spots in the bay area and this one is by far my favorite so far, keep up the good work!

This place is part of the infamous "Casey U. Tripartite Hangover Cure Extravaganza" and fulfills the category of "Greasy-ass food". Because of the trek on BART, I usually only come resort to coming here in the event that my hangover is at a level four or above (i.e. the day after drinking an entire bottle of gin, bourbon or vodka). 

My recommended hangover cure is a regular Italian-Steak with an order of chili-cheese waffle fries (!!!) with extra peppers and hot sauce. The food is good, cheap and greasy enough to turn me from a member of the living dead into something resembling either the Golem of Prague or a Classics Major. 

After eating this particular meal, my slightly less miserable, still hung-over ass usually feels good enough to take the other two parts of the my cure: a long nap in the sun (for the metaphysical hangover) and a banana split (to get the necessary fruit to turn my post-hangover meal into something resembling part of a well-balanced diet).

GUT BOMB!

Grad student tranquilizer. Digestive stress tester. Oily sheen coater.

Oh, so, so bad and so, so good.
Hoagies are decent at best... their fries are great but what brought this down to 2 stars was that I found a hair I think twice in my hoagie -.- GROSS.... never again

Ib's exists for those times where you don't know what to eat but you know it can't possibly be good for you.

Some evening I will find myself in Berkeley as the sun is setting I will feel the hunger pangs in my gut as though I have become pregnant with the lord's child, and since I am a man and do not want to engender curiosity  for being pregnant I will head directly to Ib's and attempt to kill the hungry one inside me with a cup of their chili-cheese fries. 

Which is to say, Ib's is delicious while you're eating it but has a gut rot factor that is directly proportional to how good it tastes. If only my stomach was made of the same metal that houses that deep frying oil, I  would have nothing to worry about ever, well except for having a metal stomach.

Italian Combo Hoagie
A bit pricey. Good toasty bread and tons of meat, but way to salty. Definitely kept me from enjoying the sandwich.

i will do a re-review after i try a cheesesteak or the fries.

Okay, under different circumstances I would've given this place a 4 or 5 star rating.  I mean, their hoagies are very good, and the chili cheese fries are okay.  But today, I give them 2 instead because of the horrible service I got.  I ordered a large cheese steak with everything on it, and a guy walks in a few minutes after me and orders a large something also.  A few more minutes later, the girl that takes the orders hands the other guy my sandwich, at which time he begins to take out all the lettuce, and the tomatoes off MY sandwich.  

Then the guy in the back who makes the sandwiches looks at me and then says something quietly to the girl, so I walked up to the register and say, "You gave him my sandwich right?  I figured."  The guy says sorry.  

The girl totally has no idea what's going on, or is just denying that she messed up.  She doesn't even say a word to me, like nothing ever happened.  So it takes another few minutes to get the hoagie meant for the other guy.  (If you've been there you know they don't make them fast)

The girl hands me the sandwich, still doesn't say a word, like nothing even happened.  I shoot a look at the guy, and leave the place a little disturbed by the first bad experience I've had at I.B.'s.  Don't get me wrong, the food is great, but I'm glad I can vent a little on Yelp.

Normally I'd be hesitant to eat at a place with "IBS" in the name but when I walked by IB's and saw what people were eating I stopped dead in my tracks.

*The cheesesteaks are awesome, cheese soaked and served on toasty buns. The large cheesesteak could feed 2 people easily. But it's not a Philly style cheesesteak - this is actually chopped steak and real cheese, not frozen flattened steakum and cheese wiz with a side of yelling and impatience. Honestly - the cheesesteaks in Philly are mediocre at best.

*They have curly fries, garlic fries, chili/cheese All food is fresh and cooked to order, even the fries!

*The service is fast, very friendly and they accept credit cards! There's a parking deck nearby for those who don't live work near campus.

The only con of this place is that a large cheesesteak is probably 1500 calories (just a guess) and if you eat here frequently you probably wouldn't be able to fit through a door.... maybe that's why IB's has no door?

Sorry Ib's... you get a 4. The Cheesesteak Shop gets a 5.

I think the meat here is too much like real meat. Ok. Weird comment... Lemme explain. If i want an unhealthy, fatty, cheesy cheesesteak, I want it made with delicious, tender, damn-that's-good-i-wonder-what-kind-of-meat-that is-mystery-meat. Yes yes... pretty nasty. But seriously... for example, at McDonald's, you sure as hell aren't tasting any Grade A ground chuck in those burgers! Cheap greasy eats should use cheap greasy meats! Ib's... you're meat is just too... meaty for me. Flavor is damn good though and the large is HUUUUGE!

Chili cheese fries. Order them.

Sidenote: Don't drink their "lemonade" from the fountain. It's weird....

God, my arteries hate me after eating here. It's such a greasy, guilty pleasure, but that's why it can only happen a once or twice a year. 

I'm not a huge fan of the hoagies, they're decent at best. The meat and toppings are well-grilled, but I wish the bread was crispier -- they got soggy waaaay too fast. I'm a fan of the Italian Cheese Steak which has a splash of marinara all up on the meat, cheese, and onions. And just a heads up, things get mighty messy when you eat the hoagies, everything gushes out onto your face and hands. As for their burgers, I have indulged in a bacon burger once or twice and surprisingly enough, they're pretty good!

The real star here? THE SIDES. You got curly fries, french fries, tater tots, onion rings, and then you got the option to smother those bad boys in chili cheese, plain ol' nacho-ish cheese, garlic, or just eat 'em nekkid!
