First time I went there and the pizza was good.  I liked it better than Blondie's. They had a variety of pizzas to choose from and it is thick crust which I like.  Since the place is in Berkeley on Telegraph it also has it down sides.  Everyone of the tables in the seating area was dirty and homeless people not begging but harassing you for food or money. I still will go back since it is close to Ameoba records and Rasputin's.
Their pizza is addicting. I don't really like pepperoni pizza or pizza at all.  For some reason I can't stop thinking about their pepperoni pizza. =p
my review is more of the same. good eats for cheap - it's telegraph so if its pizza you're after you got either fat slice or blondies - i vote fat slice.

The pizza is decent and what to expect for a quick and dirty slice. The pizza is fat, greasy and with a rather typical taste.

Now, if you eat the pizza at the place, you will have to fend off the odd beggar asking for a slice. If you decide to take it with you, you still have to fight off the odd beggar asking for a slice. This happens every single time I visit. Just keep that in mind, and if you're hungry, leave your conscience behind.

Fat Slice, how do I love thee?  Let me count the ways....

I love the cheese, so unassuming
I love the pepperoni, a little something extra
I love the special, always an adventure.

And you provide enough carbs to let me continue indulging for a while.  I promise you I won't get pizza anywhere else on Telly....

Can I get some pizza with that cheese?

If you like sauce on your pizza, go to Blondie's.

The fat, floury crust tastes like osteoporosis.
Great pizza - tons of cheese, and the veggie slices are loaded down with vegetables.

The GF & I came to Telegraph for Cream but we wanted to grab a little bite to eat beforehand. Fat Slice was pretty, damn good!

-- B R I E F  S U M M A R Y --
-- Berkeley parking sucks
-- If you can park on Channing in the church parking $1.00/30mins
-- FAT SLICES
-- Place is similar to Blondie's
-- Slices were a bit dry but still had good taste
-- $10 for 2 slice and 2 sodas

It's been so long so I've been on Telegraph, seriously. We came here around 7ish on a Saturday night and instantly remembered why I never come to Berkeley. It's worse than SF, lol.

Bad drivers, bums, and no parking!

Anyways we scored a paid parking garage for a buck, and it gave us an hour, even though the signs said a buck for 30 mins.

Fat Slice was pretty dead, we just had to wait for some teenagers to pick their damn slices. They have like 3 pizzas that are out for your viewing pleasure. They have specials and etc on the big board.

We ended up with 2 slices of pepperoni and 2 sodas for about $10. The slices were legitimately FAT which means a lot of crust. The slices could have used a little bit more sauce but they were still pretty good. The slice was more than plenty for each of us. 

I'd definitely come back here again if I'm in Bizerkely but probably not lol. It's really out of the way and a hassle to get to with parking and such.
Fairly tasty pizza that I eat when I'm not feelin Blondie's lines. Its a basic dirtty hole in the wall, but who cares since you take your slice to go (hopefully)

First time coming here and was debating on here or Blondies...we picked here! 

Its normal cheap pizza to me, and being a pizza lover I am, this spot wasnt for me!!! You get what you pay for, and I rather pay for better quality....

I got the pepperoni and mushroom, had to wait about 10 min. for our food, the place in the back where seating is, is dirty, I felt like I didnt want to touch anything, and if I'm feeling like that about the seating area I can only imagine the kitchen.

My choice, go pay for better quality!!!

Gigantic slices. Cheap. GOOD.

Can you say "2.50 for dinner"? Yeah. The slices are huge.

A Fat Slice = almost a quarter of a pizza. They're huge!

The pizza here is more doughy than Blondie's, so if pizza crust and base is your thing, you should pick Fat Slice. The toppings are pretty standard, and it's open late.

Not especially mind-blowing, but it gets the job done if you need a quick bite to eat or are craving some pizza. Good value for your money.

The fattest, greasiest, and overall most indulging pizza you will find in Berkeley. There's a reason they're open later than most business on Telegraph, and that is to serve the hammered hungry students of Berkeley.

I don't know about everyone else, but on nights when I've spent a good hour or so across the street at Raleigh's, I get ridiculous munchies, and Fat Slice came to the rescue on my last night in Berkeley. 

There's nothing like biting into a piece of pizza that you know would kill you in less than a month if you ate it for every dish daily. The thick layers of cheese, the greasy pepperoni, the thick but perfectly soft crust. Top it off with some parmesan and and you've got one sloppy fulfilling mess.

I will miss you Fat Slice. Stay hungry, my friends.
When I used to go to UC Berkeley, I ordered from this place a lot.  Only reason ths place gets a 4 instead of a 3 is because they deliver, and my friends and I had pizza delivered quite often.

More like focacia topped with cheese.  I definitely enjoyed it more when I indulged in reefer and stumbled the streets of Berkeley as a drunken undergrad.  But after having good pizza and growing a gut, Fat slice just isn't worth the empty calories anymore

It lives up to it's name. If you ask for an individual slice you're given one hell of a huge, fat, thick slice of pizza. I had the pepperoni, which was nothing special but nevertheless awesome since there was so much of it. I wish I had tried the veggie, that looked packed full of toppings. 
Oh, but the slices aren't as dense or heavy as it looks so there really wasn't AS MUCH food as I thought it was going to be. Pretty light eating for a pizza.
So, the foods OK, there's nothing interesting about the place itself, and I have no good reason to give it more than a 3.
Usually dirtttttttttttttttttttty!!!!  but i don't eat in! great pizza! the slices used to be bigger, but still taste just as great!! YUMMM!! i want me some fat slice right now!

The original. The best. So fat and so delicious!!!

Suck it, blondies!

This pizza. Is amazingly satisfying. But then comes the price shock. I'm just not ready to pay nearly $4 for a slice of pizza (almost 400% more than Cheeseboard, which gives you 2 slices). I just can't justify paying that much for a slice of pizza for that price, no matter how satisfying it is.

Review of the food without consideration for price: great food, the dough is actually really really good, it's a thick dough, not cooked too much so it's not super crispy. It's much more of a fluffier crust which goes really really well with all the greasy cheesy toppings. It just soaks it up.

Final decision: it's really good pizza, but just not worth $4. I could get an entire large crappy pizza from Little Ceasar's for almost the same price. So, if you don't care about your budget or your waistline, this is perfect for you. I would just recommend that being so near a campus, it's also important to serve this campus community better being more sensitive to the college student's budget.
This is not the greatest pizza in the world, but when you get out of a late movie hungry for something other than Japanese or Thai, this is the spot. Cheap slices served up hot, can't complain.

fat slice holds a special place in my heart... and my stomach... i would have died in college had it not been for delicious fat slice pizzas delivered at midnight to our dorm. this was back when the dining commons were serving us prison-grade food, or worse... (but i've heard that cal dc food is actually good now, can it be true??)

nothing satisfies better after midnight than a fat slice of chewy crust topped with gooey cheese and lots of pepperoni dripping with golden amber grease... my favorite slice of fat! then and now!
large slices!! loaded with cheese and toppings.. And yes greasy, but good... staff is kind of unfriendly but they have tazo peach tea and thats my fav... cheap priced pizza...
Best pizza ever. This is a must have whenever I go to Berkeley. Slices are huge and extremely great tasting. Makes my mouth water whenever I think about it.

Good for what it is.  2 pizza places near the southside of the berkeley campus. this and blondies.  the lowdown here is that it's fat - like the name.  it's wide and thick b/c it's doughy.  if you're looking for NY style, this isn't it.  my favorite is just a cheese or pepperoni as long as it's hot out of the oven.  

best time to eat one is when you need a quick bite.
its a ritual-go to berkeley, eat at Fat Slice. Big (Fat) slices, nice and cheap. .

Don't get excited by those big juicy looking fat slices waiting for you, they're big greasy over-cheesed constipating cholesterol heart attack trans fat death bombs waiting to kill you. No craft, gourmet, skill, or love seems to be put into it. They're just there. Sitting, waiting. Pure evil this pizza is. 

Okay, if it's raining out and it's 1am and you're starving it's perfect, but it's like your only option if you don't want to walk a block. 

The 80's neon ambiance is equally frightening and strangely alluring. Actually it's mostly pretty terrifying.
its a fat slice.  can i say ass on here?  if so its a fatass slice for 3 bucks.  i enjoy the flavor and the crust.  I have been eating it since i was just starting puberty.

Yes'm I did get a fat slice of pizza.  This was fast, cheap and easy.  Lunch for me and the boyfriend was under $9 for two veggie slices and a shared (orange) soda.

These Veggie Slices are true veggies.  Layered with red and green bellpeppers, onions, mushrooms, spinach (did I detect some parsley?), sliced tomatoes, zucchini and EVEN peas and corn bits!  Wow, a whole salad on top of doughy crust.

Too bad the dough kind of was lacking.  Tasted like I made my pizza on a, gasp, Safeway brand sweet baguette.  If they worked on their crust, added more cheese to hold the toppings together, and were more generous with the sauce, then the pizza would be superb.  Good try and great for our cheap date.

Also, the tables in back were typical college state.  I'd expect this kind of slobbery from inside a community college's cafeteria but not from an established business.  However, since they cater to college students I guess I can't really complain and I also don't want to admit how Old I feel.
I have to say that I'm a Fat Slice fan over Blondies.  Solid pizza for visiting friends or watching a sporting event at the land of the Golden Bears.

The best hands-down pizza by the slice place around.

I love the greasy...heart attack special comments..LOL...ummm yeah pizza isn't healthy. You go here to sober up or before massive drinking hoping the crust will soak up the alcohol!

I like the veggie pizza...even though I'm not a big veggie anywhere else...i do pick off the tomatoes...I'm not mature enough yet to eat them =P

Barf and barf. God I may be an east coast pizza snob but this pizza is totally inedible. Why do I want to eat a DONUT with pizza toppings. Seriously the dough is so sweet and the crust is so.... fat... yuck. The sauce also has way too much sugar and no taste. The cheese is like rubber. I don't know what that is but it is not pizza.
well, it's cheap and filling.  perfect if you're poor, young, and hungry.....

I used to come here when I was back in high school.  It was yummy then, but I was a poor teenager, so who gave a crap?   Well much time has passed since then, and now I'm a poor grad student.  Anyhow, I came home for a visit and my bro and I decided to go all nostalgic and spend the day on telegraph.  While it seemed that many of the shops on telegraph have changed, Fat Slice is still awesome!  I had a slice of Pesto pizza today and it was FANTASTIC.  Oh my god! I want another slice RIGHT NOW.  Anyone? No?  Fine... Anyhow, the pizza is still delicious.  The crust is nice and crisp on the outside but soft and warm in the middle.  The flavors are great, and it's still hella cheap!  While I was disappointed in Telegraph overall, the whole day was salvaged by Fat Slice.  Hooray for diet-busting pizza.

True funny story: During my freshman year of college, my roommate and I used to notice that fat slice would promote a slice of pizza with a drink for only $2.00 at random times in the daily cal (berkeley's school newspaper). Well one day, when the promotion was on, my roommate came with 500+ school newspapers and handed me a pair of scissors....that night after a flurry of cutting, we had secured our stash of low cost, late night dinners and snacks for the rest of the semester. Oh yeah, I gained 15 lbs that semester too.

On with the review: 
The slices are greasy, they're $4 without the coupon, and charge you 25 cents for a box if you want to take it home semi-decently (and not on a wax paper which the oil soaks through in about 5 seconds). Get some napkins and pat that sucker down, give your heart a break. 

They have 3 traditional pizzas they sell by the slice, pepperoni, cheese, and veggie. Ask the guy for some water instead of a soda if you want something to wash the grease with and not pay the extra $2....he'll hook you up with some ice and water from one of the ghettoist water pitchers around...i recently went back and I think it was the SAME one i saw from back in my freshman year 8 years ago....at least the water's cold so you can't quite taste if there's too many minerals or toxic chemicals or what not....

All in all, it won't kill you (unless you have a weak heart), it can create a great sentimental feeling, and it draws in plenty of starving college kids who hate the cafeteria food day after day if you decide not to partake. So screw you if you don't like it. (fat slice's quote, not mine)

I don't care, Fat Slice still gets 5 stars from me. For the past 20yrs I've been enjoying my slice of veggie or pepperoni here & there. Still nothings changed. The grunge ambiance, the locked shakers on the counter, and the site of seeing a pepperoni getting pulled out of the oven in front of you! Ahhhhh, love it! Whether you stay & have a slice with a cold bud in the back with the loud screaming transients or you take it to go it's a winner in my book. AND will always be!! ** (a box is free with 3 slices or more, otherwise $.50)

I'll keep this short. On a scale of 1 to 5. 1 being Little Ceasars and Dominoes, Fat Slice comes in at a 2. 

Pros: 
- Big ass slices
-Generous on the toppings

Cons:
-Thick ass crust
-Nothing stands out
-Lack of flavor

End.

Fat Slice certainly lives up to its name -- the slices are FAT! It's affordable and the pizza comes out really quickly.

Although it isn't the cleanest of atmospheres, the records displayed on the walls make up it.  They have old school vinyls from the hippie era (lots of hippies actually go there...haha!) and it's actually fun looking through them.

They have beer, which is a plus! :D

Of someone cleaned their tables more than once a day they would get 5 stars. Thier pizza is great, what blondies used to be, greasy, 9 lbs of cheese per slice and a nice thick crust. When I want thick crust, this is where I go, plus open very late! But clean the damn place more than once a day.

You place your order. You wait about 30 seconds. You get your pizza, add your toppings, and either eat standing up or at one of the back tables. Pizza, beer, and soda. The place is nothing fancy, and neither is the food, but it hits the spot. I recommend the vegetarian.
the absolute fattest slice in town
Good and greasy. Cheap. What more to say. Awesome. Love how it fits with the college town atmosphere soo very perfectly.

Late night Fat Slice helped me survive through some grueling all-nighters freshman year in architecture school at Cal.  Fat Slice also helped me attain Freshmen 20 status.  Those old coupons they had were like gold to us living in the dorms.  I must apologize to the delivery boys and girls who we tipped with our starving college student chump change.
Best slice of pizza on telegraph! The veggie slice is awesome.

FAT slice lives up to it's name.
Always a Berkeley bear's savior when it comes to starving drunken nights with no place to eat or drive. Fat Slice to the rescue. Slices big enough to stuff you back into the dorms. Alive. 

I'm not a fan of pizza, but it was never a disappointment and it was cheap and hefty. Good enough for me.

Hello Fat Slice, 

We come to every Cal game, (Go Bears!), so please don't roll your flippen eyes at my kids when they take a minute to order. They are the reason we come to your pizza place. Consider the fact that we also come to Fat Slice everytime we are in Berkeley. 

It is hard for them to decide when you only have one pizza in the window. WE are understanding about the fact that you are busy and we have to wait... maybe you should extend the same courtesy to your regular customers. 

I would rather be around the corner with my philly. That said, 

I DO LOVE THIS PIZZA. They lose two stars for being mean to my teenage boys.

Gooey, greasy, dripping with oil, kind of soggy... their pizza is NOT really good when you actually stop to critique it, but for some reason I have a thing for this place.  The restaurant is always pretty filthy, it makes you wonder how it passes health inspections, but it hasn't made me sick... yet.  I can't remember exactly how late it's open, but it's still serving past last call. It's cheap, and it hits the spot after a night of drinking.

My favorite pizza slice in Berkeley.  I'm a big fan of their specials usually, but they also do a great pesto slice, which you can get almost everyday.  You can always get a hot custom-topped slice, and my favorite combination is the pesto with sausage.  Not as greasy as Blondie's.  More seating too.   

And Dr. Joke-mon is usually outside telling jokes.

Fat Slice is my favorite pizza joint hands down!  Although there are some shady characters there the soft fluffy top of the crust and the and the crispy yet firm bottom of the crust is so delicious that its worth getting harassed by homeless guys and run away teens begging for money.  I personally like the plain old cheese pizza.  The portions are huge and they put A LOT of cheese on each slice.  I would give it five starts but parking can be a bitch and it can get pretty crowded in there.  Fat Slice blows Blondie's out of the water!  There is no comparison there!  

Fat Slice is the place for pizza in Berkeley!

Fat yes.  Doughy, yes.  

Depends if you like that type of pizza.

this brings me back, i love their pizza, i remembered when the bf and i was just beginning our relationship, we were in high school and did not have that much money. we would get one slice for the both of us and that alone would be get us full. their lines can go out the door so you have to be patient. the only prob i have with them is that they charge a 25cent fee for a box to put your sliced pizza in. but i still cant get enough of their pizza.

I've been here so many times over the years. The pizza is always consistently good so that's a definite plus.To describe the pizza, bigger than your normal slice and very cheesy! Personally I don't like eating there too much because it feels empty and it's not a very "cozy" spot to eat.

Fat Slice is SO GOOD. Prices are super reasonable and perfect for a starving college student. Now they have a crazy discount program called five stars where you buy 10 slices and get 1 slice & soda FREE!!! Looks like the five stars card can be used at nearby Naan n Curry, Tutti Frutti, C.R.E.A.M., Kip's, Joshu-Ya (the saki-bomb place), and Cafe Med as well. Am so excited to see this work :)

The next time I want a lot of grease with a little bit of pizza, I'll go to fat slice. I can't really imagine that happening unless I was on a freezing arctic expedition, so I can say with some confidence I'll never make the mistake of eating fat slice again.
one word - ew!  raw doughy pizza! OK OK more than 1 word

Everyone eats here because it's on Telegraph, but if you just hoofed it a little father you could get better pizza anywhere else. This pizza is on the thick side, which I like, but it's just soggy and nasty. Taste's similar to a frozen pizza, but one that has been sitting on counter for an hour or so. If you're strapped for cash, go buy a frozen "tony's pizza" or 5 for 10$ it'll be way better than this stuff and you'll get more of it.

hell yeah.  this was good stuff.

price is decent, but i love the taste.

For what it is:
A cheap
Thickish, tasty

Slice.
Lives up to it's name.
I thought that they would pop it into the oven for a minute though.
Can't hate on the bar of flavor-
Enhancing-free toppin's a-plenty.

Real Pizza Period, none of that thin crust stuff.

Have to try any of the special pizzas with Blue Cheese, so good.

Very yummmm pizza. I've only eaten from there really late at night and the atmosphere is pretty chill... Delish pepperoni and ham pies. If you like Blondie's... then you'll like Fat Slice. I'm hecka hungry now.

We're not talking food for royalty here (unlike a decent In-N-Out Double Double), but bear with me.. If the Fat Combo had a genesis myth, it would go something like this:

"And the Lord said unto Moises, 'Build thee a crust of remarkable height, breadth, and width, strong enough to bear the weight of a great burden, yet yielding to the softest of palates.  Anoint it with a sauce of tomato, and adorn it with a fine coat of mozzarella.  Call forth two of every vegetable, and seven of every delicious and savory meat on Earth, and stack them, one upon another, until thy work has stretched nigh to the gates of Paradise itself.  And ye shall call it the Fat Combo.'  Moises did as God had commanded him.  And it was Good."

Everything else there is very "Meh"; but I'm feeling generous:  5 stars for the Fat Combo, the Lord's great and terrible Instrument to strike down the gluttonous (albeit in sheer delight).  That's averages to about a 4 if you're scoring at home.

Oh, and God, in case you're an avid Yelper, I'm sorry for the gratuitous use of  Your Name without Thy Express Written Consent.
/Catholic guilt

Don't come here expecting anything more than a doughy, greasy, and cheeeeeeeesy slice of pizza.  Mmmm....cheeeeese.  For the price, it's decent.  

But whenever Fat Slice has $1.75/slice coupons in the Daily Cal, grab 'em and go!!!

If you need something to fill you up real quick, go to Fat Slice. It's a great deal on its own, but UC Berkeley students can reap an extra benefit. Students who can get hold of the Guide to the Good Life will find great coupons for $1 off a slice, which makes this a huge bargain!

Nobody in their right mind would say that this is the highest quality, most delicious pizza on the West Coast. But hey, if you're staggering by on Telegraph Avenue starving after a long night at the bars (or a long morning of class, whatever), it's wonderful to pop in.

I usually cross my fingers that the special that day is appealing... the cheese pizza is a bit *too* cheesy for me and the pepperoni is too greasy. I like the veggie pizza and most of their specials... they just taste more balanced.

Every time I go anywhere near Berkeley, I have to stop at Fat Slice. This place is delicious at any hour. 

It is good to hear that they take debit/ATM now.

Overall, it is one of the better pizza slices I have ever had. 

But my pizza slice experience is relegated to the big chains, so I haven't had very many dive pizza slices.

Yet another Berkeley favorite! Great place to get a fat slice of greasy pizza! This place has some nice tasting pizza! The back room has some wonderful, unique graffiti on the tables that you can admire as you eat your fat slice!
Fat slice is an understatement. I liked this place for my first time. I don't really like sitting inside, it was a tad fragrant when I went. GOOD pizza though & friendly staff.

Fat Slice is okay, like Blondie's... to be honest, they don't taste that different to me.

If you want damn good pizza, go to Zachary's.  Now that shit is good pizza.
Pizza wasn't that great. I'm not one to write bad reviews but, the place was a mess. The bathroom was even worse! It was like ordering pizza then peeing in a rest stop in the middle of nowhere.

True that price is cheap for a quick eat and the slices are huge...

BUT I find the slices so terribly greasy!  Blah!  I've tried simple cheese and pepperoni slices but the grease was so unsettling in my stomach.  I prefer to eat at Blondie's instead where they have relatively less greasy and more healthy options.

I will say when i walked into this place i was very hesitant on getting a slice of pizza. This place was straight up ghetto inside. white walls w/ very low sealing and tagging everywhere. But you cant always judge a book by it's cover, the pizza was so good! Next time I'm in down town Berkeley i will for sure come here again.

A big honkin' cheesy fat grease-fest.  You can definitely feel fat and GET fat by eating at Fat Slice.  They do, however, give you a big generous greasy slice of 'za for your money.  Prices have risen with the times - but back in the day (for me that's circe 1992-95) it was a great place to go after a drinking-smoking binge and cure those nagging munchies/

This is not gourmet pizza.  It is a gut busting experience - and nowadays just not my cup of tea.  (Or should I say slice of pie??)

Fat Slice is everything it promises to be. You get a HUGE fatty slice of pizza on the cheap, and it comes with like 50 grams of fat too, so I guess it's name has a double meaning. But it's super great when you're walking home from the bars drunk and need to get that midnight snack in! Many fond memories of this place.

Love this place, how can one complain about the huge piece of pizza at such low cost?! 

Can't wait to get a slice again... mmm ... even talking about it is making me hungry...

Leaving Blakes the other night I discovered this pizza by the slice place next door. At first I balked at the $3.79/slice price after tax, which seemed a little high. However, on closer inspection I realized that the slices were a pretty decent size and also nice and thick.

I bought a slice of vege pizza. It was excellent, and I wasn't fully inebriated (only slightly). Will be back. Will buy another vege. Will not try the meat topping pizzas, because they cost more and don't meat my cost-benefit analysis chart. And by chart I mean I'm cheap and the vege slice is bigger (thicker) for less money.

I've been to this place a number of times during my adventures in Berkeley. It was always the go to spot for quick, filling and decent food for cheap..although I do feel like prices might have gone up a bit, seemed more expensive (but still pretty cheap). 

It's hard to get a solid review of this place seeing as the business and pizza are both inconsistent. 

What I'd normally get when I come here is the veggie and pesto pizzas. The pesto is good but the pizza as a whole doesn't sing to me. I always love the veggie though, so I'll probably just stick to that whenever I come here. 

The customer service has never really impressed me. Last time I went in there the guy made it seem like it would be too much of a hassle to add tomato to my pizza (was getting the special of the day). He was telling me how the pizza is already made, but seriously dood, you're about to reheat that shit up anyways so I don't see why you can't add like 3-4 friggin tomato slices..but whatever -_- 

Their special of that day was a pesto pizza with chicken, bacon and bell peppers. Sounded orgasmic, however was very disappointing. There was maybe 4 little pieces of bacon on my entire slice..and the pesto? Couldn't even tell it was on there! 

Their crust is decent, nothing special. I mean for what it is (cheap-er, fast, fat slices of greasy pizza) it's really good, definitely not something I'd suggest someone go out  of their way to try good. BUT if you're already on telegraph and on a budget, I would suggest you go here, it will definitely fill you up!

When I'm looking for an exceptionally oily slice of pizzer, I come here. I think Blondie's down the street is an overall better option, but I feel like the pizza at fat slice is usually more "fresh" than some of the stuff at Blondie's. I stick with the slice of pepperoni.

Expected bill: $4.

Great pizza! Blows blondies out of the water(and I like Blondies too) The price is right and the za' is str8 grubbin. The stoners probably love this place, but I dont have to be high to crave some fat slice......get it everytime i'm in Berk

I've been to fat slice a number of times the pizza is ok ,a bit greasy tho .. the restaurant is so dirty theres junk everywhere newspapers graffiti an half eaten pizza on the tables. but, what really grinds my gears at this place is i was with my friends six of us and we all got pepperoni slices and soda combos it was over 20 dollars and we were a penny short .the guy who work there really thought about not let it slide it actually was so bad that the people behind us heard the conversation and handed us a penny .. i was so embarrassed over a penny . i really wish these places weren't so stingy ...

Ok if you ever go to Berkeley and you like pizza then you have got to check this place out. It's near the UC Berkeley campus so parking is gonna be a challenge, but I'm telling you it's well worth it. The pizza is very moderately priced and because it sells so fast it's always fresh and oh so delicious. Their idea of a slice is actually 2 slices which you will find out is very filling. So if you're ever in Berkeley check them out.

Telegraph landmark. I've been cloging my arteries here off and on since 1994. Used to be able to sit in the back patio area. That was great. The place is always really dirty, but that kind of adds to the charm. You can get a slice and a soda with the loose change you have in your pocket. Slices are more than generous. Great, great spot!

Fat slice got better, the veggie got soooooooo much better now, I remember it used to look all gross and blehz, but now it's soooo goood, taken my Dad there for his birthday(what a good son I am?)
It was pretty good, huge slice compared to Blondie's, hopefully coming back again:)

My first experience with Fat Slice was as a teeny-bopper 7th grader, riding B.A.R.T. & ending in cheap pizza heaven.  The first pizza I tried was pesto, recommended by a friend & also regular.  Pretty darn good.  Since, I've always ordered the veggie.  & it is quite a fat slice!  This place is great if you're not watching your figure.
You cant go wrong with fat Slice. This and Blondies was the epitome of my high school years.  Cheap, huge slice of pizza.

Fat Slice, I found you when I was drunk coming from Blake's some random night. While I don't remember ANYTHING that happened that night, I do remember eating some fat ass pizza at Fat Slice. Since then, I've come back to Fat Slice sober and have been pleasantly pleased. 

I switch between Blondie's and Fat Slice and to be honest, I really can't tell a difference between the two of them drunk or sober. I'd just have to say that Fat Slice has fatter slices but not by much. Fat Slice is also greasier than Blondie's but a wad of napkins can fix that up anytime. 

The only thing that I hate about the place is how it looks like a New York City subway inside and how I feel like I'm going to get shanked anytime I bother to sit inside and eat. Throw in the Berkeley hobos from Telegraph and some annoying high school kids that are either from Berkeley High or visited Cal and it's definitely a place I'd rather not be. Yet somehow I still find myself coming back...

Fat Slice is the best unpretentious pizza on Telegraph (not in comparison to the likes of Zachary's, The Cheese Board, etc.).  It brings you back to the days of eating good arcade pizza in Chuck E Cheese's.  It's a huge piece of pretty generic pizza: a lot of cheese, a thick crust, and lots and lots of oil.  There's nothing particularly flavorful or of quality in Fat Slice, but if you're craving FAT, GREASY, DELICIOUS pizza, swing by Fat Slice for just that.

I went here once and ordered a slice of vegetarian pizza.  The pizza was just mediocre.  The crust was burnt and too hard, and the toppings weren't as good as at Blondie's.

I have a lot of friends who like this place, but based on my one visit I don't thing that Fat Slice is even average.
Love the pizza here!  The cheese is nice and thick and....yeah, it's just damn good.  Try it =D

Pretty big slices of pizza, I got a veggie and it was yummy. A little cold for my liking but still okay. Slice of pizza and soda for about five dollars which isn't bad at all. The tables and counters could have been cleaner but I can't complain about that when there's hobos yelling outside. Would come back for a quick bite to eat.

Fat Slice is always a nice respite from record store shopping (rasputin, amoeba). The Philadelphia Lorenzo's of the West. One slice is more than enough. Doughy and hot and perfect. Quick and easy. And I love their logo.
First time there and it was great! Price is not bad. The only draw back is the sitting, but other then that the pizza is Gooood!!! Go check it out!

I love the pizza but it gives me serious diarrhea, and it's really hard to find a clean public restroom on Telegraph Ave. to take a dump. Thank goodness there's Blodies Pizzeria down the street! (No runs there!)
The slices are huge hence the name Fat Slice.  It's perfect for when you're on the go and you don't really have time to eat.  You'll get a heart attack though if you ate this stuff everyday.

Someone needs to get these guys bigger plates, my slice is hanging off the edge!

There are definitely better tasting pizzas out there, but this place takes a slice of the pie. For the low cost, giant portion, and decent taste, it is worthy of 4 stars for what it is; a college town pizza joint for the "broke-and-spent-all-my-money-on-tuition-and-books-because-the-government-is-constantly-cutting-funds-for-education" type of person.

You honestly can't beat the price, and the pizza is incredible.  LOTS of oil... but if you are ordering a pizza, you probably are not trying to watch your weight.  The place is pretty dirty, but what do you expect?

Main Tip: Stand in front of the window when eating.  Its free entertainment.

YUM!  Fat a$$ slice of pepperoni...oooey goooey and not skimpy on sauce or pepperoni slices.  Soda and a ginormous slice of pizza for 4 bucks?  Shoot, can't beat that!

Don't forget to sprinkle on the garlic powder and red pepper flakes.  Oh, and grab a fatty stack of napkins cuz you're gonna need hella to wipe the grease off your fingers...and to soak up some of the extra on the pizza itself.
i eat here almost everyday i work! thanks for being my fallback food!

Come for the Cometbus experience: ask the help to spit on your pizza. They'll look at you funny, but they'll be too self-conscious to do it. If you don't ask them, you're taking your chances. Don't laugh at the punked out teens. They actually are homeless, or mentally ill, or both. Give them a slice, or a quarter, and they'll stop looking at you.

A gimmick that works. 

They're big slices of thick pizza-like objects. I refuse to call it pizza, because they're almost like focaccia bread. 

This is a good place to go when you're hungry, don't have much to spend, and don't care about the amount of fat intake in one sitting.

Always an smart choice to nosh on if you are consumed by extreme hunger!! The slices here will definitely satisfy any incurable crud craving! I remember a friend of mine ate two slices and got really sick! What an idiot! Some of my most nostalgic memories of wondering the streets of telegraph with friends in high school and eating at fat slice as a means of our destination. Youth... how I do miss the freedom!

Delicious!!!! Yum Yum Yum!  Way better than any other pizza spot I know of.  Slices are not only big, but theyre thick!! The only thing i dont like about this place is the nastiness of the seating area.  But, its cool, i can stand and eat, or make sure the wax paper stuff is blocking the germs on the table!  This pizza brings back some nostalgia from my childhood...its that good!  however, i think the slices used to be bigger...maybe i was just little then.  wutever, ITS YUMMY!!! TRY IT!

This is a great place to go to get that "Telegraph" feel. The pizza is tasty, filling and cheap. The décor is old psychedelic concert flyers. The dining area and bathroom can be scary, so don't forget the anti-germ hand-wash.

This place is awesome.  I'm from the east coast and hate how I can never find pizza by the slice out here.

The slices are huge and cheap.  It's the perfect place to go for a slice and a beer.

It's late and you need something salty, greasy, fatty, filling and decently priced... Fat Slice is probably your best bet.  The slices are massive with TONS of cheese and TONS TONS TONS of dough.  Seriously, it's feels like a loaf's worth of dough in bread.  This has to be the least healthiest pizza I've ever had in my life.... LOVE IT!

Fat Slice is food.

Yummy.

Just not the best food.


Cheesey and thick, just what you'd like from your friendly fast food pizza joint.

On my first trip to Berkeley i received a recommendation from a CAL student to stop by and eat a slice of pizza from Fat Slice. 

It was a very unique and retro pizza place. I felt like i was transported back to the 70's with all of the vintage records on the wall. My favorite being The Doors! How could your resist Jim Morrison??

It smelled amazing right when i walked in! I ordered a slice of cheese pizza. It was one of the best and simply delicious slice of cheese pizza I've ever had. It definitely hit the spot on that cold and rainy day in Berkeley.

I definitely recommend it to anyone in the Berkeley area. The surrounding area of Fat Slice is also amazing with lots of eclectic shops & restaurants to choose from.

I guess I didn't get the experience everyone else talks about, since I went in after a tour of UC Berkeley in the middle of a Thursday afternoon. The place had an unidentifiable strange smell (strange enough to knock off two stars). Regardless, the pizza was by far the fattest I've ever had. It was pretty good.

I really love the sizes of these pizzas. Pizzas these days are getting smaller because of the hyper awareness towards carbs. I like my pizzas thick. The sauce is also great. It is very convenient to walk off telegraph and get a filling meal.
Thick, greasy layer of cheesiness with a sauce and a fatty underlayer of dough.  Quick, cheap and super hot.  Great way to keep your drinks down.
Second time back, and still as good as the first. My current pic shows my  first time experience. I got a slice + soda (Mtn Dew, since they're a Pepsi joint).

my sister and i have been coming here for over a decade and it is definitely the best slice in berkeley.  the slices are huge, thick and delicious.  a popular spot for students, especially on game day.  do not look for a friendly smile and they only take cash, but that is part of the fun of fat slice.

Being a pescaterian, I always stuck with the cheese slices, but they are possibly the BEST cheese slices I have ever had.  I always expected Fat Slice to let me down at some point, but it never did.  Consistently good with a nice crew working behind the counter, fast service, and an interesting crowd.  

Note: there are only limited places to sit and eat here.   If you're lucky you can get a stool and read the clippings on the wall, but if not, don't worry too much.  You have a plate and a dream of delicious pizza.  You're mobile and you can just wander around Telegraph taking in the madness around you while munching on your delicious slice.

I've been coming here since I was a teen and I really like this place their slices are pretty fat and one slice feels me up! Its a lil dirty in their sitting area not the cleanest and the bathrooms are not that clean either. When ever I take my kids I make sure they wash their hands before and after we leave. We always get the Pepperoni slices and my daughter when she was younger use to get the Veggie slice. Their prices are very cheap I mean $ 2.90 for a fat slice of pizza and a soda now thats a deal to me! We would come here even though it was outta our way but this was the only place we knew of at that time that they had pizza by the slice. All in All this place is good and if I am in the area and want Pizza I rather come here than Blondies!

But if ya think those slices are hella big! Try Pizza House in Hayward those are way bigger and VERY yummier to me than Fat Slice! Check em out!

Still like this place though!

Went here one day because I wanted pizza and I didn't like the daily special at Blondie's. For the same price as Blondie's, this place provides a subpar pizza with way too much grease and a bland crust. The slice of pepperoni I got was very limp and hard to handle with the sheet of parchment they give you to carry it with. Overall, Blondie's and other nearby establishments are better.
Pesto pizzzza!

3.5 stars

Better than a lot of random slices places I've been to in the bay, and the best option in the Telegraph/South Side neighborhood. Otherwise, I'd opt for Arinel's on Shattuck.
Seriously a FAT SLICE. Low quality ingredients but its cheap and one slice fills you up. Orange soda. Cool.

The food is aaaaaamazing!!
but it's not the cleanest place ):
a lot of homeless come in to use the bathrooms and I've seen teenagers throwing food on the ground or other tables.
food is great but i suggest you eat it else where.  Best to go at late nights when its really empty.

I randomly navigated my way here while staying at the nearby Claremont hotel.  I understand how they got the name. LOL.  I had one slice of the combo and could barely finish it.  It was really good.  The crust was not too thick and still had a crispy bottom.  The sauce was nice and light and the toppings were fresh.
+ Cheesy-cheese. Soft pillowy slice of puffy cheese pizza. Not a drop of grease on the bottom. Huge and gooey. One of the best slices I've had in a long time.
It's a FAT slice!

There is a reason this place is called FAT SLICE. You get one FAT slice of FATTY pizza for very cheap. Perfect place if you're on a budget but want to develop FAT thunder thighs.

My hands were dripping with oil after eating FAT Slice. Eating a slice of cheese pizza here is equivalent, in terms of caloric intake and hunger satisfaction, to eating a slice of meat trio supreme pizza anywhere else. The pizza is very delicious and the crust is a thick perfect crunchy-but-chewy texture. I just wish there was a way to drain the oil before consumption.
BEWARE: Pepperoni is extremely greasy

Service is okay, nothing to comment on. FAT Slice doesn't deliver and it's more of a place where you grab a slice and walk down Telegraph munching. The store is very old and needs to be renovated.

WILL I come back: Yes, the pizza is very yummy
WHEN will I come back: When winter is coming and I need to build up FAT reserves or go into hibernation mode
WHAT will I do differently: Grab a stack of napkins
This place is my first destination whenever I head to that part of town. Their pesto pizza is outta site! Personally, I always preferred it to Blondies.

Woahhh greasy, cheesy garlicky pizza! how can u go wrong! I was never a fan of pesto, and couldnt even imagine what it would be like on a pizza but for some reason i decided to give it a shot and LOVEDDDD it. $3 and change for a BIGGG ass slice that will fill u up, great for the broke college student on a budget.

Yummy.  Their veggie is a little better than Blondie's but otherwise Blondie's is the same or better,

love it!
One of the better pizza.  It was as good as I remember it  20 something years ago.  Slices are no longer $1.25.  LOL

pretty gross. not gunna lie. I leave kips drunk and its the only place open so i grab a piece of pizza and eat it and then after im like that was f*cking disgusting. not good quality. at 2 am, youre better off going to bed starving than eating this pizza that tastes like cardboard.

Famous pizza place in Berkeley.  Great veggie and cheese slices for cheap.  Open late.  A few seating inside on the side and in the back part of the place.  Sometimes has some crazy characters inside due to it being late night and in Berkeley!

I recently went back to Fat Slice after a buncha years. It was really good. I had my traditional slice of veggie and my sister had Pesto. I tried both and both were VERY good. The Pesto was suprisingly greasy for having no meat. But still very good. I'm goin back ASAP.

Ohhh, Fat Slice. I suppose since your pizza is crazy cheap and huge I shouldn't be all butt hurt when the dough isn't cooked all the way when I bite into my slice. Alas, that is why I am still giving you 4 stars. If you charged anymore for your heart attack on a plate I might have to second guess my choice. Thankfully, the majority of the times I've been in here it's been clean. I do wish they would invest in paper plates. Maybe they could charge me a little bit more if they did that.

If you're looking for gourmet Emilia's or Cheeseboard-grade pizza, you will be sorely disappointed at Fat Slice.

That being said, Fat Slice is worth visiting because its name captures exactly what you pay for: a slice of fat. The combination of greasy cheese and oil-saturated pepperoni are the perfect compliment to the chewy, thick dough. Definitely not the meal for vegans or the carb/calorie-conscious. The other selection of pizzas are pretty good, with the daily special always an unusual combination of meats and vegetables.

Although my arteries probably can't handle consecutive meals at Fat Slice, I frequent this place whenever I'm in the mood for pizza (but am too lazy to get out of South Berkeley.)

Oh my gosh!  Some yummy pizza.  It's not a fancy place but the pizza is my new fav pizza.  I had a slice of the veggie. Along with the typical veggies, it also came with corn...who heard of corn on a pizza.  But I like trying new things and so I ate the  corn on the pizza and it actually worked.

I got a huge veggie slice for about $ 4 and change.  I bought a box for $0.25 because I didn't want to walk around with my heavy slice on a thin piece of wax paper.  

Definitely would go there again!

If I ever go to Berkeley and I want to get a big slice of pepperoni or cheese pizza,  I go to Fat Slice.

Located right next to Blake's on Telegraph, this place has a great location being next to the many Telegraph bars, cafe's, music spots in Berkeley.

Have Blondie's slices gotten smaller over time or is it just me?  While I enjoy the flavor of both Blondie's and Fat Slice, I prefer Blondie's more.  Fat Slice though is solid, thick pizza.  If you are ever starving and have six bucks, head over to Fat Slice and get two slices.  You should be solid after that.

Quick, cheap and decent flavor. What more do you need in a slice of pizza, right? Right! It does the trick, tides one over till a good balanced meal can come along and it has enough of the staple varieties to choose from to be satisfying on variable moods and palettes. A good place for a quick bite.

the name of this place is quite fitting, I must say.  The slices are indeed FAT!  
-1 star for the dirty bathroom.  However, the pizza made up for that.

For pizza, this place was a disappointment. The crust was too thick which was the most glaring characteristic in an ensemble of bad ingredients. I don't mind grease, but it didn't even taste that good. I ordered one XL pizza with my friends so maybe I had an irregular experience. Still, I can't believe people come back here multiple times.

i wanted pizza at 11 pm and it was fat slice or blondie's. I like blondies but was pretty hungry and fat slice does fill you up. They have good specials of the day and the veggie pizza has lots and lots of toppings. I was completely satisfied!! four stars because they need to clean up the place and if its true that there are mice, EWW!!!

I liken this place to a pizza vending machine. This isn't the cheeseboard. This isn't even pizzahut... well, maybe its a little better... but thats not saying much. However, you can't go wrong with a pizza vending machine. You just have to take it for what it is, I guess.

Always come here after our digging excursions with some leftover money for a slice of pizza. Definitely enough pizza to get full, but get full of what??? I didn't know fat slice served dipping sauce aka the grease that settles at the end of that pizza paper.

Enjoying eating a slice with some cracked out homeless hippie and his dog, or eat it with some hyphy fools on a budget! 

Stick to whatever comes out of the oven at that moment. Otherwise, if you order something special, you'll get a slice of pizza sitting there long enough to be re-warmed with the topping of your choice.

I used to think that this place was great. That was, until, i had Cheeseboard, Arenell and Pie in the Sky. Berkeley has AMAZING pizza. There's no reason to settle for Fat Slice if you're not a tourist who knows nothing other than Telegraph and the campus.  It's convienient, but it's a compromise. Never really liked the cheese there. Kinda flavorless. The veggie slice is their best. Daily specials can be just plain strange.

I'd say, this place is more about quantity than quality. Had a try of the pepperoni and a couple bites of the pesto. For some reason I was reminded of Costco pizza and how much better that pizza was. But, there was a lot of pizza, toppings a-plenty, and fluffy crust if that's how you like your pizza. Not for me though.

cool place, nice enviroment but the pizza could've definitely been better! pizza by the slice is my thing and they didn't satisfy my craving for pizza!  i dont recommend this place for the pizza, just for the experience.

The slices are very big and almost deep-dish like.  A plain slice is about $2.75 which seems about right for how big the slices are.  I've tried both the plain and the pepperoni slices and they are average, nothing special.  It's a good place if you are very hungry late night and need average pizza for an average price.

I've been here a couple of times, but I generally prefer Blondies over them.  The place inside is kind of dark and juts way back into the building.  I prefer Blondie's open seating area.  I've tried two pizzas here.  One was just a regular pepperoni and once I tried their surpreme or special or whatever they call it.  It was basically a slice of vegetarian pizza LOADED with meat and I mean loaded.  That thing was stacked high.  Generally I love things with lots of meat on it but this one had so much that when they heated it up it didn't heat all the way through and I think it was a little too much for me.  I would stick to Blondies, but maybe you'd like this one.  I say at least give it a try.

In Berkeley for the UCLA game, we needed options for a bunch of kids.  What better than Fat Slice Pizza.  No frills and no thrills-fat doughy slices with generous toppings and cheese plus buy a six pack and get a free slice is a great incentive for a bunch of middle aged men to pound a few and remind themselves they're not in college anymore.  Note to management-your beers need to be colder.  Not a bad choice and a popular place on the cheap.

Divine eats! Way better than Blondies. Love the late hours. The slices are "ample" and quite tasty. The back room dining area is a bit under-cleaned, but the pizza is so good, that you won't care. Yum.

Small little joint and good luck finding parking :p

Had their sausage w/black olives and boy was it yummy!! Better than one of my all-time favorite "Blondie's" pizza in SF.  It was chewy, juicy & soft all the way to the crust and you're looking close to $6 for this slice!!

Ok ok ok, I'll confess, I only go here when the line for Top Dog is insanely long.  Mind you, I only go to Fat Slice if I'm super drunk and I can't get a hot dog within 20 minutes at Top Dog.  Therefore, I guess you can say that Fat Slice is normally my last option.  Why did I give Fat Slice three stars?  The pizza is alright and super greasy.  The service is normally fast and they have been the "cherry-on-top" on many of my drunken nights.  I normally get the cheese pizza or pep and I load on the herbs from the shaker.  I think sometimes some hippies throw some real "herb" in there, if you know what I mean!  ;)  Maybe it's just wishful thinking on my part.  Fat Slice, you have won me over . . . only if the line at Top Dog is too long.  =)

The pizza is alright, but yeah, the crust is pretty bland. I guess it's affordable, considering the options around here, but I still don't think a slice of pizza should cost $3-4. They need to do a better job in terms of take out options. If you want to just get a slice to go, you have to buy a huge friggin box for it.

I am a fan of this because hey, I like my pizza cheesy, big and oily. That combination alone makes it more than ok. It's not NY style, but if you're looking to get a bang for your buck and love to use 10 napkins in one sitting, go grab a fat slice.  I had two, in one sitting and I gotta say, the basic pepperoni is a definite winner. Not a clean place, but i'm not picky like that. The food's good, I don't care.

Can I get an order of lard soaked in grease? Well, that is what Fat Slice is. The name sticks to the pizza size you will be getting, but there is nothing special about it. I have never experienced a more greasy slice of pizza-hell a greasy meal like that ever! It is convenient for college students, but I was disgusted by the portion and how greasy it was. However, it was a pretty decent slice of pizza.

Just another pizza place. Good, but nothing that stands out to me. It's average pizza. Seating is an area that looks historically sketchy - lots of graffiti and the feeling of non-cleanliness, but not necessarily in a bad way. Just feels like I'm back in the 70s or something.
good and cheap but nothing special and I feel really guilty eating it

Defintely, not your average pizza slice joint. Whenever I'm in Berkeley, I always gotta pick up a slice of the FAT COMBO. How can all those toppings lay comfortably on top of the crispy crust without breaking it. The FAT COMBO Slice is literally almost a pound. Super cheesy and hits the spot everytime. 

Happy Grubbing!

They weren't kidding when they said FAT slice!  A slice is enough to hold you over until dinner!  If you're close to campus, this is a great place to grab a bite when you're pressed for time.  I feel like their dough is a bit better than blondies.  It's alot softer and not as dense.  It feels alot like your traditional thick crust made right.  That being said, prices are a tad steep by the slice, and their service is pretty lackluster.

PROTIP:  They are open late.

I prefer Fat Slice over Blondie's any day. I usually get the Vegetarian or Cheese and the texture of the crust is crunchy rather than oily and flimsy. The slices are huge, but sometimes they tend to go crazy w/ the cheese and add a little bit too much.

I love fat slice. Any time when I can go in and grab a FAT slice and drink for a few bucks, I'm simply sound. 

I have never had a bad experience here. The guys at the register and cooking are always super nice, and quick to get your order up. 

Any pizza you get here is great, especially the pepperoni and the vegetarian.

I got ripped off by the cashier who took my $20, but claimed it was $10. Since I came straight over from the ATM, it wasn't my imagination. While I was figuring out who to talk to, he walks out to the sidewalk presumably to slip the $10 to an accomplice. The guy couldn't look me in the eye as I was complaining to the manager. You listening Stan Kahan?

I love Fat Slice, i actually prefer it over Blondie's. Fat Slice is literally a fat slice of pizza. It's huge, its like an equivalent to 2 hefty slice of pizza. I can never finish a whole slice. With that said, the only thing that i have to complain about Fat Slice is that they don't always oven/heat the slice of pizza when you order it. 

What makes a delicious pizza is right when its out of the oven, hot and cheesy all over. Yum. Also, it's super convenient and you can head over there at midnight or walk over for lunch. 

Order the pepperoni,  it's classic and probably their best slice.
Ehhhh. I guess my expectations were too high for this place. Two slices and a soda was $10. Nothing special... mehhhh

I used to go to Fat Slice every week when I went to Cal. It's the perfect place for those 30 minute gaps in between class or on the way to an afternoon class. The pizza tastes pretty good, it's cheap, it's fast and the slices are large.

I always get the Veggie Slice. The pepperoni is too greasy, and the cheese to too plain because the sauce doesn't stand out. The veggie slice is loaded with lots of tasty toppings. Obviously it's best to get a freshly made slice, so try to ask when the next pizza is coming out so you can get a hot slice. Or you can ask them to zap your slice for a few minutes in the oven. If you don't, then your old slice ends up being pretty meh.

The forgotten brother to more popular Blondies, Fat Slice is almost as good, if not better in some cases. Fat slices as the name describes, with lots of cheese and toppings. Definitely satisfies the craving for cheesey goodness!
Its cool and open late! After the club pit stop

Nothing could have satiated a Unit 3-residing drunk and hungry college freshman better than Fat Slice.  I owed my Freshman 15 (or 20 :X) almost entirely to this fine restaurant, and I don't regret it one bite.

Fat Slice, you are a starving student's savior. Without you, I would not have a Berkeley degree hanging on my wall. I would be lying lifeless in the gutter on Telegraph, with scents of body odor, patchouli and marijuana clinging to my emaciated corpse. Every calorie absorbed into my pores as grease dripped down my acned face was one more calorie between me and death. I love you. I forgive you for being suspect of jerking off into the sauce. Maybe you did, maybe you didn't, but that's not for me to judge. I don't mind overlooking the filthy coke nail on the hand that gave me back my change; in fact, I came to admire it. I might not remember my Political Economy of Industrial Societies lectures, but I'll never forget your taste in my mouth.

Me, being a teacup, can eat this huge slice of pizza, and it's not that damn bad! I understand what everyone else is saying that Blondies and all tastes better, but I still enjoy it. I usually grab the pepperoni (can't go wrong) and have myself some private time with this gooey pizza slice!

HOWEVER! Do not use the bathroom, it will make you regurgitate what you just ate. No joke.

Listen, most pizzas you're going to have in a college town are going to be disgusting. Might as well drink yourself into oblivion and get the largest slice possible.

Fat Slice knows its place in the universe. I respect that.

I got the vegetarian special one night on my way to a late night work shift. I got it to-go. The vegetarian slice has a lot of various toppings, a plus that I love on my pizzas. It had a good variety, but didn't have the best, which is fresh juicy broccoli and thick diced tomatoes. The best slice of pizza I ever got was the pesto vegetarian from Blondies, which makes Fat Slice's pale in comparison. The only better thing about Fat Slice is its size. Bigger than even a Costco slice. 

Good:
+They have oregano/basil, cheese, and pepper flakes that you can shake on the pizza on the side, which is a plus.
+Cheap and huge slices
+$1 off any purchase coupon on GoodLife.com or something like that

Bad:
-Not restaurant atmosphere. Totally late night, college on a budget, boozey fatty feel. 
-Worst pizza crust in the world. Tastes like pure all purpose flour and water and salt thrown into an oven with toppings. Doesn't even have that dust of cornmeal that other pizza places have that gives a nice mini-crunch to your bite.
-Huge pizza to-go boxes (50 cents extra) that are a waste of space and cardboard. 

Decent pizza if you're hungry. Maybe the fatty cheesy and pepperoni ones are better, but that crust really isn't that appetizing.

Also heard from a friend that she saw a rat scurrying round the place a couple years back...

No pizza is bad pizza.  So just to give you an idea, pizza has to be Red Baron frozen bad for me not to be happy about eating it.

Fat Slice was pretty decent, and what every girl can appreciate, huge!  I thought I could handle two by eyeing it and when the counter girl plated it for me, reality sunk in.  It was tasty eats though for next night on my couch in Idaho.  We drove.

Anyways, cheap, fast, decent, and a big fat chewy crust that any carb connesuir can appreciate.  They could put a rag to the tables a little more often.  It was empty except for a couple of girls at one table, and the table we settled for was the least dirty.

While walking towards this place, you might have to hold your change so it doesn't make noise.  Otherwise, your karma will kick-in and you'll end up giving it to all those who ask for spare change.   The homeless really get creative around this block.  There's a guy with a sign that says "need money for beer."  Another guy usually tells jokes in return for some change.  It's just the part of the Fat Slice experience.  Expect a college crowd atmosphere since it's so close to U.C. Berkley. 

You can order pizza by the slice with an automatic student discount.  The pizza slices are large with a thick crust an lot's of cheese.  They usually have hot n' ready-to-go slices of meat, veggie, or pesto.  If it's packed, you might have to stand and eat.

i haven't had it in a while but i loved fat slice when i was at cal.  i almost never made it there though.  i lived in unit 1 for half of first year and almost any night when sustenance was a compulsion, my friends and i would venture out of my room to make the trek to fat slice. 

it was only 3 blocks away but it always felt really far and usually, we ended up at la burrito since that was the first food establishment we hit (less than a block away).  so we would end up with unsatisfying and mediocre burritos.  

but, when we actually made it to fat slice, after taking a bite,  i would swear that i would never be lazy about getting there again.

nowadays, i'm not really into thick crusts but i give it 3 stars for taste and 4 stars for the memories.

For some reason most people are either Fat Slice or Blondie's people. So you will either love or hate the place. Gray is not an option.  I personally love Fat Slice way better then Blondies. 

Reasons why Fat Slice Rocks:
 
-They offer better coupon deals making a slice and soda under $3. 
-More seating area
-Restroom Graffiti 
-Jokeman panhandler is way better then the gothic/punk runaway kids trickling out of Hot Topic and asking for weed.
-Bigger slices
-Closer to alcohol (Blakes)
-Opened later catering to those Blakes patrons
-It's actually good. 

I mean it's cheap pizza, you can't exactly expect gourmet here... trust me, it's good enough.

If nostalgia could be a slice of pizza, Fat Slice would be it.

This was a staple of my college life.  Ed M.'s got his shit straight about the Blondie's v. Fat Slice thing, but the way I see it is this:

You are either FOR Fat Slice, or you are AGAINST us.  I'll have none of this Blondie's crap.  You're either with us or you're not.

Minus one star for its probable unhealthiness but you just have to expect that of all eateries near college campuses.  You just learn to ignore the grease when you're counting the change in your pocket.

Having lived in Berkeley for 4 years, and lived right by Telegraph, I would have to choose Fat Slice over Blondie's.  One slice is enough to fill me up, and, man, it's so cheesy and greasy - just the way I like it! haha.  Fat Slice now accepts credit/ATM, so no more running to the ATM late at night.  I miss the college days when food was within walking distance and food was cheap!  If you don't care about the ambiance, but just want to eat a FAT slice or two of pizza, then this is the spot!  Say hello to the homeless guys out in the front too.
This pizza is pretty good if you're drunk and deciding between Blondie's and fat slice. I find it very doughy and greasy if we were to compare to the full set of choices.
not good. be like me, only eat this if you are in some type of low blood sugar attack and the box is not avalible.

A Fat Slice does have lots of mass, but it tastes like frozen pizza-- cheap frozen pizza that was defrosted alongside Encino Man. Here's my advice about its curative properties-- after taking 21 shots when you come of age, come here to induce vomiting and prevent alcohol poisoning.

The Hierarchy of Berkeley Pizza proceeds as follows:
Zachary's

(emphasis for wide gap in quality)
Fat Slice
Blondies
Kips.

Official and Confirmed

After breakdancing for spare change on the corners of telegraph.
I mustered enough to chum(p) change to make Eddy murphy proud enough for me to be his stunt double, as if he was in his glory days of the movie "Trading Places".

Now, not to knock blondies which I sincerely believe is the bastard g.f. to rasputin records. I strongly feel you have better quality Pizza for the dollar.

I use to visit here back in my college days, and when. I was homeless, I would literally wait till after they close and recieve a the left over pizza and get down
like the long lost Ninja turtle I am!

For about $3 something dollars you can get a slice of pizza so fat and so greasy
you would reenter puberty. I love this place, and yeah, when I go here I visit C.R.E.A.M. why, because I love junk food.

My only tip is Never, what so ever...EVER USE THIER RESTROOM! YUCK!
It's so nasty what I do in there. :)
Decent pizza at a decent price. All the slices of pizza are indeed "fat". Pizza slices are about $3.50 a piece.

Usually I only like to be positive and rate the ones I really recommend, but I think this merits saying.  Hopefully Fat Slice Mgt can hear.

The pizza--delicious.  Probably my favorite after Manor Room Pizza in Pacifica.

The service--HORRIBLE.  For this reason alone I docked all the stars.  Been there multiple times hoping to give 2nd, 3rd whatever chances.  Every time has been met with counter help that is rude to the point of being antagonistic.  

Have not returned.  Maybe the other locations have better training and management, but I can get pizza elsewhere.  Hold the attitude.

I used to think there was no such thing as bad pizza. You know, even bad pizza is good pizza. And then I had the pleasure of dining at Fat Slice.
It should be called Fat Stomachache.

The place was dirty and dingy---which would have been OK if the pizza was good. I have nothing against holes-in-the-wall. But the pizza was mushy, greasy, and goopy---also really bland. 

Yes, it was cheap, but I'd gladly pay more for something that didn't give me the sensation of having just drunk a quart of motor oil.

Fat Slice is traditional pizza served hot/fresh by the slice or as whole pies if you're partying or working around campus.

For my money, Fat Slice is the best pizza near campus.  Simple slices like pepperoni are always great, they never fail to be tasty and as cheap campus food goes it's right there with the best that Berkeley has to offer.

Not the best pizza available but it's nostalgia on a greasy slice. However, I've always considered this a notch above Blondies. 
I remember I would make it a point to visit Fat Slice Pizza for lunch when I made my trips to Telegraph Ave. I've been coming to this joint since HS and I remember stopping by before going to the used music store a few doors down. They had a great lunch special that included a soda. The veggie pizza was always satisfying and the size of the slice was perfect. I only wish I lived close to Berkeley again to make it out there whenever the heck I want.

one of the place i always have to stop when i'm in town.  great big slices of pizza.

its simple, but good, and filling.

Disgusting and deadly. I wish Fat Slice could be the pizza equivalent of Fat Burger, but no. Nope. Not at all. The pizzas are thick (why?!), greasy (all pizza is greasy, but this was outrageous), and just plain old bad. They also keep their pizzas there for hours because of the lack of customers- after a few hours out of the oven and under the light- that piece of pie looks like a piece of %^#$.  I also suspect its a junk spot. Not kidding... Shady transient types always do a quick roll in roll out all day long.

Nice pizza joint on Telegraph, in Berkeley.  You can choose from Peperoni, cheese, and Vegetarian as well as Daily Specials which vary.  

Pizza is served hot with thick crust/bread that is fresh. I had one of these and it was mouthwatering. Sure it's a little greasy, but hey, it's pizza.  

The eating area in the back isn't fully maintained (table, walls, bathroom). If you decide to eat in, do so in front-usually eat while standing. 

This place is a great late-night after party destination as they are open late, especially when you have partied hard earlier, a fat slice will relieve your stomach and appetite for about $5.

A Telegraph gem, Fat Slice is perfect. The restaurant fits with the overall Berkeley aesthetic--nothing is very clean, nobody will stand on their head to deliver '5-star customer service,' and the walls are adorned with classic and contemporary posters and fliers from great shows and outrageous acts. The staff is pretty apathetic but gets your order done in what feels like half a minute. The pizza is fantastic. A mammoth slice won't cost you all that much, and makes for a great lunch. As a native Southern California, pizza is not very much apart of our culture--we've got everything from Mexican to Thai, but sadly we don't have a proud regional pizza. Going up to Northern California and having a thick cheesy slice made me feel even worse for thinking good pizza is Pizza Hut. If you're in Berkeley and want to try something, I highly recommend Fat Slice.

I went here before I became vegan. The name says it all. These are FAT slices of pizza of all sorts to crave your pizza, fatty, cheesy, pepperoni desires and cravings for a few measly bucks.
Located on telegraph a short walk away from campus and other shopping areas, this place is perfect for grabbing a filling slice to blow your money on everything else on the block.
Nothing fancy, no frills or lace. Just fat slices of pizza. They sell what they advertise. Honest business.
dirty cheap food

this is a huge slice of pizza, esp when you get one that is custom ordered. the pepperoni or veggie are ready to go and delicious, sometimes warm and could use a re-heating. try ordering a tomato-olive, though. they pile on the toppings. sooo good.

I can honestly say Fat Slice got me through my first semester at Berkeley...

eating there..one slice is enough...its pretty fat...enough cheese but not too cheesy...pour some oregano over it and drink it down with a dr.pepper..errr..i mean a Mr. Pibb...all for around $3...

even better...get a couple of your homies and have it delivered to your dorm...costco sized and costco prized, with bigger slices and great tasting...

you cannot pass..big 18 inch 1 topping pizza for $10-$11...2 slices will fill you up

definite must try!!!

This is what I consider the La Burrita of pizza. Its great if you're drunk/stoned and you want pizza and all other options (Fat Slice) are closed. Workers are dirty. The place is dirty. Their pizza is shoddy at best. If you're not sober and can overlook all the contraindications, by all means eat here. Otherwise, walk down the street to Blondies.
Damn huge slice but really good!! Very affordable and self serve.

The FATTEST slice of pizza I've ever seen in my life... hence it's name.

Pros: You'll probably get full before you even finish that one slice.

Cons: It's REALLY REALLY greasy. It took several wipes to get all that grease off the cheese. But hey, it's pizza. The greasier the better, right?

Oh, and eat it when it's hot!! It doesn't taste good the morning after....
Veggie pizza is bomb. My carnivore boyfriend even likes it. Yay, for Fat Slice at 2 in the morning!

In a fit of nostalgia after spending my afternoon watching Akira, I got a hankering for Fat Slice.  So off we go, my mouth getting set for a taste of my teenhood.

Wow, have things changed!  The pizza is what I remember... large gooey slices and a root beer.  But maybe I am too bourgeois now.  I remember the service being a lot better.  We were in line behind 3 guys, 2 more guys behind us and the cashier was on the phone... for days.  I thought people physically at the restaurant take precedence over phone orders?   Anyway,  we go ahead and finally order almost 10 minutes later.  I couldn't understand one word the cashier said and he almost shorted us one soda (which we pointed out).

Now, I know Berkeley has its share of true homeless people.  However, there was this group of 5 pseudo homeless posers sitting out in the front, clearly unshowered but having accoutrements that didn't belong on truly homeless persons.  Well one of these cranked out idiots walks right in, starts rummaging through the trash and knocks over a bunch of trays onto the floor.   No response from the three men working there- maybe they are used to it. Well crackhead finds a half eaten slice, pulls it out, dumps of some of the free cheese on it and sits outside.  Now I am definitely not touching the parmesan after that.... Now this dope has emanated his wonderfully unwashed smell in the restaurant with no fans on.... great.  Just as I am waiting patiently for my order 2 more of these posers come in with their stanky butts and rummage some more in the two trash cans in the restaurant, making a mess.  They pull out like 5 crusts, dump some parmesan from the community cheese shaker and plant themselves right outside at the door.  All without one word from the workers.  Again, maybe they are used to this, but a few of the customers ended up picking up trays?  WTH!!!  Needless to say, I wasn't about to touch the community shaker....

By the time my food came, the smell from the open trash and the body odors destroyed my appetite completely.  I am sorry but the smell of a$$ does not make any pizza (no matter how good) palatable.  I ended up getting a box and taking mine to go, which I am eating as I write this.  In the comfort of my home, with no odious unwashed masses, the pizza is ok.

Come on Fat Slice management.... I know we are all uber-liberal, but shouldn't you give a crap about us paying customers who have been coming here for more than 20 years?  Really?

The slices are big, the prices are cheap. What more can you ask for?

Also it's open late, so it's about the best place to be when you're half drunk and hungry.

Fat Slice is decent, fast, and adequately tasty pizza.  I like the cheap prices and the daily special idea, but the pizza is almost too fat for me.  I think that, for all my defending of California pizza while living east-side, I've actually grown to appreciate the thin crust (not on the edge but underneath) of a tasty two-am New York pizza.  And I don't mean that as in New York Pizza on Park St. in Alameda, I mean it as in New York Pizza from that place right off Union Square, or our favorite East Village pizzeria across from Tompkins Square Park.  I drool just remembering you, oh lovely taken for granted pizzas...but I digress.  Fat Slice is decent but nothing to write home about.

Decided to go there after walking the slums of Berkeley, and I must say this place was a disspointment. I'm not a fan of the thick crust so I guess I shouldn't be going here, but Blondies which is a couple steps away was closed so I had no other choice. If blondies was open I would have gone there most definitely.  One positive note was that customer service was really friendly and that was a plus but other then that the slice was very mundane. You dissapoint me people who like fat slice. Considering the pizza guru I am I would have to say this place is only good if your drunk and its the only late night spot open.

When I was a student at Berkeley, It took me a while to duke out Fat Slice and Blondie's against each other. This is probably of very practical reasons, such as the fact that I lived far into the South side of campus half the time and it was the first thing I hit on my way down the hill. Or for a while, I couldn't resist redeeming so many "$3.00 for a slice and a soda" coupons clipped out of useless phone books, orientation packets, and free local papers.

After a while, Fat Slice lagged in the race, but I always came here if I wasn't going to get pepperoni, because the veggie slice was pretty legit, and had that dense, half-raw, doughy base that gave sligthly more for the buck. It felt good to come here when I was feeling down after class or exhausted after the RSF, plop down on the filmy seats in the back, lock eyes with a bum, and realize I should be more grateful in life.

Thick, delicious pizza! $0.25 for a box unless you buy 3 or more boxes, the location is pretty old and they haven't updated it for years, it is pretty dirty inside and they don't clean up frequently.  The back room where the tables are for you to sit and eat stinks like the bathroom in the back.  

If you're stopping by just to pickup and take to eat, the food is amazing, but if you want to eat there it's kind of gross and you may even lose your appetite.

It is an epic question that many Berkeley students debate. But in my mind, there is NO doubt about whether Fat Slice or Blondies is better.

Put simply, Fat Slice has some of the worst pizza I ate ever, second only to a time when Dominoes delivered me burnt pizza a few years ago . Crust was a soggy mess, cheese was like the plastic stuff you get in an elementary school cafeteria (I thought I had escaped from that nightmare), and WTF is with the heart attack grease? I LIKE grease in my pizzas and burgers (PLEASE, patting it down with a napkin is for "GIRLIE MEN") but this is entering ridiculous territory. A wretched, pooling, glistening, cardiac arrest-ing BEAST that stares straight into your soul and drowns it.

Aside from channeling of AH-NOLD SCHWAR-ZE-NEHGAH and the overdramatization, save your money and head to Blondies down the street. They don't have the BEST pizza but they definitely have the BETTER pizza. You might spend a little more, but at least you will be getting a (+) with your food instead of a (-).

I am not going to front, this place isn't like gourmet ass pizza or even the quality of round table for that matter.  However, this will get the job done when you are short on cash, if you are as drunk as an Irishmen or high as G5.

The slices are, well, FAT (pun intended).  They really only have 3 choices, pepperoni, cheese, and vegetarian for you douchebags who don't support cows/pigs/chickens.  It is smothered with grease, and the slices are as thick as kim kardashian's ass (pretty thick slices).  It isn't as good tasting as say Blondies but you definitely get more bang for your buck.

Heres my story.   Basically, I was high, I had blondies for 3.90. I believe it was like 4.65 or some shit with a drink, decided to not go with the combo.  After my meal, and still high, I went to fat slice and saw a pepperoni+ drink combo for 3.75 and i was like fuck yeah! Great deal, devoured it and scooted out with satisfaction.

A little bit more about the place, it has a good amount of seating, lots of napkins, a bathroom, spices and shit for your pizza, lids for you sodas, starws and etc.
